śanaiḥ śanaiḥ śanair-mehī mandaṃ mandaṃ pramehati | / lālā-tantu-yutaṃ mūtraṃ lālā-mehena picchilam ||
gandha-varṇa-rasa-sparśaiḥ kṣāreṇa kṣāra-toya-vat | / nīla-mehena nīlābhaṃ kāla-mehī maṣī-nibham ||
hāridra-mehī kaṭukaṃ haridrā-sannibhaṃ dahat | / visraṃ māñjiṣṭha-mehena mañjiṣṭhā-salilopamam ||
visram uṣṇaṃ sa-lavaṇaṃ raktābhaṃ rakta-mehataḥ | / vasā-mehī vasā-miśraṃ vasāṃ vā mūtrayen muhuḥ ||
majjānaṃ majja-miśraṃ vā majja-mehī muhur muhuḥ | / hastī matta ivājasraṃ mūtraṃ vega-vivarjitam ||
sa-lasīkaṃ vibaddhaṃ ca hasti-mehī pramehati | / madhu-mehī madhu-samaṃ jāyate sa kila dvi-dhā ||
kruddhe dhātu-kṣayād vāyau doṣāvṛta-pathe 'tha-vā | / āvṛto doṣa-liṅgāni so '-nimittaṃ pradarśayet ||
kṣīṇaḥ kṣaṇāt kṣaṇāt pūrṇo bhajate kṛcchra-sādhya-tām | / kālenopekṣitāḥ sarve yad yānti madhu-meha-tām ||
madhuraṃ yac ca sarveṣu prāyo madhv iva mehati | / sarve 'pi madhu-mehākhyā mādhuryāc ca tanor ataḥ ||
a-vipāko '-ruciś chardir nidrā kāsaḥ sa-pīnasaḥ | / upadravāḥ prajāyante mehānāṃ kapha-janmanām ||
vasti-mehanayos todo muṣkāvadaraṇaṃ jvaraḥ | / dāhas tṛṣṇāmlako mūrchā viḍ-bhedaḥ pitta-janmanām ||
vātikānām udāvarta-kampa-hṛd-graha-lola-tāḥ | / śūlam unnidra-tā śoṣaḥ kāsaḥ śvāsaś ca jāyate ||
śarāvikā kacchapikā jālinī vinatālajī | / masūrikā sarṣapikā putriṇī sa-vidārikā ||
vidradhiś ceti piṭikāḥ pramehopekṣayā daśa | / sandhi-marmasu jāyante māṃsaleṣu ca dhāmasu ||
antonnatā madhya-nimnā śyāvā kleda-rujānvitā | / śarāva-māna-saṃsthānā piṭikā syāc charāvikā ||
avagāḍhārti-nistodā mahā-vastu-parigrahā | / ślakṣṇā kacchapa-pṛṣṭhābhā piṭikā kacchapī matā ||
stabdhā sirā-jāla-vatī snigdha-srāvā mahāśayā | / rujā-nistoda-bahulā sūkṣma-cchidrā ca jālinī ||
avagāḍha-rujā-kledā pṛṣṭhe vā jaṭhare 'pi vā | / mahatī piṭikā nīlā vinatā vinatā smṛtā ||
dahati tvacam utthāne bhṛśaṃ kaṣṭā visarpiṇī | / rakta-kṛṣṇāti-tṛṭ-sphoṭa-dāha-moha-jvarālajī ||
māna-saṃsthānayos tulyā masūreṇa masūrikā | / sarṣapā-māna-saṃsthānā kṣipra-pākā mahā-rujā ||
sarṣapī sarṣapā-tulya-piṭikā-parivāritā | / putriṇī mahatī bhūri-su-sūkṣma-piṭikācitā ||
vidārī-kanda-vad vṛttā kaṭhinā ca vidārikā | / vidradhir vakṣyate 'nya-tra tatrādyaṃ piṭikā-trayam ||
putriṇī ca vidārī ca duḥ-sahā bahu-medasaḥ | / sahyāḥ pittolbaṇās tv anyāḥ sambhavanty alpa-medasaḥ ||
tāsu meha-vaśāc ca syād doṣodreko yathā-yatham || 36ab || / prameheṇa vināpy etā jāyante duṣṭa-medasaḥ || 36cd || / tāvac ca nopalakṣyante yāvad vastu-parigrahaḥ || 36ef ||
hāridra-varṇaṃ raktaṃ vā meha-prāg-rūpa-varjitam | / yo mūtrayen na taṃ mehaṃ rakta-pittaṃ tu tad viduḥ ||
svedo 'ṅga-gandhaḥ śithila-tvam aṅge śayyāsana-svapna-sukhābhiṣaṅgaḥ | / hṛn-netra-jihvā-śravaṇopadeho ghanāṅga-tā keśa-nakhāti-vṛddhiḥ ||
śīta-priya-tvaṃ gala-tālu-śoṣo mādhuryam āsye kara-pāda-dāhaḥ | / bhaviṣyato meha-gaṇasya rūpaṃ mūtre 'bhidhāvanti pipīlikāś ca ||
dṛṣṭvā pramehaṃ madhuraṃ sa-picchaṃ madhūpamaṃ syād vividho vicāraḥ | / sampūraṇād vā kapha-sambhavaḥ syāt kṣīṇeṣu doṣeṣv anilātmako vā ||
sa-pūrva-rūpāḥ kapha-pitta-mehāḥ krameṇa ye vāta-kṛtāś ca mehāḥ | / sādhyā na te pitta-kṛtās tu yāpyāḥ sādhyās tu medo yadi nāti-duṣṭam ||
bhuktaiḥ paryuṣitāty-uṣṇa-rūkṣa-śuṣka-vidāhibhiḥ | / jihma-śayyā-viceṣṭābhis tais taiś cāsṛk-pradūṣaṇaiḥ ||
duṣṭa-tvaṅ-māṃsa-medo-'sthi-snāyv-asṛk-kaṇḍarāśrayaḥ | / yaḥ śopho bahir antar vā mahā-mūlo mahā-rujaḥ ||
vṛttaḥ syād āyato yo vā smṛtaḥ ṣo-ḍhā sa vidradhiḥ | / doṣaiḥ pṛthak samuditaiḥ śoṇitena kṣatena ca ||
bāhyo 'tra tatra tatrāṅge dāruṇo grathitonnataḥ | / āntaro dāruṇa-taro gambhīro gulma-vad ghanaḥ ||
valmīka-vat samucchrāyī śīghra-ghāty agni-śastra-vat | / nābhi-vasti-yakṛt-plīha-kloma-hṛt-kukṣi-vaṅkṣaṇe ||
syād vṛkkayor apāne ca vātāt tatrāti-tīvra-ruk | / śyāvāruṇaś cirotthāna-pāko viṣama-saṃsthitiḥ ||
vyadha-ccheda-bhramānāha-spanda-sarpaṇa-śabda-vān | / rakta-tāmrāsitaḥ pittāt tṛṇ-moha-jvara-dāha-vān ||
kṣiprotthāna-prapākaś ca pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍū-yutaḥ kaphāt | / sotkleśa-śītaka-stambha-jṛmbhā-rocaka-gauravaḥ ||
cirotthāna-vipākaś ca saṅkīrṇaḥ sannipātataḥ | / sāmarthyāc cātra vibhajed bāhyābhyantara-lakṣaṇam ||
kṛṣṇa-sphoṭāvṛtaḥ śyāvas tīvra-dāha-rujā-jvaraḥ | / pitta-liṅgo 'sṛjā bāhyaḥ strīṇām eva tathāntaraḥ ||
śastrādyair abhighātena kṣate vā-pathya-kāriṇaḥ | / kṣatoṣmā vāyu-vikṣiptaḥ sa-raktaṃ pittam īrayan ||
pittāsṛg-lakṣaṇaṃ kuryād vidradhiṃ bhūry-upadravam | / teṣūpadrava-bhedaś ca smṛto 'dhiṣṭhāna-bhedataḥ ||
nābhyāṃ hidhmā bhaved vastau mūtraṃ kṛcchreṇa pūti ca | / śvāso yakṛti rodhas tu plīhny ucchvāsasya tṛṭ punaḥ ||
gala-grahaś ca klomni syāt sarvāṅga-pragraho hṛdi | / pramohas tamakaḥ kāso hṛdaye ghaṭṭanaṃ vyathā ||
kukṣi-pārśvāntarāṃsārtiḥ kukṣāv āṭopa-janma ca | / sakthnor graho vaṅkṣaṇayor vṛkkayoḥ kaṭi-pṛṣṭhayoḥ ||
pārśvayoś ca vyathā pāyau pavanasya nirodhanam | / āma-pakva-vidagdha-tvaṃ teṣāṃ śopha-vad ādiśet ||
nābher ūrdhvaṃ mukhāt pakvāḥ prasravanty adhare gudāt | / gudāsyān nābhi-jo vidyād doṣaṃ kledāc ca vidradhau ||
yathā-svaṃ vraṇa-vat tatra vivarjyaḥ sannipāta-jaḥ | / pakvo hṛn-nābhi-vasti-stho bhinno 'ntar bahir eva vā ||
pakvaś cāntaḥ sravan vaktrāt kṣīṇasyopadravānvitaḥ | / evam eva stana-sirā vivṛtāḥ prāpya yoṣitām ||
sūtānāṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ vā sambhavec chvayathur ghanaḥ | / stane sa-dugdhe '-dugdhe vā bāhya-vidradhi-lakṣaṇaḥ ||
nāḍīnāṃ sūkṣma-vaktra-tvāt kanyānāṃ na sa jāyate | / kruddho ruddha-gatir vāyuḥ śopha-śūla-karaś caran ||
muṣkau vaṅkṣaṇataḥ prāpya phala-kośābhivāhinīḥ | / prapīḍya dhamanīr vṛddhiṃ karoti phala-kośayoḥ ||
doṣāsra-medo-mūtrāntraiḥ sa vṛddhiḥ sapta-dhā gadaḥ | / mūtrāntra-jāv apy anilād dhetu-bhedas tu kevalam ||
vāta-pūrṇa-dṛti-sparśo rūkṣo vātād a-hetu-ruk | / pakvodumbara-saṅkāśaḥ pittād dāhoṣma-pāka-vān ||
kaphāc chīto guruḥ snigdhaḥ kaṇḍū-mān kaṭhino 'lpa-ruk | / kṛṣṇa-sphoṭāvṛtaḥ pitta-vṛddhi-liṅgaś ca raktataḥ ||
kapha-van medasā vṛddhir mṛdus tāla-phalopamaḥ | / mūtra-dhāraṇa-śīlasya mūtra-jaḥ sa tu gacchataḥ ||
ambhobhiḥ pūrṇa-dṛti-vat kṣobhaṃ yāti sa-ruṅ mṛduḥ | / mūtra-kṛcchram adhas-tāc ca valayaṃ phala-kośayoḥ ||
vāta-kopibhir āhāraiḥ śīta-toyāvagāhanaiḥ | / dhāraṇeraṇa-bhārādhva-viṣamāṅga-pravartanaiḥ ||
kṣobhaṇaiḥ kṣubhito 'nyaiś ca kṣudrāntrāvayavaṃ yadā | / pavano vi-guṇī-kṛtya sva-niveśād adho nayet ||

kuryād vaṅkṣaṇa-sandhi-stho granthy-ābhaṃ śvayathuṃ tadā || 30ab || / upekṣyamāṇasya ca muṣka-vṛddhim ādhmāna-ruk-stambha-vatīṃ sa vāyuḥ || 30cd || / prapīḍito 'ntaḥ svana-vān prayāti pradhmāpayann eti punaś ca muktaḥ || 30ef ||
antra-vṛddhir a-sādhyo 'yaṃ vāta-vṛddhi-samākṛtiḥ ||
rūkṣa-kṛṣṇāruṇa-sirā-tantu-jāla-gavākṣitaḥ | / gulmo 'ṣṭa-dhā pṛthag doṣaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭair nicayaṃ gataiḥ ||
ārtavasya ca doṣeṇa nārīṇāṃ jāyate 'ṣṭamaḥ | / jvara-cchardy-atisārādyair vamanādyaiś ca karmabhiḥ ||
karśito vātalāny atti śītaṃ vāmbu bubhukṣitaḥ | / yaḥ pibaty anu cānnāni laṅghana-plavanādikam ||
sevate deha-saṅkṣobhi cchardiṃ vā samudīrayet | / an-udīrṇām udīrṇān vā vātādīn na vimuñcati ||
sneha-svedāv an-abhyasya śodhanaṃ vā niṣevate | / śuddho vāśu vidāhīni bhajate syandanāni vā ||
vātolbaṇās tasya malāḥ pṛthak kruddhā dvi-śo 'tha-vā | / sarve vā rakta-yuktā vā mahā-sroto-'nuśāyinaḥ ||
ūrdhvādho-mārgam āvṛtya kurvate śūla-pūrvakam | / sparśopalabhyaṃ gulmākhyam utplutaṃ granthi-rūpiṇam ||
karśanāt kapha-viṭ-pittair mārgasyāvaraṇena vā | / vāyuḥ kṛtāśrayaḥ koṣṭhe raukṣyāt kāṭhinyam āgataḥ ||
sva-tantraḥ svāśraye duṣṭaḥ para-tantraḥ parāśraye | / piṇḍita-tvād a-mūrto 'pi mūrta-tvam iva saṃśritaḥ ||
gulma ity ucyate vasti-nābhi-hṛt-pārśva-saṃśrayaḥ | / vātān manyā-śiraḥ-śūlaṃ jvara-plīhāntra-kūjanam ||
vyadhaḥ sūcyeva viṭ-saṅgaḥ kṛcchrād ucchvasanaṃ muhuḥ | / stambho gātre mukhe śoṣaḥ kārśyaṃ viṣama-vahni-tā ||
rūkṣa-kṛṣṇa-tvag-ādi-tvaṃ cala-tvād anilasya ca | / a-nirūpita-saṃsthāna-sthāna-vṛddhi-kṣaya-vyathaḥ ||
pipīlikā-vyāpta iva gulmaḥ sphurati tudyate | / pittād dāho 'mlako mūrchā-viḍ-bheda-sveda-tṛḍ-jvarāḥ ||
hāridra-tvaṃ tvag-ādyeṣu gulmaś ca sparśanā-sahaḥ | / dūyate dīpyate soṣmā sva-sthānaṃ dahatīva ca ||
kaphāt staimityam a-ruciḥ sadanaṃ śiśira-jvaraḥ | / pīnasālasya-hṛl-lāsa-kāsa-śukla-tvag-ādi-tāḥ ||
gulmo 'vagāḍhaḥ kaṭhino guruḥ suptaḥ sthiro 'lpa-ruk | / sva-doṣa-sthāna-dhāmānaḥ sve sve kāle ca ruk-karāḥ ||
prāyas trayas tu dvandvotthā gulmāḥ saṃsṛṣṭa-lakṣaṇāḥ | / sarva-jas tīvra-rug-dāhaḥ śīghra-pākī ghanonnataḥ ||
so '-sādhyo rakta-gulmas tu striyā eva prajāyate | / ṛtau vā nava-sūtā vā yadi vā yoni-rogiṇī ||
sevate vātalāni strī kruddhas tasyāḥ samīraṇaḥ | / niruṇaddhy ārtavaṃ yonyāṃ prati-māsam avasthitam ||
kukṣiṃ karoti tad-garbha-liṅgam āviṣ-karoti ca | / hṛl-lāsa-daurhṛda-stanya-darśana-kṣāma-tādikam ||
krameṇa vāyu-saṃsargāt pitta-yoni-tayā ca tat | / śoṇitaṃ kurute tasyā vāta-pittottha-gulma-jān ||
ruk-stambha-dāhātīsāra-tṛḍ-jvarādīn upadravān | / garbhāśaye ca su-tarāṃ śūlaṃ duṣṭāsṛg-āśraye ||
yonyāś ca srāva-daurgandhya-toda-spandana-vedanāḥ | / na cāṅgair garbha-vad gulmaḥ sphuraty api tu śūla-vān ||
piṇḍī-bhūtaḥ sa evāsyāḥ kadā-cit spandate cirāt | / na cāsyā vardhate kukṣir gulma eva tu vardhate ||
sva-doṣa-saṃśrayo gulmaḥ sarvo bhavati tena saḥ | / pākaṃ cireṇa bhajate naiva vā vidradhiḥ punaḥ ||
pacyate śīghram aty-arthaṃ duṣṭa-raktāśraya-tvataḥ | / ataḥ śīghra-vidāhi-tvād vidradhiḥ so 'bhidhīyate ||
gulme 'ntar-āśraye vasti-kukṣi-hṛt-plīha-vedanāḥ | / agni-varṇa-bala-bhraṃśo vegānāṃ cā-pravartanam ||
ato viparyayo bāhye koṣṭhāṅgeṣu tu nāti-ruk | / vaivarṇyam avakāśasya bahir unnata-tādhikam ||
sāṭopam aty-ugra-rujam ādhmānam udare bhṛśam | / ūrdhvādho-vāta-rodhena tam ānāhaṃ pracakṣate ||
ghano 'ṣṭhīlopamo granthir aṣṭhīlordhvaṃ samunnataḥ | / ānāha-liṅgas tiryak tu pratyaṣṭhīlā tad-ākṛtiḥ ||
pakvāśayād gudopasthaṃ vāyus tīvra-rujaḥ prayān | / tūṇī pratūṇī tu bhavet sa evāto viparyaye ||
udgāra-bāhulya-purīṣa-bandha-tṛpty-a-kṣama-tvāntra-vikūjanāni | / āṭopam ādhmānam a-pakti-śaktim āsanna-gulmasya vadanti cihnam ||
rogāḥ sarve 'pi mande 'gnau su-tarām udarāṇi tu | / a-jīrṇān malinaiś cānnair jāyante mala-sañcayāt ||
ūrdhvādho dhātavo ruddhvā vāhinīr ambu-vāhinīḥ | / prāṇāgny-apānān sandūṣya kuryus tvaṅ-māṃsa-sandhi-gāḥ ||
ādhmāpya kukṣim udaram aṣṭa-dhā tac ca bhidyate | / pṛthag doṣaiḥ samastaiś ca plīha-baddha-kṣatodakaiḥ ||
tenārtāḥ śuṣka-tālv-oṣṭhāḥ śūna-pāda-karodarāḥ | / naṣṭa-ceṣṭā-balāhārāḥ kṛśāḥ pradhmāta-kukṣayaḥ ||
syuḥ preta-rūpāḥ puruṣā bhāvinas tasya lakṣaṇam | / kṣun-nāśo 'nnaṃ cirāt sarvaṃ sa-vidāhaṃ ca pacyate ||
jīrṇā-jīrṇaṃ na jānāti sauhityaṃ sahate na ca | / kṣīyate balataḥ śaśvac chvasity alpe 'pi ceṣṭite ||
vṛddhir viṣo '-pravṛttiś ca kiñ-cic chophaś ca pādayoḥ | / rug-vasti-sandhau tata-tā laghv-alpā-bhojanair api ||
rājī-janma valī-nāśo jaṭhare jaṭhareṣu tu | / sarveṣu tandrā sadanaṃ mala-saṅgo 'lpa-vahni-tā ||
dāhaḥ śvayathur ādhmānam ante salila-sambhavaḥ | / sarvaṃ tv a-toyam aruṇam a-śophaṃ nāti-bhārikam ||
gavākṣitaṃ sirā-jālaiḥ sadā guḍaguḍāyate | / nābhim antraṃ ca viṣṭabhya vegaṃ kṛtvā praṇaśyati ||
māruto hṛt-kaṭī-nābhi-pāyu-vaṅkṣaṇa-vedanāḥ | / sa-śabdo niścared vāyur viḍ baddhā mūtram alpakam ||
nāti-mando 'nalo laulyaṃ na ca syād vi-rasaṃ mukham | / tatra vātodare śophaḥ pāṇi-pān-muṣka-kukṣiṣu ||
kukṣi-pārśvodara-kaṭī-pṛṣṭha-ruk parva-bhedanam | / śuṣka-kāso 'ṅga-mardo 'dho-guru-tā mala-saṅgrahaḥ ||
śyāvāruṇa-tvag-ādi-tvam a-kasmād vṛddhi-hrāsa-vat | / sa-toda-bhedam udaraṃ tanu-kṛṣṇa-sirā-tatam ||
ādhmāta-dṛti-vac chabdam āhataṃ prakaroti ca | / vāyuś cātra sa-ruk-śabdo vicaret sarvato-gatiḥ ||
pittodare jvaro mūrchā dāhas tṛṭ kaṭukāsya-tā | / bhramo 'tīsāraḥ pīta-tvaṃ tvag-ādāv udaraṃ harit ||
pīta-tāmra-sirānaddhaṃ sa-svedaṃ soṣma dahyate | / dhūmāyati mṛdu-sparśaṃ kṣipra-pākaṃ pradūyate ||
śleṣmodare 'ṅga-sadanaṃ svāpaḥ śvayathu-gauravam | / nidrotkleśā-ruci-śvāsa-kāsa-śukla-tvag-ādi-tā ||
udaraṃ stimitaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ śukla-rājī-tataṃ mahat | / cirābhivṛddhi kaṭhinaṃ śīta-sparśaṃ guru sthiram ||
tri-doṣa-kopanais tais taiḥ strī-dattaiś ca rajo-malaiḥ | / gara-dūṣī-viṣādyaiś ca sa-raktāḥ sañcitā malāḥ ||
koṣṭhaṃ prāpya vikurvāṇāḥ śoṣa-mūrchā-bhramānvitam | / kuryus tri-liṅgam udaraṃ śīghra-pākaṃ su-dāruṇam ||
bādhate tac ca su-tarāṃ śīta-vātābhra-darśane | / aty-āśitasya saṅkṣobhād yāna-yānādi-ceṣṭitaiḥ ||
ati-vyavāya-karmādhva-vamana-vyādhi-karśanaiḥ | / vāma-pārśvāśritaḥ plīhā cyutaḥ sthānād vivardhate ||
śoṇitaṃ vā rasādibhyo vivṛddhaṃ taṃ vivardhayet | / so 'ṣṭhīlevāti-kaṭhinaḥ prāk tataḥ kūrma-pṛṣṭha-vat ||
krameṇa vardhamānaś ca kukṣāv udaram āvahet | / śvāsa-kāsa-pipāsāsya-vairasyādhmāna-rug-jvaraiḥ ||
pāṇḍu-tva-mūrchā-chardībhir dāha-mohaiś ca saṃyutam | / aruṇābhaṃ vi-varṇaṃ vā nīla-hāridra-rāji-mat ||
udāvarta-rujānāhair moha-tṛḍ-dahana-jvaraiḥ | / gauravā-ruci-kāṭhinyair vidyāt tatra malān kramāt ||
plīha-vad dakṣiṇāt pārśvāt kuryād yakṛd api cyutam | / pakṣma-vālaiḥ sahānnena bhuktair baddhāyane gude ||
dur-nāmabhir udāvartair anyair vāntropalepibhiḥ | / varcaḥ-pitta-kaphān ruddhvā karoti kupito 'nilaḥ ||
apāno jaṭharaṃ tena syur dāha-jvara-tṛṭ-kṣavāḥ | / kāsa-śvāsoru-sadanaṃ śiro-hṛn-nābhi-pāyu-ruk ||
mala-saṅgo '-ruciś chardir udaraṃ mūḍha-mārutam | / sthiraṃ nīlāruṇa-sirā-rājī-naddham a-rāji vā ||
nābher upari ca prāyo go-pucchākṛti jāyate | / asthy-ādi-śalyaiḥ sānnaiś ced bhuktair aty-aśanena vā ||
bhidyate pacyate vāntraṃ tac-chidraiś ca sravan bahiḥ | / āma eva gudād eti tato 'lpālpaṃ sa-viḍ-rasaḥ ||
tulyaḥ kuṇapa-gandhena picchilaḥ pīta-lohitaḥ | / śeṣaś cāpūrya jaṭharaṃ jaṭharaṃ ghoram āvahet ||
vardhayet tad adho nābher āśu caiti jalātma-tām | / udrikta-doṣa-rūpaṃ ca vyāptaṃ ca śvāsa-tṛḍ-bhramaiḥ ||
chidrodaram idaṃ prāhuḥ parisrāvīti cāpare | / pravṛtta-sneha-pānādeḥ sahasāmāmbu-pāyinaḥ ||
aty-ambu-pānān mandāgneḥ kṣīṇasyāti-kṛśasya vā | / ruddhvāmbu-mārgān anilaḥ kaphaś ca jala-mūrchitaḥ ||
vardhayetāṃ tad evāmbu tat-sthānād udarāśritau | / tataḥ syād udaraṃ tṛṣṇā-guda-sruti-rujānvitam ||
kāsa-śvāsā-ruci-yutaṃ nānā-varṇa-sirā-tatam | / toya-pūrṇa-dṛti-sparśa-śabda-prakṣobha-vepathu ||
dakodaraṃ mahat snigdhaṃ sthiram āvṛtta-nābhi tat | / upekṣayā ca sarveṣu doṣāḥ sva-sthānataś cyutāḥ ||
pākād dravā dravī-kuryuḥ sandhi-sroto-mukhāny api | / svedaś ca bāhya-srotaḥsu vihatas tiryag-āsthitaḥ ||
tad evodakam āpyāyya picchāṃ kuryāt tadā bhavet | / gurūdaraṃ sthiraṃ vṛttam āhataṃ ca na śabda-vat ||
mṛdu vyapeta-rājīkaṃ nābhyāṃ spṛṣṭaṃ ca sarpati | / tad anūdaka-janmāsmin kukṣi-vṛddhis tato 'dhikam ||
sirāntardhānam udaka-jaṭharoktaṃ ca lakṣaṇam | / vāta-pitta-kapha-plīha-sannipātodakodaram ||
kṛcchraṃ yathottaraṃ pakṣāt paraṃ prāyo 'pare hataḥ | / sarvaṃ ca jāta-salilaṃ riṣṭoktopadravānvitam ||
janmanaivodaraṃ sarvaṃ prāyaḥ kṛcchra-tamaṃ matam | / balinas tad a-jātāmbu yatna-sādhyaṃ navotthitam ||
pitta-pradhānāḥ kupitā yathoktaiḥ kopanair malāḥ | / tatrānilena balinā kṣiptaṃ pittaṃ hṛdi sthitam ||
dhamanīr daśa samprāpya vyāpnuvat sakalāṃ tanum | / śleṣma-tvag-rakta-māṃsāni pradūṣyāntaram āśritam ||
tvaṅ-māṃsayos tat kurute tvaci varṇān pṛthag-vidhān | / pāṇḍu-hāridra-haritān pāṇḍu-tvaṃ teṣu cādhikam ||
yato 'taḥ pāṇḍur ity uktaḥ sa rogas tena gauravam | / dhātūnāṃ syāc ca śaithilyam ojasaś ca guṇa-kṣayaḥ ||
tato 'lpa-rakta-medasko niḥ-sāraḥ syāc chlathendriyaḥ | / mṛdyamānair ivāṅgair nā dravatā hṛdayena ca ||
śūnākṣi-kūṭaḥ sadanaḥ kopanaḥ ṣṭhīvano 'lpa-vāk | / anna-dviṭ śiśira-dveṣī śīrṇa-romā hatānalaḥ ||
sanna-saktho jvarī śvāsī karṇa-kṣveḍī bhramī śramī | / sa pañca-dhā pṛthag doṣaiḥ samastair mṛttikādanāt ||
prāg-rūpam asya hṛdaya-spandanaṃ rūkṣa-tā tvaci | / a-ruciḥ pīta-mūtra-tvaṃ svedā-bhāvo 'lpa-vahni-tā ||
sādaḥ śramo 'nilāt tatra gātra-ruk-toda-kampanam | / kṛṣṇa-rūkṣāruṇa-sirā-nakha-viṇ-mūtra-netra-tā ||
śophānāhāsya-vairasya-viṭ-śoṣāḥ pārśva-mūrdha-ruk | / pittād dharita-pītābha-sirādi-tvaṃ jvaras tamaḥ ||
tṛṭ-sveda-mūrchā-śītecchā daurgandhyaṃ kaṭu-vaktra-tā | / varco-bhedo 'mlako dāhaḥ kaphāc chukla-sirādi-tā ||
tandrā lavaṇa-vaktra-tvaṃ roma-harṣaḥ svara-kṣayaḥ | / kāsaś chardiś ca nicayān miśra-liṅgo 'ti-duḥ-sahaḥ ||
mṛt kaṣāyānilaṃ pittam ūṣarā madhurā kapham | / dūṣayitvā rasādīṃś ca raukṣyād bhuktaṃ virūkṣya ca ||
srotāṃsy a-pakvaivāpūrya kuryād ruddhvā ca pūrva-vat | / pāṇḍu-rogaṃ tataḥ śūna-nābhi-pādāsya-mehanaḥ ||
purīṣaṃ kṛmi-man muñced bhinnaṃ sāsṛk kaphaṃ naraḥ | / yaḥ pāṇḍu-rogī seveta pittalaṃ tasya kāmalām ||
koṣṭha-śākhāśrayāṃ pittaṃ dagdhvāsṛṅ-māṃsam āvahet | / hāridra-netra-mūtra-tvaṅ-nakha-vaktra-śakṛt-tayā ||
dāhā-vipāka-tṛṣṇā-vān bhekābho dur-balendriyaḥ | / bhavet pittolbaṇasyāsau pāṇḍu-rogād ṛte 'pi ca ||
upekṣayā ca śophāḍhyā sā kṛcchrā kumbha-kāmalā | / harita-śyāva-pīta-tvaṃ pāṇḍu-roge yadā bhavet ||
vāta-pittād bhramas tṛṣṇā strīṣv a-harṣo mṛdur jvaraḥ | / tandrā balānala-bhraṃśo loḍharaṃ taṃ halīmakam ||
alasaṃ ceti śaṃsanti teṣāṃ pūrvam upadravāḥ | / śopha-pradhānāḥ kathitāḥ sa evāto nigadyate ||
pitta-rakta-kaphān vāyur duṣṭo duṣṭān bahiḥ-sirāḥ | / nītvā ruddha-gatis tair hi kuryāt tvaṅ-māṃsa-saṃśrayam ||
utsedhaṃ saṃhataṃ śophaṃ tam āhur nicayād ataḥ | / sarvaṃ hetu-viśeṣais tu rūpa-bhedān navātmakam ||
doṣaiḥ pṛthag dvayaiḥ sarvair abhighātād viṣād api | / dvi-dhā vā nijam āgantuṃ sarvāṅgaikāṅga-jaṃ ca tam ||
pṛthūnnata-grathita-tā-viśeṣaiś ca tri-dhā viduḥ | / sāmānya-hetuḥ śophānāṃ doṣa-jānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
vyādhi-karmopavāsādi-kṣīṇasya bhajato drutam | / ati-mātram athānyasya gurv-amla-snigdha-śītalam ||
lavaṇa-kṣāra-tīkṣṇoṣṇa-śākāmbu svapna-jāgaram | / mṛd-grāmya-māṃsa-vallūram a-jīrṇa-śrama-maithunam ||
padāter mārga-gamanaṃ yānena kṣobhiṇāpi vā | / śvāsa-kāsātisārārśo-jaṭhara-pradara-jvarāḥ ||
viṣūcy-alasaka-cchardi-garbha-visarpa-pāṇḍavaḥ | / anye ca mithyopakrāntās tair doṣā vakṣasi sthitāḥ ||
ūrdhvaṃ śopham adho vastau madhye kurvanti madhya-gāḥ | / sarvāṅga-gāḥ sarva-gataṃ pratyaṅgeṣu tad-āśrayāḥ ||
tat-pūrva-rūpaṃ davathuḥ sirāyāmo 'ṅga-gauravam | / vātāc chophaś calo rūkṣaḥ khara-romāruṇāsitaḥ ||
saṅkoca-spanda-harṣārti-toda-bheda-prasupti-mān | / kṣiprotthāna-śamaḥ śīghram unnamet pīḍitas tanuḥ ||
snigdhoṣṇa-mardanaiḥ śāmyed rātrāv alpo divā mahān | / tvak ca sarṣapa-lipteva tasmiṃś cimicimāyate ||
pīta-raktāsitābhāsaḥ pittād ā-tāmra-roma-kṛt | / śīghrānusāra-praśamo madhye prāg jāyate tanuḥ ||
sa-tṛḍ-dāha-jvara-sveda-dava-kleda-mada-bhramaḥ | / śītābhilāṣī viḍ-bhedī gandhī sparśā-saho mṛduḥ ||
kaṇḍū-mān pāṇḍu-roma-tvak kaṭhinaḥ śītalo guruḥ | / snigdhaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ sthiraḥ styāno nidrā-chardy-agni-sāda-kṛt ||
ākrānto nonnamet kṛcchra-śama-janmā niśā-balaḥ | / sraven nāsṛk cirāt picchāṃ kuśa-śastrādi-vikṣataḥ ||
sparśoṣṇa-kāṅkṣī ca kaphād yathā-svaṃ dvandva-jās trayaḥ | / saṅkarād dhetu-liṅgānāṃ nicayān nicayātmakaḥ ||
abhighātena śastrādi-ccheda-bheda-kṣatādibhiḥ | / himāniloda-dhy-anilair bhallāta-kapikacchu-jaiḥ ||
rasaiḥ śūkaiś ca saṃsparśāc chvayathuḥ syād visarpa-vān | / bhṛśoṣmā lohitābhāsaḥ prāya-śaḥ pitta-lakṣaṇaḥ ||
viṣa-jaḥ sa-viṣa-prāṇi-parisarpaṇa-mūtraṇāt | / daṃṣṭrā-danta-nakhāpātād a-viṣa-prāṇinām api ||
viṇ-mūtra-śukropahata-mala-vad-vastra-saṅkarāt | / viṣa-vṛkṣānila-sparśād gara-yogāvacūrṇanāt ||
mṛduś calo 'valambī ca śīghro dāha-rujā-karaḥ | / navo 'n-upadravaḥ śophaḥ sādhyo '-sādhyaḥ pureritaḥ ||
syād visarpo 'bhighātāntair doṣair dūṣyaiś ca śopha-vat | / try-adhiṣṭhānaṃ ca taṃ prāhur bāhyāntar-ubhayāśrayāt ||
yathottaraṃ ca duḥ-sādhyās tatra doṣā yathā-yatham | / prakopaṇaiḥ prakupitā viśeṣeṇa vidāhibhiḥ ||
dehe śīghraṃ visarpanti te 'ntar antaḥ-sthitā bahiḥ | / bahiḥ-sthā dvitaye dvi-sthā vidyāt tatrāntar-āśrayam ||
marmopatāpāt sammohād ayanānāṃ vighaṭṭanāt | / tṛṣṇāti-yogād vegānāṃ viṣamaṃ ca pravartanāt ||
āśu cāgni-bala-bhraṃśād ato bāhyaṃ viparyayāt | / tatra vātāt parīsarpo vāta-jvara-sama-vyathaḥ ||
śopha-sphuraṇa-nistoda-bhedāyāmārti-harṣa-vān | / pittād druta-gatiḥ pitta-jvara-liṅgo 'ti-lohitaḥ ||
kaphāt kaṇḍū-yutaḥ snigdhaḥ kapha-jvara-samāna-ruk | / sva-doṣa-liṅgaiś cīyante sarve sphoṭair upekṣitāḥ ||
te pakva-bhinnāḥ svaṃ svaṃ ca bibhrati vraṇa-lakṣaṇam | / vāta-pittāj jvara-cchardi-mūrchātīsāra-tṛḍ-bhramaiḥ ||
asthi-bhedāgni-sadana-tamakā-rocakair yutaḥ | / karoti sarvam aṅgaṃ ca dīptāṅgārāvakīrṇa-vat ||
yaṃ yaṃ deśaṃ visarpaś ca visarpati bhavet sa saḥ | / śāntāṅgārāsito nīlo rakto vāśu ca cīyate ||
agni-dagdha iva sphoṭaiḥ śīghra-ga-tvād drutaṃ ca saḥ | / marmānusārī vīsarpaḥ syād vāto 'ti-balas tataḥ ||
vyathetāṅgaṃ haret sañjñāṃ nidrāṃ ca śvāsam īrayet | / hidhmāṃ ca sa gato 'vasthām īdṛśīṃ labhate na nā ||
kva-cic charmā-rati-grasto bhūmi-śayyāsanādiṣu | / ceṣṭamānas tataḥ kliṣṭo mano-deha-śramodbhavām ||
duṣ-prabodho 'śnute nidrāṃ so 'gni-visarpa ucyate | / kaphena ruddhaḥ pavano bhittvā taṃ bahu-dhā kapham ||
raktaṃ vā vṛddha-raktasya tvak-sirā-snāva-māṃsa-gam | / dūṣayitvā ca dīrghāṇu-vṛtta-sthūla-kharātmanām ||
granthīnāṃ kurute mālāṃ raktānāṃ tīvra-rug-jvarām | / śvāsa-kāsātisārāsya-śoṣa-hidhmā-vami-bhramaiḥ ||
moha-vaivarṇya-mūrchāṅga-bhaṅgāgni-sadanair yutām | / ity ayaṃ granthi-vīsarpaḥ kapha-māruta-kopa-jaḥ ||
kapha-pittāj jvaraḥ stambho nidrā-tandrā-śiro-rujaḥ | / aṅgāvasāda-vikṣepa-pralāpā-rocaka-bhramāḥ ||
mūrchāgni-hānir bhedo 'sthnāṃ pipāsendriya-gauravam | / āmopaveśanaṃ lepaḥ srotasāṃ sa ca sarpati ||
prāyeṇāmāśaye gṛhṇann eka-deśaṃ na cāti-ruk | / piṭikair avakīrṇo 'ti-pīta-lohita-pāṇḍuraiḥ ||
mecakābho 'sitaḥ snigdho malinaḥ śopha-vān guruḥ | / gambhīra-pākaḥ prājyoṣmā spṛṣṭaḥ klinno 'vadīryate ||
paṅka-vac-chīrṇa-māṃsaś ca spaṣṭa-snāyu-sirā-gaṇaḥ | / śava-gandhiś ca vīsarpaṃ kardamākhyam uśanti tam ||
sarva-jo lakṣaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sarva-dhātv-atisarpaṇaḥ | / bāhya-hetoḥ kṣatāt kruddhaḥ sa-raktaṃ pittam īrayan ||
visarpaṃ mārutaḥ kuryāt kulattha-sadṛśaiś citam | / sphoṭaiḥ śopha-jvara-rujā-dāhāḍhyaṃ śyāva-lohitam ||
pṛthag doṣais trayaḥ sādhyā dvandva-jāś cān-upadravāḥ | / a-sādhyau kṣata-sarvotthau sarve cākrānta-marmakāḥ ||
mithyāhāra-vihāreṇa viśeṣeṇa virodhinā | / sādhu-nindā-vadhānya-sva-haraṇādyaiś ca sevitaiḥ ||
pāpmabhiḥ karmabhiḥ sadyaḥ prāktanair veritā malāḥ | / sirāḥ prapadya tiryag-gās tvag-lasīkāsṛg-āmiṣam ||
dūṣayanti ślathī-kṛtya niścarantas tato bahiḥ | / tvacaḥ kurvanti vaivarṇyaṃ duṣṭāḥ kuṣṭham uśanti tat ||
kālenopekṣitaṃ yasmāt sarvaṃ kuṣṇāti tad vapuḥ | / prapadya dhātūn vyāpyāntaḥ sarvān saṅkledya cāvahet ||
sa-sveda-kleda-saṅkothān kṛmīn sūkṣmān su-dāruṇān | / roma-tvak-snāyu-dhamanī-taruṇāsthīni yaiḥ kramāt ||
bhakṣayec chvitram asmāc ca kuṣṭha-bāhyam udāhṛtam | / kuṣṭhāni sapta-dhā doṣaiḥ pṛthaṅ miśraiḥ samāgataiḥ ||
sarveṣv api tri-doṣeṣu vyapadeśo 'dhika-tvataḥ | / vātena kuṣṭhaṃ kāpālaṃ pittād audumbaraṃ kaphāt ||
maṇḍalākhyaṃ vicarcī ca ṛkṣākhyaṃ vāta-pitta-jam | / carmaika-kuṣṭha-kiṭibha-sidhmālasa-vipādikāḥ ||
vāta-śleṣmodbhavāḥ śleṣma-pittād dadrū-śatāruṣī | / puṇḍarīkaṃ sa-visphoṭaṃ pāmā carma-dalaṃ tathā ||
sarvaiḥ syāt kākaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ trikaṃ dadru sa-kākaṇam | / puṇḍarīkarkṣa-jihve ca mahā-kuṣṭhāni sapta tu ||
ati-ślakṣṇa-khara-sparśa-khedā-sveda-vi-varṇa-tāḥ | / dāhaḥ kaṇḍūs tvaci svāpas todaḥ koṭhonnatiḥ śramaḥ ||
vraṇānām adhikaṃ śūlaṃ śīghrotpattiś cira-sthitiḥ | / rūḍhānām api rūkṣa-tvaṃ nimitte 'lpe 'pi kopanam ||
roma-harṣo 'sṛjaḥ kārṣṇyam kuṣṭha-lakṣaṇam agra-jam | / kṛṣṇāruṇa-kapālābhaṃ rūkṣaṃ suptaṃ kharaṃ tanu ||
vistṛtā-sama-pary-antaṃ hṛṣitair romabhiś citam | / todāḍhyam alpa-kaṇḍūkaṃ kāpālaṃ śīghra-sarpi ca ||
pakvodumbara-tāmra-tvag-roma gaura-sirā-citam | / bahalaṃ bahala-kleda-raktaṃ dāha-rujādhikam ||
āśūtthānāvadaraṇa-kṛmi vidyād udumbaram | / sthiraṃ styānaṃ guru snigdhaṃ śveta-raktam an-āśu-gam ||
anyo-'nya-saktam utsannaṃ bahu-kaṇḍū-sruti-krimi | / ślakṣṇa-pītābha-pary-antaṃ maṇḍalaṃ parimaṇḍalam ||
sa-kaṇḍū-piṭikā śyāvā lasīkāḍhyā vicarcikā | / paruṣaṃ tanu raktāntam antaḥ-śyāvaṃ samunnatam ||
sa-toda-dāha-ruk-kledaṃ karkaśaiḥ piṭikaiś citam | / ṛkṣa-jihvākṛti proktam ṛkṣa-jihvaṃ bahu-krimi ||
hasti-carma-khara-sparśaṃ carmaikākhyaṃ mahāśrayam | / a-svedaṃ matsya-śakala-sannibhaṃ kiṭibhaṃ punaḥ ||
rūkṣaṃ kiṇa-khara-sparśaṃ kaṇḍū-mat paruṣāsitam | / sidhmaṃ rūkṣaṃ bahiḥ snigdham antar ghṛṣṭaṃ rajaḥ kiret ||
ślakṣṇa-sparśaṃ tanu śveta-tāmraṃ daugdhika-puṣpa-vat | / prāyeṇa cordhva-kāye syād gaṇḍaiḥ kaṇḍū-yutaiś citam ||
raktair alasakaṃ pāṇi-pāda-dāryo vipādikāḥ | / tīvrārtyo manda-kaṇḍvaś ca sa-rāga-piṭikācitāḥ ||
dīrgha-pratānā dūrvā-vad atasī-kusuma-cchaviḥ | / utsanna-maṇḍalā dadrūḥ kaṇḍū-maty anuṣaṅgiṇī ||
sthūla-mūlaṃ sa-dāhārti rakta-śyāvaṃ bahu-vraṇam | / śatāruḥ kleda-jantv-āḍhyaṃ prāya-śaḥ parva-janma ca ||
raktāntam antarā pāṇḍu kaṇḍū-dāha-rujānvitam | / sotsedham ācitaṃ raktaiḥ padma-pattram ivāṃśubhiḥ ||
ghana-bhūri-lasīkāsṛk-prāyam āśu vibhedi ca | / puṇḍarīkaṃ tanu-tvagbhiś citaṃ sphoṭaiḥ sitāruṇaiḥ ||
visphoṭaṃ piṭikāḥ pāmā kaṇḍū-kleda-rujādhikāḥ | / sūkṣmāḥ śyāvāruṇā bahvyaḥ prāyaḥ sphik-pāṇi-kūrpare ||
sa-sphoṭam a-sparśa-sahaṃ kaṇḍūṣā-toda-dāha-vat | / raktaṃ dalac carma-dalaṃ kākaṇaṃ tīvra-dāha-ruk ||
pūrvaṃ raktaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca kākaṇantī-phalopamam | / kuṣṭha-liṅgair yutaṃ sarvair naika-varṇaṃ tato bhavet ||
doṣa-bhedīya-vihitair ādiśel liṅga-karmabhiḥ | / kuṣṭheṣu doṣolbaṇa-tāṃ sarva-doṣolbaṇaṃ tyajet ||
riṣṭoktaṃ yac ca yac cāsthi-majja-śukra-samāśrayam | / yāpyaṃ medo-gataṃ kṛcchraṃ pitta-dvandvāsra-māṃsa-gam ||
a-kṛcchraṃ kapha-vātāḍhyaṃ tvak-stham eka-malaṃ ca yat | / tatra tvaci sthite kuṣṭhe toda-vaivarṇya-rūkṣa-tāḥ ||
sveda-svāpa-śvayathavaḥ śoṇite piśite punaḥ | / pāṇi-pādāśritāḥ sphoṭāḥ kledaḥ sandhiṣu cādhikam ||
kauṇyaṃ gati-kṣayo 'ṅgānāṃ dalanaṃ syāc ca medasi | / nāsā-bhaṅgo 'sthi-majja-sthe netra-rāgaḥ svara-kṣayaḥ ||
kṣate ca kṛmayaḥ śukre sva-dārāpatya-bādhanam | / yathā-pūrvaṃ ca sarvāṇi syur liṅgāny asṛg-ādiṣu ||
kuṣṭhaika-sambhavaṃ śvitraṃ kilāsaṃ dāruṇaṃ ca tat | / nirdiṣṭam a-parisrāvi tri-dhātūdbhava-saṃśrayam ||
vātād rūkṣāruṇaṃ pittāt tāmraṃ kamala-pattra-vat | / sa-dāhaṃ roma-vidhvaṃsi kaphāc chvetaṃ ghanaṃ guru ||
sa-kaṇḍu ca kramād rakta-māṃsa-medaḥsu cādiśet | / varṇenaivedṛg ubhayaṃ kṛcchraṃ tac cottarottaram ||
a-śukla-romā-bahalam a-saṃsṛṣṭaṃ mitho navam | / an-agni-dagdha-jaṃ sādhyaṃ śvitraṃ varjyam ato 'nya-thā ||
guhya-pāṇi-talauṣṭheṣu jātam apy a-ciran-tanam | / sparśaikāhāra-śayyādi-sevanāt prāya-śo gadāḥ ||
sarve sañcāriṇo netra-tvag-vikārā viśeṣataḥ | / kṛmayas tu dvi-dhā proktā bāhyābhyantara-bhedataḥ ||
bahir-mala-kaphāsṛg-viḍ-janma-bhedāc catur-vidhāḥ | / nāmato viṃśati-vidhā bāhyās tatrā-mṛjodbhavāḥ ||
tila-pramāṇa-saṃsthāna-varṇāḥ keśāmbarāśrayāḥ | / bahu-pādāś ca sūkṣmāś ca yūkā likṣāś ca nāmataḥ ||
dvi-dhā te koṭha-piṭikā-kaṇḍū-gaṇḍān prakurvate | / kuṣṭhaika-hetavo 'ntar-jāḥ śleṣma-jās teṣu cādhikam ||
madhurānna-guḍa-kṣīra-dadhi-saktu-navaudanaiḥ | / śakṛj-jā bahu-viḍ-dhānya-parṇa-śākolakādibhiḥ ||
kaphād āmāśaye jātā vṛddhāḥ sarpanti sarvataḥ | / pṛthu-bradhna-nibhāḥ ke-cit ke-cid gaṇḍū-padopamāḥ ||
rūḍha-dhānyāṅkurākārās tanu-dīrghās tathāṇavaḥ | / śvetās tāmrāvabhāsāś ca nāmataḥ sapta-dhā tu te ||
antrādā udarāveṣṭā hṛdayādā mahā-kuhāḥ | / kuravo darbha-kusumāḥ su-gandhās te ca kurvate ||
hṛl-lāsam āsya-sravaṇam a-vipākam a-rocakam | / mūrchā-chardi-jvarānāha-kārśya-kṣavathu-pīnasān ||
rakta-vāhi-sirotthānā rakta-jā jantavo 'ṇavaḥ | / a-pādā vṛtta-tāmrāś ca saukṣmyāt ke-cid a-darśanāḥ ||
keśādā roma-vidhvaṃsā roma-dvīpā udumbarāḥ | / ṣaṭ te kuṣṭhaika-karmāṇaḥ saha-saurasa-mātaraḥ ||
pakvāśaye purīṣotthā jāyante 'dho-visarpiṇaḥ | / vṛddhāḥ santo bhaveyuś ca te yadāmāśayon-mukhāḥ ||
tadāsyodgāra-niḥśvāsā viḍ-gandhānuvidhāyinaḥ | / pṛthu-vṛtta-tanu-sthūlāḥ śyāva-pīta-sitāsitāḥ ||
te pañca nāmnā kṛmayaḥ kakeruka-makerukāḥ | / sausurādāḥ sulūnākhyā lelihā janayanti ca ||
viḍ-bheda-śūla-viṣṭambha-kārśya-pāruṣya-pāṇḍu-tāḥ | / roma-harṣāgni-sadana-guda-kaṇḍūr vinirgamāt ||
sarvārthān-artha-karaṇe viśvasyāsyaika-kāraṇam | / a-duṣṭa-duṣṭaḥ pavanaḥ śarīrasya viśeṣataḥ ||
sa viśva-karmā viśvātmā viśva-rūpaḥ prajāpatiḥ | / sraṣṭā dhātā vibhur viṣṇuḥ saṃhartā mṛtyur antakaḥ ||
tad-a-duṣṭau prayatnena yatitavyam ataḥ sadā | / tasyoktaṃ doṣa-vijñāne karma prākṛta-vaikṛtam ||
samāsād vyāsato doṣa-bhedīye nāma dhāma ca | / praty-ekaṃ pañca-dhā cāro vyāpāraś ceha vaikṛtam ||
tasyocyate vibhāgena sa-nidānaṃ sa-lakṣaṇam | / dhātu-kṣaya-karair vāyuḥ kupyaty ati-niṣevitaiḥ ||
caran srotaḥsu rikteṣu bhṛśaṃ tāny eva pūrayan | / tebhyo 'nya-doṣa-pūrṇebhyaḥ prāpya vāvaraṇaṃ balī ||
tatra pakvāśaye kruddhaḥ śūlānāhāntra-kūjanam | / mala-rodhāśma-vardhmārśas-trika-pṛṣṭha-kaṭī-graham ||
karoty adhara-kāye ca tāṃs tān kṛcchrān upadravān | / āmāśaye tṛḍ-vamathu-śvāsa-kāsa-viṣūcikāḥ ||
kaṇṭhoparodham udgārān vyādhīn ūrdhvaṃ ca nābhitaḥ | / śrotrādiṣv indriya-vadhaṃ tvaci sphuṭana-rūkṣa-te ||
rakte tīvrā rujaḥ svāpaṃ tāpaṃ rāgaṃ vi-varṇa-tām | / arūṃṣy annasya viṣṭambham a-ruciṃ kṛśa-tāṃ bhramam ||
māṃsa-medo-gato granthīṃs todāḍhyān karkaśāñ chramam | / gurv aṅgaṃ cāti-ruk stabdhaṃ muṣṭi-daṇḍa-hatopamam ||
asthi-sthaḥ sakthi-sandhy-asthi-śūlaṃ tīvraṃ bala-kṣayam | / majja-stho 'sthiṣu sauṣiryam a-svapnaṃ santatāṃ rujam ||
śukrasya śīghram utsargaṃ saṅgaṃ vikṛtim eva vā | / tad-vad garbhasya śukra-sthaḥ sirāsv ādhmāna-rikta-te ||
tat-sthaḥ snāva-sthitaḥ kuryād gṛdhrasy-āyāma-kubja-tāḥ | / vāta-pūrṇa-dṛti-sparśaṃ śophaṃ sandhi-gato 'nilaḥ ||
prasāraṇākuñcanayoḥ pravṛttiṃ ca sa-vedanām | / sarvāṅga-saṃśrayas toda-bheda-sphuraṇa-bhañjanam ||
stambhanākṣepaṇa-svāpa-sandhy-ākuñcana-kampanam | / yadā tu dhamanīḥ sarvāḥ kruddho 'bhyeti muhur muhuḥ ||
tadāṅgam ākṣipaty eṣa vyādhir ākṣepakaḥ smṛtaḥ | / adhaḥ pratihato vāyur vrajann ūrdhvaṃ hṛd-āśritāḥ ||
nāḍīḥ praviśya hṛdayaṃ śiraḥ śaṅkhau ca pīḍayan | / ākṣipet parito gātraṃ dhanur-vac cāsya nāmayet ||
kṛcchrād ucchvasiti stabdha-srasta-mīlita-dṛk tataḥ | / kapota iva kūjec ca niḥ-sañjñaḥ so 'patantrakaḥ ||
sa eva cāpatānākyho mukte tu marutā hṛdi | / aśnuvīta muhuḥ svāsthyaṃ muhur a-svāsthyam āvṛte ||
garbha-pāta-samutpannaḥ śoṇitāti-sravotthitaḥ | / abhighāta-samutthaś ca duś-cikitsya-tamo hi saḥ ||
manye saṃstabhya vāto 'ntar āyacchan dhamanīr yadā | / vyāpnoti sakalaṃ dehaṃ jatrur āyamyate tadā ||
antar dhanur ivāṅgaṃ ca vegaiḥ stambhaṃ ca netrayoḥ | / karoti jṛmbhāṃ daśanaṃ daśanānāṃ kaphodvamam ||
pārśvayor vedanāṃ vākya-hanu-pṛṣṭha-śiro-graham | / antar-āyāma ity eṣa bāhyāyāmaś ca tad-vidhaḥ ||
dehasya bahir-āyāmāt pṛṣṭhato nīyate śiraḥ | / uraś cotkṣipyate tatra kandharā cāvamṛdyate ||
danteṣv āsye ca vaivarṇyaṃ prasvedaḥ srasta-gātra-tā | / bāhyāyāmaṃ dhanuḥ-ṣkambhaṃ bruvate veginaṃ ca tam ||
vraṇaṃ marmāśritaṃ prāpya samīraṇa-samīraṇāt | / vyāyacchanti tanuṃ doṣāḥ sarvām ā-pāda-mastakam ||
tṛṣyataḥ pāṇḍu-gātrasya vraṇāyāmaḥ sa varjitaḥ | / gate vege bhavet svāsthyaṃ sarveṣv ākṣepakeṣu ca ||
jihvāti-lekhanāc chuṣka-bhakṣaṇād abhighātataḥ | / kupito hanu-mūla-sthaḥ sraṃsayitvānilo hanū ||
karoti vivṛtāsya-tvam atha-vā saṃvṛtāsya-tām | / hanu-sraṃsaḥ sa tena syāt kṛcchrāc carvaṇa-bhāṣaṇam ||
vāg-vāhinī-sirā-saṃstho jihvāṃ stambhayate 'nilaḥ | / jihvā-stambhaḥ sa tenānna-pāna-vākyeṣv an-īśa-tā ||
śirasā bhāra-haraṇād ati-hāsya-prabhāṣaṇāt | / uttrāsa-vaktra-kṣavathoḥ khara-kārmuka-karṣaṇāt ||
viṣamād upadhānāc ca kaṭhinānāṃ ca carvaṇāt | / vāyur vivṛddhas tais taiś ca vātalair ūrdhvam āsthitaḥ ||
vakrī-karoti vaktrārdham uktaṃ hasitam īkṣitam | / tato 'sya kampate mūrdhā vāk-saṅgaḥ stabdha-netra-tā ||
danta-cālaḥ svara-bhraṃśaḥ śruti-hāniḥ kṣava-grahaḥ | / gandhā-jñānaṃ smṛter mohas trāsaḥ suptasya jāyate ||
niṣṭhīvaḥ pārśvato yāyād ekasyākṣṇo nimīlanam | / jatror ūrdhvaṃ rujā tīvrā śarīrārdhe 'dhare 'pi vā ||
tam āhur arditaṃ ke-cid ekāyāmam athāpare | / raktam āśritya pavanaḥ kuryān mūrdha-dharāḥ sirāḥ ||
rūkṣāḥ sa-vedanāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ so '-sādhyaḥ syāt sirā-grahaḥ | / gṛhītvārdhaṃ tanor vāyuḥ sirāḥ snāyūr viśoṣya ca ||
pakṣam anya-taraṃ hanti sandhi-bandhān vimokṣayan | / kṛtsno 'rdha-kāyas tasya syād a-karmaṇyo vi-cetanaḥ ||
ekāṅga-rogaṃ taṃ ke-cid anye pakṣa-vadhaṃ viduḥ | / sarvāṅga-rogaṃ tad-vac ca sarva-kāyāśrite 'nile ||
śuddha-vāta-hataḥ pakṣaḥ kṛcchra-sādhya-tamo mataḥ | / kṛcchras tv anyena saṃsṛṣṭo vivarjyaḥ kṣaya-hetukaḥ ||
āma-baddhāyanaḥ kuryāt saṃsthabhyāṅgaṃ kaphānvitaḥ | / a-sādhyaṃ hata-sarvehaṃ daṇḍa-vad daṇḍakaṃ marut ||
aṃsa-mūla-sthito vāyuḥ sirāḥ saṅkocya tatra-gāḥ | / bāhu-praspandita-haraṃ janayaty ava-bāhukam ||
talaṃ praty aṅgulīnāṃ yā kaṇḍarā bāhu-pṛṣṭhataḥ | / bāhu-ceṣṭāpaharaṇī viśvācī nāma sā smṛtā ||
vāyuḥ kaṭyāṃ sthitaḥ sakthnaḥ kaṇḍarām ākṣiped yadā | / tadā khañjo bhavej jantuḥ paṅguḥ sakthnor dvayor api ||
kampate gamanārambhe khañjann iva ca yāti yaḥ | / kalāya-khañjaṃ taṃ vidyān mukta-sandhi-prabandhanam ||
śītoṣṇa-drava-saṃśuṣka-guru-snigdhair niṣevitaiḥ | / jīrṇā-jīrṇe tathāyāsa-saṅkṣobha-svapna-jāgaraiḥ ||
sa-śleṣma-medaḥ-pavanam āmam aty-artha-sañcitam | / abhibhūyetaraṃ doṣam ūrū cet pratipadyate ||
sakthy-asthīni prapūryāntaḥ śleṣmaṇā stimitena tat | / tadā skabhnāti tenorū stabdhau śītāvacetanau ||
parakīyāv iva gurū syātām ati-bhṛśa-vyathau | / dhyānāṅga-marda-staimitya-tandrā-chardy-a-ruci-jvaraiḥ ||
saṃyutau pāda-sadana-kṛcchroddharaṇa-suptibhiḥ | / tam ūru-stambham ity āhur āḍhya-vātam athāpare ||
vāta-śoṇita-jaḥ śopho jānu-madhye mahā-rujaḥ | / jñeyaḥ kroṣṭuka-śīrṣaś ca sthūlaḥ kroṣṭuka-śīrṣa-vat ||
ruk pāde viṣama-nyaste śramād vā jāyate yadā | / vātena gulpham āśritya tam āhur vāta-kaṇṭakam ||
pārṣṇiṃ praty aṅgulīnāṃ yā kaṇḍarā mārutārditā | / sakthy-utkṣepaṃ nigṛhṇāti gṛdhrasīṃ tāṃ pracakṣate ||
viśvācī gṛdhrasī coktā khallis tīvra-rujānvite | / hṛṣyete caraṇau yasya bhavetāṃ ca prasupta-vat ||
pāda-harṣaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ kapha-māruta-kopa-jaḥ | / pādayoḥ kurute dāhaṃ pittāsṛk-sahito 'nilaḥ ||
vidāhy annaṃ viruddhaṃ ca tat tac cāsṛk-pradūṣaṇam | / bhajatāṃ vidhi-hīnaṃ ca svapna-jāgara-maithunam ||
prāyeṇa su-kumārāṇām a-caṅkramaṇa-śīlinām | / abhighātād a-śuddheś ca nṛṇām asṛji dūṣite ||
vātalaiḥ śītalair vāyur vṛddhaḥ kruddho vi-mārga-gaḥ | / tādṛśaivāsṛjā ruddhaḥ prāk tad eva pradūṣayet ||
āḍhya-rogaṃ khuḍaṃ vāta-balāsaṃ vāta-śoṇitam | / tad āhur nāmabhis tac ca pūrvaṃ pādau pradhāvati ||
viśeṣād yāna-yānād yaiḥ pralambau tasya lakṣaṇam | / bhaviṣyataḥ kuṣṭha-samaṃ tathā sādaḥ ślathāṅga-tā ||
jānu-jaṅghoru-kaṭy-aṃsa-hasta-pādāṅga-sandhiṣu | / kaṇḍū-sphuraṇa-nistoda-bheda-gaurava-supta-tāḥ ||
bhūtvā bhūtvā praṇaśyanti muhur āvir-bhavanti ca | / pādayor mūlam āsthāya kadā-cid dhastayor api ||
ākhor iva viṣaṃ kruddhaṃ kṛtsnaṃ dehaṃ vidhāvati | / tvaṅ-māṃsāśrayam uttānaṃ tat pūrvaṃ jāyate tataḥ ||
kālāntareṇa gambhīraṃ sarvān dhātūn abhidravat | / kaṇḍv-ādi-saṃyutottāne tvak tāmrā śyāva-lohitā ||
sāyāmā bhṛśa-dāhoṣā gambhīre 'dhika-pūrva-ruk | / śvayathur grathitaḥ pākī vāyuḥ sandhy-asthi-majjasu ||
chindann iva caraty antar vakrī-kurvaṃś ca vega-vān | / karoti khañjaṃ paṅguṃ vā śarīre sarvataś caran ||
vāte 'dhike 'dhikaṃ tatra śūla-sphuraṇa-todanam | / śophasya raukṣya-kṛṣṇa-tva-śyāva-tā-vṛddhi-hānayaḥ ||
dhamany-aṅguli-sandhīnāṃ saṅkoco 'ṅga-graho 'ti-ruk | / śīta-dveṣān-upaśayau stambha-vepathu-suptayaḥ ||
rakte śopho 'ti-ruk todas tāmraś cimicimāyate | / snigdha-rūkṣaiḥ śamaṃ naiti kaṇḍū-kleda-samanvitaḥ ||
pitte vidāhaḥ sammohaḥ svedo mūrchā madaḥ sa-tṛṭ | / sparśā-kṣama-tvaṃ rug rāgaḥ śophaḥ pāko bhṛśoṣma-tā ||
kaphe staimitya-guru-tā-supti-snigdha-tva-śita-tāḥ | / kaṇḍūr mandā ca rug dvandva-sarva-liṅgaṃ ca saṅkare ||
eka-doṣānugaṃ sādhyaṃ navaṃ yāpyaṃ dvi-doṣa-jam | / tri-doṣa-jaṃ tyajet srāvi stabdham arbuda-kāri ca ||
rakta-mārgaṃ nihatyāśu śākhā-sandhiṣu mārutaḥ | / niviśyānyo-'nyam āvārya vedanābhir haraty asūn ||
vāyau pañcātmake prāṇo raukṣya-vyāyāma-laṅghanaiḥ | / aty-āhārābhighātādhva-vegodīraṇa-dhāraṇaiḥ ||
kupitaś cakṣur-ādīnām upaghātaṃ pravartayet | / pīnasārdita-tṛṭ-kāsa-śvāsādīṃś cāmayān bahūn ||
udānaḥ kṣavathūdgāra-cchardi-nidrā-vidhāraṇaiḥ | / guru-bhārāti-rudita-hāsyādyair vikṛto gadān ||
kaṇṭha-rodha-mano-bhraṃśa-cchardy-a-rocaka-pīnasān | / kuryāc ca gala-gaṇḍādīṃs tāṃs tāñ jatrūrdhva-saṃśrayān ||
vyāno 'ti-gamana-dhyāna-krīḍā-viṣama-ceṣṭitaiḥ | / virodhi-rūkṣa-bhī-harṣa-viṣādādyaiś ca dūṣitaḥ ||
puṃs-tvotsāha-bala-bhraṃśa-śopha-cittotplava-jvarān | / sarvāṅga-roga-nistoda-roma-harṣāṅga-supta-tāḥ ||
kuṣṭhaṃ visarpam anyāṃś ca kuryāt sarvāṅga-gān gadān | / samāno viṣamā-jīrṇa-śīta-saṅkīrṇa-bhojanaiḥ ||
karoty a-kāla-śayana-jāgarādyaiś ca dūṣitaḥ | / śūla-gulma-grahaṇy-ādīn pakvāmāśaya-jān gadān ||
apāno rūkṣa-gurv-anna-vegāghātāti-vāhanaiḥ | / yāna-yānāsana-sthāna-caṅkramaiś cāti-sevitaiḥ ||
kupitaḥ kurute rogān kṛcchrān pakvāśayāśrayān | / mūtra-śukra-pradoṣārśo-guda-bhraṃśādikān bahūn ||
sarvaṃ ca mārutaṃ sāmaṃ tandrā-staimitya-gauravaiḥ | / snigdha-tvā-rocakālasya-śaitya-śophāgni-hānibhiḥ ||
kaṭu-rūkṣābhilāṣeṇa tad-vidhopaśayena ca | / yuktaṃ vidyān nir-āmaṃ tu tandrādīnāṃ viparyayāt ||
vāyor āvaraṇaṃ cāto bahu-bhedaṃ pravakṣyate | / liṅgaṃ pittāvṛte dāhas tṛṣṇā śūlaṃ bhramas tamaḥ ||
kaṭukoṣṇāmla-lavaṇair vidāhaḥ śīta-kāma-tā | / śaitya-gaurava-śūlāni kaṭv-ādy-upaśayo 'dhikam ||
laṅghanāyāsa-rūkṣoṣṇa-kāma-tā ca kaphāvṛte | / raktāvṛte sa-dāhārtis tvaṅ-māṃsāntara-jā bhṛśam ||
bhavec ca rāgī śvayathur jāyante maṇḍalāni ca | / māṃsena kaṭhinaḥ śopho vi-varṇaḥ piṭikās tathā ||
harṣaḥ pipīlikānāṃ ca sañcāra iva jāyate | / calaḥ snigdho mṛduḥ śītaḥ śopho gātreṣv a-rocakaḥ ||
āḍhya-vāta iti jñeyaḥ sa kṛcchro medasāvṛte | / sparśam asthy-āvṛte 'ty-uṣṇaṃ pīḍanaṃ cābhinandati ||
sūcyeva tudyate 'ty-artham aṅgaṃ sīdati śūlyate | / majjāvṛte vinamanaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ pariveṣṭanam ||
śūlaṃ ca pīḍyamānena pāṇibhyāṃ labhate sukham | / śukrāvṛte 'ti-vego vā na vā niṣ-phala-tāpi vā ||
bhukte kukṣau rujā jīrṇe śāmyaty annāvṛte 'nile | / mūtrā-pravṛttir ādhmānaṃ vaster mūtrāvṛte bhavet ||
viḍ-āvṛte vibandho 'dhaḥ sva-sthāne parikṛntati | / vrajaty āśu jarāṃ sneho bhukte cānahyate naraḥ ||
śakṛt pīḍitam annena duḥkhaṃ śuṣkaṃ cirāt sṛjet | / sarva-dhātv-āvṛte vāyau śroṇi-vaṅkṣaṇa-pṛṣṭha-ruk ||
vilomo māruto '-svasthaṃ hṛdayaṃ pīḍyate 'ti ca | / bhramo mūrchā rujā dāhaḥ pittena prāṇa āvṛte ||
vidagdhe 'nne ca vamanam udāne 'pi bhramādayaḥ | / dāho 'ntar ūrjā-bhraṃśaś ca dāho vyāne ca sarva-gaḥ ||
klamo 'ṅga-ceṣṭā-saṅgaś ca sa-santāpaḥ sa-vedanaḥ | / samāna ūṣmopahatir ati-svedo '-ratiḥ sa-tṛṭ ||
dāhaś ca syād apāne tu male hāridra-varṇa-tā | / rajo-'tivṛttis tāpaś ca yoni-mehana-pāyuṣu ||
śleṣmaṇā tv āvṛte prāṇe sādas tandrā-rucir vamiḥ | / ṣṭhīvanaṃ kṣavathūdgāra-niḥśvāsocchvāsa-saṅgrahaḥ ||
udāne guru-gātra-tvam a-rucir vāk-svara-grahaḥ | / bala-varṇa-praṇāśaś ca vyāne parvāsthi-vāg-grahaḥ ||
guru-tāṅgeṣu sarveṣu skhalitaṃ ca gatau bhṛśam | / samāne 'ti-himāṅga-tvam a-svedo manda-vahni-tā ||
apāne sa-kaphaṃ mūtra-śakṛtaḥ syāt pravartanam | / iti dvā-viṃśati-vidhaṃ vāyor āvaraṇaṃ viduḥ ||
prāṇādayas tathānyo-'nyam āvṛṇvanti yathā-kramam | / sarve 'pi viṃśati-vidhaṃ vidyād āvaraṇaṃ ca tat ||
niḥśvāsocchvāsa-saṃrodhaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ śiro-grahaḥ | / hṛd-rogo mukha-śoṣaś ca prāṇenodāna āvṛte ||
udānenāvṛte prāṇe varṇaujo-bala-saṅkṣayaḥ | / diśānayā ca vibhajet sarvam āvaraṇaṃ bhiṣak ||
sthānāny avekṣya vātānāṃ vṛddhiṃ hāniṃ ca karmaṇām | / prāṇādīnāṃ ca pañcānāṃ miśram āvaraṇaṃ mithaḥ ||
pittādibhir dvā-daśabhir miśrāṇāṃ miśritaiś ca taiḥ | / miśraiḥ pittādibhis tad-van miśraṇābhir aneka-dhā ||
tāratamya-vikalpāc ca yāty āvṛtir a-saṅkhya-tām | / tāṃ lakṣayed avahito yathā-svaṃ lakṣaṇodayāt ||
śanaiḥ śanaiś copaśayād gūḍhām api muhur muhuḥ | / viśeṣāj jīvitaṃ prāṇa udāno balam ucyate ||
syāt tayoḥ pīḍanād dhānir āyuṣaś ca balasya ca | / āvṛtā vāyavo '-jñātā jñātā vā vatsaraṃ sthitāḥ ||
prayatnenāpi duḥ-sādhyā bhaveyur vān-upakramāḥ | / vidradhi-plīha-hṛd-roga-gulmāgni-sadanādayaḥ ||
āmāśaya-stho hatvāgniṃ sāmo mārgān pidhāya yat | / vidadhāti jvaraṃ doṣas tasmāt kurvīta laṅghanam ||
prāg-rūpeṣu jvarādau vā balaṃ yatnena pālayan | / balādhiṣṭhānam ārogyam ārogyārthaḥ kriyā-kramaḥ ||
laṅghanaiḥ kṣapite doṣe dīpte 'gnau lāghave sati | / svāsthyaṃ kṣut tṛḍ ruciḥ paktir balam ojaś ca jāyate ||
tatrotkṛṣṭe samutkliṣṭe kapha-prāye cale male | / sa-hṛl-lāsa-prasekānna-dveṣa-kāsa-viṣūcike ||
sadyo-bhuktasya sañjāte jvare sāme viśeṣataḥ | / vamanaṃ vamanārhasya śastaṃ kuryāt tad anya-thā ||
śvāsātīsāra-sammoha-hṛd-roga-viṣama-jvarān | / pippalībhir yutān gālān kaliṅgair madhukena vā ||
uṣṇāmbhasā sa-madhunā pibet sa-lavaṇena vā | / paṭola-nimba-karkoṭa-vetra-pattrodakena vā ||
tarpaṇena rasenekṣor madyaiḥ kalpoditāni vā | / vamanāni prayuñjīta bala-kāla-vibhāga-vit ||
kṛte '-kṛte vā vamane jvarī kuryād viśoṣaṇam | / doṣāṇāṃ samudīrṇānāṃ pācanāya śamāya ca ||
doṣeṇa bhasmanevāgnau channe 'nnaṃ na vipacyate | / tasmād ā-doṣa-pacanāj jvaritān upavāsayet ||
tṛṣṇag alpālpam uṣṇāmbu pibed vāta-kapha-jvare | / tat kaphaṃ vilayaṃ nītvā tṛṣṇām āśu nivartayet ||
udīrya cāgniṃ srotāṃsi mṛdū-kṛtya viśodhayet | / līna-pittānila-sveda-śakṛn-mūtrānulomanam ||
nidrā-jāḍyā-ruci-haraṃ prāṇānām avalambanam | / viparītam ataḥ śītaṃ doṣa-saṅghāta-vardhanam ||
uṣṇam evaṅ-guṇa-tve 'pi yuñjyān naikānta-pittale | / udrikta-pitte davathu-dāha-mohātisāriṇi ||
viṣa-madyotthite grīṣme kṣata-kṣīṇe 'sra-pittini | / ghana-candana-śuṇṭhy-ambu-parpaṭośīra-sādhitam ||
śītaṃ tebhyo hitaṃ toyaṃ pācanaṃ tṛḍ-jvarāpaham | / ūṣmā pittād ṛte nāsti jvaro nāsty ūṣmaṇā vinā ||
tasmāt pitta-viruddhāni tyajet pittādhike 'dhikam | / snānābhyaṅga-pradehāṃś ca pariśeṣaṃ ca laṅghanam ||
a-jīrṇa iva śūla-ghnaṃ sāme tīvra-ruji jvare | / na pibed auṣadhaṃ tad dhi bhūya evāmam āvahet ||
āmābhibhūta-koṣṭhasya kṣīraṃ viṣam aher iva | / sodarda-pīnasa-śvāse jaṅghā-parvāsthi-śūlini ||
vāta-śleṣmātmake svedaḥ praśastaḥ sa pravartayet | / sveda-mūtra-śakṛd-vātān kuryād agneś ca pāṭavam ||
snehoktam ācāra-vidhiṃ sarva-śaś cānupālayet | / laṅghanaṃ svedanaṃ kālo yavāgvas tiktako rasaḥ ||
malānāṃ pācanāni syur yathāvasthaṃ krameṇa vā | / śuddha-vāta-kṣayāgantu-jīrṇa-jvariṣu laṅghanam ||
neṣyate teṣu hi hitaṃ śamanaṃ yan na karśanam | / tatra sāma-jvarākṛtyā jānīyād a-viśoṣitam ||
dvi-vidhopakrama-jñānam avekṣeta ca laṅghane | / yuktaṃ laṅghita-liṅgais tu taṃ peyābhir upācaret ||
yathā-svauṣadha-siddhābhir maṇḍa-pūrvābhir āditaḥ | / ṣaḍ-ahaṃ vā mṛdu-tvaṃ vā jvaro yāvad avāpnuyāt ||
tasyāgnir dīpyate tābhiḥ samidbhir iva pāvakaḥ | / prāg lāja-peyāṃ su-jarāṃ sa-śuṇṭhī-dhānya-pippalīm ||
sa-saindhavāṃ tathāmlārthī tāṃ pibet saha-dāḍimām | / sṛṣṭa-viḍ bahu-pitto vā sa-śuṇṭhī-mākṣikāṃ himām ||
vasti-pārśva-śiraḥ-śūlī vyāghrī-gokṣura-sādhitām | / pṛśniparṇī-balā-bilva-nāgarotpala-dhānyakaiḥ ||
siddhāṃ jvarātisāry amlāṃ peyāṃ dīpana-pācanīm | / hrasvena pañca-mūlena hikkā-ruk-śvāsa-kāsa-vān ||
pañca-mūlena mahatā kaphārto yava-sādhitām | / vibaddha-varcāḥ sa-yavāṃ pippaly-āmalakaiḥ kṛtāṃ ||
yavāgūṃ sarpiṣā bhṛṣṭāṃ mala-doṣānulomanīm | / cavikā-pippalī-mūla-drākṣāmalaka-nāgaraiḥ ||
koṣṭhe vibaddhe sa-ruji pibet tu parikartini | / kola-vṛkṣāmla-kalaśī-dhāvanī-śrīphalaiḥ kṛtām ||
a-sveda-nidras tṛṣṇārtaḥ sitāmalaka-nāgaraiḥ | / sitā-badara-mṛdvīkā-śārivā-musta-candanaiḥ ||
tṛṣṇā-chardi-parīdāha-jvara-ghnīṃ kṣaudra-saṃyutām | / kuryāt peyauṣadhair eva rasa-yūṣādikān api ||
madyodbhave madya-nitye pitta-sthāna-gate kaphe | / grīṣme tayor vādhikayos tṛṭ-chardir-dāha-pīḍite ||
ūrdhvaṃ pravṛtte rakte ca peyāṃ necchanti teṣu tu | / jvarāpahaiḥ phala-rasair adbhir vā lāja-tarpaṇāt ||
pibet sa-śarkarā-kṣaudrān tato jīrṇe tu tarpaṇe | / yavāgvāṃ vaudanaṃ kṣud-vān aśnīyād bhṛṣṭa-taṇḍulam ||
daka-lāvaṇikair yūṣai rasair vā mudga-lāva-jaiḥ | / ity ayaṃ ṣaḍ-aho neyo balaṃ doṣaṃ ca rakṣatā ||
tataḥ pakveṣu doṣeṣu laṅghanādyaiḥ praśasyate | / kaṣāyo doṣa-śeṣasya pācanaḥ śamano 'tha-vā ||
tiktaḥ pitte viśeṣeṇa prayojyaḥ kaṭukaḥ kaphe | / pitta-śleṣma-hara-tve 'pi kaṣāyaḥ sa na śasyate ||
nava-jvare mala-stambhāt kaṣāyo viṣama-jvaram | / kurute '-ruci-hṛl-lāsa-hidhmādhmānādikān api ||
saptāhād auṣadhaṃ ke-cid āhur anye daśāhataḥ | / ke-cil laghv-anna-bhuktasya yojyam āmolbaṇe na tu ||
tīvra-jvara-parītasya doṣa-vegodaye yataḥ | / doṣe 'tha-vāti-nicite tandrā-staimitya-kāriṇi ||
a-pacyamānaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ bhūyo jvalayati jvaram | / mṛdur jvaro laghur dehaś calitāś ca malā yadā ||
a-cira-jvaritasyāpi bheṣajaṃ yojayet tadā | / mustayā parpaṭaṃ yuktaṃ śuṇṭhyā duḥsparśayāpi vā ||
pākyaṃ śīta-kaṣāyaṃ vā pāṭhośīraṃ sa-vālakam | / pibet tad-vac ca bhūnimba-guḍūcī-musta-nāgaram ||
yathā-yogam ime yojyāḥ kaṣāyā doṣa-pācanāḥ | / jvarā-rocaka-tṛṣṇāsya-vairasyā-pakti-nāśanāḥ ||
paṭolaṃ śārivā mustā pāṭhā kaṭuka-rohiṇī | / paṭola-nimba-tri-phalā-mṛdvīkā-musta-vatsakāḥ ||
kirātatiktam amṛtā candanaṃ viśva-bheṣajam | / dhātrī-mustāmṛtā-kṣaudram ardha-śloka-samāpanāḥ ||
pañcaite santatādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ śamanā matāḥ | / durālabhāmṛtā-mustā-nāgaraṃ vāta-je jvare ||
atha-vā pippalī-mūla-guḍūcī-viśva-bheṣajam | / kanīyaḥ pañca-mūlaṃ ca pitte śakrayavā ghanam ||
kaṭukā ceti sa-kṣaudraṃ mustā-parpaṭakaṃ tathā | / sa-dhanvayāsa-bhūnimbaṃ vatsakādyo gaṇaḥ kaphe ||
atha-vā vṛṣa-gāṅgeyī-śṛṅgavera-durālabhāḥ | / rug-vibandhānila-śleṣma-yukte dīpana-pācanam ||
abhayā-pippalī-mūla-śamyāka-kaṭukā-ghanam | / drākṣā-madhūka-madhuka-lodhra-kāśmarya-śārivāḥ ||
mustāmalaka-hrīvera-padma-kesara-padmakam | / mṛṇāla-candanośīra-nīlotpala-parūṣakam ||
phāṇṭo himo vā drākṣādir jātī-kusuma-vāsitaḥ | / yukto madhu-sitā-lājair jayaty anila-pitta-jam ||
jvaraṃ madātyayaṃ chardiṃ mūrchāṃ dāhaṃ śramaṃ bhramam | / ūrdhva-gaṃ rakta-pittaṃ ca pipāsāṃ kāmalām api ||
pācayet kaṭukāṃ piṣṭvā karpare 'bhinave śucau | / niṣpīḍito ghṛta-yutas tad-raso jvara-dāha-jit ||
kapha-vāte vacā-tiktā-pāṭhāragvadha-vatsakāḥ | / pippalī-cūrṇa-yukto vā kvāthaś chinnodbhavodbhavaḥ ||
vyāghrī-śuṇṭhy-amṛtā-kvāthaḥ pippalī-cūrṇa-saṃyutaḥ | / vāta-śleṣma-jvara-śvāsa-kāsa-pīnasa-śūla-jit ||
pathyā-kustumburī-mustā-śuṇṭhī-kaṭtṛṇa-parpaṭam | / sa-kaṭphala-vacā-bhārgī-devāhvaṃ madhu-hiṅgu-mat ||
kapha-vāta-jvara-ṣṭhīva-kukṣi-hṛt-pārśva-vedanāḥ | / kaṇṭhāmayāsya-śvayathu-kāsa-śvāsān niyacchati ||
āragvadhādiḥ sa-kṣaudraḥ kapha-pitta-jvaraṃ jayet | / tathā tiktā-vṛṣośīra-trāyantī-tri-phalāmṛtāḥ ||
paṭolātiviṣā-nimba-mūrvā-dhanvayavāsakāḥ | / sannipāta-jvare vyāghrī-devadāru-niśā-ghanam ||
paṭola-pattra-nimba-tvak-tri-phalā-kaṭukā-yutam | / nāgaraṃ pauṣkaraṃ mūlaṃ guḍūcī kaṇṭakārikā ||
sa-kāsa-śvāsa-pārśvārtau vāta-śleṣmottare jvare | / madhūka-puṣpa-mṛdvīkā-trāyamāṇā-parūṣakam ||
sośīra-tiktā-tri-phalā-kāśmaryaṃ kalpayed dhimam | / kaṣāyaṃ taṃ piban kāle jvarān sarvān apohati ||
jāty-āmalaka-mustāni tad-vad dhanvayavāsakam | / baddha-viṭ kaṭukā-drākṣā-trāyantī-tri-phalā-guḍam ||
jīrṇauṣadho 'nnaṃ peyādyam ācarec chleṣma-vān na tu | / peyā kaphaṃ vardhayati paṅkaṃ pāṃsuṣu vṛṣṭi-vat ||
śleṣmābhiṣyaṇṇa-dehānām ataḥ prāg api yojayet | / yūṣān kulattha-caṇaka-kalāyādi-kṛtān laghūn ||
rūkṣāṃs tikta-rasopetān hṛdyān ruci-karān paṭūn | / raktādyāḥ śālayo jīrṇāḥ ṣaṣṭikāś ca jvare hitāḥ ||
śleṣmottare vīta-tuṣās tathā vāṭī-kṛtā yavāḥ | / odanas taiḥ sruto dvis triḥ prayoktavyo yathā-yatham ||
doṣa-dūṣyādi-balato jvara-ghna-kvātha-sādhitaḥ | / mudgādyair laghubhir yūṣāḥ kulatthaiś ca jvarāpahāḥ ||
kāravellaka-karkoṭa-bāla-mūlaka-parpaṭaiḥ | / vārtāka-nimba-kusuma-paṭola-phala-pallavaiḥ ||
aty-anta-laghubhir māṃsair jāṅgalaiś ca hitā rasāḥ | / vyāghrī-parūṣa-tarkārī-drākṣāmalaka-dāḍimaiḥ ||
saṃskṛtāḥ pippalī-śuṇṭhī-dhānya-jīraka-saindhavaiḥ | / sitā-madhubhyāṃ prāyeṇa saṃyutā vā kṛtā-kṛtāḥ ||
an-amla-takra-siddhāni rucyāni vyañjanāni ca | / acchāny anala-sampannāny anu-pāne 'pi yojayet ||
tāni kvathita-śītaṃ ca vāri madyaṃ ca sātmyataḥ | / sa-jvaraṃ jvara-muktaṃ vā dinānte bhojayel laghu ||
śleṣma-kṣaya-vivṛddhoṣmā bala-vān analas tadā | / yathocite 'tha-vā kāle deśa-sātmyānurodhataḥ ||
prāg alpa-vahnir bhuñjāno na hy a-jīrṇena pīḍyate | / kaṣāya-pāna-pathyānnair daśāha iti laṅghite ||
sarpir dadyāt kaphe mande vāta-pittottare jvare | / pakveṣu doṣeṣv amṛtaṃ tad viṣopamam anya-thā ||
daśāhe syād atīte 'pi jvaropadrava-vṛddhi-kṛt | / laṅghanādi-kramaṃ tatra kuryād ā-kapha-saṅkṣayāt ||
deha-dhātv-a-bala-tvāc ca jvaro jīrṇo 'nuvartate | / rūkṣaṃ hi tejo jvara-kṛt tejasā rūkṣitasya ca ||
vamana-sveda-kālāmbu-kaṣāya-laghu-bhojanaiḥ | / yaḥ syād ati-balo dhātuḥ saha-cārī sadā-gatiḥ ||
tasya saṃśamanaṃ sarpir dīptasyevāmbu veśmanaḥ | / vāta-pitta-jitām agryaṃ saṃskāraṃ cānurudhyate ||
su-tarāṃ tad dhy ato dadyād yathā-svauṣadha-sādhitam | / viparītaṃ jvaroṣmāṇaṃ jayet pittaṃ ca śaityataḥ ||
snehād vātaṃ ghṛtaṃ tulyaṃ yoga-saṃskārataḥ kapham | / pūrve kaṣāyāḥ sa-ghṛtāḥ sarve yojyā yathā-malam ||
tri-phalā-picumanda-tvaṅ-madhukaṃ bṛhatī-dvayam | / sa-masūra-dalaṃ kvāthaḥ sa-ghṛto jvara-kāsa-hā ||
pippalīndrayava-dhāvani-tiktā-śārivāmalaka-tāmalakībhiḥ | / bilva-musta-hima-pālani-sevyair drākṣayātiviṣayā sthirayā ca ||
ghṛtam āśu nihanti sādhitaṃ jvaram agniṃ viṣamaṃ halīmakam | / a-ruciṃ bhṛśa-tāpam aṃsayor vamathuṃ pārśva-śiro-rujaṃ kṣayam ||
tailvakaṃ pavana-janmani jvare yojayet trivṛtayā viyojitam | / tiktakaṃ vṛṣa-ghṛtaṃ ca paittike yac ca pālanikayā śṛtaṃ haviḥ ||
viḍaṅga-sauvarcala-cavya-pāṭhā-vyoṣāgni-sindhūdbhava-yāva-śūkaiḥ | / palāṃśakaiḥ kṣīra-samaṃ ghṛtasya prasthaṃ pacej jīrṇa-kapha-jvara-ghnam ||
guḍūcyā rasa-kalkābhyāṃ tri-phalāyā vṛṣasya vā | / mṛdvīkāyā balāyāś ca snehāḥ siddhā jvara-cchidaḥ ||
jīrṇe ghṛte ca bhuñjīta mṛdu-māṃsa-rasaudanam | / balaṃ hy alaṃ doṣa-haraṃ paraṃ tac ca bala-pradam ||
kapha-pitta-harā mudga-kāravellādi-jā rasāḥ | / prāyeṇa tasmān na hitā jīrṇe vātottare jvare ||
śūlodāvarta-viṣṭambha-jananā jvara-vardhanāḥ | / na śāmyaty evam api cej jvaraḥ kurvīta śodhanam ||
śodhanārhasya vamanaṃ prāg uktaṃ tasya yojayet | / āmāśaya-gate doṣe balinaḥ pālayan balam ||
pakve tu śithile doṣe jvare vā viṣa-madya-je | / modakaṃ tri-phalā-śyāmā-trivṛt-pippali-kesaraiḥ ||
sa-sitā-madhubhir dadyād vyoṣādyaṃ vā virecanam | / drākṣā-dhātrī-rasaṃ tad-vat sa-drākṣāṃ vā harītakīm ||
āragvadhaṃ vā payasā mṛdvīkānāṃ rasena vā | / tri-phalāṃ trāyamāṇāṃ vā payasā jvaritaḥ pibet ||
viriktānāṃ ca saṃsargī maṇḍa-pūrvā yathā-kramam | / cyavamānaṃ jvarotkliṣṭam upekṣeta malaṃ sadā ||
pakvo 'pi hi vikurvīta doṣaḥ koṣṭhe kṛtāspadaḥ | / atipravartamānaṃ vā pācayan saṅgrahaṃ nayet ||
āma-saṅgrahaṇe doṣā doṣopakrama īritāḥ | / pāyayed doṣa-haraṇaṃ mohād āma-jvare tu yaḥ ||
prasuptaṃ kṛṣṇa-sarpaṃ sa karāgreṇa parāmṛśet | / jvara-kṣīṇasya na hitaṃ vamanaṃ na virecanam ||
kāmaṃ tu payasā tasya nirūhair vā haren malān | / kṣīrocitasya prakṣīṇa-śleṣmaṇo dāha-tṛḍ-vataḥ ||
kṣīraṃ pittānilārtasya pathyam apy atisāriṇaḥ | / tad vapur laṅghanottaptaṃ pluṣṭaṃ vanam ivāgninā ||
divyāmbu jīvayet tasya jvaraṃ cāśu niyacchati | / saṃskṛtaṃ śītam uṣṇaṃ vā tasmād dhāroṣṇam eva vā ||
vibhajya kāle yuñjīta jvariṇaṃ hanty ato 'nya-thā | / payaḥ sa-śuṇṭhī-kharjūra-mṛdvīkā-śarkarā-ghṛtam ||
śṛta-śītaṃ madhu-yutaṃ tṛḍ-dāha-jvara-nāśanam | / tad-vad drākṣā-balā-yaṣṭī-śārivā-kaṇa-candanaiḥ ||
catur-guṇenāmbhasā vā pippalyā vā śṛtaṃ pibet | / kāsāc chvāsāc chiraḥ-śūlāt pārśva-śūlāc cira-jvarāt ||
mucyate jvaritaḥ pītvā pañca-mūlī-śṛtaṃ payaḥ | / śṛtam eraṇḍa-mūlena bāla-bilvena vā jvarāt ||
dhāroṣṇaṃ vā payaḥ pītvā vibaddhānila-varcasaḥ | / sa-rakta-picchātisṛteḥ sa-tṛṭ-śūla-pravāhikāt ||
siddhaṃ śuṇṭhī-balā-vyāghrī-gokaṇṭaka-guḍaiḥ payaḥ | / śopha-mūtra-śakṛd-vāta-vibandha-jvara-kāsa-jit ||
vṛścīva-bilva-varṣābhū-sādhitaṃ jvara-śopha-nut | / śiṃśipā-sāra-siddhaṃ ca kṣīram āśu jvarāpaham ||
nirūhas tu balaṃ vahniṃ vi-jvara-tvaṃ mudaṃ rucim | / doṣe yuktaḥ karoty āśu pakve pakvāśayaṃ gate ||
pittaṃ vā kapha-pittaṃ vā pakvāśaya-gataṃ haret | / sraṃsanaṃ trīn api malān vastiḥ pakvāśayāśrayān ||
prakṣīṇa-kapha-pittasya trika-pṛṣṭha-kaṭī-grahe | / dīptāgner baddha-śakṛtaḥ prayuñjītānuvāsanam ||
paṭola-nimba-cchadana-kaṭukā-caturaṅgulaiḥ | / sthirā-balā-gokṣuraka-madanośīra-vālakaiḥ ||
payasy ardhodake kvāthaṃ kṣīra-śeṣaṃ vimiśritam | / kalkitair musta-madana-kṛṣṇā-madhuka-vatsakaiḥ ||
vastiṃ madhu-ghṛtābhyāṃ ca pīḍayej jvara-nāśanam | / catasraḥ parṇinīr yaṣṭī-phalośīra-nṛpadrumān ||
kvāthayet kalkayed yaṣṭī-śatāhvā-phalinī-phalam | / mustaṃ ca vastiḥ sa-guḍa-kṣaudra-sarpir jvarāpahaḥ ||
jīvantīṃ madanaṃ medāṃ pippalīṃ madhukaṃ vacām | / ṛddhiṃ rāsnāṃ balāṃ bilvaṃ śatapuṣpāṃ śatāvarīm ||
piṣṭvā kṣīraṃ jalaṃ sarpis tailaṃ caika-tra sādhitam | / jvare 'nuvāsanaṃ dadyād yathā-snehaṃ yathā-malam ||
ye ca siddhiṣu vakṣyante vastayo jvara-nāśanāḥ | / śiro-rug-gaurava-śleṣma-haram indriya-bodhanam ||
jīrṇa-jvare ruci-karaṃ dadyān nasyaṃ virecanam | / snaihikaṃ śūnya-śiraso dāhārte pitta-nāśanam ||
dhūma-gaṇḍūṣa-kavaḍān yathā-doṣaṃ ca kalpayet | / pratiśyāyāsya-vairasya-śiraḥ-kaṇṭhāmayāpahān ||
a-rucau mātuluṅgasya kesaraṃ sājya-saindhavam | / dhātrī-drākṣā-sitānāṃ vā kalkam āsyena dhārayet ||
yathopaśaya-saṃsparśān śītoṣṇa-dravya-kalpitān | / abhyaṅgālepa-sekādīñ jvare jīrṇe tvag-āśrite ||
kuryād añjana-dhūmāṃś ca tathaivāgantu-je 'pi tān | / dāhe sahasra-dhautena sarpiṣābhyaṅgam ācaret ||
sūtroktaiś ca gaṇais tais tair madhurāmla-kaṣāyakaiḥ | / dūrvādibhir vā pitta-ghnaiḥ śodhanādi-gaṇoditaiḥ ||
śīta-vīryair hima-sparśaiḥ kvātha-kalkī-kṛtaiḥ pacet | / tailaṃ sa-kṣīram abhyaṅgāt sadyo dāha-jvaropaham ||
śiro gātraṃ ca tair eva nāti-piṣṭaiḥ pralepayet | / tat-kvāthena parīṣekam avagāhaṃ ca yojayet ||
tathāranāla-salila-kṣīra-śukta-ghṛtādibhiḥ | / kapittha-mātuluṅgāmla-vidārī-lodhra-dāḍimaiḥ ||
badarī-pallavotthena phenenāriṣṭakasya vā | / lipte 'ṅge dāha-ruṅ-mohāś chardis tṛṣṇā ca śāmyati ||
yo varṇitaḥ pitta-haro doṣopakramaṇe kramaḥ | / taṃ ca śīlayataḥ śīghraṃ sa-dāho naśyati jvaraḥ ||
vīryoṣṇair uṣṇa-saṃsparśais tagarāguru-kuṅkumaiḥ | / kuṣṭha-sthauṇeya-śaileya-saralāmaradārubhiḥ ||
nakha-rāsnā-pura-vacā-caṇḍailā-dvaya-corakaiḥ | / pṛthvīkā-śigru-surasā-hiṃsrā-dhyāmaka-sarṣapaiḥ ||
daśa-mūlāmṛtairaṇḍa-dvaya-pattūra-rohiṣaiḥ | / tamāla-pattra-bhūtīka-śallakī-dhānya-dīpyakaiḥ ||
miśi-māṣa-kulatthāgni-prakīryā-nākulī-dvayaiḥ | / anyaiś ca tad-vidhair dravyaiḥ śīte tailaṃ jvare pacet ||
kvathitaiḥ kalkitair yuktaiḥ surā-sauvīrakādibhiḥ | / tenābhyañjyāt sukhoṣṇena taiḥ su-piṣṭaiś ca lepayet ||
kavoṣṇais taiḥ parīṣekam avagāhaṃ ca kalpayet | / kevalair api tad-vac ca śukta-go-mūtra-mastubhiḥ ||
āragvadhādi-vargaṃ ca pānābhyañjana-lepane | / dhūpān aguru-jān yāṃś ca vakṣyante viṣama-jvare ||
agny-an-agni-kṛtān svedān svedi bheṣaja-bhojanan | / garbha-bhū-veśma-śayanaṃ kutha-kambala-rallakān ||
nir-dhūma-dīptair aṅgārair hasantīś ca hasantikāḥ | / madyaṃ sa-try-ūṣaṇaṃ takraṃ kulattha-vrīhi-kodravān ||
saṃśīlayed vepathu-mān yac cānyad api pittalam | / dayitāḥ stana-śālinyaḥ pīnā vibhrama-bhūṣaṇāḥ ||
yauvanāsava-mattāś ca tam āliṅgeyur aṅganāḥ | / vīta-śītaṃ ca vijñāya tās tato 'panayet punaḥ ||
vardhanenaika-doṣasya kṣapaṇenocchritasya vā | / kapha-sthānānupūrvyā vā tulya-kakṣāñ jayen malān ||
sannipāta-jvarasyānte karṇa-mūle su-dāruṇaḥ | / śophaḥ sañjāyate yena kaś-cid eva vimucyate ||
raktāvasecanaiḥ śīghraṃ sarpiḥ-pānaiś ca taṃ jayet | / pradehaiḥ kapha-pitta-ghnair nāvanaiḥ kavaḍa-grahaiḥ ||
śītoṣṇa-snigdha-rūkṣādyair jvaro yasya na śāmyati | / śākhānusārī tasyāśu muñced bāhvoḥ kramāt sirām ||
ayam eva vidhiḥ kāryo viṣame 'pi yathā-yatham | / jvare vibhajya vātādīn yaś cān-antaram ucyate ||
paṭola-kaṭukā-mustā-prāṇadā-madhukaiḥ kṛtāḥ | / tri-catuḥ-pañca-śaḥ kvāthā viṣama-jvara-nāśanāḥ ||
yojayet tri-phalāṃ pathyāṃ guḍūcīṃ pippalīṃ pṛthak | / tais tair vidhānaiḥ sa-guḍaṃ bhallātakam athāpi vā ||
laṅghanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ vādau jvarāgamana-vāsare | / prātaḥ sa-tailaṃ laśunaṃ prāg-bhaktaṃ vā tathā ghṛtam ||
jīrṇaṃ tad-vad dadhi payas takraṃ sarpiś ca ṣaṭ-palam | / kalyāṇakaṃ pañca-gavyaṃ tiktākhyaṃ vṛṣa-sādhitam ||
tri-phalā-kola-tarkārī-kvāthe dadhnā śṛtaṃ ghṛtam | / tilvaka-tvak-kṛtāvāpaṃ viṣama-jvara-jit param ||
surāṃ tīkṣṇaṃ ca yan madyaṃ śikhi-tittiri-dakṣa-jam | / māṃsaṃ medyoṣṇa-vīryaṃ ca sahānnena pra-kāmataḥ ||
sevitvā tad-ahaḥ svapyād atha-vā punar ullikhet | / sarpiṣo mahatīṃ mātrāṃ pītvā vā chardayet punaḥ ||
nīlinīm ajagandhāṃ ca trivṛtāṃ kaṭu-rohiṇīm | / pibej jvarasyāgamane sneha-svedopapāditaḥ ||
manohvā saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇā tailena nayanāñjanam | / yojyaṃ hiṅgu-samā vyāghrī-vasā nasyaṃ sa-saindhavam ||
purāṇa-sarpiḥ siṃhasya vasā tad-vat sa-saindhavā | / palaṅkaṣā nimba-pattraṃ vacā kuṣṭhaṃ harītakī ||
sarṣapāḥ sa-yavāḥ sarpir dhūpo viḍ vā biḍāla-jā | / pura-dhyāma-vacā-sarja-nimbārkāguru-dārubhiḥ ||
dhūpo jvareṣu sarveṣu kāryo 'yam a-parājitaḥ | / dhūpa-nasyāñjanottrāsā ye coktāś citta-vaikṛte ||
daivāśrayaṃ ca bhaiṣajyaṃ jvarān sarvān vyapohati | / viśeṣād viṣamān prāyas te hy āgantv-anubandha-jāḥ ||
yathā-svaṃ ca sirāṃ vidhyed a-śāntau viṣama-jvare | / kevalānila-vīsarpa-visphoṭābhihata-jvare ||
sarpiḥ-pāna-himālepa-seka-māṃsa-rasāśanam | / kuryād yathā-svam uktaṃ ca rakta-mokṣādi sādhanam ||
grahotthe bhūta-vidyoktaṃ bali-mantrādi sādhanam | / oṣadhi-gandha-je pitta-śamanaṃ viṣa-jid viṣe ||
iṣṭair arthair mano-jñaiś ca yathā-doṣa-śamena ca | / hitā-hita-vivekaiś ca jvaraṃ krodhādi-jaṃ jayet ||
krodha-jo yāti kāmena śāntiṃ krodhena kāma-jaḥ | / bhaya-śokodbhavau tābhyāṃ bhī-śokābhyāṃ tathetarau ||
śāpātharvaṇa-mantrotthe vidhir daiva-vyapāśrayaḥ | / te jvarāḥ kevalāḥ pūrvaṃ vyāpyante 'n-antaram malaiḥ ||
tasmād doṣānusāreṇa teṣv āhārādi kalpayet | / na hi jvaro 'nubadhnāti mārutādyair vinā kṛtaḥ ||
jvara-kāla-smṛtiṃ cāsya hāribhir viṣayair haret | / karuṇārdraṃ manaḥ śuddhaṃ sarva-jvara-vināśanam ||
tyajed ā-bala-lābhāc ca vyāyāma-snāna-maithunam | / gurv-a-sātmya-vidāhy annaṃ yac cānyaj jvara-kāraṇam ||
na vi-jvaro 'pi sahasā sarvānnīno bhavet tathā | / nivṛtto 'pi jvaraḥ śīghraṃ vyāpādayati dur-balam ||
sadyaḥ prāṇa-haro yasmāt tasmāt tasya viśeṣataḥ | / tasyāṃ tasyām avasthāyāṃ tat tat kuryād bhiṣag-jitam ||
oṣadhayo maṇayaś ca su-mantrāḥ sādhu-guru-dvi-ja-daivata-pūjāḥ | / prīti-karā manaso viṣayāś ca ghnanty api viṣṇu-kṛtaṃ jvaram ugram ||
ūrdhva-gaṃ balino '-vegam eka-doṣānugaṃ navam | / rakta-pittaṃ sukhe kāle sādhayen nir-upadravam ||
adho-gaṃ yāpayed raktaṃ yac ca doṣa-dvayānugam | / śāntaṃ śāntaṃ punaḥ kupyan mārgān mārgāntaraṃ ca yat ||
ati-pravṛttaṃ mandāgnes tri-doṣaṃ dvi-pathaṃ tyajet | / jñātvā nidānam ayanaṃ malāv anu-balau balam ||
deśa-kālādy-avasthāṃ ca rakta-pitte prayojayet | / laṅghanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ vādau śodhanaṃ śamanaṃ tathā ||
santarpaṇotthaṃ balino bahu-doṣasya sādhayet | / ūrdhva-bhāgaṃ virekeṇa vamanena tv adho-gatam ||
śamanair bṛṃhaṇaiś cānyal laṅghya-bṛṃhyān avekṣya ca | / ūrdhvaṃ pravṛtte śamanau rasau tikta-kaṣāyakau ||
upavāsaś ca niḥ-śuṇṭhī-ṣaḍ-aṅgodaka-pāyinaḥ | / adho-ge rakta-pitte tu bṛṃhaṇo madhuro rasaḥ ||
ūrdhva-ge tarpaṇaṃ yojyaṃ prāk ca peyā tv adho-gate | / aśnato balino '-śuddhaṃ na dhāryaṃ tad dhi roga-kṛt ||
dhārayed anya-thā śīghram agni-vac chīghra-kāri tat | / trivṛc-chyāmā-kaṣāyeṇa kalkena ca sa-śarkaram ||
sādhayed vidhi-val lehaṃ lihyāt pāṇi-talaṃ tataḥ | / trivṛtā tri-phalā śyāmā pippalī śarkarā madhu ||
modakaḥ sannipātordhva-rakta-śopha-jvarāpahaḥ | / trivṛt sama-sitā tad-vat pippalī-pāda-saṃyutā ||
vamanaṃ phala-saṃyuktaṃ tarpaṇaṃ sa-sitā-madhu | / sa-sitaṃ vā jalaṃ kṣaudra-yuktaṃ vā madhukodakam ||
kṣīraṃ vā rasam ikṣor vā śuddhasyān-antaro vidhiḥ | / yathā-svaṃ mantha-peyādiḥ prayojyo rakṣatā balam ||
mantho jvarokto drākṣādiḥ pitta-ghnair vā phalaiḥ kṛtaḥ | / madhu-kharjūra-mṛdvīkā-parūṣaka-sitāmbhasā ||
mantho vā pañca-sāreṇa sa-ghṛtair lāja-saktubhiḥ | / dāḍimāmalakāmlo vā mandāgny-amlābhilāṣiṇām ||
kamalotpala-kiñjalka-pṛśniparṇī-priyaṅgukāḥ | / uśīraṃ śabaraṃ lodhraṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ ku-candanam ||
hrīveraṃ dhātakī-puṣpaṃ bilva-madhyaṃ durālabhā | / ardhārdhair vihitāḥ peyā vakṣyante pāda-yaugikāḥ ||
bhūnimba-sevya-jaladā masūrāḥ pṛśniparṇy api | / vidārigandhā mudgāś ca balā sarpir hareṇukāḥ ||
jāṅgalāni ca māṃsāni śīta-vīryāṇi sādhayet | / pṛthak pṛthag jale teṣāṃ yavāgūḥ kalpayed rase ||
śītāḥ sa-śarkarā-kṣaudrās tad-van māṃsa-rasān api | / īṣad-amlān an-amlān vā ghṛta-bhṛṣṭān sa-śarkarān ||
śūka-śimbī-bhavaṃ dhānyaṃ rakte śākaṃ ca śasyate | / anna-sva-rūpa-vijñāne yad uktaṃ laghu-śītalam ||
pūrvoktam ambu pānīyaṃ pañca-mūlena vā śṛtam | / laghunā śṛta-śītaṃ vā madhv-ambho vā phalāmbu vā ||
śaśaḥ sa-vāstukaḥ śasto vibandhe tittiriḥ punaḥ | / udumbarasya niryūhe sādhito mārute 'dhike ||
plakṣasya barhiṇas tad-van nyagrodhasya ca kukkuṭaḥ | / yat kiñ-cid rakta-pittasya nidānaṃ tac ca varjayet ||
vāsā-rasena phalinī-mṛl-lodhrāñjana-mākṣikam | / pittāsṛk śamayet pītaṃ niryāso vāṭarūṣakāt ||
śarkarā-madhu-saṃyuktaḥ kevalo vā śṛto 'pi vā | / vṛṣaḥ sadyo jayaty asraṃ sa hy asya param auṣadham ||
paṭola-mālatī-nimba-candana-dvaya-padmakam | / lodhro vṛṣas taṇḍulīyaḥ kṛṣṇā mṛn madayantikā ||
śatāvarī gopakanyā kākolyau madhuyaṣṭikā | / rakta-pitta-harāḥ kvāthās trayaḥ sa-madhu-śarkarāḥ ||
palāśa-valka-kvātho vā su-śītaḥ śarkarānvitaḥ | / lihyād vā madhu-sarpirbhyāṃ gavāśva-śakṛto rasam ||
sa-kṣaudraṃ grathite rakte lihyāt pārāvatāc chakṛt | / ati-niḥsruta-raktaś ca kṣaudreṇa rudhiraṃ pibet ||
jāṅgalaṃ bhakṣayed vājam āmaṃ pitta-yutaṃ yakṛt | / candanośīra-jalada-lāja-mudga-kaṇā-yavaiḥ ||
balā-jale paryuṣitaiḥ kaṣāyo rakta-pitta-hā | / prasādaś candanāmbho-ja-sevya-mṛd-bhṛṣṭa-loṣṭa-jaḥ ||
su-śītaḥ sa-sitā-kṣaudraḥ śoṇitāti-pravṛtti-jit | / āpothya vā nave kumbhe plāvayed ikṣu-gaṇḍikāḥ ||
sthitaṃ tad guptam ākāśe rātriṃ prātaḥ srutaṃ jalam | / madhu-mad vikacāmbho-ja-kṛtottaṃsaṃ ca tad-guṇam ||
ye ca pitta-jvare coktāḥ kaṣāyās tāṃś ca yojayet | / kaṣāyair vividhair ebhir dīpte 'gnau vijite kaphe ||
rakta-pittaṃ na cec chāmyet tatra vātolbaṇe payaḥ | / yuñjyāc chāgaṃ śṛtaṃ tad-vad gavyaṃ pañca-guṇe 'mbhasi ||
pañca-mūlena laghunā śṛtaṃ vā sa-sitā-madhu | / jīvakarṣabhaka-drākṣā-balā-gokṣura-nāgaraiḥ ||
pṛthak pṛthak śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ sa-ghṛtaṃ sitayātha-vā | / gokaṇṭakābhīru-śṛtaṃ parṇinībhis tathā payaḥ ||
hanty āśu raktaṃ sa-rujaṃ viśeṣān mūtra-mārga-gam | / viṇ-mārga-ge viśeṣeṇa hitaṃ moca-rasena tu ||
vaṭa-prarohair śuṅgair vā śuṇṭhy-udīcyotpalair api | / raktātīsāra-dur-nāma-cikitsāṃ cātra kalpayet ||
pītvā kaṣāyān payasā bhuñjīta payasaiva ca | / kaṣāya-yogair ebhir vā vipakvaṃ pāyayed ghṛtam ||
sa-mūla-mastakaṃ kṣuṇṇaṃ vṛṣam aṣṭa-guṇe 'mbhasi | / paktvāṣṭāṃśāvaśeṣeṇa ghṛtaṃ tena vipācayet ||
tat-puṣpa-garbhaṃ tac chītaṃ sa-kṣaudraṃ pitta-śoṇitam | / pitta-gulma-jvara-śvāsa-kāsa-hṛd-roga-kāmalāḥ ||
timira-bhrama-vīsarpa-svara-sādāṃś ca nāśayet | / palāśa-vṛnta-sva-rase tad-garbhaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ pacet ||
sa-kṣaudraṃ tac ca rakta-ghnaṃ tathaiva trāyamāṇayā | / rakte sa-picche sa-kaphe grathite kaṇṭha-mārga-ge ||
lihyān mākṣika-sarpirbhyāṃ kṣāram utpala-nāla-jam | / pṛthak pṛthak tathāmbho-ja-reṇu-śyāmā-madhūka-jam ||
gudāgame viśeṣeṇa śoṇite vastir iṣyate | / ghrāṇa-ge rudhire śuddhe nāvanaṃ cānuṣecayet ||
kaṣāya-yogān pūrvoktān kṣīrekṣv-ādi-rasāplutān | / kṣīrādīn sa-sitāṃs toyaṃ kevalaṃ vā jalaṃ hitaṃ ||
raso dāḍima-puṣpāṇām āmrāsthnaḥ śādvalasya vā | / kalpayec chīta-vargaṃ ca pradehābhyañjanādiṣu ||
yac ca pitta-jvare proktaṃ bahir antaś ca bheṣajam | / rakta-pitte hitaṃ tac ca kṣata-kṣīṇe hitaṃ ca yat ||
kevalānila-jaṃ kāsaṃ snehair ādāv upācaret | / vāta-ghna-siddhaiḥ snigdhaiś ca peyā-yūṣa-rasādibhiḥ ||
lehair dhūmais tathābhyaṅga-sveda-sekāvagāhanaiḥ | / vastibhir baddha-viḍ-vātaṃ sa-pittaṃ tūrdhva-bhaktikaiḥ ||
ghṛtaiḥ kṣīraiś ca sa-kaphaṃ jayet sneha-virecanaiḥ | / guḍūcī-kaṇṭakārībhyāṃ pṛthak triṃśat-palād rase ||
prasthaḥ siddho ghṛtād vāta-kāsa-nud vahni-dīpanaḥ | / kṣāra-rāsnā-vacā-hiṅgu-pāṭhā-yaṣṭy-āhva-dhānyakaiḥ ||
dvi-śāṇaiḥ sarpiṣaḥ prasthaṃ pañca-kola-yutaiḥ pacet | / daśa-mūlasya niryūhe pīto maṇḍānupāyinā ||
sa kāsa-śvāsa-hṛt-pārśva-grahaṇī-roga-gulma-nut | / droṇe 'pāṃ sādhayed rāsnā-daśa-mūla-śatāvarīḥ ||
palonmitā dvi-kuḍavaṃ kulatthaṃ badaraṃ yavaṃ | / tulārdhaṃ cāja-māṃsasya tena sādhyaṃ ghṛtāḍhakam ||
sama-kṣīraṃ palāṃśaiś ca jīvanīyaiḥ samīkṣya tat | / prayuktaṃ vāta-rogeṣu pāna-nāvana-vastibhiḥ ||
pañca-kāsāñ chiraḥ-kampaṃ yoni-vaṅkṣaṇa-vedanām | / sarvāṅgaikāṅga-rogāṃś ca sa-plīhordhvānilāñ jayet ||
vidāry-ādi-gaṇa-kvātha-kalka-siddhaṃ ca kāsa-jit | / aśoka-bīja-kṣavaka-jantughnāñjana-padmakaiḥ ||
sa-viḍaiś ca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ tac-cūrṇaṃ vā ghṛta-plutam | / lihyāt payaś cānupibed ājaṃ kāsāti-pīḍitaḥ ||
viḍaṅgaṃ nāgaraṃ rāsnā pippalī hiṅgu saindhavam | / bhārgī kṣāraś ca tac cūrṇaṃ pibed vā ghṛta-mātrayā ||
sa-kaphe 'nila-je kāse śvāsa-hidhmā-hatāgniṣu | / durālabhāṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ śaṭhīṃ drākṣāṃ sitopalām ||
lihyāt karkaṭaśṛṅgīṃ ca kāse tailena vāta-je | / duḥsparśāṃ pippalīṃ mustāṃ bhārgīṃ karkaṭakīṃ śaṭhīm ||
purāṇa-guḍa-tailābhyāṃ cūrṇitāny avalehayet | / tad-vat sa-kṛṣṇāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ ca sa-bhārgīṃ tad-vad eva ca ||
pibec ca kṛṣṇāṃ koṣṇena salilena sa-saindhavām | / mastunā sa-sitāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ dadhnā vā kaṇa-reṇukām ||
pibed badara-majjño vā madirā-dadhi-mastubhiḥ | / atha-vā pippalī-kalkaṃ ghṛta-bhṛṣṭaṃ sa-saindhavam ||
kāsī sa-pīnaso dhūmaṃ snaihikaṃ vidhinā pibet | / hidhmā-śvāsokta-dhūmāṃś ca kṣīra-māṃsa-rasāśanaḥ ||
grāmyānūpaudakaiḥ śāli-yava-godhūma-ṣaṣṭikān | / rasair māṣātmaguptānāṃ yūṣair vā bhojayed dhitān ||
yavānī-pippalī-bilva-madhya-nāgara-citrakaiḥ | / rāsnājājī-pṛthakparṇī-palāśa-śaṭhi-pauṣkaraiḥ ||
siddhāṃ snigdhāmla-lavaṇāṃ peyām anila-je pibet | / kaṭī-hṛt-pārśva-koṣṭhārti-śvāsa-hidhmā-praṇāśanīm ||
daśa-mūla-rase tad-vat pañca-kola-guḍānvitām | / pibet peyāṃ sama-tilāṃ kṣaireyīṃ vā sa-saindhavām ||
mātsya-kaukkuṭa-vārāhair māṃsair vā sājya-saindhavām | / vāstuko vāyasī-śākaṃ kāsaghnaḥ suniṣaṇṇakaḥ ||
kaṇṭakāryāḥ phalaṃ pattraṃ bālaṃ śuṣkaṃ ca mūlakam | / snehās tailādayo bhakṣyāḥ kṣīrekṣu-rasa-gauḍikāḥ ||
dadhi-mastv-āranālāmla-phalāmbu-madirāḥ pibet | / pitta-kāse tu sa-kaphe vamanaṃ sarpiṣā hitam ||
tathā madana-kāśmarya-madhuka-kvathitair jalaiḥ | / phala-yaṣṭy-āhva-kalkair vā vidārīkṣu-rasāplutaiḥ ||
pitta-kāse tanu-kaphe trivṛtāṃ madhurair yutām | / yuñjyād virekāya yutāṃ ghana-śleṣmaṇi tiktakaiḥ ||
hṛta-doṣo himaṃ svādu snigdhaṃ saṃsarjanaṃ bhajet | / ghane kaphe tu śiśiraṃ rūkṣaṃ tiktopasaṃhitam ||
lehaḥ paitte sitā-dhātrī-kṣaudra-drākṣā-himotpalaiḥ | / sa-ghṛtaḥ sānile hitaḥ sa-kaphe sābda-maricaḥ ||
mṛdvīkārdha-śataṃ triṃśat pippalīḥ śarkarā-palam | / lehayen madhunā gor vā kṣīra-pasya śakṛd-rasam ||
tvag-elā-vyoṣa-mṛdvīkā-pippalī-mūla-pauṣkaraiḥ | / lāja-mustā-śaṭhī-rāsnā-dhātrī-phala-vibhītakaiḥ ||
śarkarā-kṣaudra-sarpirbhir leho hṛd-roga-kāsa-hā | / madhurair jāṅgala-rasair yava-śyāmāka-kodravāḥ ||
mudgādi-yūṣaiḥ śākaiś ca tiktakair mātrayā hitāḥ | / ghana-śleṣmaṇi lehāś ca tiktakā madhu-saṃyutāḥ ||
śālayaḥ syus tanu-kaphe ṣaṣṭikāś ca rasādibhiḥ | / śarkarāmbho 'nu-pānārthaṃ drākṣekṣu-sva-rasāḥ payaḥ ||
kākolī-bṛhatī-medā-dvayaiḥ sa-vṛṣa-nāgaraiḥ | / pitta-kāse rasa-kṣīra-peyā-yūṣān prakalpayet ||
drākṣāṃ kaṇāṃ pañca-mūlaṃ tṛṇākhyaṃ ca pacej jale | / tena kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ śītaṃ pibet sa-madhu-śarkaram ||
sādhitāṃ tena peyāṃ vā su-śītāṃ madhunānvitām | / śaṭhī-hrīvera-bṛhatī-śarkarā-viśva-bheṣajam ||
piṣṭvā rasaṃ pibet pūtaṃ vastreṇa ghṛta-mūrchitam | / medāṃ vidārīṃ kākolīṃ svayaṅguptā-phalaṃ balām ||
śarkarāṃ jīvakaṃ mudga-māṣaparṇyau durālabhām | / kalkī-kṛtya pacet sarpiḥ kṣīreṇāṣṭa-guṇena tat ||
pāna-bhojana-leheṣu prayuktaṃ pitta-kāsa-jit | / lihyād vā cūrṇam eteṣāṃ kaṣāyam atha-vā pibet ||
kapha-kāsī pibed ādau surakāṣṭhāt pradīpitāt | / snehaṃ parisrutaṃ vyoṣa-yava-kṣārāvacūrṇitam ||
snigdhaṃ virecayed ūrdhvam adho mūrdhni ca yuktitaḥ | / tīkṣṇair virekair balinaṃ saṃsargīṃ cāsya yojayet ||
yava-mudga-kulatthānnair uṣṇa-rūkṣaiḥ kaṭūtkaṭaiḥ | / kāsamardaka-vārtāka-vyāghrī-kṣāra-kaṇānvitaiḥ ||
dhānva-baila-rasaiḥ snehais tila-sarṣapa-nimba-jaiḥ | / daśa-mūlāmbu gharmāmbu madyaṃ madhv-ambu vā pibet ||
mūlaiḥ pauṣkara-śamyāka-paṭolaiḥ saṃsthitaṃ niśām | / pibed vāri saha-kṣaudraṃ kāleṣv annasya vā triṣu ||
pippalī pippalī-mūlaṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ vibhītakam | / śikhi-kukkuṭa-picchānāṃ maṣī kṣāro yavodbhavaḥ ||
viśālā pippalī-mūlaṃ trivṛtā ca madhu-dravāḥ | / kapha-kāsa-harā lehās trayaḥ ślokārdha-yojitāḥ ||
madhunā maricaṃ lihyān madhunaiva ca joṅgakam | / pṛthag rasāṃś ca madhunā vyāghrī-vārtāka-bhṛṅga-jān ||
kāsaghnasyāśva-śakṛtaḥ surasasyāsitasya ca | / devadāru-śaṭhī-rāsnā-karkaṭākhyā-durālabhāḥ ||
pippalī nāgaraṃ mustaṃ pathyā dhātrī sitopalā | / lājāḥ sitopalā sarpiḥ śṛṅgī dhātrī-phalodbhavā ||
madhu-taila-yutā lehās trayo vātānuge kaphe | / dve pale dāḍimād aṣṭau guḍād vyoṣāt pala-trayam ||
rocanaṃ dīpanaṃ svaryaṃ pīnasa-śvāsa-kāsa-jit | / guḍa-kṣāroṣaṇa-kaṇā-dāḍimaṃ śvāsa-kāsa-jit ||
kramāt pala-dvayārdhākṣa-karṣārdhākṣa-palonmitam | / pibej jvaroktaṃ pathyādi sa-śṛṅgīkaṃ ca pācanam ||
atha-vā dīpyaka-trivṛd-viśālā-ghana-pauṣkaram | / sa-kaṇaṃ kvathitaṃ mūtre kapha-kāsī jale 'pi vā ||
taila-bhṛṣṭaṃ ca vaidehī-kalkākṣaṃ sa-sitopalam | / pāyayet kapha-kāsa-ghnaṃ kulattha-salilāplutam ||
daśa-mūlāḍhake prasthaṃ ghṛtasyākṣa-samaiḥ pacet | / puṣkarāhva-śaṭhī-bilva-surasā-vyoṣa-hiṅgubhiḥ ||
peyānu-pānaṃ tat sarva-vāta-śleṣmāmayāpaham | / nirguṇḍī-pattra-niryāsa-sādhitaṃ kāsa-jid ghṛtam ||

punarnava-śivātikā-sarala-kāsamardāmṛtā- || 58a || / paṭola-bṛhatī-phaṇijjaka-rasaiḥ payaḥ-saṃyutaiḥ || 58b || / ghṛtaṃ tri-kaṭunā ca siddham upayujya sañjāyate || 58c || / na kāsa-viṣama-jvara-kṣaya-gudāṅkurebhyo bhayam || 58d ||
ghṛta-prasthaṃ balā-vyoṣa-viḍaṅga-śaṭhi-dāḍimaiḥ | / sauvarcala-yava-kṣāra-mūlāmalaka-pauṣkaraiḥ ||
vṛścīva-bṛhatī-pathyā-yavānī-citrakarddhibhiḥ | / mṛdvīkā-cavya-varṣābhū-durālabhāmla-vetasaiḥ ||
śṛṅgī-tāmalakī-bhārgī-rāsnā-gokṣurakaiḥ pacet | / kalkais tat sarva-kāseṣu śvāsa-hidhmāsu ceṣyate ||
kaṇṭakārī-ghṛtaṃ caitat kapha-vyādhi-vināśanam | / paced vyāghrī-tulāṃ kṣuṇṇāṃ vahe 'pām āḍhaka-sthite ||
kṣipet pūte tu sañcūrṇya vyoṣa-rāsnāmṛtāgnikān | / śṛṅgī-bhārgī-ghana-granthi-dhanvayāsān palārdhakān ||
sarpiṣaḥ ṣo-ḍaśa-palaṃ catvāriṃśat palāni ca | / matsyaṇḍikāyāḥ śuddhāyāḥ punaś ca tad adhiśrayet ||
darvī-lepini śīte ca pṛthag dvi-kuḍavaṃ kṣipet | / pippalīnāṃ tavakṣīryā mākṣikasyā-navasya ca ||
leho 'yaṃ gulma-hṛd-roga-dur-nāma-śvāsa-kāsa-jit | / śamanaṃ ca pibed dhūmaṃ śodhanaṃ bahale kaphe ||
manaḥśilāla-madhuka-māṃsī-musteṅgudī-tvacaḥ | / dhūmaṃ kāsa-ghna-vidhinā pītvā kṣīraṃ pibed anu ||
niṣṭhyūtānte guḍa-yutaṃ koṣṇaṃ dhūmo nihanti saḥ | / vāta-śleṣmottarān kāsān a-cireṇa ciran-tanān ||
tamakaḥ kapha-kāse tu syāc cet pittānubandha-jaḥ | / pitta-kāsa-kriyāṃ tatra yathāvasthaṃ prayojayet ||
kaphānubandhe pavane kuryāt kapha-harāṃ kriyām | / pittānubandhayor vāta-kaphayoḥ pitta-nāśinīm ||
vāta-śleṣmātmake śuṣke snigdham ārdre virūkṣaṇam | / kāse karma sa-pitte tu kapha-je tikta-saṃyutam ||
urasy antaḥ-kṣate sadyo lākṣāṃ kṣaudra-yutāṃ pibet | / kṣīreṇa śālīn jīrṇe 'dyāt kṣīreṇaiva sa-śarkarān ||
pārśva-vasti-sa-ruk cālpa-pittāgnis tāṃ surā-yutām | / bhinna-viṭkaḥ sa-mustātiviṣā-pāṭhāṃ sa-vatsakām ||
lākṣāṃ sarpir madhūcchiṣṭaṃ jīvanīyaṃ gaṇaṃ sitām | / tvakkṣīrīṃ samitaṃ kṣīre paktvā dīptānalaḥ pibet ||
ikṣvārikā-bisa-granthi-padma-kesara-candanaiḥ | / śṛtaṃ payo madhu-yutaṃ sandhānārthaṃ pibet kṣatī ||
yavānāṃ cūrṇam āmānāṃ kṣīre siddhaṃ ghṛtānvitam | / jvara-dāhe sitā-kṣaudra-saktūn vā payasā pibet ||
kāsa-vāṃs tu pibet sarpir madhurauṣadha-sādhitam | / guḍodakaṃ vā kvathitaṃ sa-kṣaudra-maricaṃ hitam ||
cūrṇam āmalakānāṃ vā kṣīre pakvaṃ ghṛtānvitam | / rasāyana-vidhānena pippalīr vā prayojayet ||
kāsī parvāsthi-śūlī ca lihyāt sa-ghṛta-mākṣikāḥ | / madhūka-madhuka-drākṣā-tvakkṣīrī-pippalī-balāḥ ||
tri-jātam ardha-karṣāṃśaṃ pippaly-ardha-palaṃ sitā | / drākṣā madhūkaṃ kharjūraṃ palāśaṃ ślakṣṇa-cūrṇitam ||
madhunā guṭikā ghnanti tā vṛṣyāḥ pitta-śoṇitam | / kāsa-śvāsā-ruci-cchardi-mūrchā-hidhmā-mada-bhramān ||
kṣata-kṣaya-svara-bhraṃśa-plīha-śoṣāḍhya-mārutān | / rakta-niṣṭhīva-hṛt-pārśva-ruk-pipāsā-jvarān api ||
varṣābhū-śarkarā-rakta-śāli-taṇḍula-jaṃ rajaḥ | / rakta-ṣṭhīvī pibet siddhaṃ drākṣā-rasa-payo-ghṛtaiḥ ||
madhūka-madhuka-kṣīra-siddhaṃ vā taṇḍulīyakam | / yathā-svaṃ mārga-visṛte rakte kuryāc ca bheṣajam ||
mūḍha-vātas tv ajā-medaḥ surā-bhṛṣṭaṃ sa-saindhavam | / kṣāmaḥ kṣīṇaḥ kṣatorasko manda-nidro 'gni-dīpti-mān ||
śṛta-kṣīra-sareṇādyāt sa-ghṛta-kṣaudra-śarkaram | / śarkarā-yava-godhūmaṃ jīvakarṣabhakau madhu ||
śṛta-kṣīrānu-pānaṃ vā lihyāt kṣīṇaḥ kṣataḥ kṛśaḥ | / kravyāt-piśita-niryūhaṃ ghṛta-bhṛṣṭaṃ pibec ca saḥ ||
pippalī-kṣaudra-saṃyuktaṃ māṃsa-śoṇita-vardhanam | / nyagrodhodumbarāśvattha-plakṣa-śāla-priyaṅgubhiḥ ||
tāla-mastaka-jambū-tvak-priyālaiś ca sa-padmakaiḥ | / sāśvakarṇaiḥ śṛtāt kṣīrād adyāj jātena sarpiṣā ||
śāly-odanaṃ kṣatoraskaḥ kṣīṇa-śukra-balendriyaḥ | / vāta-pittārdite 'bhyaṅgo gātra-bhede ghṛtair mataḥ ||
tailaiś cānila-roga-ghnaiḥ pīḍite mātariśvanā | / hṛt-pārśvārtiṣu pānaṃ syāj jīvanīyasya sarpiṣaḥ ||
kuryād vā vāta-roga-ghnaṃ pitta-raktā-virodhi yat | / yaṣṭy-āhva-nāgabalayoḥ kvāthe kṣīra-same ghṛtam ||
payasyā-pippalī-vāṃśī-kalkaiḥ siddhaṃ kṣate hitam | / jīvanīyo gaṇaḥ śuṇṭhī varī vīrā punarnavā ||
balā-bhārgī-svaguptarddhi-śaṭhī-tāmalakī-kaṇāḥ | / śṛṅgāṭakaṃ payasyā ca pañca-mūlaṃ ca yal laghu ||
drākṣākṣoṭādi ca phalaṃ madhura-snigdha-bṛṃhaṇam | / taiḥ pacet sarpiṣaḥ prasthaṃ karṣāṃśaiḥ ślakṣṇa-kalkitaiḥ ||
kṣīra-dhātrī-vidārīkṣu-cchāga-māṃsa-rasānvitam | / prasthārdhaṃ madhunaḥ śīte śarkarārdha-tulā-rajaḥ ||
palārdhakaṃ ca marica-tvag-elā-pattra-kesaram | / vinīya prasṛtaṃ tasmāl lihyān mātrāṃ yathā-balam ||
amṛta-prāśam ity etan narāṇām amṛtaṃ ghṛtam | / sudhāmṛta-rasaṃ prāśyaṃ kṣīra-māṃsa-rasāśinā ||
naṣṭa-śukra-kṣata-kṣīṇa-dur-bala-vyādhi-karśitān | / strī-prasaktān kṛśān varṇa-svara-hīnāṃś ca bṛṃhayet ||
kāsa-hidhmā-jvara-śvāsa-dāha-tṛṣṇāsra-pitta-nut | / putra-daṃ chardi-mūrchā-hṛd-yoni-mūtrāmayāpaham ||
śvadaṃṣṭrośīra-mañjiṣṭhā-balā-kāśmarya-kaṭtṛṇam | / darbha-mūlaṃ pṛthakparṇīṃ palāśarṣabhakau sthirām ||
pālikāni pacet teṣāṃ rase kṣīra-catur-guṇe | / kalkaiḥ svaguptā-jīvantī-medarṣabhaka-jīvakaiḥ ||
śatāvary-ṛddhi-mṛdvīkā-śarkarā-śrāvaṇī-bisaiḥ | / prasthaḥ siddho ghṛtād vāta-pitta-hṛd-roga-śūla-nut ||
mūtra-kṛcchra-pramehārśaḥ-kāsa-śoṣa-kṣayāpahaḥ | / dhanuḥ-strī-madya-bhārādhva-khinnānāṃ bala-māṃsa-daḥ ||
madhukāṣṭa-pala-drākṣā-prastha-kvāthe paced ghṛtam | / pippaly-aṣṭa-pale kalke prasthaṃ siddhe ca śītale ||
pṛthag aṣṭa-palaṃ kṣaudra-śarkarābhyāṃ vimiśrayet | / sama-saktu kṣata-kṣīṇa-rakta-gulmeṣu tad dhitam ||
dhātrī-phala-vidārīkṣu-jīvanīya-rasād ghṛtāt | / gavyājayoś ca payasoḥ prasthaṃ prasthaṃ vipācayet ||
siddha-śīte sitā-kṣaudraṃ dvi-prasthaṃ vinayet tataḥ | / yakṣmāpasmāra-pittāsṛk-kāsa-meha-kṣayāpaham ||
vayaḥ-sthāpanam āyuṣyaṃ māṃsa-śukra-bala-pradam | / ghṛtaṃ tu pitte 'bhyadhike lihyād vāte 'dhike pibet ||
līḍhaṃ nirvāpayet pittam alpa-tvād dhanti nānalam | / ākrāmaty anilaṃ pītam ūṣmāṇaṃ niruṇaddhi ca ||
kṣāma-kṣīṇa-kṛśāṅgānām etāny eva ghṛtāni tu | / tvakkṣīrī-śarkarā-lāja-cūrṇaiḥ styānāni yojayet ||
sarpir-guḍān sa-madhv-aṃśān kṛtvā dadyāt payo 'nu ca | / reto vīryaṃ balaṃ puṣṭiṃ tair āśu-taram āpnuyāt ||
vīta-tvag-asthi-kūṣmāṇḍa-tulāṃ svinnāṃ punaḥ pacet | / ghaṭṭayan sarpiṣaḥ prasthe kṣaudra-varṇe 'tra ca kṣipet ||
khaṇḍāc chataṃ kaṇā-śuṇṭhyor dvi-palaṃ jīrakād api | / tri-jāta-dhānya-maricaṃ pṛthag ardha-palāṃśakam ||
avatārita-śīte ca dattvā kṣaudraṃ ghṛtārdhakam | / khajenāmathya ca sthāpyaṃ tan nihanty upayojitam ||
kāsa-hidhmā-jvara-śvāsa-rakta-pitta-kṣata-kṣayān | / uraḥ-sandhāna-jananaṃ medhā-smṛti-bala-pradam ||
aśvibhyāṃ vihitaṃ hṛdyaṃ kūṣmāṇḍaka-rasāyanam | / piben nāgabalā-mūlasyārdha-karṣābhivardhitam ||
palaṃ kṣīra-yutaṃ māsaṃ kṣīra-vṛttir an-anna-bhuk | / eṣa prayogaḥ puṣṭy-āyur-bala-varṇa-karaḥ param ||
maṇḍūkaparṇyāḥ kalpo 'yaṃ yaṣṭyā viśvauṣadhasya ca | / pāda-śeṣaṃ jala-droṇe pacen nāgabalā-tulām ||
tena kvāthena tulyāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ ca sādhayet | / palārdhikaiś cātibalā-balā-yaṣṭī-punarnavaiḥ ||
prapauṇḍarīka-kāśmarya-priyāla-kapikacchubhiḥ | / aśvagandhā-sitābhīru-medā-yugma-trikaṇṭakaiḥ ||
kākolī-kṣīra-kākolī-kṣīraśuklā-dvi-jīrakaiḥ | / mṛṇāla-bisa-kharjūra-śṛṅgāṭaka-kaserukaiḥ ||
etan nāgabalā-sarpiḥ pitta-rakta-kṣata-kṣayān | / jayet tṛḍ-bhrama-dāhāṃś ca bala-puṣṭi-karaṃ param ||
varṇyam āyuṣyam ojasyaṃ valī-palita-nāśanam | / upayujya ca ṣaṇ māsān vṛddho 'pi taruṇāyate ||
dīpte 'gnau vidhir eṣa syān mande dīpana-pācanaḥ | / yakṣmoktaḥ kṣatināṃ śasto grāhī śakṛti tu drave ||
daśa-mūlaṃ svayaṅguptāṃ śaṅkhapuṣpīṃ śaṭhīṃ balām | / hasti-pippaly-apāmārga-pippalī-mūla-citrakān ||
bhārgīṃ puṣkara-mūlaṃ ca dvi-palāṃśaṃ yavāḍhakam | / harītakī-śataṃ caikaṃ jala-pañcāḍhake pacet ||
yava-svede kaṣāyaṃ taṃ pūtaṃ tac cābhayā-śatam | / paced guḍa-tulāṃ dattvā kuḍavaṃ ca pṛthag ghṛtāt ||
tailāt sa-pippalī-cūrṇāt siddha-śīte ca mākṣikāt | / lehaṃ dve cābhaye nityam ataḥ khāded rasāyanāt ||
tad valī-palitaṃ hanyād varṇāyur-bala-vardhanam | / pañca-kāsān kṣayaṃ śvāsaṃ sa-hidhmaṃ viṣama-jvaram ||
meha-gulma-grahaṇy-arśo-hṛd-rogā-ruci-pīnasān | / agastya-vihitaṃ dhanyam idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rasāyanam ||
daśa-mūlaṃ balāṃ mūrvāṃ haridre pippalī-dvayam | / pāṭhāśvagandhāpāmārga-svaguptātiviṣāmṛtāḥ ||
bāla-bilvaṃ trivṛd-dantī-mūlaṃ pattraṃ ca citrakāt | / payasyāṃ kuṭajaṃ hiṃsrāṃ puṣpaṃ sāraṃ ca bījakāt ||
boṭa-sthavira-bhallāta-vikaṅkata-śatāvarīḥ | / pūti-karañja-śamyāka-candralekhā-sahācaram ||
śaubhāñjanaka-nimba-tvag-ikṣuraṃ ca palāṃśakam | / pathyā-sahasraṃ sa-śataṃ yavānāṃ cāḍhaka-dvayam ||
paced aṣṭa-guṇe toye yava-svede 'vatārayet | / pūte kṣipet sa-pathye ca tatra jīrṇa-guḍāt tulām ||
tailājya-dhātrī-rasataḥ prasthaṃ prasthaṃ tataḥ punaḥ | / adhiśrayen mṛdāv agnau darvī-lepe 'vatārya ca ||
śīte prastha-dvayaṃ kṣaudrāt pippalī-kuḍavaṃ kṣipet | / cūrṇī-kṛtaṃ tri-jātāc ca tri-palaṃ nikhanet tataḥ ||
dhānye purāṇa-kumbha-sthaṃ māsaṃ khādec ca pūrva-vat | / rasāyanaṃ vasiṣṭhoktam etat pūrva-guṇādhikam ||
svasthānāṃ niṣ-parīhāraṃ sarvartuṣu ca śasyate | / pālikaṃ saindhavaṃ śuṇṭhī dve ca sauvarcalāt pale ||
kuḍavāṃśāni vṛkṣāmlaṃ dāḍimaṃ pattram ārjakāt | / ekaikāṃ maricājājyor dhānyakād dve caturthike ||
śarkarāyāḥ palāny atra daśa dve ca pradāpayet | / kṛtvā cūrṇam ato mātrām anna-pāneṣu dāpayet ||
rucyaṃ tad dīpanaṃ balyaṃ pārśvārti-śvāsa-kāsa-jit | / ekāṃ ṣo-ḍaśikāṃ dhānyād dve dve cājāji-dīpyakāt ||
tābhyāṃ dāḍima-vṛkṣāmle dvir dviḥ sauvarcalāt palam | / śuṇṭhyāḥ karṣaṃ dadhitthasya madhyāt pañca palāni ca ||
tac cūrṇaṃ ṣo-ḍaśa-palaiḥ śarkarāyā vimiśrayet | / ṣāḍavo 'yaṃ pradeyaḥ syād anna-pāneṣu pūrva-vat ||
vidhiś ca yakṣma-vihito yathāvasthaṃ kṣate hitaḥ | / nivṛtte kṣata-doṣe tu kaphe vṛddha uraḥ śiraḥ ||
dālyate kāsino yasya sa nā dhūmān pibed imān | / dvi-medā-dvi-balā-yaṣṭī-kalkaiḥ kṣaume su-bhāvite ||
vartiṃ kṛtvā pibed dhūmaṃ jīvanīya-ghṛtānupaḥ | / manaḥśilā-palāśājagandhā-tvakkṣīri-nāgaraiḥ ||
tad-vad evānu-pānaṃ tu śarkarekṣu-guḍodakam | / piṣṭvā manaḥśilāṃ tulyām ārdrayā vaṭa-śuṅgayā ||
sa-sarpiṣkaṃ pibed dhūmaṃ tittiri-pratibhojanam | / kṣaya-je bṛṃhaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ kuryād agneś ca vardhanam ||
bahu-doṣāya sa-snehaṃ mṛdu dadyād virecanam | / śamyākena trivṛtayā mṛdvīkā-rasa-yuktayā ||
tilvakasya kaṣāyeṇa vidārī-sva-rasena ca | / sarpiḥ siddhaṃ pibed yuktyā kṣīṇa-deho viśodhanam ||
pitte kaphe dhātuṣu ca kṣīṇeṣu kṣaya-kāsa-vān | / ghṛtaṃ karkaṭakī-kṣīra-dvi-balā-sādhitaṃ pibet ||
vidārībhiḥ kadambair vā tāla-sasyaiś ca sādhitam | / ghṛtaṃ payaś ca mūtrasya vaivarṇye kṛcchra-nirgame ||
śūne sa-vedane meḍhre pāyau sa-śroṇi-vaṅkṣaṇe | / ghṛta-maṇḍena laghunānuvāsyo miśrakeṇa vā ||
jāṅgalair pratibhuktasya vartakādyā bile-śayāḥ | / krama-śaḥ prasahās tad-vat prayojyāḥ piśitāśinaḥ ||
auṣṇyāt pramāthi-bhāvāc ca srotobhyaś cyāvayanti te | / kaphaṃ śuddhaiś ca taiḥ puṣṭiṃ kuryāt samyag vahan rasaḥ ||
cavikā-tri-phalā-bhārgī-daśa-mūlaiḥ sa-citrakaiḥ | / kulattha-pippalī-mūla-pāṭhā-kola-yavair jale ||
śṛtair nāgara-duḥsparśā-pippalī-śaṭhi-pauṣkaraiḥ | / piṣṭaiḥ karkaṭaśṛṅgyā ca samaiḥ sarpir vipācayet ||
siddhe 'smiṃś cūrṇitau kṣārau dvau pañca lavaṇāni ca | / dattvā yuktyā piben mātrāṃ kṣaya-kāsa-nipīḍitaḥ ||
kāsamardābhayā-mustā-pāṭhā-kaṭphala-nāgaraiḥ | / pippalyā kaṭu-rohiṇyā kāśmaryā surasena ca ||
akṣa-mātrair ghṛta-prasthaṃ kṣīra-drākṣā-rasāḍhake | / pacec choṣa-jvara-plīha-sarva-kāsa-haraṃ śivam ||
vṛṣa-vyāghrī-guḍūcīnāṃ pattra-mūla-phalāṅkurāt | / rasa-kalkair ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ hanti kāsa-jvarā-rucīḥ ||
dvi-guṇe dāḍima-rase siddhaṃ vā vyoṣa-saṃyutam | / pibed upari bhuktasya yava-kṣāra-yutaṃ naraḥ ||
pippalī-guḍa-siddhaṃ vā chāga-kṣīra-yutaṃ ghṛtam | / etāny agni-vivṛddhy-arthaṃ sarpīṃṣi kṣaya-kāsinām ||
syur doṣa-baddha-kaṇṭhoraḥ-srotasāṃ ca viśuddhaye | / prasthonmite yava-kvāthe viṃśatiṃ vijayāḥ pacet ||
svinnā mṛditvā tās tasmin purāṇāt ṣaṭ-palaṃ guḍāt | / pippalyā dvi-palaṃ karṣaṃ manohvāyā rasāñjanāt ||
dattvārdhākṣaṃ paced bhūyaḥ sa lehaḥ śvāsa-kāsa-jit | / śvāvidhāṃ sūcayo dagdhāḥ sa-ghṛta-kṣaudra-śarkarāḥ ||
śvāsa-kāsa-harā barhi-pādau vā madhu-sarpiṣā | / eraṇḍa-pattra-kṣāraṃ vā vyoṣa-taila-guḍānvitam ||
lehayet kṣāram evaṃ vā surasairaṇḍa-pattra-jam | / lihyāt try-ūṣaṇa-cūrṇaṃ vā purāṇa-guḍa-sarpiṣā ||
padmakaṃ tri-phalā vyoṣaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ devadāru ca | / balā rāsnā ca tac-cūrṇaṃ samastaṃ sama-śarkaram ||
khāden madhu-ghṛtābhyāṃ vā lihyāt kāsa-haraṃ param | / tad-van marica-cūrṇaṃ vā sa-ghṛta-kṣaudra-śarkaram ||
pathyā-śuṇṭhī-ghana-guḍair guṭikāṃ dhārayen mukhe | / sarveṣu śvāsa-kāseṣu kevalaṃ vā vibhītakam ||
pattra-kalkaṃ ghṛta-bhṛṣṭaṃ tilvakasya sa-śarkaram | / peyā votkārikā chardi-tṛṭ-kāsāmātisāra-jit ||
kaṇṭakārī-rase siddho kṣīraṃ yūṣān rasān api | / sa-gaurāmalakaḥ sāmlaḥ sarva-kāsa-bhiṣag-jitam ||
