ekaikaḥ prasṛtas taila-prasannā-kṣaudra-sarpiṣām | / bilvādi-mūla-kvāthād dvau kaulatthād dvau sa vāta-jit ||
paṭola-nimba-bhūtīka-rāsnā-saptacchadāmbhasaḥ | / prasṛtaḥ pṛthag ājyāc ca vastiḥ sarṣapa-kalka-vān ||
sa pañca-tikto 'bhiṣyanda-kṛmi-kuṣṭha-prameha-hā | / catvāras taila-go-mūtra-dadhi-maṇḍāmla-kāñjikāt ||
prasṛtāḥ sarṣapaiḥ piṣṭair viṭ-saṅgānāha-bhedanaḥ | / payasyekṣu-sthirā-rāsnā-vidārī-kṣaudra-sarpiṣām ||
ekaikaḥ prasṛto vastiḥ kṛṣṇā-kalko vṛṣa-tva-kṛt | / siddha-vastīn ato vakṣye sarva-dā yān prayojayet ||
nir-vyāpado bahu-phalān bala-puṣṭi-karān sukhān | / madhu-taile same karṣaḥ saindhavād dvi-picur miśiḥ ||
eraṇḍa-mūla-kvāthena nirūho mādhutailikaḥ | / rasāyanaṃ pramehārśaḥ-kṛmi-gulmāntra-vṛddhi-nut ||
sa-yaṣṭīmadhukaś caiṣa cakṣuṣyo rakta-pitta-jit | / yāpano ghana-kalkena madhu-taila-rasājya-vān ||
pāyu-jānūru-vṛṣaṇa-vasti-mehana-śūla-jit | / prasṛtāṃśair ghṛta-kṣaudra-vasā-tailaiḥ prakalpayet ||
yāpanaṃ saindhavārdhākṣa-hapuṣārdha-palānvitam | / eraṇḍa-mūla-niḥkvātho madhu-tailaṃ sa-saindhavam ||
eṣa yukta-ratho vastiḥ sa-vacā-pillalī-phalaḥ | / sa kvātho madhu-ṣaḍgranthā-śatāhvā-hiṅgu-saindhavam ||
suradāru ca rāsnā ca vastir doṣa-haraḥ śivaḥ | / pañca-mūlasya niḥkvāthas tailaṃ māgadhikā madhu ||
sa-saindhavaḥ sa-madhukaḥ siddha-vastir iti smṛtaḥ | / dvi-pañca-mūla-tri-phalā-phala-bilvāni pācayet ||
go-mūtre tena piṣṭaiś ca pāṭhā-vatsaka-toyadaiḥ | / sa-phalaiḥ kṣaudra-tailābhyāṃ kṣāreṇa lavaṇena ca ||
yukto vastiḥ kapha-vyādhi-pāṇḍu-roga-viṣūciṣu | / śukrānila-vibandheṣu vasty-āṭope ca pūjitaḥ ||
mustā-pāṭhāmṛtairaṇḍa-balā-rāsnā-punarnavāḥ | / mañjiṣṭhāragvadhośīra-trāyamāṇākṣa-rohiṇīḥ ||
kanīyaḥ pañca-mūlaṃ ca pālikaṃ madanāṣṭakam | / jalāḍhake pacet tac ca pāda-śeṣaṃ parisrutam ||
kṣīra-dvi-prastha-saṃyuktaṃ kṣīra-śeṣaṃ punaḥ pacet | / sa-pāda-jāṅgala-rasaḥ sa-sarpir-madhu-saindhavaḥ ||
piṣṭair yaṣṭī-miśi-śyāmā-kaliṅgaka-rasāñjanaiḥ | / vastiḥ sukhoṣṇo māṃsāgni-bala-śukra-vivardhanaḥ ||
vātāsṛṅ-moha-mehārśo-gulma-viṇ-mūtra-saṅgrahān | / viṣama-jvara-vīsarpa-vardhmādhmāna-pravāhikāḥ ||
vaṅkṣaṇoru-kaṭī-kukṣi-manyā-śrotra-śiro-rujaḥ | / hanyād asṛg-daronmāda-śopha-kāsāśma-kuṇḍalān ||
cakṣuṣyaḥ putra-do rājā yāpanānāṃ rasāyanam | / mṛgāṇāṃ laghu-vadrāṇāṃ daśa-mūlasya cāmbhasā ||
hapuṣā-miśi-gāṅgeyī-kalkair vāta-haraḥ param | / nirūho 'ty-artha-vṛṣyaś ca mahā-sneha-samanvitaḥ ||
mayūraṃ pakṣa-pittāntra-pāda-viṭ-tuṇḍa-varjitam | / laghunā pañca-mūlena pālikena samanvitam ||
paktvā kṣīra-jale kṣīra-śeṣaṃ sa-ghṛta-mākṣikam | / tad vidārī-kaṇā-yaṣṭī-śatāhvā-phala-kalka-vat ||
vastir īṣat-paṭu-yutaḥ paramaṃ bala-śukra-kṛt | / kalpaneyaṃ pṛthak kāryā tittiri-prabhṛtiṣv api ||
viṣkireṣu samasteṣu pratuda-prasaheṣu ca | / jala-cāriṣu tad-vac ca matsyeṣu kṣīra-varjitā ||
godhā-nakula-mārjāra-śalyakondura-jaṃ palam | / pṛthag daśa-palaṃ kṣīre pañca-mūlaṃ ca sādhayet ||
tat payaḥ phala-vaidehī-kalka-dvi-lavaṇānvitam | / sa-sitā-taila-madhv-ājyo vastir yojyo rasāyanam ||
vyāyāma-mathitoraska-kṣīṇendriya-balaujasām | / vibaddha-śukra-viṇ-mūtra-khuḍa-vāta-vikāriṇām ||
gaja-vāji-ratha-kṣobha-bhagna-jarjaritātmanām | / punar-nava-tvaṃ kurute vājī-karaṇam uttamam ||
siddhena payasā bhojyam ātmaguptoccaṭekṣuraiḥ | / snehāṃś cā-yantraṇān siddhān siddha-dravyaiḥ prakalpayet ||
doṣa-ghnāḥ sa-parīhārā vakṣyante sneha-vastayaḥ | / daśa-mūlaṃ balāṃ rāsnām aśvagandhāṃ punarnavām ||
guḍūcyairaṇḍa-bhūtīka-bhārgī-vṛṣaka-rohiṣam | / śatāvarīṃ sahacaraṃ kākanāsāṃ palāṃśakam ||
yava-māṣātasī-kola-kulatthān prasṛtonmitān | / vahe vipācya toyasya droṇa-śeṣeṇa tena ca ||
pacet tailāḍhakaṃ peṣyair jīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ | / anuvāsanam ity etat sarva-vāta-vikāra-nut ||
ānūpānāṃ vasā tad-vaj jīvanīyopasādhitā | / śatāhvā-ciribilvāmlais tailaṃ siddhaṃ samīraṇe ||
saindhavenāgni-varṇena taptaṃ cānila-jid ghṛtam | / jīvantīṃ madanaṃ medāṃ śrāvaṇīṃ madhukaṃ balām ||
śatāhvarṣabhakau kṛṣṇāṃ kākanāsāṃ śatāvarīm | / svaguptāṃ kṣīra-kākolīṃ karkaṭākhyāṃ śaṭhīṃ vacām ||
piṣṭvā taila-ghṛtaṃ kṣīre sādhayet tac-catur-guṇe | / bṛṃhaṇaṃ vāta-pitta-ghnaṃ bala-śukrāgni-vardhanam ||
rajaḥ-śukrāmaya-haraṃ putrīyaṃ cānuvāsanam | / saindhavaṃ madanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śatāhvā niculo vacā ||
hrīveraṃ madhukaṃ bhārgī devadāru sa-kaṭphalam | / nāgaraṃ puṣkaraṃ medā cavikā citrakaḥ śaṭhī ||
viḍaṅgātiviṣe śyāmā hareṇur nīlinī sthirā | / bilvājamoda-capalā dantī rāsnā ca taiḥ samaiḥ ||
sādhyam eraṇḍa-tailaṃ vā tailaṃ vā kapha-roga-nut | / vardhmodāvarta-gulmārśaḥ-plīha-mehāḍhya-mārutān ||
ānāham aśmarīṃ cāśu hanyāt tad anuvāsanam | / sādhitaṃ pañca-mūlena tailaṃ bilvādinātha-vā ||
kapha-ghnaṃ kalpayet tailaṃ dravyair vā kapha-ghātibhiḥ | / phalair aṣṭa-guṇaiś cāmlaiḥ siddham anvāsanaṃ kaphe ||
mṛdu-vasti-jaḍī-bhūte tīkṣṇo 'nyo vastir iṣyate | / tīkṣṇair vikarṣite snigdho madhuraḥ śiśiro mṛduḥ ||
tīkṣṇa-tvaṃ mūtra-pīlv-agni-lavaṇa-kṣāra-sarṣapaiḥ | / prāpta-kālaṃ vidhātavyaṃ kṣīrājyādyais tu mārdavam ||
bala-kāla-roga-doṣa-prakṛtīḥ pravibhajya yojito vastiḥ | / svaiḥ svair auṣadha-vargaiḥ svān svān rogān nivartayati ||
uṣṇārtānāṃ śītāñ chītārtānāṃ tathā sukhoṣṇāṃś ca | / tad-yogyauṣadha-yuktān vastīn santarkya yuñjīta ||
vastīn na bṛṃhaṇīyān dadyād vyādhiṣu viśodhanīyeṣu | / medasvino viśodhyā ye ca narāḥ kuṣṭha-mehārtāḥ ||
na kṣīṇa-kṣata-dur-bala-mūrchita-kṛśa-śuṣka-śuddha-dehānām | / dadyād viśodhanīyān doṣa-nibaddhāyuṣo ye ca ||
a-snigdha-svinna-dehasya guru-koṣṭhasya yojitaḥ | / śīto 'lpa-sneha-lavaṇa-dravya-mātro ghano 'pi vā ||
vastiḥ saṅkṣobhya taṃ doṣaṃ dur-bala-tvād a-nirharan | / karoty a-yogaṃ tena syād vāta-mūtra-śakṛd-grahaḥ ||
nābhi-vasti-rujā dāho hṛl-lepaḥ śvayathur gude | / kaṇḍūr gaṇḍāni vaivarṇyam a-ratir vahni-mārdavam ||
kvātha-dvayaṃ prāg-vihitaṃ madhya-doṣe 'tisāriṇi | / uṣṇasya tasmād ekasya tatra pānaṃ praśasyate ||
phala-vartyas tathā svedāḥ kālaṃ jñātvā virecanam | / bilva-mūla-trivṛd-dāru-yava-kola-kulattha-vān ||
surādi-mūtra-vān vastiḥ sa-prāk-peṣyas tam ānayet | / yukto 'lpa-vīryo doṣāḍhye rūkṣe krūrāśaye 'tha-vā ||
vastir doṣāvṛto ruddha-mārgo rundhyāt samīraṇam | / sa vi-mārgo 'nilaḥ kuryād ādhmānaṃ marma-pīḍanam ||
vidāhaṃ guda-koṣṭhasya muṣka-vaṅkṣaṇa-vedanām | / ruṇaddhi hṛdayaṃ śūlair itaś cetaś ca dhāvati ||
sv-abhyakta-svinna-gātrasya tatra vartiṃ prayojayet | / bilvādiś ca nirūhaḥ syāt pīlu-sarṣapa-mūtra-vān ||
saralāmaradārubhyāṃ sādhitaṃ cānuvāsanam | / kurvato vega-saṃrodhaṃ pīḍito vāti-mātrayā ||
a-snigdha-lavaṇoṣṇo vā vastir alpo 'lpa-bheṣajaḥ | / mṛdur vā mārutenordhvaṃ vikṣipto mukha-nāsikāt ||
nireti mūrchā-hṛl-lāsa-tṛḍ-dāhādīn pravartayan | / mūrchā-vikāraṃ dṛṣṭvāsya siñcec chītāmbunā mukham ||
vyajed ā-klama-nāśāc ca prāṇāyāmaṃ ca kārayet | / pṛṣṭha-pārśvodaraṃ mṛjyāt karair uṣṇair adho-mukham ||
keśeṣūtkṣipya dhunvīta bhīṣayed vyāla-daṃṣṭribhiḥ | / śastrolkā-rāja-puruṣair vastir eti tathā hy adhaḥ ||
pāṇi-vastrair galāpīḍaṃ kuryān na mriyate tathā | / prāṇodāna-nirodhād dhi su-prasiddha-tarāyanaḥ ||
apānaḥ pavano vastiṃ tam āśv evāpakarṣati | / kuṣṭha-kramuka-kalkaṃ ca pāyayetāmla-saṃyutam ||
auṣṇyāt taikṣṇyāt sara-tvāc ca vastiṃ so 'syānulomayet | / go-mūtreṇa trivṛt-pathyā-kalkaṃ vādho-'nulomanam ||
pakvāśaya-sthite svinne nirūho dāśamūlikaḥ | / yava-kola-kulatthaiś ca vidheyo mūtra-sādhitaiḥ ||
vastir go-mūtra-siddhair vā sāmṛtā-vaṃśa-pallavaiḥ | / pūti-karañja-tvak-pattra-śaṭhī-devāhva-rohiṣaiḥ ||
sa-taila-guḍa-sindhūttho virekauṣadha-kalka-vān | / bilvādi-pañca-mūlena siddho vastir uraḥ-sthite ||
śiraḥ-sthe nāvanaṃ dhūmaḥ pracchādyaṃ sarṣapaiḥ śiraḥ | / vastir aty-uṣṇa-tīkṣṇāmla-ghano 'ti-sveditasya vā ||
alpe doṣe mṛdau koṣṭhe prayukto vā punaḥ punaḥ | / ati-yoga-tvam āpanno bhavet kukṣi-rujā-karaḥ ||
virecanāti-yogena sa tulyākṛti-sādhanaḥ | / vastiḥ kṣārāmla-tīkṣṇoṣṇa-lavaṇaḥ paittikasya vā ||
gudaṃ dahan likhan kṣiṇvan karoty asya parisravam | / sa vidagdhaṃ sravaty asraṃ varṇaiḥ pittaṃ ca bhūribhiḥ ||
bahu-śaś cāti-vegena mohaṃ gacchati so '-sakṛt | / rakta-pittātisāra-ghnī kriyā tatra praśasyate ||
dāhādiṣu trivṛt-kalkaṃ mṛdvīkā-vāriṇā pibet | / tad dhi pitta-śakṛd-vātān hṛtvā dāhādikāñ jayet ||
viśuddhaś ca pibec chītāṃ yavāgūṃ śarkarā-yutām | / yuñjyād vāti-viriktasya kṣīṇa-viṭkasya bhojanam ||
māṣa-yūṣeṇa kulmāṣān pānaṃ dadhy atha-vā surām | / siddhir vasty-āpadām evaṃ sneha-vastes tu vakṣyate ||
śīto 'lpo vādhike vāte pitte 'ty-uṣṇaḥ kaphe mṛduḥ | / ati-bhukte gurur varcaḥ-sañcaye 'lpa-balas tathā ||
dattas tair āvṛtaḥ sneho nāyāty abhibhavād api | / stambhoru-sadanādhmāna-jvara-śūlāṅga-mardanaiḥ ||
pārśva-rug-veṣṭanair vidyād vāyunā sneham āvṛtam | / snigdhāmla-lavaṇoṣṇais taṃ rāsnā-pītadru-tailikaiḥ ||
sauvīraka-surā-kola-kulattha-yava-sādhitaiḥ | / nirūhair nirharet samyak sa-mūtraiḥ pāñcamūlikaiḥ ||
tābhyām eva ca tailābhyāṃ sāyaṃ bhukte 'nuvāsayet | / tṛḍ-dāha-rāga-sammoha-vaivarṇya-tamaka-jvaraiḥ ||
vidyāt pittāvṛtaṃ svādu-tiktais taṃ vastibhir haret | / tandrā-śīta-jvarālasya-prasekā-ruci-gauravaiḥ ||
sammūrchā-glānibhir vidyāc chleṣmaṇā sneham āvṛtam | / kaṣāya-tikta-kaṭukaiḥ surā-mūtropasādhitaiḥ ||
phala-taila-yutaiḥ sāmlair vastibhis taṃ vinirharet | / chardi-mūrchā-ruci-glāni-śūla-nidrāṅga-mardanaiḥ ||
āma-liṅgaiḥ sa-dāhais taṃ vidyād aty-aśanāvṛtam | / kaṭūnāṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca kvāthaiś cūrṇaiś ca pācanam ||
mṛdur virekaḥ sarvaṃ ca tatrāma-vihitaṃ hitam | / viṇ-mūtrānila-saṅgārti-guru-tvādhmāna-hṛd-grahaiḥ ||
snehaṃ viḍ-āvṛtaṃ jñātvā sneha-svedaiḥ sa-vartibhiḥ | / śyāmā-bilvādi-siddhaiś ca nirūhaiḥ sānuvāsanaiḥ ||
nirhared vidhinā samyag udāvarta-hareṇa ca | / a-bhukte śūna-pāyau vā peyā-mātrāśitasya vā ||
gude praṇihitaḥ sneho vegād dhāvaty an-āvṛtaḥ | / ūrdhvaṃ kāyaṃ tataḥ kaṇṭhād ūrdhvebhyaḥ khebhya ety api ||
mūtra-śyāmā-trivṛt-siddho yava-kola-kulattha-vān | / tat-siddha-tailo deyaḥ syān nirūhaḥ sānuvāsanaḥ ||
kaṇṭhād āgacchataḥ stambha-kaṇṭha-graha-virecanaiḥ | / chardi-ghnībhiḥ kriyābhiś ca tasya kuryān nibarhaṇam ||
nā-pakvaṃ praṇayet snehaṃ gudaṃ sa hy upalimpati | / tataḥ kuryāt sa-ruṅ-moha-kaṇḍū-śophān kriyātra ca ||
tīkṣṇo vastis tathā tailam arka-pattra-rase śṛtam | / an-ucchvāsya tu baddhe vā datte niḥśeṣa eva vā ||
praviśya kṣubhito vāyuḥ śūla-toda-karo bhavet | / tatrābhyaṅgo gude svedo vāta-ghnāny aśanāni ca ||
drutaṃ praṇīte niṣkṛṣṭe sahasotkṣipta eva vā | / syāt kaṭī-guda-jaṅghoru-vasti-stambhārti-bhedanam ||
bhojanaṃ tatra vāta-ghnaṃ svedābhyaṅgāḥ sa-vastayaḥ | / pīḍyamāne 'ntarā mukte gude pratihato 'nilaḥ ||
uraḥ-śiro-rujaṃ sādam ūrvoś ca janayed balī | / vastiḥ syāt tatra bilvādi-phala-śyāmādi-mūtra-vān ||
ati-prapīḍitaḥ koṣṭhe tiṣṭhaty āyāti vā galam | / tatra vastir virekaś ca gala-pīḍādi karma ca ||
vamanādyair viśuddhaṃ ca kṣāma-deha-balānalam | / yathāṇḍaṃ taruṇaṃ pūrṇaṃ taila-pātraṃ yathā tathā ||
bhiṣak prayatnato rakṣet sarvasmād apacārataḥ | / dadyān madhura-hṛdyāni tato 'mla-lavaṇau rasau ||
svādu-tiktau tato bhūyaḥ kaṣāya-kaṭukau tataḥ | / anyo-'nya-praty-anīkānāṃ rasānāṃ snigdha-rūkṣayoḥ ||
vyatyāsād upayogena kramāt taṃ prakṛtiṃ nayet | / sarvaṃ-sahaḥ sthira-balo vijñeyaḥ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ ||
dhanve sādhāraṇe deśe same san-mṛttike śucau | / śmaśāna-caityāyatana-śvabhra-valmīka-varjite ||
mṛdau pradakṣiṇa-jale kuśa-rohiṣa-saṃstṛte | / a-phāla-kṛṣṭe 'n-ākrānte pādapair bala-vat-taraiḥ ||
śasyate bheṣajaṃ jātaṃ yuktaṃ varṇa-rasādibhiḥ | / jantv-a-jagdhaṃ davā-dagdham a-vidagdhaṃ ca vaikṛtaiḥ ||
bhūtaiś chāyātapāmbv-ādyair yathā-kālaṃ ca sevitam | / avagāḍha-mahā-mūlam udīcīṃ diśam āśritam ||
atha kalyāṇa-caritaḥ śrāddhaḥ śucir upoṣitaḥ | / gṛhṇīyād auṣadhaṃ su-sthaṃ sthitaṃ kāle ca kalpayet ||
sa-kṣīraṃ tad a-sampattāv an-atikrānta-vatsaram | / ṛte guḍa-ghṛta-kṣaudra-dhānya-kṛṣṇā-viḍaṅgataḥ ||
payo bāṣkayaṇaṃ grāhyaṃ viṇ-mūtraṃ tac ca nī-rujām | / vayo-bala-vatāṃ dhātu-piccha-śṛṅga-khurādikam ||
kaṣāya-yonayaḥ pañca rasā lavaṇa-varjitāḥ | / rasaḥ kalkaḥ śṛtaḥ śītaḥ phāṇṭaś ceti prakalpanā ||
pañca-dhaiva kaṣāyāṇāṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ balādhikā | / sadyaḥ-samuddhṛtāt kṣuṇṇād yaḥ sravet paṭa-pīḍitāt ||
sva-rasaḥ sa samuddiṣṭaḥ kalkaḥ piṣṭo dravāplutaḥ | / cūrṇo '-plutaḥ śṛtaḥ kvāthaḥ śīto rātriṃ drave sthitaḥ ||
sadyo-'bhiṣuta-pūtas tu phāṇṭas tan-māna-kalpane | / yuñjyād vyādhy-ādi-balatas tathā ca vacanaṃ muneḥ ||
mātrāyā na vyavasthāsti vyādhiṃ koṣṭhaṃ balaṃ vayaḥ | / ālocya deśa-kālau ca yojyā tad-vac ca kalpanā ||
madhyaṃ tu mānaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ sva-rasasya catuḥ-palam | / peṣyasya karṣam āloḍyaṃ tad dravasya pala-traye ||
kvāthaṃ dravya-pale kuryāt prasthārdhaṃ pāda-śeṣitam | / śītaṃ pale palaiḥ ṣaḍbhiś caturbhis tu tato 'param ||
sneha-pāke tv a-mānoktau catur-guṇa-vivardhitam | / kalka-sneha-dravaṃ yojyam adhīte śaunakaḥ punaḥ ||
snehe sidhyati śuddhāmbu-niḥkvātha-sva-rasaiḥ kramāt | / kalkasya yojayed aṃśaṃ caturthaṃ ṣaṣṭham aṣṭamam ||
pṛthak sneha-samaṃ dadyāt pañca-prabhṛti tu dravam | / nāṅgulī-grāhi-tā kalke na snehe 'gnau sa-śabda-tā ||
varṇādi-sampac ca yadā tadainaṃ śīghram āharet | / ghṛtasya phenopaśamas tailasya tu tad-udbhavaḥ ||
lehasya tantu-mat-tāpsu majjanaṃ saraṇaṃ na ca | / pākas tu tri-vidho mandaś cikkaṇaḥ khara-cikkaṇaḥ ||
mandaḥ kalka-same kiṭṭe cikkaṇo madanopame | / kiñ-cit sīdati kṛṣṇe ca vartya-māne ca paścimaḥ ||
dagdho 'ta ūrdhvaṃ niṣkāryaḥ syād āmas tv agni-sāda-kṛt | / mṛdur nasye kharo 'bhyaṅge pāne vastau ca cikkaṇaḥ ||
śāṇaṃ pāṇi-talaṃ muṣṭiṃ kuḍavaṃ prastham āḍhakam | / droṇaṃ vahaṃ ca krama-śo vijānīyāc catur-guṇam ||
dvi-guṇaṃ yojayed ārdraṃ kuḍavādi tathā dravam | / peṣaṇāloḍane vāri sneha-pāke ca nir-drave ||
kalpayet sadṛśān bhāgān pramāṇaṃ yatra noditam | / kalkī-kuryāc ca bhaiṣajyam a-nirūpita-kalpanam ||
aṅgān-uktau tu mūlaṃ syād a-prasiddhau tad eva tu | / dvau śāṇau vaṭakaḥ kolaṃ badaraṃ draṅkṣaṇaś ca tau ||
akṣaṃ picuḥ pāṇi-talaṃ suvarṇaṃ kavaḍa-grahaḥ | / karṣo biḍāla-padakaṃ tindukaḥ pāṇi-mānikā ||
śabdānya-tvam a-bhinne 'rthe śuktir aṣṭamikā picū | / palaṃ prakuñco bilvaṃ ca muṣṭir āmraṃ caturthikā ||
dve pale prasṛtas tau dvāv añjalis tau tu mānikā | / āḍhakaṃ bhājanaṃ kaṃso droṇaḥ kumbho ghaṭo 'rmaṇam ||
tulā pala-śataṃ tāni viṃśatir bhāra ucyate | / himavad-vindhya-śailābhyāṃ prāyo vyāptā vasundharā ||
jāta-mātraṃ viśodhyolbād bālaṃ saindhava-sarpiṣā | / prasūti-kleśitaṃ cānu balā-tailena secayet ||
aśmanor vādanaṃ cāsya karṇa-mūle samācaret | / athāsya dakṣiṇe karṇe mantram uccārayed imam ||
aṅgād aṅgāt sambhavasi hṛdayād abhijāyase | / ātmā vai putra-nāmāsi sañjīva śaradāṃ śatam ||
śatāyuḥ śata-varṣo 'si dīrgham āyur avāpnuhi | / nakṣatrāṇi diśo rātrir ahaś ca tvābhirakṣatu ||
svasthī-bhūtasya nābhiṃ ca sūtreṇa catur-aṅgulāt | / baddhvordhvaṃ vardhayitvā ca grīvāyām avasañjayet ||
nābhiṃ ca kuṣṭha-tailena secayet snāpayed anu | / kṣīri-vṛkṣa-kaṣāyeṇa sarva-gandhodakena vā ||
koṣṇena tapta-rajata-tapanīya-nimajjanaiḥ | / tato dakṣiṇa-tarjanyā tālūnnamyāvaguṇṭhayet ||
śirasi sneha-picunā prāśyaṃ cāsya prayojayet | / hareṇu-mātraṃ medhāyur-balārtham abhimantritam ||
aindrī-brāhmī-vacā-śaṅkhapuṣpī-kalkaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu | / cāmīkara-vacā-brāhmī-tāpya-pathyā rajī-kṛtāḥ ||
lihyān madhu-ghṛtopetā hema-dhātrī-rajo 'tha-vā | / garbhāmbhaḥ saindhava-vatā sarpiṣā vāmayet tataḥ ||
prājāpatyena vidhinā jāta-karmāṇi kārayet | / sirāṇāṃ hṛdaya-sthānāṃ vivṛta-tvāt prasūtitaḥ ||
tṛtīye 'hni caturthe vā strīṇāṃ stanyaṃ pravartate | / prathame divase tasmāt tri-kālaṃ madhu-sarpiṣī ||
anantā-miśrite mantra-pāvite prāśayec chiśum | / dvitīye lakṣmaṇā-siddhaṃ tṛtīye ca ghṛtaṃ tataḥ ||
prāṅ-niṣiddha-stanasyāsya tat-pāṇi-tala-sammitam | / stanyānu-pānaṃ dvau kālau nava-nītaṃ prayojayet ||
mātur eva pibet stanyaṃ tad dhy alaṃ deha-vṛddhaye | / stanya-dhātryāv ubhe kārye tad-a-sampadi vatsale ||
a-vyaṅge brahma-cāriṇyau varṇa-prakṛtitaḥ same | / nī-ruje madhya-vayasau jīvad-vatse na lolupe ||
hitāhāra-vihāreṇa yatnād upacarec ca te | / śuk-krodha-laṅghanāyāsāḥ stanya-nāśasya hetavaḥ ||
stanyasya sīdhu-varjyāni madyāny ānūpa-jā rasāḥ | / kṣīraṃ kṣīriṇya oṣadhyaḥ śokādeś ca viparyayaḥ ||
viruddhāhāra-bhuktāyāḥ kṣudhitāyā vi-cetasaḥ | / praduṣṭa-dhātor garbhiṇyāḥ stanyaṃ roga-karaṃ śiśoḥ ||
stanyā-bhāve payaś chāgaṃ gavyaṃ vā tad-guṇaṃ pibet | / hrasvena pañca-mūlena sthirābhyāṃ vā sitā-yutam ||
ṣaṣṭhīṃ niśāṃ viśeṣeṇa kṛta-rakṣā-bali-kriyāḥ | / jāgṛyur bāndhavās tasya dadhataḥ paramāṃ mudam ||
daśame divase pūrṇe vidhibhiḥ sva-kulocitaiḥ | / kārayet sūtikotthānaṃ nāma bālasya cārcitam ||
bibhrato 'ṅgair manohvāla-rocanāguru-candanam | / nakṣatra-devatā-yuktaṃ bāndhavaṃ vā samākṣaram ||
tataḥ prakṛti-bhedokta-rūpair āyuḥ-parīkṣaṇam | / prāg-udak-śirasaḥ kuryād bālasya jñāna-vān bhiṣak ||
śuci-dhautopadhānāni nir-valīni mṛdūni ca | / śayyāstaraṇa-vāsāṃsi rakṣo-ghnair dhūpitāni ca ||
kāko viśastaḥ śastaś ca dhūpane trivṛtānvitaḥ | / jīvat-khaḍgādi-śṛṅgotthān sadā bālaḥ śubhān maṇīn ||
dhārayed auṣadhīḥ śreṣṭhāḥ brāhmy-aindrī-jīvakādikāḥ | / hastābhyāṃ grīvayā mūrdhnā viśeṣāt satataṃ vacām ||
āyur-medhā-smṛti-svāsthya-karīṃ rakṣo-'bhirakṣiṇīm | / ṣaṭ-saptāṣṭama-māseṣu nī-rujasya śubhe 'hani ||
karṇau himāgame vidhyed dhātry-aṅka-sthasya sāntvayan | / prāg dakṣiṇaṃ kumārasya bhiṣag vāmaṃ tu yoṣitaḥ ||
dakṣiṇena dadhat sūcīṃ pālīm anyena pāṇinā | / madhyataḥ karṇa-pīṭhasya kiñ-cid gaṇḍāśrayaṃ prati ||
jarāyu-mātra-pracchanne ravi-raśmy-avabhāsite | / ghṛtasya niś-calaṃ samyag alaktaka-rasāṅkite ||
vidhyed daiva-kṛte cchidre sakṛd evarju lāghavāt | / nordhvaṃ na pārśvato nādhaḥ sirās tatra hi saṃśritāḥ ||
kālikā-marmarī-raktās tad-vyadhād rāga-rug-jvarāḥ | / sa-śopha-dāha-saṃrambha-manyā-stambhāpatānakāḥ ||
teṣāṃ yathāmayaṃ kuryād vibhajyāśu cikitsitam | / sthāne vyadhān na rudhiraṃ na rug-rāgādi-sambhavaḥ ||
snehāktaṃ sūcy-anusyūtaṃ sūtraṃ cānu nidhāpayet | / āma-tailena siñcec ca bahalāṃ tad-vad ārayā ||
vidhyet pālīṃ hita-bhujaḥ sañcāryātha sthavīyasī | / vartis try-ahāt tato rūḍhaṃ vardhayeta śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||
athainaṃ jāta-daśanaṃ krameṇāpanayet stanāt | / pūrvoktaṃ yojayet kṣīram annaṃ ca laghu bṛṃhaṇam ||
priyāla-majja-madhuka-madhu-lāja-sitopalaiḥ | / apa-stanasya saṃyojyaḥ prīṇano modakaḥ śiśoḥ ||
dīpano bāla-bilvailā-śarkarā-lāja-saktubhiḥ | / saṅgrāhī dhātakī-puṣpa-śarkarā-lāja-tarpaṇaiḥ ||
rogāṃś cāsya jayet saumyair bheṣajair a-viṣādakaiḥ | / anya-trātyayikād vyādher virekaṃ su-tarāṃ tyajet ||
trāsayen nā-vidheyaṃ taṃ trastaṃ gṛhṇanti hi grahāḥ | / vastra-vātāt para-sparśāt pālayel laṅghanāc ca tam ||
brāhmī-siddhārthaka-vacā-śārivā-kuṣṭha-saindhavaiḥ | / sa-kaṇaiḥ sādhitaṃ pītaṃ vāṅ-medhā-smṛti-kṛd ghṛtam ||
āyuṣyaṃ pāpma-rakṣo-ghnaṃ bhūtonmāda-nibarhaṇam | / vacendulekhā-maṇḍūkī-śaṅkhapuṣpī-śatāvarīḥ ||
brahmasomāmṛtā-brāhmīḥ kalkī-kṛtya palāṃśikāḥ | / aṣṭāṅgaṃ vipacet sarpiḥ prasthaṃ kṣīra-catur-guṇam ||
tat pītaṃ dhanyam āyuṣyaṃ vāṅ-medhā-smṛti-buddhi-kṛt | / ajā-kṣīrābhayā-vyoṣa-pāṭhogrā-śigru-saindhavaiḥ ||
siddhaṃ sārasvataṃ sarpir vāṅ-medhā-smṛti-vahni-kṛt | / vacāmṛtā-śaṭhī-pathyā-śaṅkhinī-vella-nāgaraiḥ ||
apāmārgeṇa ca ghṛtaṃ sādhitaṃ pūrva-vad guṇaiḥ | / hema śveta-vacā kuṣṭham arkapuṣpī sa-kāñcanā ||
hema matsyākṣakaḥ śaṅkhaḥ kaiḍaryaḥ kanakaṃ vacā | / catvāra ete pādoktāḥ prāśā madhu-ghṛta-plutāḥ ||
varṣaṃ līḍhā vapur-medhā-bala-varṇa-karāḥ śubhāḥ | / vacā-yaṣṭy-āhva-sindhūttha-pathyā-nāgara-dīpyakaiḥ ||
tri-vidhaḥ kathito bālaḥ kṣīrānnobhaya-vartanaḥ | / svāsthyaṃ tābhyām a-duṣṭābhyāṃ duṣṭābhyāṃ roga-sambhavaḥ ||
yad adbhir eka-tāṃ yāti na ca doṣair adhiṣṭhitam | / tad viśuddhaṃ payo vātād duṣṭaṃ tu plavate 'mbhasi ||
kaṣāyaṃ phenilaṃ rūkṣaṃ varco-mūtra-vibandha-kṛt | / pittād uṣṇāmla-kaṭukaṃ pīta-rājy apsu dāha-kṛt ||
kaphāt sa-lavaṇaṃ sāndraṃ jale majjati picchilam | / saṃsṛṣṭa-liṅgaṃ saṃsargāt tri-liṅgaṃ sānnipātikam ||
yathā-sva-liṅgāṃs tad vyādhīn janayaty upayojitam | / śiśos tīkṣṇam abhīkṣṇaṃ ca rodanāl lakṣayed rujam ||
sa yaṃ spṛśed bhṛśaṃ deśaṃ yatra ca sparśanā-kṣamaḥ | / tatra vidyād rujaṃ mūrdhni rujaṃ cākṣi-nimīlanāt ||
hṛdi jihvauṣṭha-daśana-śvāsa-muṣṭi-nipīḍanaiḥ | / koṣṭhe vibandha-vamathu-stana-daṃśāntra-kūjanaiḥ ||
ādhmāna-pṛṣṭha-namana-jaṭharonnamanair api | / vastau guhye ca viṇ-mūtra-saṅgottrāsa-dig-īkṣaṇaiḥ ||
atha dhātryāḥ kriyāṃ kuryād yathā-doṣaṃ yathāmayam | / tatra vātātmake stanye daśa-mūlaṃ try-ahaṃ pibet ||
atha-vāgni-vacā-pāṭhā-kaṭukā-kuṣṭha-dīpyakam | / sa-bhārgī-dāru-sarala-vṛścikālī-kaṇoṣaṇam ||
tataḥ pibed anya-tamaṃ vāta-vyādhi-haraṃ ghṛtam | / anu cāccha-surām evaṃ snigdhāṃ mṛdu virecayet ||
vasti-karma tataḥ kuryāt svedādīṃś cānilāpahān | / rāsnājamodā-sarala-devadāru-rajo-'nvitam ||
bālo lihyād ghṛtaṃ tair vā vipakvaṃ sa-sitopalam | / pitta-duṣṭe 'mṛtābhīru-paṭolī-nimba-candanam ||
dhātrī kumāraś ca pibet kvāthayitvā sa-śārivam | / atha-vā tri-phalā-musta-bhūnimba-kaṭu-rohiṇīḥ ||
śārivādiṃ paṭolādiṃ padmakādiṃ tathā gaṇam | / ghṛtāny ebhiś ca siddhāni pitta-ghnaṃ ca virecanam ||
śītāṃś cābhyaṅga-lepādīn yuñjyāc chleṣmātmake punaḥ | / yaṣṭy-āhva-saindhava-yutaṃ kumāraṃ pāyayed ghṛtam ||
sindhūttha-pippalī-mad vā piṣṭaiḥ kṣaudra-yutair atha | / rāṭha-puṣpaiḥ stanau limpec chiśoś ca daśana-cchadau ||
sukham evaṃ vamed bālaḥ tīkṣṇair dhātrīṃ tu vāmayet | / athācarita-saṃsargī mustādiṃ kvathitaṃ pibet ||
tad-vat tagara-pṛthvīkā-suradāru-kaliṅgakān | / atha-vātiviṣā-musta-ṣaḍgranthā-pañca-kolakam ||
stanye tri-doṣa-maline dur-gandhy āmaṃ jalopamam | / vibaddham acchaṃ vicchinnaṃ phenilaṃ copaveśyate ||
śakṛn nānā-vyathā-varṇaṃ mūtraṃ pītaṃ sitaṃ ghanam | / jvarā-rocaka-tṛṭ-chardi-śuṣkodgāra-vijṛmbhikāḥ ||
aṅga-bhaṅgo 'ṅga-vikṣepaḥ kūjanaṃ vepathur bhramaḥ | / ghrāṇākṣi-mukha-pākādyā jāyante 'nye 'pi taṃ gadam ||
kṣīrālasakam ity āhur atyayaṃ cāti-dāruṇam | / tatrāśu dhātrīṃ bālaṃ ca vamanenopapādayet ||
vihitāyāṃ ca saṃsargyāṃ vacādiṃ yojayed gaṇam | / niśādiṃ vātha-vā mādrī-pāṭhā-tiktā-ghanāmayān ||
pāṭhā-śuṇṭhy-amṛtā-tikta-tiktā-devāhva-śārivāḥ | / sa-musta-mūrvendrayavāḥ stanya-doṣa-harāḥ param ||
anubandhe yathā-vyādhi pratikurvīta kāla-vit | / dantodbhedaś ca rogāṇāṃ sarveṣām api kāraṇam ||
viśeṣāj jvara-viḍ-bheda-kāsa-cchardi-śiro-rujām | / abhiṣyandasya pothakyā visarpasya ca jāyate ||
pṛṣṭha-bhaṅge biḍālānāṃ barhiṇāṃ ca śikhodbhave | / dantodbhede ca bālānāṃ na hi kiñ-cin na dūyate ||
yathā-doṣaṃ yathā-rogaṃ yathodrekaṃ yathā-bhayam | / vibhajya deśa-kālādīṃs tatra yojyaṃ bhiṣag-jitam ||
ta eva doṣā dūṣyāś ca jvarādyā vyādhayaś ca yat | / atas tad eva bhaiṣajyaṃ mātrā tv asya kanīyasī ||
saukumāryālpa-kāya-tvāt sarvānnān-upasevanāt | / snigdhā eva sadā bālā ghṛta-kṣīra-niṣevaṇāt ||
sadyas tān vamanaṃ tasmāt pāyayen mati-mān mṛdu | / stanyasya tṛptaṃ vamayet kṣīra-kṣīrānna-sevinam ||
pīta-vantaṃ tanuṃ peyām annādaṃ ghṛta-saṃyutām | / vastiṃ sādhye virekeṇa marśena pratimarśanam ||
yuñjyād virecanādīṃs tu dhātryā eva yathoditān | / mūrvā-vyoṣa-varā-kola-jambū-tvag-dāru-sarṣapāḥ ||
sa-pāṭhā madhunā līḍhāḥ stanya-doṣa-harāḥ param | / danta-pālīṃ sa-madhunā cūrṇena pratisārayet ||
pippalyā dhātakī-puṣpa-dhātrī-phala-kṛtena vā | / lāva-tittiri-vallūra-rajaḥ puṣpa-rasa-drutam ||
drutaṃ karoti bālānāṃ danta-kesara-van mukham | / vacā-dvi-bṛhatī-pāṭhā-kaṭukātiviṣā-ghanaiḥ ||
madhuraiś ca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ siddhaṃ daśana-janmani | / rajanī-dāru-sarala-śreyasī-bṛhatī-dvayam ||
pṛśniparṇī śatāhvā ca līḍhaṃ mākṣika-sarpiṣā | / grahaṇī-dīpanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mārutasyānulomanam ||
atīsāra-jvara-śvāsa-kāmalā-pāṇḍu-kāsa-nut | / bālasya sarva-rogeṣu pūjitaṃ bala-varṇa-dam ||
samaṅgā-dhātakī-lodhra-kuṭannaṭa-balā-dvayaiḥ | / mahā-sahā-kṣudra-sahā-mudga-bilva-śalāṭubhiḥ ||
sa-kārpāsī-phalais toye sādhitaiḥ sādhitaṃ ghṛtam | / kṣīra-mastu-yutaṃ hanti śīghraṃ dantodbhavodbhavān ||
vividhān āmayān etad vṛddha-kāśyapa-nirmitam | / dantodbhaveṣu rogeṣu na bālam atiyantrayet ||
svayam apy upaśāmyanti jāta-dantasya yad-gadāḥ | / aty-ahaḥ-svapna-śītāmbu-ślaiṣmika-stanya-sevinaḥ ||
śiśoḥ kaphena ruddheṣu srotaḥsu rasa-vāhiṣu | / a-rocakaḥ pratiśyāyo jvaraḥ kāsaś ca jāyate ||
kumāraḥ śuṣyati tataḥ snigdha-śukla-mukhekṣaṇaḥ | / saindhava-vyoṣa-śārṅgaṣṭā-pāṭhā-giri-kadambakān ||
śuṣyato madhu-sarpirbhyām a-rucy-ādiṣu yojayet | / aśoka-rohiṇī-yuktaṃ pañca-kolaṃ ca cūrṇitam ||
badarī-dhātakī-dhātrī-cūrṇaṃ vā sarpiṣā drutam | / sthirā-vacā-dvi-bṛhatī-kākolī-pippalī-nataiḥ ||
niculotpala-varṣābhū-bhārgī-mustaiś ca kārṣikaiḥ | / siddhaṃ prasthārdham ājyasya srotasāṃ śodhanaṃ param ||
siṃhy-aśvagandhā-surasā-kaṇā-garbhaṃ ca tad-guṇam | / yaṣṭy-āhva-pippalī-lodhra-padmakotpala-candanaiḥ ||
tālīśa-śārivābhyāṃ ca sādhitaṃ śoṣa-jid ghṛtam | / śṛṅgī-madhūlikā-bhārgī-pippalī-devadārubhiḥ ||
aśvagandhā-dvi-kākolī-rāsnarṣabhaka-jīvakaiḥ | / śūrpaparṇī-viḍaṅgaiś ca kalkitaiḥ sādhitaṃ ghṛtam ||
śaśottamāṅga-niryūhe śuṣyataḥ puṣṭi-kṛt param | / vacā-vayaḥsthā-tagara-kāyasthā-corakaiḥ śṛtam ||
basta-mūtra-surābhyāṃ ca tailam abhyañjane hitam | / lākṣā-rasa-samaṃ taila-prasthaṃ mastu catur-guṇam ||
aśvagandhā-niśā-dāru-kauntī-kuṣṭhābda-candanaiḥ | / sa-mūrvā-rohiṇī-rāsnā-śatāhvā-madhukaiḥ samaiḥ ||
siddhaṃ lākṣādikaṃ nāma tailam abhyañjanād idam | / balyaṃ jvara-kṣayonmāda-śvāsāpasmāra-vāta-nut ||
yakṣa-rākṣasa-bhūta-ghnaṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ ca śasyate | / madhunātiviṣā-śṛṅgī-pippalīr lehayec chiśum ||
ekāṃ vātiviṣāṃ kāsa-jvara-cchardir-upadrutam | / pītaṃ pītaṃ vamati yaḥ stanyaṃ taṃ madhu-sarpiṣā ||
dvi-vārtākī-phala-rasaṃ pañca-kolaṃ ca lehayet | / pippalī-pañca-lavaṇaṃ kṛmijit-pāribhadrakam ||
tad-val lihyāt tathā vyoṣaṃ maṣīṃ vā roma-carmaṇām | / lābhataḥ śalyaka-śvāvid-godharkṣa-śikhi-janmanām ||
khadirārjuna-tālīśa-kuṣṭha-candana-je rase | / sa-kṣīraṃ sādhitaṃ sarpir vamathuṃ viniyacchati ||
sa-danto jāyate yas tu dantāḥ prāg yasya cottarāḥ | / kurvīta tasminn utpāte śāntiṃ taṃ ca dvi-jātaye ||
dadyāt sa-dakṣiṇaṃ bālaṃ naigameṣaṃ ca pūjayet | / tālu-māṃse kaphaḥ kruddhaḥ kurute tālu-kaṇṭakam ||
tena tālu-pradeśasya nimna-tā mūrdhni jāyate | / tālu-pātaḥ stana-dveṣaḥ kṛcchrāt pānaṃ śakṛd-dravam ||
tṛḍ-āsya-kaṇḍv-akṣi-rujā grīvā-dur-dhara-tā vamiḥ | / tatrotkṣipya yava-kṣāra-kṣaudrābhyāṃ pratisārayet ||
tālu tad-vat kaṇā-śuṇṭhī-go-śakṛd-rasa-saindhavaiḥ | / śṛṅgavera-niśā-bhṛṅgaṃ kalkitaṃ vaṭa-pallavaiḥ ||
baddhvā go-śakṛtā liptam kukūle svedayet tataḥ | / rasena limpet tālv-āsyaṃ netre ca pariṣecayet ||
harītakī-vacā-kuṣṭha-kalkaṃ mākṣika-saṃyutam | / pītvā kumāraḥ stanyena mucyate tālu-kaṇṭakāt ||
malopalepāt svedād vā gude rakta-kaphodbhavaḥ | / tāmro vraṇo 'ntaḥ kaṇḍū-mān jāyate bhūry-upadravaḥ ||
ke-cit taṃ mātṛkā-doṣaṃ vadanty anye 'hi-pūtanam | / pṛṣṭhārur guda-kuṭṭaṃ ca ke-cic ca tam a-nāmikam ||
tatra dhātryāḥ payaḥ śodhyaṃ pitta-śleṣma-harauṣadhaiḥ | / śṛta-śītaṃ ca śītāmbu-yuktam antara-pānakam ||
sa-kṣaudra-tārkṣya-śailena vraṇaṃ tena ca lepayet | / tri-phalā-badarī-plakṣa-tvak-kvātha-pariṣecitam ||
kāsīsa-rocanā-tuttha-manohvāla-rasāñjanaiḥ | / lepayed amla-piṣṭair vā cūrṇitair vāvacūrṇayet ||
su-ślakṣṇair atha-vā yaṣṭī-śaṅkha-sauvīrakāñjanaiḥ | / śārivā-śaṅkhanābhibhyām asanasya tvacātha-vā ||
rāga-kaṇḍūtkaṭe kuryād rakta-srāvaṃ jalaukasā | / sarvaṃ ca pitta-vraṇa-jic chasyate guda-kuṭṭake ||
pāṭhā-vella-dvi-rajanī-musta-bhārgī-punarnavaiḥ | / sa-bilva-try-ūṣaṇaiḥ sarpiḥ vṛścikālī-yutaiḥ śṛtam ||
lihāno mātrayā rogair mucyate mṛttikodbhavaiḥ || 77ab || / vyādher yady asya bhaiṣajyaṃ stanas tena pralepitaḥ || 77cd || / sthito muhūrtaṃ dhauto 'nu pītas taṃ taṃ jayed gadam || 77ef ||
purā guhasya rakṣārthaṃ nirmitāḥ śūla-pāṇinā | / manuṣya-vigrahāḥ pañca sapta strī-vigrahā grahāḥ ||
skando viśākho meṣākhyaḥ śva-grahaḥ pitṛ-sañjñitaḥ | / śakuniḥ pūtanā śīta-pūtanā-dṛṣṭi-pūtanā ||
mukha-maṇḍitikā tad-vad revatī śuṣka-revatī | / teṣāṃ grahīṣyatāṃ rūpaṃ pratataṃ rodanaṃ jvaraḥ ||
sāmānyaṃ rūpam uttrāsa-jṛmbhā-bhrū-kṣepa-dīna-tāḥ | / phena-srāvordhva-dṛṣṭy-oṣṭha-danta-daṃśa-prajāgarāḥ ||
rodanaṃ kūjanaṃ stanya-vidveṣaḥ svara-vaikṛtam | / nakhair a-kasmāt paritaḥ sva-dhātry-aṅga-vilekhanam ||
tatraika-nayana-srāvī śiro vikṣipate muhuḥ | / hataika-pakṣaḥ stabdhāṅgaḥ sa-svedo nata-kandharaḥ ||
danta-khādī stana-dveṣī trasyan roditi vi-svaram | / vakra-vaktro vaman lālāṃ bhṛśam ūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣate ||
vasāsṛg-gandhir udvigno baddha-muṣṭi-śakṛc chiśuḥ | / calitaikākṣi-gaṇḍa-bhrūḥ saṃraktobhaya-locanaḥ ||
skandārtas tena vaikalyaṃ maraṇaṃ vā bhaved dhruvam | / sañjñā-nāśo muhuḥ keśa-luñcanaṃ kandharā-natiḥ ||
vinamya jṛmbhamāṇasya śakṛn-mūtra-pravartanam | / phenodvamanam ūrdhvekṣā hasta-bhrū-pāda-nartanam ||
stana-sva-jihvā-sandaṃśa-saṃrambha-jvara-jāgarāḥ | / pūya-śoṇita-gandhaś ca skandāpasmāra-lakṣaṇam ||
ādhmānaṃ pāṇi-pādasya spandanaṃ phena-nirvamaḥ | / tṛṇ-muṣṭi-bandhātīsāra-svara-dainya-vi-varṇa-tāḥ ||
kūjanaṃ stananaṃ chardiḥ kāsa-hidhmā-prajāgarāḥ | / oṣṭha-daṃśāṅga-saṅkoca-stambha-bastābha-gandha-tāḥ ||
ūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣya hasanaṃ madhye vinamanaṃ jvaraḥ | / mūrchaika-netra-śophaś ca naigameṣa-grahākṛtiḥ ||
kampo hṛṣita-roma-tvaṃ svedaś cakṣur-nimīlanam | / bahir-āyāmanaṃ jihvā-daṃśo 'ntaḥ-kaṇṭha-kūjanam ||
dhāvanaṃ viṭ-sa-gandha-tvaṃ krośanaṃ ca śva-vac chuni | / roma-harṣo muhus trāsaḥ sahasā rodanaṃ jvaraḥ ||
kāsātīsāra-vamathu-jṛmbhā-tṛṭ-śava-gandha-tāḥ | / aṅgeṣv ākṣepa-vikṣepa-śoṣa-stambha-vi-varṇa-tāḥ ||
muṣṭi-bandhaḥ srutiś cākṣṇor bālasya syuḥ pitṛ-grahe | / srastāṅga-tvam atīsāro jihvā-tālu-gale vraṇāḥ ||
sphoṭāḥ sa-dāha-ruk-pākāḥ sandhiṣu syuḥ punaḥ punaḥ | / niśy ahni pravilīyante pāko vaktre gude 'pi vā ||
bhayaṃ śakuni-gandha-tvaṃ jvaraś ca śakuni-grahe | / pūtanāyāṃ vamiḥ kampas tandrā rātrau prajāgaraḥ ||
hidhmādhmānaṃ śakṛd-bhedaḥ pipāsā mūtra-nigrahaḥ | / srasta-hṛṣṭāṅga-roma-tvaṃ kāka-vat pūti-gandhi-tā ||
śīta-pūtanayā kampo rodanaṃ tiryag-īkṣaṇam | / tṛṣṇāntra-kūjo 'tīsāro vasā-vad visra-gandha-tā ||
pārśvasyaikasya śīta-tvam uṣṇa-tvam aparasya ca | / andha-pūtanayā chardir jvaraḥ kāso 'lpa-nidra-tā ||
varcaso bheda-vaivarṇya-daurgandhyāny aṅga-śoṣaṇam | / dṛṣṭeḥ sādāti-ruk-kaṇḍū-pothakī-janma-śūna-tāḥ ||
hidhmodvega-stana-dveṣa-vaivarṇya-svara-tīkṣṇa-tāḥ | / vepathur matsya-gandha-tvam atha-vā sāmla-gandha-tā ||
mukha-maṇḍitayā pāṇi-pādāsya-ramaṇīya-tā | / sirābhir asitābhābhir ācitodara-tā jvaraḥ ||
a-rocako 'ṅga-glapanaṃ go-mūtra-sama-gandha-tā | / revatyāṃ śyāva-nīla-tvaṃ karṇa-nāsākṣi-mardanam ||
kāsa-hidhmākṣi-vikṣepa-vakra-vaktra-tva-rakta-tāḥ | / basta-gandho jvaraḥ śoṣaḥ purīṣaṃ haritaṃ dravam ||
jāyate śuṣka-revatyāṃ kramāt sarvāṅga-saṅkṣayaḥ | / keśa-śāto 'nna-vidveṣaḥ svara-dainyaṃ vi-varṇa-tā ||
rodanaṃ gṛdhra-gandha-tvaṃ dīrgha-kālānuvartanam | / udare granthayo vṛttā yasya nānā-vidhaṃ śakṛt ||
jihvāyā nimna-tā madhye śyāvaṃ tālu ca taṃ tyajet | / bhuñjāno 'nnaṃ bahu-vidhaṃ yo bālaḥ parihīyate ||
tṛṣṇā-gṛhītaḥ kṣāmākṣo hanti taṃ śuṣka-revatī | / hiṃsā-raty-arcanākāṅkṣā graha-grahaṇa-kāraṇam ||
tatra hiṃsātmake bālo mahān vā sruta-nāsikaḥ | / kṣata-jihvaḥ kvaṇed bāḍham a-sukhī sāśru-locanaḥ ||
dur-varṇo hīna-vacanaḥ pūti-gandhiś ca jāyate | / kṣāmo mūtra-purīṣaṃ svaṃ mṛdnāti na jugupsate ||
hastau codyamya saṃrabdho hanty ātmānaṃ tathā param | / tad-vac ca śastra-kāṣṭhādyair agniṃ vā dīptam āviśet ||
apsu majjet patet kūpe kuryād anyac ca tad-vidham | / tṛḍ-dāha-mohān pūyasya cchardanaṃ ca pravartayet ||
raktaṃ ca sarva-mārgebhyo riṣṭotpattiṃ ca taṃ tyajet | / rahaḥ-strī-rati-saṃlāpa-gandha-srag-bhūṣaṇa-priyaḥ ||
hṛṣṭaḥ śāntaś ca duḥ-sādhyo rati-kāmena pīḍitaḥ | / dīnaḥ parimṛśan vaktraṃ śuṣkauṣṭha-gala-tālukaḥ ||
śaṅkitaṃ vīkṣate rauti dhyāyaty āyāti dīna-tām | / annam annābhilāṣe 'pi dattaṃ nāti bubhukṣate ||
gṛhītaṃ bali-kāmena taṃ vidyāt sukha-sādhanam | / hantu-kāmaṃ jayed dhomaiḥ siddha-mantra-pravartitaiḥ ||
itarau tu yathā-kāmaṃ rati-baly-ādi-dānataḥ | / atha sādhya-grahaṃ bālaṃ vivikte śaraṇe sthitam ||
trir ahnaḥ sikta-sammṛṣṭe sadā sannihitānale | / vikīrṇa-bhūti-kusuma-pattra-bījānna-sarṣape ||
rakṣo-ghna-taila-jvalita-pradīpa-hata-pāpmani | / vyavāya-madya-piśita-nivṛtta-paricārake ||
purāṇa-sarpiṣābhyaktaṃ pariṣiktaṃ sukhāmbunā | / sādhitena balā-nimba-vaijayantī-nṛpadrumaiḥ ||
pāribhadraka-kaṭvaṅga-jambū-varuṇa-kaṭtṛṇaiḥ | / kapotavaṅkāpāmārga-pāṭalā-madhu-śigrubhiḥ ||
kākajaṅghā-mahāśvetā-kapittha-kṣīri-pādapaiḥ | / sa-kadamba-karañjaiś ca dhūpaṃ snātasya cācaret ||
dvīpi-vyāghrāhi-siṃharkṣa-carmabhir ghṛta-miśritaiḥ | / pūti-daśāṅga-siddhārtha-vacā-bhallāta-dīpyakaiḥ ||
sa-kuṣṭhaiḥ sa-ghṛtair dhūpaḥ sarva-graha-vimokṣaṇaḥ | / sarṣapā nimba-pattrāṇi mūlam aśvakhurā vacā ||
bhūrja-pattraṃ ghṛtaṃ dhūpaḥ sarva-graha-nivāraṇaḥ | / anantāmrāsthi-tagaraṃ maricaṃ madhuro gaṇaḥ ||
śṛgālavinnā mustā ca kalkitais tair ghṛtaṃ pacet | / daśa-mūla-rasa-kṣīra-yuktaṃ tad graha-jit param ||
rāsnā-dvy-aṃśumatī-vṛddha-pañca-mūla-balā-ghanāt | / kvāthe sarpiḥ pacet piṣṭaiḥ śārivā-vyoṣa-citrakaiḥ ||
pāṭhā-viḍaṅga-madhuka-payasyā-hiṅgu-dārubhiḥ | / sa-granthikaiḥ sendrayavaiḥ śiśos tat satataṃ hitam ||
sarva-roga-graha-haraṃ dīpanaṃ bala-varṇa-dam | / śārivā-surabhi-brāhmī-śaṅkhinī-kuṣṭha-sarṣapaiḥ ||
vacāśvagandhā-surasa-yuktaiḥ sarpir vipācayet | / tan nāśayed grahān sarvān pānenābhyañjanena ca ||
go-śṛṅga-carma-vālāhi-nirmokaṃ vṛṣa-daṃśa-viṭ | / nimba-pattrājya-kaṭukā-madanaṃ bṛhatī-dvayam ||
kārpāsāsthi-yava-cchāga-roma-devāhva-sarṣapam | / mayūra-pattra-śrīvāsaṃ tuṣa-keśaṃ sa-rāmaṭham ||
mṛd-bhāṇḍe basta-mūtreṇa bhāvitaṃ ślakṣṇa-cūrṇitam | / dhūpanaṃ ca hitaṃ sarva-bhūteṣu viṣama-jvare ||
ghṛtāni bhūta-vidyāyāṃ vakṣyante yāni tāni ca | / yuñjyāt tathā baliṃ homaṃ snapanaṃ mantra-tantra-vit ||
pūti-karañja-tvak-pattraṃ kṣīribhyo barbarād api | / tumbī-viśālāraluka-śamī-bilva-kapitthataḥ ||
utkvāthya toyaṃ tad rātrau bālānāṃ snapanaṃ śivam | / anubandhān yathā-kṛcchraṃ grahāpāye 'py upadravān ||
lakṣayej jñāna-vijñāna-vāk-ceṣṭā-bala-pauruṣam | / puruṣe '-pauruṣaṃ yatra tatra bhūta-grahaṃ vadet ||
bhūtasya rūpa-prakṛti-bhāṣā-gaty-ādi-ceṣṭitaiḥ | / yasyānukāraṃ kurute tenāviṣṭaṃ tam ādiśet ||
so 'ṣṭā-daśa-vidho deva-dānavādi-vibhedataḥ | / hetus tad-anuṣaktau tu sadyaḥ pūrva-kṛto 'tha-vā ||
prajñāparādhaḥ su-tarāṃ tena kāmādi-janmanā | / lupta-dharma-vratācāraḥ pūjyān apy ativartate ||
taṃ tathā bhinna-maryādaṃ pāpam ātmopaghātinam | / devādayo 'py anughnanti grahāś chidra-prahāriṇaḥ ||
chidraṃ pāpa-kriyārambhaḥ pāko 'n-iṣṭasya karmaṇaḥ | / ekasya śūnye 'vasthānaṃ śmaśānādiṣu vā niśi ||
dig-vāsas-tvaṃ guror nindā rater a-vidhi-sevanam | / a-śucer devatārcādi para-sūtaka-saṅkaraḥ ||
homa-mantra-balījyānāṃ vi-guṇaṃ parikarma ca | / samāsād dina-caryādi-proktācāra-vyatikramaḥ ||
gṛhṇanti śukla-pratipat-trayo-daśyoḥ surā naram | / śukla-trayo-daśī-kṛṣṇa-dvā-daśyor dānavā grahāḥ ||
gandharvās tu catur-daśyāṃ dvā-daśyāṃ coragāḥ punaḥ | / pañcamyāṃ śukla-saptamy-ekā-daśyos tu dhaneśvarāḥ ||
śuklāṣṭa-pañcamī-paurṇamāsīṣu brahma-rākṣasāḥ | / kṛṣṇe rakṣaḥ-piśācādyā nava-dvā-daśa-parvasu ||
daśāmāvāsyayor aṣṭa-navamyoḥ pitaro 'pare | / guru-vṛddhādayaḥ prāyaḥ kālaṃ sandhyāsu lakṣayet ||
phulla-padmopama-mukhaṃ saumya-dṛṣṭim a-kopanam | / alpa-vāk-sveda-viṇ-mūtraṃ bhojanān-abhilāṣiṇam ||
deva-dvi-jāti-paramaṃ śuciṃ saṃskṛta-vādinam | / mīlayantaṃ cirān netre surabhiṃ vara-dāyinam ||
śukla-mālyāmbara-saric-chailocca-bhavana-priyam | / a-nidram a-pradhṛṣyaṃ ca vidyād deva-vaśī-kṛtam ||
jihma-dṛṣṭiṃ dur-ātmānaṃ guru-deva-dvi-ja-dviṣam | / nir-bhayaṃ māninaṃ śūraṃ krodhanaṃ vyavasāyinam ||
rudraḥ skando viśākho 'ham indro 'ham iti vādinam | / surā-māṃsa-ruciṃ vidyād daitya-graha-gṛhītakam ||
sv-ācāraṃ surabhiṃ hṛṣṭaṃ gīta-nartana-kāriṇam | / snānodyāna-ruciṃ rakta-vastra-mālyānulepanam ||
śṛṅgāra-līlābhirataṃ gandharvādhyuṣitaṃ vadet | / raktākṣaṃ krodhanaṃ stabdha-dṛṣṭiṃ vakra-gatiṃ calam ||
śvasantam a-niśaṃ jihvā-lolinaṃ sṛkkiṇī-liham | / priya-dugdha-guḍa-snānam adho-vadana-śāyinam ||
uragādhiṣṭhitaṃ vidyāt trasyantaṃ cātapa-trataḥ | / vipluta-trasta-raktākṣaṃ śubha-gandhaṃ su-tejasam ||
priya-nṛtya-kathā-gīta-snāna-mālyānulepanam | / matsya-māṃsa-ruciṃ hṛṣṭaṃ tuṣṭaṃ balinam a-vyatham ||
calitāgra-karaṃ kasmai kiṃ dadāmīti vādinam | / rahasya-bhāṣiṇaṃ vaidya-dvi-jāti-paribhāvinam ||
alpa-roṣaṃ druta-gatiṃ vidyād yakṣa-gṛhītakam | / hāsya-nṛtya-priyaṃ raudra-ceṣṭaṃ chidra-prahāriṇam ||
ākrośinaṃ śīghra-gatiṃ deva-dvi-ja-bhiṣag-dviṣam | / ātmānaṃ kāṣṭha-śastrādyair ghnantaṃ bhoḥ-śabda-vādinam ||
śāstra-veda-paṭhaṃ vidyād gṛhītaṃ brahma-rākṣasaiḥ | / sa-krodha-dṛṣṭiṃ bhrū-kuṭīm udvahantaṃ sa-sambhramaṃ ||
praharantaṃ pradhāvantaṃ śabdantaṃ bhairavānanam | / annād vināpi balinaṃ naṣṭa-nidraṃ niśā-caram ||
nir-lajjam a-śuciṃ śūraṃ krūraṃ paruṣa-bhāṣiṇam | / roṣaṇaṃ rakta-mālya-strī-rakta-madyāmiṣa-priyam ||
dṛṣṭvā ca raktaṃ māṃsaṃ vālihānaṃ daśana-cchadau | / hasantam anna-kāle ca rākṣasādhiṣṭhitaṃ vadet ||
a-svastha-cittaṃ naika-tra tiṣṭhantaṃ paridhāvinam | / ucchiṣṭa-nṛtya-gandharva-hāsa-madyāmiṣa-priyam ||
nirbhartsanād dīna-mukhaṃ rudantam a-nimittataḥ | / nakhair likhantam ātmānaṃ rūkṣa-dhvasta-vapuḥ-svaram ||
āvedayantam duḥkhādi sambaddhā-baddha-bhāṣiṇam | / naṣṭa-smṛtiṃ śūnya-ratiṃ lolaṃ nagnaṃ malīmasam ||
rathyā-caila-parīdhānaṃ tṛṇa-mālā-vibhūṣaṇam | / ārohantaṃ ca kāṣṭhāśvaṃ tathā saṅkara-kūṭakam ||
bahv-āśinaṃ piśācena vijānīyād adhiṣṭhitam | / pretākṛti-kriyā-gandhaṃ bhītam āhāra-vidviṣam ||
tṛṇa-cchidaṃ ca pretena gṛhītaṃ naram ādiśet | / bahu-pralāpaṃ kṛṣṇāsyaṃ pravilambita-yāyinam ||
śūna-pralamba-vṛṣaṇaṃ kūṣmāṇḍādhiṣṭhitaṃ vadet | / gṛhītvā kāṣṭha-loṣṭādi bhramantaṃ cīra-vāsasam ||
nagnaṃ dhāvantam uttrasta-dṛṣṭiṃ tṛṇa-vibhūṣaṇam | / śmaśāna-śūnyāyatana-rathyaika-druma-sevinam ||
tilānna-madya-māṃseṣu satataṃ sakta-locanaṃ | / niṣādādhiṣṭhitaṃ vidyād vadantaṃ paruṣāṇi ca ||
yācantam udakaṃ cānnaṃ trasta-lohita-locanam | / ugra-vākyaṃ ca jānīyān naram aukiraṇārditam ||
gandha-mālya-ratiṃ satya-vādinaṃ parivepinam | / bahu-nidraṃ ca jānīyād vetālena vaśī-kṛtam ||
a-prasanna-dṛśaṃ dīna-vadanaṃ śuṣka-tālukam | / calan-nayana-pakṣmāṇaṃ nidrāluṃ manda-pāvakam ||
apasavya-parīdhānaṃ tila-māṃsa-guḍa-priyam | / skhalad-vācaṃ ca jānīyāt pitṛ-graha-vaśī-kṛtam ||
guru-vṛddharṣi-siddhābhiśāpa-cintānurūpataḥ | / vyāhārāhāra-ceṣṭābhir yathā-svaṃ tad-grahaṃ vadet ||
kumāra-vṛndānugataṃ nagnam uddhata-mūrdha-jam | / a-svastha-manasaṃ dairghya-kālikaṃ sa-grahaṃ tyajet ||
bhūtaṃ jayed a-hiṃsecchaṃ japa-homa-bali-vrataiḥ | / tapaḥ-śīla-samādhāna-dāna-jñāna-dayādibhiḥ ||
hiṅgu-vyoṣāla-nepālī-laśunārka-jaṭā-jaṭāḥ | / ajalomī sa-golomī bhūtakeśī vacā latā ||
kukkuṭī sarpagandhākhyā tilāḥ kāṇa-vikāṇike | / vajraproktā vayaḥsthā ca śṛṅgī mohanavally api ||
sroto-jāñjana-rakṣoghnaṃ rakṣo-ghnaṃ cānyad auṣadham | / kharāśva-śvāvid-uṣṭrarkṣa-godhā-nakula-śalyakāt ||
dvīpi-mārjāra-go-siṃha-vyāghra-sāmudra-sat-tvataḥ | / carma-pitta-dvi-ja-nakhā varge 'smin sādhayed ghṛtam ||
purāṇam atha-vā tailaṃ navaṃ tat pāna-nasyayoḥ | / abhyaṅge ca prayoktavyam eṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ ca dhūpane ||
ebhiś ca guṭikāṃ yuñjyād añjane sāvapīḍane | / pralepe kalkam eteṣāṃ kvāthaṃ ca pariṣecane ||
prayogo 'yaṃ grahonmādān sāpasmārāñ chamaṃ nayet | / gajāhvā-pippalī-mūla-vyoṣāmalaka-sarṣapān ||
godhā-nakula-mārjāra-jhaṣa-pitta-prapeṣitān | / nāvanābhyaṅga-sekeṣu vidadhīta grahāpahān ||
siddhārthaka-vacā-hiṅgu-priyaṅgu-rajanī-dvayam | / mañjiṣṭhā śveta-kaṭabhī varā śvetādrikarṇikā ||
nimbasya pattraṃ bījaṃ tu naktamāla-śirīṣayoḥ | / surāhvaṃ try-ūṣaṇaṃ sarpir go-mūtre taiś catur-guṇe ||
siddhaṃ siddhārthakaṃ nāma pāne nasye ca yojitam | / grahān sarvān nihanty āśu viśeṣād āsurān grahān ||
kṛtyā-lakṣmī-viṣonmāda-jvarāpasmāra-pāpma ca | / ebhir evauṣadhair basta-vāriṇā kalpito '-gadaḥ ||
pāna-nasyāñjanālepa-snānodgharṣaṇa-yojitaḥ | / guṇaiḥ pūrva-vad uddiṣṭo rāja-dvāre ca siddhi-kṛt ||
siddhārthaka-vyoṣa-vacāśvagandhā niśā-dvayaṃ hiṅgu-palāṇḍu-kandaḥ | / bījaṃ karañjāt kusumaṃ śirīṣāt phalaṃ ca valkaṃ ca kapittha-vṛkṣāt ||
sa-māṇimanthaṃ sa-nataṃ sa-kuṣṭhaṃ śyoṇāka-mūlaṃ kiṇihī sitā ca | / bastasya mūtreṇa su-bhāvitaṃ tat pittena gavyena guḍān vidadhyāt ||
duṣṭa-vraṇonmāda-tamo-niśāndhān udbandhakān vāri-nimagna-dehān | / digdhāhatān darpita-sarpa-daṣṭāṃs te sādhayanty añjana-nasya-lepaiḥ ||

kārpāsāsthi-mayūra-pattra-bṛhatī-nirmālya-piṇḍītaka- || 18a || / -tvaṅ-māṃsī-vṛṣa-daṃśa-viṭ-tuṣa-vacā-keśāhi-nirmokakaiḥ || 18b || / nāgendra-dvi-ja-śṛṅga-hiṅgu-maricais tulyaiḥ kṛtaṃ dhūpanaṃ || 18c || / skandonmāda-piśāca-rākṣasa-surāveśa-jvara-ghnaṃ param || 18d ||

tri-kaṭuka-dala-kuṅkuma-granthika-kṣāra-siṃhī-niśā-dāru-siddhārtha-yugmāmbu-śakrāhvayaiḥ || 19a || / sita-laśuna-phala-trayośīra-tiktā-vacā-tuttha-yaṣṭī-balā-lohitailā-śilā-padmakaiḥ || 19b || / dadhi-tagara-madhūka-sāra-priyāhvā-viṣākhyā-viṣā-tārkṣya-śailaiḥ sa-cavyāmayaiḥ kalkitaiḥ || 19c || / ghṛtam a-navam a-śeṣa-mūtrāṃśa-siddhaṃ mataṃ bhūta-rāvāhvayaṃ pānatas tad graha-ghnaṃ param || 19d ||

nata-madhuka-karañja-lākṣā-paṭolī-samaṅgā-vacā-pāṭalī-hiṅgu-siddhārtha-siṃhī-niśā-yug-latā-rohiṇī- || 20a || / -badara-kaṭu-phala-trikā-kāṇḍa-dāru-kṛmighnājagandhāmarāṅkolla-kośātakī-śigru-nimbāmbu dendrāhvayaiḥ || 20b || / gada-śukataru-puṣpa-bījogra-yaṣṭy-adrikarṇī-nikumbhāgni-bilvaiḥ samaiḥ kalkitair mūtra-vargeṇa siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ || 20c || / vidhi-vinihitam āśu sarvaiḥ kramair yojitaṃ hanti sarva-grahonmāda-kuṣṭha-jvarāṃs tan mahā-bhūta- rāvaṃ smṛtam || 20d ||
grahā gṛhṇanti ye yeṣu teṣāṃ teṣu viśeṣataḥ | / dineṣu bali-homādīn prayuñjīta cikitsakaḥ ||
snāna-vastra-vasā-māṃsa-madya-kṣīra-guḍādi ca | / rocate yad yadā yebhyas tat teṣām āharet tadā ||
ratnāni gandha-mālyāni bījāni madhu-sarpiṣī | / bhakṣyāś ca sarve sarveṣāṃ sāmānyo vidhir ity ayam ||
surarṣi-guru-vṛddhebhyaḥ siddhebhyaś ca surālaye | / diśy uttarasyāṃ tatrāpi devāyopahared balim ||
paścimāyāṃ yathā-kālaṃ daitya-bhūtāya catvare | / gandharvāya gavāṃ mārge sa-vastrābharaṇaṃ balim ||
pitṛ-nāga-grahe nadyāṃ nāgebhyaḥ pūrva-dakṣiṇe | / yakṣāya yakṣāyatane saritor vā samāgame ||
catuṣ-pathe rākṣasāya bhīmeṣu gahaneṣu ca | / rakṣasāṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ tu pūrvasyāṃ brahma-rakṣasām ||
śūnyālaye piśācāya paścimāṃ diśam āsthite | / śuci-śuklāni mālyāni gandhāḥ kṣaireyam odanam ||
dadhi cchattraṃ ca dhavalaṃ devānāṃ balir iṣyate | / hiṅgu-sarṣapa-ṣaḍgranthā-vyoṣair ardha-palonmitaiḥ ||
catur-guṇe gavāṃ mūtre ghṛta-prasthaṃ vipācayet | / tat-pāna-nāvanābhyaṅgair deva-graha-vimokṣaṇam ||
nasyāñjanaṃ vacā-hiṅgu-laśunaṃ basta-vāriṇā | / daitye balir bahu-phalaḥ sośīra-kamalotpalaḥ ||
nāgānāṃ sumano-lāja-guḍāpūpa-guḍaudanaiḥ | / paramānna-madhu-kṣīra-kṛṣṇa-mṛn-nāgakesaraiḥ ||
vacā-padma-purośīra-raktotpala-dalair baliḥ | / śvetapattraṃ ca lodhraṃ ca tagaraṃ nāga-sarṣapāḥ ||
śītena vāriṇā piṣṭaṃ nāvanāñjanayor hitam | / yakṣāṇāṃ kṣīra-dadhy-ājya-miśrakaudana-guggulu ||
devadārūtpalaṃ padmaṃ uśīraṃ vastra-kāñcanam | / hiraṇyaṃ ca balir yojyo mūtrājya-kṣīram ekataḥ ||
siddhaṃ samonmitaṃ pāna-nāvanābhyañjane hitam | / harītakī haridre dve laśuno maricaṃ vacā ||
nimba-pattraṃ ca bastāmbu-kalkitaṃ nāvanāñjanam | / brahma-rakṣo-baliḥ siddhaṃ yavānāṃ pūrṇam āḍhakam ||
toyasya kumbhaḥ palalaṃ chattraṃ vastram vilepanam | / gāyatrī-viṃśati-pala-kvāthe 'rdha-palikaiḥ pacet ||
try-ūṣaṇa-tri-phalā-hiṅgu-ṣaḍgranthā-miśi-sarṣapaiḥ | / sa-nimba-pattra-laśunaiḥ kuḍavān sapta sarpiṣaḥ ||
go-mūtre tri-guṇe pāna-nasyābhyaṅgeṣu tad dhitam | / rakṣasāṃ palalaṃ śuklaṃ kusumaṃ miśrakaudanam ||
baliḥ pakvāma-māṃsāni niṣpāvā rudhirokṣitāḥ | / naktamāla-śirīṣa-tvaṅ-mūla-puṣpa-phalāni ca ||
tad-vac ca kṛṣṇa-pāṭalyā bilva-mūlaṃ kaṭu-trikam | / hiṅgv-indrayava-siddhārtha-laśunāmalakī-phalam ||
nāvanāñjanayor yojyo basta-mūtra-yuto '-gadaḥ | / ebhir eva ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ gavāṃ mūtre catur-guṇe ||
rakṣo-grahān vārayate pānābhyañjana-nāvanaiḥ | / piśācānāṃ baliḥ sīdhuḥ piṇyākaḥ palalaṃ dadhi ||
mūlakaṃ lavaṇaṃ sarpiḥ sa-bhūtaudana-yāvakam | / haridrā-dvaya-mañjiṣṭhā-miśi-saindhava-nāgaram ||
hiṅgu-priyaṅgu-tri-kaṭu-laśuna-tri-phalā vacā | / pāṭalī-śveta-kaṭabhī-śirīṣa-kusumair ghṛtam ||
go-mūtra-pādikaṃ siddhaṃ pānābhyañjanayor hitam | / bastāmbu-piṣṭais tair eva yojyam añjana-nāvanam ||
devarṣi-pitṛ-gandharve tīkṣṇaṃ nasyādi varjayet | / sarpiḥ-pānādi mṛdv asmin bhaiṣajyam avacārayet ||
ṛte piśācāt sarveṣu pratikūlaṃ ca nācaret | / sa-vaidyam āturaṃ ghnanti kruddhās te hi mahaujasaḥ ||
īśvaraṃ dvā-daśa-bhujaṃ nātham āryāvalokitam | / sarva-vyādhi-cikitsāṃ ca japan sarva-grahān jayet ||
tathonmādān apasmārān anyaṃ vā citta-viplavam | / mahā-vidyāṃ ca māyūrīṃ śuciṃ taṃ śrāvayet sadā ||
bhūteśaṃ pūjayet sthāṇuṃ pramathākhyāṃś ca tad-gaṇān | / japan siddhāṃś ca tan-mantrān grahān sarvān apohati ||
yac cān-antarayoḥ kiñ-cid vakṣyate 'dhyāyayor hitam | / yac coktam iha tat sarvaṃ prayuñjīta paras-param ||
unmādāḥ ṣaṭ pṛthag-doṣa-nicayādhi-viṣodbhavāḥ | / unmādo nāma manaso doṣair unmārga-gair madaḥ ||
śārīra-mānasair duṣṭair a-hitād anna-pānataḥ | / vikṛtā-sātmya-sa-malād viṣamād upayogataḥ ||
viṣaṇṇasyālpa-sat-tvasya vyādhi-vega-samudgamāt | / kṣīṇasya ceṣṭā-vaiṣamyāt pūjya-pūjā-vyatikramāt ||
ādhibhir citta-vibhraṃśād viṣeṇopaviṣeṇa ca | / ebhir hi hīna-sat-tvasya hṛdi doṣāḥ pradūṣitāḥ ||
dhiyo vidhāya kāluṣyaṃ hṛtvā mārgān mano-vahān | / unmādaṃ kurvate tena dhī-vijñāna-smṛti-bhramāt ||
deho duḥkha-sukha-bhraṣṭo bhraṣṭa-sārathi-vad rathaḥ | / bhramaty a-cintitārambhas tatra vātāt kṛśāṅga-tā ||
a-sthāne rodanākrośa-hasita-smita-nartanam | / gīta-vāditra-vāg-aṅga-vikṣepāsphoṭanāni ca ||
a-sāmnā veṇu-vīṇādi-śabdānukaraṇaṃ muhuḥ | / āsyāt phenāgamo 'jasram aṭanaṃ bahu-bhāṣi-tā ||
alaṅkāro 'n-alaṅkārair a-yānair gamanodyamaḥ | / gṛddhir abhyavahāryeṣu tal-lābhe cāvamāna-tā ||
utpiṇḍitāruṇākṣi-tvaṃ jīrṇe cānne gadodbhavaḥ | / pittāt santarjanaṃ krodho muṣṭi-loṣṭādy-abhidravaḥ ||
śīta-cchāyodakākāṅkṣā nagna-tvaṃ pīta-varṇa-tā | / a-satya-jvalana-jvālā-tārakā-dīpa-darśanam ||
kaphād a-rocakaś chardir alpehāhāra-vākya-tā | / strī-kāma-tā rahaḥ-prītir lālā-siṅghāṇaka-srutiḥ ||
baibhatsyaṃ śauca-vidveṣo nidrā śvayathur ānane | / unmādo bala-vān rātrau bhukta-mātre ca jāyate ||
sarvāyatana-saṃsthāna-sannipāte tad-ātmakam | / unmādaṃ dāruṇaṃ vidyāt taṃ bhiṣak parivarjayet ||
dhana-kāntādi-nāśena duḥ-sahenābhiṣaṅga-vān | / pāṇḍur dīno muhur muhyan hāheti paridevate ||
rodity a-kasmān mriyate tad-guṇān bahu manyate | / śoka-kliṣṭa-manā dhyāyañ jāgarūko viceṣṭate ||
viṣeṇa śyāva-vadano naṣṭa-cchāyā-balendriyaḥ | / vegāntare 'pi sambhrānto raktākṣas taṃ vivarjayet ||
athānila-ja unmāde sneha-pānaṃ prayojayet | / pūrvam āvṛta-mārge tu sa-snehaṃ mṛdu śodhanam ||
kapha-pitta-bhave 'py ādau vamanaṃ sa-virecanam | / snigdha-svinnasya vastiṃ ca śirasaḥ sa-virecanam ||
tathāsya śuddha-dehasya prasādaṃ labhate manaḥ | / ittham apy anuvṛttau tu tīkṣṇaṃ nāvanam añjanam ||
harṣaṇāśvāsanottrāsa-bhaya-tāḍana-tarjanam | / abhyaṅgodvartanālepa-dhūpān pānaṃ ca sarpiṣaḥ ||
yuñjyāt tāni hi śuddhasya nayanti prakṛtiṃ manaḥ | / hiṅgu-sauvarcala-vyoṣair dvi-palāṃśair ghṛtāḍhakam ||
siddhaṃ sa-mūtram unmāda-bhūtāpasmāra-nut param | / dvau prasthau sva-rasād brāhmyā ghṛta-prasthaṃ ca sādhitam ||
vyoṣa-śyāmā-trivṛd-dantī-śaṅkhapuṣpī-nṛpadrumaiḥ | / sa-saptalā-kṛmiharaiḥ kalkitair akṣa-sammitaiḥ ||
pala-vṛddhyā prayuñjīta paraṃ mātrā catuḥ-palam | / unmāda-kuṣṭhāpasmāra-haraṃ vandhyā-suta-pradam ||
vāk-svara-smṛti-medhā-kṛd dhanyaṃ brāhmī-ghṛtaṃ smṛtam | / varā-viśālā-bhadrailā-devadārv-elavālukaiḥ ||
dvi-śārivā-dvi-rajanī-dvi-sthirā-phalinī-nataiḥ | / bṛhatī-kuṣṭha-mañjiṣṭhā-nāgakesara-dāḍimaiḥ ||
vella-tālīśa-pattrailā-mālatī-mukulotpalaiḥ | / sa-dantī-padmaka-himaiḥ karṣāṃśaiḥ sarpiṣaḥ pacet ||
prasthaṃ bhūta-grahonmāda-kāsāpasmāra-pāpmasu | / pāṇḍu-kaṇḍū-viṣe śoṣe mohe mehe gare jvare ||
a-retasy a-prajasi vā daivopahata-cetasi | / a-medhasi skhalad-vāci smṛti-kāme 'lpa-pāvake ||
balyaṃ maṅgalyam āyuṣyaṃ kānti-saubhāgya-puṣṭi-dam | / kalyāṇakam idaṃ sarpiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ puṃ-savaneṣu ca ||
ebhyo dvi-śārivādīni jale paktvaika-viṃśatim | / rase tasmin pacet sarpir gṛṣṭi-kṣīra-catur-guṇam ||
vīrā-dvi-medā-kākolī-kapikacchū-viṣāṇibhiḥ | / śūrpaparṇī-yutair etan mahā-kalyāṇakaṃ param ||
bṛṃhaṇaṃ sannipāta-ghnaṃ pūrvasmād adhikaṃ guṇaiḥ | / jaṭilā pūtanā keśī cāraṭī markaṭī vacā ||
trāyamāṇā jayā vīrā corakaḥ kaṭu-rohiṇī | / vayaḥsthā śūkarī chattrā sāticchattrā palaṅkaṣā ||
mahāpuruṣadantā ca kāyasthā nākulī-dvayam | / kaṭambharā vṛścikālī śāliparṇī ca tair ghṛtam ||
siddhaṃ cāturthikonmāda-grahāpasmāra-nāśanam | / mahā-paiśācakaṃ nāma ghṛtam etad yathāmṛtam ||
buddhi-medhā-smṛti-karaṃ bālānāṃ cāṅga-vardhanam | / brāhmīm aindrīṃ viḍaṅgāni vyoṣaṃ hiṅgu jaṭāṃ murām ||
rāsnāṃ viṣaghnāṃ laśunaṃ viśalyāṃ surasāṃ vacām | / jyotiṣmatīṃ nāgavinnām anantāṃ sa-harītakīm ||
kāṅkṣīṃ ca hasti-mūtreṇa piṣṭvā chāyā-viśoṣītā | / vartir nasyāñjanālepa-dhūpair unmāda-sūdanī ||
avapīḍāś ca vividhāḥ sarṣapāḥ sneha-saṃyutāḥ | / kaṭu-tailena cābhyaṅgo dhmāpayec cāsya tad rajaḥ ||
sa-hiṅgus tīkṣṇa-dhūmaś ca sūtra-sthānodito hitaḥ | / śṛgāla-śalyakolūka-jalaukā-vṛṣa-basta-jaiḥ ||
mūtra-pitta-śakṛd-roma-nakha-carmabhir ācaret | / dhūpa-dhūmāñjanābhyaṅga-pradeha-pariṣecanam ||
dhūpayet satataṃ cainaṃ śva-go-matsyaiḥ su-pūtibhiḥ | / vāta-śleṣmātmake prāyaḥ paittike tu praśasyate ||
tiktakaṃ jīvanīyaṃ ca sarpiḥ snehaś ca miśrakaḥ | / śītāni cānna-pānāni madhurāṇi laghūni ca ||
vidhyet sirāṃ yathoktāṃ vā tṛptaṃ medyāmiṣasya vā | / nivāte śāyayed evaṃ mucyate mati-vibhramāt ||
prakṣipyā-salile kūpe śoṣayed vā bubhukṣayā | / āśvāsayet suhṛt taṃ vā vākyair dharmārtha-saṃhitaiḥ ||
brūyād iṣṭa-vināśaṃ vā darśayed adbhutāni vā | / baddhaṃ sarṣapa-tailāktaṃ nyased vottānam ātape ||
kapikacchvātha-vā taptair loha-taila-jalaiḥ spṛśet | / kaśābhis tāḍayitvā vā baddhaṃ śvabhre viniḥkṣipet ||
atha-vā vīta-śastrāśma-jane santamase gṛhe | / sarpeṇoddhṛta-daṃṣṭreṇa dāntaiḥ siṃhair gajaiś ca tam ||
atha-vā rāja-puruṣā bahir nītvā su-saṃyatam | / bhāpayeyur vadhenainaṃ tarjayanto nṛpājñayā ||
deha-duḥkha-bhayebhyo hi paraṃ prāṇa-bhayaṃ matam | / tena yāti śamaṃ tasya sarvato viplutaṃ manaḥ ||
siddhā kriyā prayojyeyaṃ deśa-kālādy-apekṣayā | / iṣṭa-dravya-vināśāt tu mano yasyopahanyate ||
tasya tat-sadṛśa-prāpti-sāntvāśvāsaiḥ śamaṃ nayet | / kāma-śoka-bhaya-krodha-harṣerṣyā-lobha-sambhavān ||
paras-para-prati-dvandvair ebhir eva śamaṃ nayet | / bhūtānubandham īkṣeta prokta-liṅgādhikākṛtim ||
yady unmāde tataḥ kuryād bhūta-nirdiṣṭam auṣadham | / baliṃ ca dadyāt palalaṃ yāvakaṃ saktu-piṇḍikām ||
snigdhaṃ madhuram āhāraṃ taṇḍulān rudhirokṣitān | / pakvāmakāni māṃsāni surāṃ maireyam āsavam ||
atimuktasya puṣpāṇi jātyāḥ sahacarasya ca | / catuṣ-pathe gavāṃ tīrthe nadīnāṃ saṅgameṣu ca ||
nivṛttāmiṣa-madyo yo hitāśī prayataḥ śuciḥ | / nijāgantubhir unmādaiḥ sat-tva-vān na sa yujyate ||
prasāda indriyārthānāṃ buddhy-ātma-manasāṃ tathā | / dhātūnāṃ prakṛti-stha-tvaṃ vigatonmāda-lakṣaṇam ||
smṛty-apāyo hy apasmāraḥ sa dhī-sat-tvābhisamplavāt | / jāyate 'bhihate citte cintā-śoka-bhayādibhiḥ ||
unmāda-vat prakupitaiś citta-deha-gatair malaiḥ | / hate sat-tve hṛdi vyāpte sañjñā-vāhiṣu kheṣu ca ||
tamo viśan mūḍha-matir bībhatsāḥ kurute kriyāḥ | / dantān khādan vaman phenaṃ hastau pādau ca vikṣipan ||
paśyann a-santi rūpāṇi praskhalan patati kṣitau | / vijihmākṣi-bhruvo doṣa-vege 'tīte vibudhyate ||
kālāntareṇa sa punaś caivam eva viceṣṭate | / apasmāraś catur-bhedo vātādyair nicayena ca ||
rūpam utpatsyamāne 'smin hṛt-kampaḥ śūnya-tā bhramaḥ | / tamaso darśanaṃ dhyānaṃ bhrū-vyudāso 'kṣi-vaikṛtam ||
a-śabda-śravaṇaṃ svedo lālā-siṅghāṇaka-srutiḥ | / a-vipāko '-rucir mūrchā kukṣy-āṭopo bala-kṣayaḥ ||
nidrā-nāśo 'ṅga-mardas tṛṭ svapne gānaṃ sa-nartanam | / pānaṃ tailasya madyasya tayor eva ca mehanam ||
tatra vātāt sphurat-sakthiḥ prapataṃś ca muhur muhuḥ | / apasmarati sañjñāṃ ca labhate vi-svaraṃ rudan ||
utpiṇḍitākṣaḥ śvasiti phenaṃ vamati kampate | / āvidhyati śiro dantān daśaty ādhmāta-kandharaḥ ||
parito vikṣipaty aṅgaṃ viṣamaṃ vinatāṅguliḥ | / rūkṣa-śyāvāruṇākṣi-tvaṅ-nakhāsyaḥ kṛṣṇam īkṣate ||
capalaṃ paruṣaṃ rūpaṃ vi-rūpaṃ vikṛtānanam | / apasmarati pittena muhuḥ sañjñāṃ ca vindati ||
pīta-phenākṣi-vaktra-tvag āsphālayati medinīm | / bhairavādīpta-ruṣita-rūpa-darśī tṛṣānvitaḥ ||
kaphāc cireṇa grahaṇaṃ cireṇaiva vibodhanam | / ceṣṭālpā bhūyasī lālā śukla-netra-nakhāsya-tā ||
śuklābha-rūpa-darśi-tvaṃ sarva-liṅgaṃ tu varjayet | / athāvṛtānāṃ dhī-citta-hṛt-khānāṃ prāk-prabodhanam ||
tīkṣṇaiḥ kuryād apasmāre karmabhir vamanādibhiḥ | / vātikaṃ vasti-bhūyiṣṭhaiḥ paittaṃ prāyo virecanaiḥ ||
ślaiṣmikaṃ vamana-prāyair apasmāram upācaret | / sarvataḥ su-viśuddhasya samyag āśvāsitasya ca ||
apasmāra-vimokṣārthaṃ yogān saṃśamanāñ chṛṇu | / go-maya-sva-rasa-kṣīra-dadhi-mūtraiḥ śṛtaṃ haviḥ ||
apasmāra-jvaronmāda-kāmalānta-karaṃ pibet | / dvi-pañca-mūla-tri-phalā-dvi-niśā-kuṭaja-tvacaḥ ||
saptaparṇam apāmārgaṃ nīlinīṃ kaṭu-rohiṇīm | / śamyāka-puṣkara-jaṭā-phalgu-mūla-durālabhāḥ ||
dvi-palāḥ salila-droṇe paktvā pādāvaśeṣite | / bhārgī-pāṭhāḍhakī-kumbha-nikumbha-vyoṣa-rohiṣaiḥ ||
mūrvā-bhūtika-bhūnimba-śreyasī-śārivā-dvayaiḥ | / madayanty-agni-niculair akṣāṃśaiḥ sarpiṣaḥ pacet ||
prasthaṃ tad-vad dravaiḥ pūrvaiḥ pañca-gavyam idaṃ mahat | / jvarāpasmāra-jaṭhara-bhagandara-haraṃ param ||
śophārśaḥ-kāmalā-pāṇḍu-gulma-kāsa-grahāpaham | / brāhmī-rasa-vacā-kuṣṭha-śaṅkhapuṣpī-śṛtaṃ ghṛtam ||
purāṇaṃ medhyam unmādā-lakṣmy-apasmāra-pāpma-jit | / taila-prasthaṃ ghṛta-prasthaṃ jīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ ||
kṣīra-droṇe pacet siddham apasmāra-vimokṣaṇam | / kaṃse kṣīrekṣu-rasayoḥ kāśmarye 'ṣṭa-guṇe rase ||
kārṣikair jīvanīyaiś ca sarpiḥ-prasthaṃ vipācayet | / vāta-pittodbhavaṃ kṣipram apasmāraṃ nihanti tat ||
tad-vat kāśa-vidārīkṣu-kuśa-kvātha-śṛtaṃ payaḥ | / kūṣmāṇḍa-sva-rase sarpir aṣṭā-daśa-guṇe śṛtam ||
yaṣṭī-kalkam apasmāra-haraṃ dhī-vāk-svara-pradam | / kapilānāṃ gavāṃ pittaṃ nāvane paramaṃ hitam ||
śva-śṛgāla-biḍālānāṃ siṃhādīnāṃ ca pūjitam | / godhā-nakula-nāgānāṃ pṛṣatarkṣa-gavām api ||
pitteṣu sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasye 'bhyaṅge ca śasyate | / tri-phalā-vyoṣa-pītadru-yava-kṣāra-phaṇijjakaiḥ ||
śry-āhvāpāmārga-kārañja-bījais tailaṃ vipācitam | / basta-mūtre hitaṃ nasyaṃ cūrṇaṃ vā dhmāpayed bhiṣak ||
nakulolūka-mārjāra-gṛdhra-kīṭāhi-kāka-jaiḥ | / tuṇḍaiḥ pakṣaiḥ purīṣaiś ca dhūpam asya prayojayet ||
śīlayet taila-laśunaṃ payasā vā śatāvarīm | / brāhmī-rasaṃ kuṣṭha-rasaṃ vacāṃ vā madhu-saṃyutām ||
samaṃ kruddhair apasmāro doṣaiḥ śārīra-mānasaiḥ | / yaj jāyate yataś caiṣa mahā-marma-samāśrayaḥ ||
tasmād rasāyanair enaṃ duś-cikitsyam upācaret | / tad-ārtaṃ cāgni-toyāder viṣamāt pālayet sadā ||
muktaṃ mano-vikāreṇa tvam itthaṃ kṛta-vān iti | / na brūyād viṣayair iṣṭaiḥ kliṣṭaṃ ceto 'sya bṛṃhayet ||
sarva-roga-nidānoktair a-hitaiḥ kupitā malāḥ | / a-cakṣuṣyair viśeṣeṇa prāyaḥ pittānusāriṇaḥ ||
sirābhir ūrdhvaṃ prasṛtā netrāvayavam āśritāḥ | / vartma sandhiṃ sitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ vā sarvam akṣi vā ||
rogān kuryuś calas tatra prāpya vartmāśrayāḥ sirāḥ | / suptotthitasya kurute vartma-stambhaṃ sa-vedanam ||
pāṃsu-pūrṇābha-netra-tvaṃ kṛcchronmīlanam aśru ca | / vimardanāt syāc ca śamaḥ kṛcchronmūlaṃ vadanti tat ||
cālayan vartmanī vāyur nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ muhuḥ | / karoty a-ruṅ nimeṣo 'sau vartma yat tu nimīlyate ||
vimukta-sandhi niś-ceṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ vāta-hataṃ hi tat | / kṛṣṇāḥ pittena bahvyo 'ntar-vartma kumbhīka-bīja-vat ||
ādhmāyante punar bhinnāḥ piṭikāḥ kumbhi-sañjñitāḥ | / sa-dāha-kleda-nistodaṃ raktābhaṃ sparśanā-kṣamam ||
pittena jāyate vartma pittotkliṣṭam uśanti tat | / karoti kaṇḍūṃ dāhaṃ ca pittaṃ pakṣṃāntam āsthitam ||
pakṣmaṇāṃ śātanaṃ cānu pakṣma-śātaṃ vadanti tam | / pothakyaḥ piṭikāḥ śvetāḥ sarṣapābhā ghanāḥ kaphāt ||
śophopadeha-ruk-kaṇḍū-picchilāśru-samanvitāḥ | / kaphotkliṣṭaṃ bhaved vartma stambha-kledopadeha-vat ||
granthiḥ pāṇḍura-ruk-pākaḥ kaṇḍū-mān kaṭhinaḥ kaphāt | / kola-mātraḥ sa lagaṇaḥ kiñ-cid alpas tato 'tha-vā ||
raktā raktena piṭikā tat-tulya-piṭikācitā | / utsaṅgākhyā tathotkliṣṭaṃ rājī-mat sparśanā-kṣamam ||
arśo 'dhi-māṃsaṃ vartmāntaḥ stabdhaṃ snigdhaṃ sa-dāha-ruk | / raktaṃ raktena tat-srāvi cchinnaṃ chinnaṃ ca vardhate ||
madhye vā vartmano 'nte vā kaṇḍūṣā-rug-vatī sthirā | / mudga-mātrāsṛjā tāmrā piṭikāñjana-nāmikā ||
doṣair vartma bahiḥ śūnaṃ yad antaḥ sūkṣma-khācitam | / sa-srāvam antar-udakaṃ bisābhaṃ bisa-vartma tat ||
yad vartmotkliṣṭam utkliṣṭam a-kasmān mlāna-tām iyāt | / rakta-doṣa-trayotkleśād bhavaty utkliṣṭa-vartma tat ||
śyāva-vartma malaiḥ sāsraiḥ śyāvaṃ ruk-kleda-śopha-vat | / śliṣṭākhyaṃ vartmanī śliṣṭe kaṇḍū-śvayathu-rāgiṇī ||
vartmano 'ntaḥ kharā rūkṣāḥ piṭikāḥ sikatopamāḥ | / sikatā-vartma kṛṣṇaṃ tu kardamaṃ kardamopamam ||
bahalaṃ bahalair māṃsaiḥ sa-varṇaiś cīyate samaiḥ | / kukūṇakaḥ śiśor eva dantotpatti-nimitta-jaḥ ||
syāt tena śiśur ucchūna-tāmrākṣo vīkṣaṇā-kṣamaḥ | / sa-vartma-śūla-paicchilyaḥ karṇa-nāsākṣi-mardanaḥ ||
pakṣmoparodhe saṅkoco vartmanāṃ jāyate tathā | / khara-tāntar-mukha-tvaṃ ca romṇām anyāni vā punaḥ ||
kaṇṭakair iva tīkṣṇāgrair ghṛṣṭaṃ tair akṣi śūyate | / uṣyate cānilādi-dviḍ alpāhaḥ śāntir uddhṛtaiḥ ||
kanīnake bahir-vartma kaṭhino granthir unnataḥ | / tāmraḥ pakvo 'sra-pūya-srud alajy ādhmāyate muhuḥ ||
vartmāntar māṃsa-piṇḍābhaḥ śvayathur grathito '-rujaḥ | / sāsraiḥ syād arbudo doṣair viṣamo bāhyataś calaḥ ||
catur-viṃśatir ity ete vyādhayo vartma-saṃśrayāḥ | / ādyo 'tra bheṣajaiḥ sādhyo dvau tato 'rśaś ca varyajet ||
pakṣmoparodho yāpyaḥ syāc cheṣāñ chastreṇa sādhayet | / kuṭṭayet pakṣma-sadanaṃ chindyāt teṣv api cārbudam ||
bhindyāl lagaṇa-kumbhīkā-bisotsaṅgāñjanālajīḥ | / pothakī-śyāva-sikatā-śliṣṭotkliṣṭa-catuṣṭayam ||
kṛcchronmīle purāṇājyaṃ drākṣā-kalkāmbu-sādhitam | / sa-sitaṃ yojayet snigdhaṃ nasya-dhūmāñjanādi ca ||
kumbhīkā-vartma-likhitaṃ saindhava-pratisāritam | / yaṣṭī-dhātrī-paṭolīnāṃ kvāthena pariṣecayet ||
nivāte 'dhiṣṭhitasyāptaiḥ śuddhasyottāna-śāyinaḥ | / bahiḥ koṣṇāmbu-taptena sveditaṃ vartma vāsasā ||
nirbhujya vastrāntaritaṃ vāmāṅguṣṭhāṅgulī-ghṛtam | / na sraṃsate calati vā vartmaivaṃ sarvatas tataḥ ||
maṇḍalāgreṇa tat tiryak kṛtvā śastra-padāṅkitam | / likhet tenaiva pattrair vā śāka-śephālikādi-jaiḥ ||
phenena toya-rāśer vā picunā pramṛjann asṛk | / sthite rakte su-likhitaṃ sa-kṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet ||
yathā-svam uktair anu ca prakṣālyoṣṇena vāriṇā | / ghṛtena siktam abhyaktaṃ badhnīyān madhu-sarpiṣā ||
ūrdhvādhaḥ karṇayor dattvā piṇḍīṃ ca yava-saktubhiḥ | / dvitīye 'hani muktasya pariṣekaṃ yathā-yatham ||
kuryāc caturthe nasyādīn muñced evāhni pañcame | / samaṃ nakha-nibhaṃ śopha-kaṇḍū-gharṣādya-pīḍitam ||
vidyāt su-likhitaṃ vartma likhed bhūyo viparyaye | / ruk-pakṣma-vartma-sadana-sraṃsanāny ati-lekhanāt ||
sneha-svedādikas tasminn iṣṭo vāta-haraḥ kramaḥ | / abhyajya nava-nītena śveta-lodhraṃ pralepayet ||
eraṇḍa-mūla-kalkena puṭa-pāke pacet tataḥ | / svinnaṃ prakṣālitaṃ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇitaṃ poṭalī-kṛtam ||
striyāḥ kṣīre chagalyā vā mṛditaṃ netra-secanam | / śāli-taṇḍula-kalkena liptaṃ tad-vat pariṣkṛtam ||
kuryān netre 'ti-likhite mṛditaṃ dadhi-mastunā | / kevalenāpi vā sekaṃ mastunā jāṅgalāśinaḥ ||
piṭikā vrīhi-vaktreṇa bhittvā tu kaṭhinonnatāḥ | / niṣpīḍayed anu vidhiḥ pariśeṣas tu pūrva-vat ||
lekhane bhedane cāyaṃ kramaḥ sarva-tra vartmani | / pittāsrotkliṣṭayoḥ svādu-skandha-siddhena sarpiṣā ||
sirā-vimokṣaḥ snigdhasya trivṛc chreṣṭhaṃ virecanam | / likhite sruta-rakte ca vartmani kṣālanaṃ hitam ||
yaṣṭī-kaṣāyaḥ sekas tu kṣīraṃ candana-sādhitam | / pakṣmaṇāṃ sadane sūcyā roma-kūpān vikuṭṭayet ||
grāhayed vā jalaukobhiḥ payasekṣu-rasena vā | / vamanaṃ nāvanaṃ sarpiḥ śṛtaṃ madhura-śītalaiḥ ||
sañcūrṇya puṣpa-kāsīsaṃ bhāvayet surasā-rasaiḥ | / tāmre daśāhaṃ paramaṃ pakṣma-śāte tad añjanam ||
pothakīr likhitāḥ śuṇṭhī-saindhava-pratisāritāḥ | / uṣṇāmbu-kṣālitāḥ siñcet khadirāḍhaki-śigrubhiḥ ||
ap-siddhair dvi-niṣā-śreṣṭhā-madhukair vā sa-mākṣikaiḥ | / kaphotkliṣṭe vilikhite sa-kṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇam ||
sūkṣmaiḥ saindhava-kāsīsa-manohvā-kaṇa-tārkṣya-jaiḥ | / vamanāñjana-nasyādi sarvaṃ ca kapha-jid dhitam ||
kartavyaṃ lagaṇe 'py etad a-śāntāv agninā dahet | / kukūṇe khadira-śreṣṭhā-nimba-pattra-śṛtaṃ ghṛtam ||
pītvā dhātrī vamet kṛṣṇā-yaṣṭī-sarṣapa-saindhavaiḥ | / abhayā-pippalī-drākṣā-kvāthenaināṃ virecayet ||
mustā-dvi-rajanī-kṛṣṇā-kalkenālepayet stanau | / dhūpayet sarṣapaiḥ sājyaiḥ śuddhāṃ kvāthaṃ ca pāyayet ||
paṭola-musta-mṛdvīkā-guḍūcī-tri-phalodbhavam | / śiśos tu likhitaṃ vartma srutāsṛg vāmbu-janmabhiḥ ||
dhātry-aśmantaka-jambūttha-pattra-kvāthena secayet | / prāyaḥ kṣīra-ghṛtāśi-tvād bālānāṃ śleṣma-jā gadāḥ ||
tasmād vamanam evāgre sarva-vyādhiṣu pūjitam | / sindhūttha-kṛṣṇāpāmārga-bījājya-stanya-mākṣikam ||
cūrṇo vacāyāḥ sa-kṣaudro madanaṃ madhukānvitam | / kṣīraṃ kṣīrānnam annaṃ ca bhajataḥ kramataḥ śiśoḥ ||
vamanaṃ sarva-rogeṣu viśeṣeṇa kukūṇake | / saptalā-rasa-siddhājyaṃ yojyaṃ cobhaya-śodhanam ||
dvi-niśā-lodhra-yaṣṭy-āhva-rohiṇī-nimba-pallavaiḥ | / kukūṇake hitā vartiḥ piṣṭais tāmra-rajo-'nvitaiḥ ||
kṣīra-kṣaudra-ghṛtopetaṃ dagdhaṃ vā loha-jaṃ rajaḥ | / elā-laśuna-kataka-śaṅkhoṣaṇa-phaṇijjakaiḥ ||
vartiḥ kukūṇa-pothakyoḥ surā-piṣṭaiḥ sa-kaṭphalaiḥ | / pakṣma-rodhe pravṛddheṣu śuddha-dehasya romasu ||
utsṛjya dvau bhruvo 'dhas-tād bhāgau bhāgaṃ ca pakṣmataḥ | / yava-mātraṃ yavākāraṃ tiryak chittvārdra-vāsasā ||
apaneyam asṛk tasminn alpī-bhavati śoṇite | / sīvyet kuṭilayā sūcyā mudga-mātrāntaraiḥ padaiḥ ||
baddhvā lalāṭe paṭṭaṃ ca tatra sīvana-sūtrakam | / nāti-gāḍha-ślathaṃ sūcyā nikṣiped atha yojayet ||
madhu-sarpiḥ-kavalikāṃ na cāsmin bandham ācaret | / nyagrodhādi-kaṣāyaiś ca sa-kṣīraiḥ secayed ruji ||
pañcame divase sūtram apanīyāvacūrṇayet | / gairikeṇa vraṇaṃ yuñjyāt tīkṣṇaṃ nasyāñjanādi ca ||
dahed a-śāntau nirbhujya vartma-doṣāśrayāṃ valīm | / sandaṃśenādhikaṃ pakṣma hṛtvā tasyāśrayaṃ dahet ||
sūcy-agreṇāgni-varṇena dāho bāhyālajeḥ punaḥ | / bhinnasya kṣāra-vahnibhyāṃ su-cchinnasyārbudasya ca ||
vāyuḥ kruddhaḥ sirāḥ prāpya jalābhaṃ jala-vāhinīḥ | / aśru srāvayate vartma-śukla-sandheḥ kanīnakāt ||
tena netraṃ sa-rug-rāga-śophaṃ syāt sa jalāsravaḥ | / kaphāt kaphāsrave śvetaṃ picchilaṃ bahalaṃ sravet ||
kaphena śophas tīkṣṇāgraḥ kṣāra-budbudakopamaḥ | / pṛthu-mūla-balaḥ snigdhaḥ sa-varṇo mṛdu-picchilaḥ ||
mahān a-pākaḥ kaṇḍū-mān upanāhaḥ sa nī-rujaḥ | / raktād raktāsrāve tāmraṃ bahūṣṇaṃ cāśru saṃsravet ||
vartma-sandhy-āśrayā śukle piṭikā dāha-śūlinī | / tāmrā mudgopamā bhinnā raktaṃ sravati parvaṇī ||
pūyāsrave malāḥ sāsrā vartma-sandheḥ kanīnakāt | / srāvayanti muhuḥ pūyaṃ sāsraṃ tvaṅ-māṃsa-pākataḥ ||
pūyālaso vraṇaḥ sūkṣmaḥ śopha-saṃrambha-pūrvakaḥ | / kanīna-sandhāv ādhmāyī pūyāsrāvī sa-vedanaḥ ||
kanīnasyāntar alajī śopho ruk-toda-dāha-vān | / apāṅge vā kanīne vā kaṇḍūṣā-pakṣma-poṭa-vān ||
pūyāsrāvī kṛmi-granthir granthiḥ kṛmi-yuto 'rti-mān | / upanāha-kṛmi-granthi-pūyālasaka-parvaṇīḥ ||
śastreṇa sādhayet pañca sālajīn āsravāṃs tyajet | / pittaṃ kuryāt site bindūn asita-śyāva-pītakān ||
malāktādarśa-tulyaṃ vā sarvaṃ śuklaṃ sa-dāha-ruk | / rogo 'yaṃ śuktikā-sañjñaḥ sa-śakṛd-bheda-tṛḍ-jvaraḥ ||
kaphāc chukle samaṃ śvetaṃ cira-vṛddhy-adhi-māṃsakam | / śuklārma śophas tv a-rujaḥ sa-varṇo bahalo '-mṛduḥ ||
guruḥ snigdho 'mbu-bindv-ābho balāsa-grathitaṃ smṛtaṃ | / bindubhiḥ piṣṭa-dhavalair utsannaiḥ piṣṭakaṃ vadet ||
rakta-rājī-tataṃ śuklam uṣyate yat sa-vedanam | / a-śophāśrūpadehaṃ ca sirotpātaḥ sa śoṇitāt ||
upekṣitah sirotpāto rājīs tā eva vardhayan | / kuryāt sāsraṃ sirā-harṣaṃ tenākṣy-udvīkṣaṇā-kṣamam ||
sirā-jāle sirā-jālaṃ bṛhad raktaṃ ghanonnatam | / śoṇitārma samaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ padmābham adhi-māṃsakam ||
nī-ruk ślakṣṇo 'rjunaṃ binduḥ śaśa-lohita-lohitaḥ | / mṛdv-āśu-vṛddhy-a-ruṅ-māṃsaṃ prastāri śyāva-lohitam ||
prastāry-arma malaiḥ sāsraiḥ snāvārma snāva-sannibham | / śuṣkāsṛk-piṇḍa-vac chyāvaṃ yan māṃsaṃ bahalaṃ pṛthu ||
adhi-māṃsārma tad dāha-gharṣa-vatyaḥ sirāvṛtāḥ | / kṛṣṇāsannāḥ sirā-sañjñāḥ piṭikāḥ sarṣapopamāḥ ||
śukti-harṣa-sirotpāta-piṣṭaka-grathitārjunam | / sādhayed auṣadhaiḥ ṣaṭkaṃ śeṣaṃ śastreṇa saptakam ||
navotthaṃ tad api dravyair armoktaṃ yac ca pañca-dhā | / tac chedyam asita-prāptaṃ māṃsa-snāva-sirāvṛtam ||
carmoddāla-vad ucchrāyi dṛṣṭi-prāptaṃ ca varjayet | / pittaṃ kṛṣṇe 'tha-vā dṛṣṭau śukraṃ todāśru-rāga-vat ||
chittvā tvacaṃ janayati tena syāt kṛṣṇa-maṇḍalam | / pakva-jambū-nibhaṃ kiñ-cin nimnaṃ ca kṣata-śukrakam ||
tat kṛcchra-sādhyaṃ yāpyaṃ tu dvitīya-paṭala-vyadhāt | / tatra todādi-bāhulyaṃ sūcī-viddhābha-kṛṣṇa-tā ||
tṛtīya-paṭala-cchedād a-sādhyaṃ nicitaṃ vraṇaiḥ | / śaṅkha-śuklaṃ kaphāt sādhyaṃ nāti-ruk śuddha-śukrakam ||
ā-tāmra-picchilāsra-srud ā-tāmra-piṭikāti-ruk | / ajā-viṭ-sadṛśocchrāya-kārṣṇyā varjyāsṛjājakā ||
sirā-śukraṃ malaiḥ sāsrais taj-juṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇa-maṇḍalam | / sa-toda-dāha-tāmrābhiḥ sirābhir avatanyate ||
a-nimittoṣṇa-śītāccha-ghanāsra-sruc ca tat tyajet | / doṣaiḥ sāsraiḥ sakṛt kṛṣṇaṃ nīyate śukla-rūpa-tām ||
dhavalābhropaliptābhaṃ niṣpāvārdha-dalākṛti | / ati-tīvra-rujā-rāga-dāha-śvayathu-pīḍitam ||
pākātyayena tac chukraṃ varjayet tīvra-vedanam | / yasya vā liṅga-nāśo 'ntaḥ śyāvaṃ yad vā sa-lohitam ||
aty-utsedhāvagāḍhaṃ vā sāśru nāḍī-vraṇāvṛtam | / purāṇaṃ viṣamaṃ madhye vicchinnaṃ yac ca śukrakam ||
upanāhaṃ bhiṣak svinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vrīhi-mukhena ca | / lekhayen maṇḍalāgreṇa tataś ca pratisārayet ||
pippalī-kṣaudra-sindhūtthair badhnīyāt pūrva-vat tataḥ | / paṭola-pattrāmalaka-kvāthenāścyotayec ca tam ||
parvaṇī baḍiśenāttā bāhya-sandhi-tri-bhāgataḥ | / vṛddhi-pattreṇa vardhyārdhe syād aśru-gatir anya-thā ||
cikitsā cārma-vat kṣaudra-saindhava-pratisāritā | / pūyālase sirāṃ vidhyet tatas tam upanāhayet ||
kurvīta cākṣi-pākoktaṃ sarvaṃ karma yathā-vidhi | / saindhavārdraka-kāsīsa-loha-tāmraiḥ su-cūrṇitaiḥ ||
cūrṇāñjanaṃ prayuñjīta sa-kṣaudrair vā rasa-kriyām | / kṛmi-granthiṃ karīṣeṇa svinnaṃ bhittvā vilikhya ca ||
tri-phalā-kṣaudra-kāsīsa-saindhavaiḥ pratisārayet | / pittābhiṣyanda-vac chuktiṃ balāsāhvaya-piṣṭake ||
kaphābhiṣyanda-van muktvā sirā-vyadham upācaret | / bījapūra-rasāktaṃ ca vyoṣa-kaṭphalam añjanam ||
jātī-mukula-sindhūttha-devadāru-mahauṣadhaiḥ | / piṣṭaiḥ prasannayā vartiḥ śopha-kaṇḍū-ghnam añjanam ||
rakta-syanda-vad utpāta-harṣa-jālārjuna-kriyā | / sirotpāte viśeṣeṇa ghṛta-mākṣikam añjanam ||
sirā-harṣe tu madhunā ślakṣṇa-ghṛṣṭaṃ rasāñjanam | / arjune śarkarā-mastu-kṣaudrair āścyotanaṃ hitam ||
sphaṭikaḥ kuṅkumaṃ śaṅkho madhukaṃ madhunāñjanam | / madhunā cāñjanaṃ śaṅkhaḥ pheno vā sitayā saha ||
armoktaṃ pañca-dhā tatra tanu dhūmāvilaṃ ca yat | / raktaṃ dadhi-nibhaṃ yac ca śukra-vat tasya bheṣajam ||
uttānasyetarat svinnaṃ sa-sindhūtthena cāñjitam | / rasena bījapūrasya nimīlyākṣi vimardayet ||
itthaṃ saṃroṣitākṣasya pracale 'rmādhi-māṃsake | / ghṛtasya niś-calaṃ mūrdhni vartmanoś ca viśeṣataḥ ||
apāṅgam īkṣamāṇasya vṛddhe 'rmaṇi kanīnakāt | / valī syād yatra tatrārma baḍiśenāvalambitam ||
nāty-āyataṃ mucuṇḍyā vā sūcyā sūtreṇa vā tataḥ | / samantān maṇḍalāgreṇa mocayed atha mokṣitam ||
kanīnakam upānīya catur-bhāgāvaśeṣitam | / chindyāt kanīnakaṃ rakṣed vāhinīś cāśru-vāhinīḥ ||
kanīnaka-vyadhād aśru nāḍī cākṣṇi pravartate | / vṛddhe 'rmaṇi tathāpāṅgāt paśyato 'sya kanīnakam ||
samyak-chinnaṃ madhu-vyoṣa-saindhava-pratisāritam | / uṣṇena sarpiṣā siktam abhyaktaṃ madhu-sarpiṣā ||
badhnīyāt secayen muktvā tṛtīyādi-dineṣu ca | / karañja-bīja-siddhena kṣīreṇa kvathitais tathā ||
sa-kṣaudrair dvi-niśā-lodhra-paṭolī-yaṣṭi-kiṃśukaiḥ | / kuraṇṭa-mukulopetair muñced evāhni saptame ||
samyak-chinne bhavet svāsthyaṃ hīnāti-ccheda-jān gadān | / sekāñjana-prabhṛtibhir jayel lekhana-bṛṃhaṇaiḥ ||
sitā-manaḥśilaileya-lavaṇottama-nāgaram | / ardha-karṣonmitaṃ tārkṣyaṃ palārdhaṃ ca madhu-drutam ||
añjanaṃ śleṣma-timira-pilla-śukrārma-śoṣa-jit | / tri-phalaika-tama-dravya-tvacaṃ pānīya-kalkitām ||
śarāva-pihitāṃ dagdhvā kapāle cūrṇayet tataḥ | / pṛthak-śeṣauṣadha-rasaiḥ pṛthag eva ca bhāvitā ||
sā maṣī śoṣitā peṣyā bhūyo dvi-lavaṇānvitā | / trīṇy etāny añjanāny āha lekhanāni paraṃ nimiḥ ||
sirā-jāle sirā yās tu kaṭhinā lekhanauṣadhaiḥ | / na sidhyanty arma-vat tāsāṃ piṭikānāṃ ca sādhanam ||
doṣānurodhāc chukreṣu snigdha-rūkṣā varā ghṛtam | / tiktam ūrdhvam asṛk-srāvo reka-sekādi ceṣyate ||
tris trivṛd-vāriṇā pakvaṃ kṣata-śukre ghṛtaṃ pibet | / sirayānu hared raktaṃ jalaukobhiś ca locanāt ||
siddhenotpala-kākolī-drākṣā-yaṣṭī-vidāribhiḥ | / sa-sitenāja-payasā secanaṃ salilena vā ||
rāgāśru-vedanā-śāntau paraṃ lekhanam añjanam | / vartayo jāti-mukula-lākṣā-gairika-candanaiḥ ||
prasādayanti pittāsraṃ ghnanti ca kṣata-śukrakam | / dantair danti-varāhoṣṭra-gavāśvāja-kharodbhavaiḥ ||
sa-śaṅkha-mauktikāmbho-dhi-phenair marica-pādikaiḥ | / kṣata-śukram api vyāpi danta-vartir nivartayet ||
tamāla-pattraṃ go-danta-śaṅkha-pheno 'sthi gārdabham | / tāmraṃ ca vartir mūtreṇa sarva-śukraka-nāśinī ||
ratnāni dantāḥ śṛṅgāṇi dhātavas try-ūṣaṇaṃ truṭī | / karañja-bījaṃ laśuno vraṇa-sādi ca bheṣajam ||
sa-vraṇā-vraṇa-gambhīra-tvak-stha-śukra-ghnam añjanam | / nimnam unnamayet sneha-pāna-nasya-rasāñjanaiḥ ||
sa-rujaṃ nī-rujaṃ tṛpti-puṭa-pākena śukrakam | / śuddha-śukre niśā-yaṣṭī-śārivā-śābarāmbhasā ||
secanaṃ lodhra-poṭalyā koṣṇāmbho-magnayātha-vā | / bṛhatī-mūla-yaṣṭy-āhva-tāmra-saindhava-nāgaraiḥ ||
dhātrī-phalāmbunā piṣṭair lepitaṃ tāmra-bhājanam | / yavājyāmalakī-pattrair bahu-śo dhūpayet tataḥ ||
tatra kurvīta guṭikās tā jala-kṣaudra-peṣitāḥ | / mahā-nīlā iti khyātāḥ śuddha-śukra-harāḥ param ||
sthire śukre ghane cāsya bahu-śo 'pahared asṛk | / śiraḥ-kāya-virekāṃś ca puṭa-pākāṃś ca bhūri-śaḥ ||
kuryān marica-vaidehī-śirīṣa-phala-saindhavaiḥ | / harṣaṇaṃ tri-phalā-kvātha-pītena lavaṇena vā ||
kuryād añjana-yogau vā ślokārdha-gaditāv imau | / śaṅkha-kolāsthi-kataka-drākṣā-madhuka-mākṣikaiḥ ||
surā-dantārṇava-malaiḥ śirīṣa-kusumānvitaiḥ | / dhātrī-phaṇijjaka-rase kṣāro lāṅgalikodbhavaḥ ||
uṣitaḥ śoṣitaś cūrṇaḥ śukra-harṣaṇam añjanam | / mudgā vā nis-tuṣāḥ piṣṭāḥ śaṅkha-kṣaudra-samāyutāḥ ||
sāro madhūkān madhu-mān majjā vākṣāt sa-mākṣikā | / go-kharāśvoṣṭra-daśanāḥ śaṅkhaḥ phenaḥ samudra-jaḥ ||
vartir arjuna-toyena hṛṣṭa-śukraka-nāśinī | / utsannaṃ vā sa-śalyaṃ vā śūkraṃ vālādibhir likhet ||
sirā-śukre tv a-dṛṣṭi-ghne cikitsā vraṇa-śukra-vat | / puṇḍra-yaṣṭy-āhva-kākolī-siṃhī-loha-niśāñjanam ||
kalkitaṃ chāga-dugdhena sa-ghṛtair dhūpitaṃ yavaiḥ | / dhātrī-pattraiś ca paryāyād vartir atrāñjanaṃ param ||
a-śāntāv arma-vac chastram ajakākhye ca yojayet | / ajakāyām a-sādhyāyāṃ śukre 'nya-tra ca tad-vidhe ||
vedanopaśamaṃ sneha-pānāsṛk-srāvaṇādibhiḥ | / kuryād bībhatsa-tāṃ jetuṃ śukrasyotsedha-sādhanam ||
nārikelāsthi-bhallāta-tāla-vaṃśa-karīra-jam | / bhasmādbhiḥ srāvayet tābhir bhāvayet karabhāsthi-jam ||
cūrṇaṃ śukreṣv a-sādhyeṣu tad vaivarṇya-ghnam añjanam | / sādhyeṣu sādhanāyālam idam eva ca śīlitam ||
ajakāṃ pārśvato viddhvā sūcyā visrāvya codakam | / samaṃ prapīḍyāṅguṣṭhena vasārdreṇānu pūrayet ||
vraṇaṃ go-māṃsa-cūrṇena baddhaṃ baddhaṃ vimucya ca | / sapta-rātrād vraṇe rūḍhe kṛṣṇa-bhāge same sthire ||
snehāñjanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ nasyaṃ ca kṣīra-sarpiṣā | / tathāpi punar-ādhmāne bheda-cchedādikāṃ kriyām ||
nityaṃ ca śukreṣu śṛtaṃ yathā-svaṃ pāne ca marśe ca ghṛtaṃ vidadhyāt | / na hīyate labdha-balā tathāntas tīkṣṇāñjanair dṛk satataṃ prayuktaiḥ ||
sirānusāriṇi male prathamaṃ paṭalaṃ śrite | / a-vyaktam īkṣate rūpaṃ vyaktam apy a-nimittataḥ ||
prāpte dvitīyaṃ paṭalaṃ a-bhūtam api paśyati | / bhūtaṃ tu yatnād āsannaṃ dūre sūkṣmaṃ ca nekṣate ||
dūrāntika-sthaṃ rūpaṃ ca viparyāsena manyate | / doṣe maṇḍala-saṃsthāne maṇḍalānīva paśyati ||
dvi-dhaikaṃ dṛṣṭi-madhya-sthe bahu-dhā bahu-dhā-sthite | / dṛṣṭer abhyantara-gate hrasva-vṛddha-viparyayam ||
nāntika-stham adhaḥ-saṃsthe dūra-gaṃ nopari sthite | / pārśve paśyen na pārśva-sthe timirākhyo 'yam āmayaḥ ||
prāpnoti kāca-tāṃ doṣe tṛtīya-paṭalāśrite | / tenordhvam īkṣate nādhas tanu-cailāvṛtopamam ||
yathā-varṇaṃ ca rajyeta dṛṣṭir hīyeta ca kramāt | / tathāpy upekṣamāṇasya caturthaṃ paṭalaṃ gataḥ ||
liṅga-nāśaṃ malaḥ kurvaṃś chādayed dṛṣṭi-maṇḍalam | / tatra vātena timire vyāviddham iva paśyati ||
calāvilāruṇābhāsaṃ prasannaṃ cekṣate muhuḥ | / jālāni keśān maśakān raśmīṃś copekṣite 'tra ca ||
kācī-bhūte dṛg aruṇā paśyaty āsyam a-nāsikam | / candra-dīpādy-aneka-tvaṃ vakram ṛjv api manyate ||
vṛddhaḥ kāco dṛśaṃ kuryād rajo-dhūmāvṛtām iva | / spaṣṭāruṇābhāṃ vistīrṇāṃ sūkṣmāṃ vā hata-darśanām ||
sa liṅga-nāśo vāte tu saṅkocayati dṛk-sirāḥ | / dṛṅ-maṇḍalaṃ viśaty antar gambhīrā dṛg asau smṛtā ||
pitta-je timire vidyut-khadyota-dyota-dīpitam | / śikhi-tittiri-pattrābhaṃ prāyo nīlaṃ ca paśyati ||
kāce dṛg kāca-nīlābhā tādṛg eva ca paśyati | / arkendu-pariveṣāgni-marīcīndra-dhanūṃṣi ca ||
bhṛṅga-nīlā nir-ālokā dṛk snigdhā liṅga-nāśataḥ | / dṛṣṭiḥ pittena hrasvākhyā sā hrasvā hrasva-darśinī ||
bhavet pitta-vidagdhākhyā pītā pītābha-darśanā | / kaphena timire prāyaḥ snigdhaṃ śvetaṃ ca paśyati ||
śaṅkhendu-kunda-kusumaiḥ kumudair iva cācitam | / kāce tu niṣ-prabhendv-arka-pradīpādyair ivācitam ||
sitābhā sā ca dṛṣṭiḥ syāl liṅga-nāśe tu lakṣyate | / mūrtaḥ kapho dṛṣṭi-gataḥ snigdho darśana-nāśanaḥ ||
bindur jalasyeva calaḥ padminī-puṭa-saṃsthitaḥ | / uṣṇe saṅkocam āyāti cchāyāyāṃ parisarpati ||
śaṅkha-kundendu-kumuda-sphaṭikopama-śuklimā | / raktena timire raktaṃ tamo-bhūtaṃ ca paśyati ||
kācena raktā kṛṣṇā vā dṛṣṭis tādṛk ca paśyati | / liṅga-nāśe 'pi tādṛg dṛṅ niṣ-prabhā hata-darśanā ||
saṃsarga-sannipāteṣu vidyāt saṅkīrṇa-lakṣaṇān | / timirādīn a-kasmāc ca taiḥ syād vyaktākulekṣaṇaḥ ||
timire śeṣayor dṛṣṭau citro rāgaḥ prajāyate | / dyotyate nakulasyeva yasya dṛṅ nicitā malaiḥ ||
nakulāndhaḥ sa tatrāhni citraṃ paśyati no niśi | / arke 'sta-mastaka-nyasta-gabhastau stambham āgatāḥ ||
sthagayanti dṛśaṃ doṣā doṣāndhaḥ sa gado 'paraḥ | / divā-kara-kara-spṛṣṭā bhraṣṭā dṛṣṭi-pathān malāḥ ||
vilīna-līnā yacchanti vyaktam atrāhni darśanam | / uṣṇa-taptasya sahasā śīta-vāri-nimajjanāt ||
tri-doṣa-rakta-sampṛkto yāty ūṣmordhvaṃ tato 'kṣiṇi | / dāhoṣe malinaṃ śuklam ahany āvila-darśanam ||
rātrāv āndhyaṃ ca jāyeta vidagdhoṣṇena sā smṛtā | / bhṛśam amlāśanād doṣaiḥ sāsrair yā dṛṣṭir ācitā ||
sa-kleda-kaṇḍū-kaluṣā vidagdhāmlena sā smṛtā | / śoka-jvara-śiro-roga-santaptasyānilādayaḥ ||
dhūmāvilāṃ dhūma-dṛśaṃ dṛśaṃ kuryuḥ sa dhūmaraḥ | / sahasaivālpa-sat-tvasya paśyato rūpam adbhutam ||
bhāsvaraṃ bhās-karādiṃ vā vātādyā nayanāśritāḥ | / kurvanti tejaḥ saṃśoṣya dṛṣṭiṃ muṣita-darśanām ||
vaiḍūrya-varṇāṃ stimitāṃ prakṛti-sthām ivā-vyathām | / aupasargika ity eṣa liṅga-nāśo 'tra varjayet ||
vinā kaphāl liṅga-nāśān gambhīrāṃ hrasva-jām api | / ṣaṭ kācā nakulāndhaś ca yāpyāḥ śeṣāṃs tu sādhayet ||
timiraṃ kāca-tāṃ yāti kāco 'py āndhyam upekṣayā | / netra-rogeṣv ato ghoraṃ timiraṃ sādhayed drutam ||
tulāṃ paceta jīvantyā droṇe 'pāṃ pāda-śeṣite | / tat-kvāthe dvi-guṇa-kṣīraṃ ghṛta-prasthaṃ vipācayet ||
prapauṇḍarīka-kākolī-pippalī-lodhra-saindhavaiḥ | / śatāhvā-madhuka-drākṣā-sitā-dāru-phala-trayaiḥ ||
kārṣikair niśi tat pītaṃ timirāpaharaṃ param | / drākṣā-candana-mañjiṣṭhā-kākolī-dvaya-jīvakaiḥ ||
sitā-śatāvarī-medā-puṇḍrāhva-madhukotpalaiḥ | / pacej jīrṇa-ghṛta-prasthaṃ sama-kṣīraṃ picūnmitaiḥ ||
hanti tat kāca-timira-rakta-rājī-śiro-rujaḥ | / paṭola-nimba-kaṭukā-dārvī-sevya-varā-vṛṣam ||
sa-dhanvayāsa-trāyantī-parpaṭaṃ pālikaṃ pṛthak | / prastham āmalakānāṃ ca kvāthayen nalvaṇe 'mbhasi ||
tad-āḍhake 'rdha-palikaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ prasthaṃ ghṛtāt pacet | / musta-bhūnimba-yaṣṭy-āhva-kuṭajodīcya-candanaiḥ ||
sa-pippalīkais tat sarpir ghrāṇa-karṇāsya-roga-jit | / vidradhi-jvara-duṣṭārur-visarpāpaci-kuṣṭha-nut ||
viśeṣāc chukra-timira-naktāndhyoṣṇāmla-dāha-hṛt | / tri-phalāṣṭa-palaṃ kvāthyaṃ pāda-śeṣaṃ jalāḍhake ||
tena tulya-payaskena tri-phalā-pala-kalka-vān | / ardha-prastho ghṛtāt siddhaḥ sitayā mākṣikeṇa vā ||
yuktaṃ pibet tat timirī tad-yuktaṃ vā varā-rasam | / yaṣṭīmadhu-dvi-kākolī-vyāghrī-kṛṣṇāmṛtotpalaiḥ ||
pālikaiḥ sa-sitā-drākṣair ghṛta-prasthaṃ pacet samaiḥ | / ajā-kṣīra-varā-vasā-mārkava-sva-rasaiḥ pṛthak ||
mahā-traiphalam ity etat paraṃ dṛṣṭi-vikāra-jit | / traiphalenātha haviṣā lihānas tri-phalāṃ niśi ||
yaṣṭīmadhuka-saṃyuktāṃ madhunā ca pariplutām | / māsam ekaṃ hitāhāraḥ pibann āmalakodakam ||
sauparṇaṃ labhate cakṣur ity āha bhaga-vān nimiḥ | / tāpyāyo-hema-yaṣṭy-āhva-sitā-jīrṇājya-mākṣikaiḥ ||
saṃyojitā yathā-kāmaṃ timira-ghnī varā varā | / sa-ghṛtaṃ vā varā-kvāthaṃ śīlayet timirāmayī ||
apūpa-sūpa-saktūn vā tri-phalā-cūrṇa-saṃyutān | / pāyasaṃ vā varā-yuktaṃ śītaṃ sa-madhu-śarkaram ||
prātar bhaktasya vā pūrvam adyāt pathyāṃ pṛthak pṛthak | / mṛdvīkā-śarkarā-kṣaudraiḥ satataṃ timirāturaḥ ||
sroto-jāṃśāṃś catuḥ-ṣaṣṭiṃ tāmrāyo-rūpya-kāñcanaiḥ | / yuktān praty-ekam ekāṃśair andha-mūṣodara-sthitān ||
dhmāpayitvā samāvṛttaṃ tatas tac ca niṣecayet | / rasa-skandha-kaṣāyeṣu sapta-kṛtvaḥ pṛthak pṛthak ||
vaiḍūrya-muktā-śaṅkhānāṃ tribhir bhāgair yutaṃ tataḥ | / cūrṇāñjanaṃ prayuñjīta tat sarva-timirāpaham ||
māṃsī-tri-jātakāyaḥ-kuṅkuma-nīlotpalābhayā-tutthaiḥ | / sita-kāca-śaṅkha-phenaka-maricāñjana-pippalī-madhukaiḥ ||
candre 'śvinī-sa-nāthe su-cūrṇitair añjayed yugalaṃ akṣṇoḥ | / timirārma-rakta-rājī-kaṇḍū-kācādi-śamam icchan ||
marica-vara-lavaṇa-bhāgau bhāgau dvau kaṇa-samudra-phenābhyām | / sauvīra-bhāga-navakaṃ citrāyāṃ cūrṇitaṃ kaphāmaya-jit ||
drākṣā-mṛṇālī-sva-rase kṣīra-madya-vasāsu ca | / pṛthak divyāpsu sroto-jaṃ sapta-kṛtvo niṣecayet ||
tac cūrṇitaṃ sthitaṃ śaṅkhe dṛk-prasādanam añjanam | / śastaṃ sarvākṣi-rogeṣu videha-pati-nirmitam ||
nirdagdhaṃ bādarāṅgārais tutthaṃ cetthaṃ niṣecitam | / kramād ajā-payaḥ-sarpiḥ-kṣaudre tasmāt pala-dvayam ||
kārṣikais tāpya-marica-sroto-ja-kaṭukā-nataiḥ | / paṭu-lodhra-śilā-pathyā-kaṇailāñjana-phenakaiḥ ||
yuktaṃ palena yaṣṭyāś ca mūṣāntar-dhmāta-cūrṇitam | / hanti kācārma-naktāndhya-rakta-rājīḥ su-śīlitaḥ ||
cūrṇo viśeṣāt timiraṃ bhās-karo bhās-karo yathā | / triṃśad-bhāgā bhujaṅgasya gandha-pāṣāṇa-pañcakam ||
śulba-tālakayor dvau dvau vaṅgasyaiko 'ñjanāt trayam | / andha-mūṣī-kṛtaṃ dhmātaṃ pakvaṃ vi-malam añjanam ||

timirānta-karaṃ loke dvitīya iva bhās-karaḥ || 33ab || / go-mūtre chagaṇa-rase 'mla-kāñjike ca strī-stanye || 33c || / haviṣi viṣe ca mākṣike ca || 33d || / yat tutthaṃ jvalitam aneka-śo niṣiktaṃ || 33e || / tat kuryād garuḍa-samaṃ narasya cakṣuḥ || 33f ||
śreṣṭhā-jalaṃ bhṛṅga-rasaṃ sa-viṣājyam ajā-payaḥ | / yaṣṭī-rasaṃ ca yat sīsaṃ sapta-kṛtvaḥ pṛthak pṛthak ||
taptaṃ taptaṃ pāyitaṃ tac-chalākā netre yuktā sāñjanān-añjanā vā | / taimiryārma-srāva-paicchilya-paillaṃ kaṇḍūṃ jāḍyaṃ rakta-rājīṃ ca hanti ||
rasendra-bhujagau tulyau tayos tulyam athāñjanam | / īṣat-karpūra-saṃyuktam añjanaṃ timirāpaham ||
yo gṛdhras taruṇa-ravi-prakāśa-gallas tasyāsyaṃ samaya-mṛtasya go-śakṛdbhiḥ | / nirdagdhaṃ sama-ghṛtam añjanaṃ ca peṣyaṃ yogo 'yaṃ nayana-balaṃ karoti gārdhram ||
kṛṣṇa-sarpa-vadane sa-haviṣkaṃ dagdham añjana-niḥsṛta-dhūmam | / cūrṇitaṃ nalada-pattra-vimiśraṃ bhinna-tāram api rakṣati cakṣuḥ ||
kṛṣṇa-sarpaṃ mṛtaṃ nyasya caturaś cāpi vṛścikān | / kṣīra-kumbhe tri-saptāhaṃ kledayitvā pramanthayet ||
tatra yan nava-nītaṃ syāt puṣṇīyāt tena kukkuṭam | / andhas tasya puṛīṣeṇa prekṣate dhruvam añjanāt ||
kṛṣṇa-sarpa-vasā śaṅkhaḥ katakāt phalam añjanam | / rasa-kriyeyam a-cirād andhānāṃ darśana-pradā ||
maricāni daśārdha-picus tāpyāt tutthāt palaṃ picur yaṣṭyāḥ | / kṣīrārdra-dagdham añjanam a-pratisārākhyam uttamaṃ timire ||
akṣa-bīja-maricāmalaka-tvak-tuttha-yaṣṭimadhukair jala-piṣṭaiḥ | / chāyayaiva guṭikāḥ pariśuṣkā nāśayanti timirāṇy a-cireṇa ||
maricāmalaka-jalodbhava-tutthāñjana-tāpya-dhātubhiḥ krama-vṛddhaiḥ | / ṣaṇ-mākṣika iti yogas timirārma-kleda-kāca-kaṇḍū-hantā ||
ratnāni rūpyaṃ sphaṭikaṃ suvarṇaṃ sroto-'ñjanaṃ tāmram ayaḥ sa-śaṅkhaṃ | / ku-candanaṃ lohita-gairikaṃ ca cūrṇāñjanaṃ sarva-dṛg-āmaya-ghnam ||
tila-tailam akṣa-tailaṃ bhṛṅga-sva-raso 'sanāc ca niryūhaḥ | / āyasa-pātra-vipakvaṃ karoti dṛṣṭer balaṃ nasyam ||
doṣānurodhena ca naika-śas taṃ snehāsra-visrāvaṇa-reka-nasyaiḥ | / upācared añjana-mūrdha-vasti-vasti-kriyā-tarpaṇa-lepa-sekaiḥ ||
vāta-je timire tatra daśa-mūlāmbhasā ghṛtam | / kṣīre catur-guṇe śreṣṭhā-kalka-pakvaṃ pibet tataḥ ||
tri-phalā-pañca-mūlānāṃ kaṣāyaṃ kṣīra-saṃyutam | / eraṇḍa-taila-saṃyuktaṃ yojayec ca virecanam ||
sa-mūla-jāla-jīvantī-tulāṃ droṇe 'mbhasaḥ pacet | / aṣṭa-bhāga-sthite tasmiṃs taila-prasthaṃ payaḥ-same ||
balā-tritaya-jīvantī-varī-mūlaiḥ palonmitaiḥ | / yaṣṭī-palaiś caturbhiś ca loha-pātre vipācayet ||
loha eva sthitaṃ māsaṃ nāvanād ūrdhva-jatru-jān | / vāta-pittāmayān hanti tad viśeṣād dṛg-āśrayān ||
keśāsya-kandharā-skandha-puṣṭi-lāvaṇya-kānti-dam | / sitairaṇḍa-jaṭā-siṃhī-phala-dāru-vacā-nataiḥ ||
ghoṣayā bilva-mūlaiś ca tailaṃ pakvaṃ payo-'nvitam | / nasyaṃ sarvordhva-jatrūttha-vāta-śleṣmāmayārti-jit ||
vasāñjane ca vaiyāghrī vārāhī vā praśasyate | / gṛdhrāhi-kukkuṭotthā vā madhukenānvitā pṛthak ||
pratyañjane ca sroto-jaṃ rasa-kṣīra-ghṛte kramāt | / niṣiktaṃ pūrva-vad yojyaṃ timira-ghnam an-uttamam ||
na ced evaṃ śamaṃ yāti tatas tarpaṇam ācaret | / śatāhvā-kuṣṭha-nalada-kākolī-dvaya-yaṣṭibhiḥ ||
prapauṇḍarīka-sarala-pippalī-devadārubhiḥ | / sarpir aṣṭa-guṇa-kṣīraṃ pakvaṃ tarpaṇam uttamam ||
medasas tad-vad aiṇeyād dugdha-siddhāt khajāhatāt | / uddhṛtaṃ sādhitaṃ tejo madhukośīra-candanaiḥ ||
śvāvic-chalyaka-godhānāṃ dakṣa-tittiri-barhiṇām | / pṛthak pṛthag anenaiva vidhinā kalpayed vasām ||
prasādanaṃ snehanaṃ ca puṭa-pākaṃ prayojayet | / vāta-pīnasa-vac cātra nirūhaṃ sānuvāsanam ||
pitta-je timire sarpir jīvanīya-phala-trayaiḥ | / vipācitaṃ pāyayitvā snigdhasya vyadhayet sirām ||
śarkarailā-trivṛc-cūrṇair madhu-yuktair virecayet | / su-śītān seka-lepādīn yuñjyān netrāsya-mūrdhasu ||
śārivā-padmakośīra-muktā-śābara-candanaiḥ | / vartiḥ śastāñjane cūrṇas tathā pattrotpalāñjanaiḥ ||
