sa-nāgapuṣpa-karpūra-yaṣṭy-āhva-svarṇa-gairikaiḥ | / sauvīrāñjana-tutthaka-śṛṅgī-dhātrī-phala-sphaṭika-karpūram ||
pañcāṃśaṃ pañcāṃśaṃ try-aṃśam athaikāṃśam añjanaṃ timira-ghnam | / nasyaṃ cājyaṃ śṛtaṃ kṣīra-jīvanīya-sitotpalaiḥ ||
śleṣmodbhave 'mṛtā-kvātha-varā-kaṇa-śṛtaṃ ghṛtam | / vidhyet sirāṃ pīta-vato dadyāc cānu virecanam ||
kvāthaṃ pūgābhayā-śuṇṭhī-kṛṣṇā-kumbha-nikumbha-jam | / hrīvera-dāru-dvi-niśā-kṛṣṇā-kalkaiḥ payo-'nvitaiḥ ||
dvi-pañca-mūla-niryūhe tailaṃ pakvaṃ ca nāvanam | / śaṅkha-priyaṅgu-nepālī-kaṭu-trika-phala-trikaiḥ ||
dṛg-vaimalyāya vi-malā vartiḥ syāt kokilā punaḥ | / kṛṣṇa-loha-rajo-vyoṣa-saindhava-tri-phalāñjanaiḥ ||
śaśa-go-khara-siṃhoṣṭra-dvi-jā lālāṭam asthi ca | / śveta-go-vāla-marica-śaṅkha-candana-phenakam ||
piṣṭaṃ stanyājya-dugdhābhyāṃ vartis timira-śukra-jit | / rakta-je pitta-vat siddhiḥ śītaiś cāsraṃ prasādayet ||
drākṣayā nalada-lodhra-yaṣṭibhiḥ śaṅkha-tāmra-hima-padma-padmakaiḥ | / sotpalaiś chagala-dugdha-vartitair asra-jaṃ timiram āśu naśyati ||
saṃsarga-sannipātotthe yathā-doṣodayaṃ kriyā | / siddhaṃ madhūka-kṛmijin-maricāmaradārubhiḥ ||
sa-kṣīraṃ nāvanaṃ tailaṃ piṣṭair lepo mukhasya ca | / nata-nīlotpalānantā-yaṣṭy-āhva-suniṣaṇṇakaiḥ ||
sādhitaṃ nāvane tailaṃ śiro-vastau ca śasyate | / dadyād uśīra-niryūhe cūrṇitaṃ kaṇa-saindhavam ||
tat srutaṃ sa-ghṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ pacet kṣaudraṃ ghane kṣipet | / śīte cāsmin hitam idaṃ sarva-je timire 'ñjanam ||
asthīni majja-pūrṇāni sat-tvānāṃ rātri-cāriṇām | / sroto-jāñjana-yuktāni vahaty ambhasi vāsayet ||
māsaṃ viṃśati-rātraṃ vā tataś coddhṛtya śoṣayet | / sa-meṣaśṛṅgī-puṣpāṇi sa-yaṣṭy-āhvāni tāny anu ||
cūrṇitāny añjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ timire sānnipātike | / kāce 'py eṣā kriyā muktvā sirāṃ yantra-nipīḍitāḥ ||
āndhyāya syur malā dadyāt srāvye tv asre jalaukasaḥ | / guḍaḥ pheno 'ñjanaṃ kṛṣṇā maricaṃ kuṅkumād rajaḥ ||
rasa-kriyeyaṃ sa-kṣaudrā kāca-yāpanam añjanam | / nakulāndhe tri-doṣotthe taimirya-vihito vidhiḥ ||
rasa-kriyā ghṛta-kṣaudra-go-maya-sva-rasa-drutaiḥ | / tārkṣya-gairika-tālīśair niśāndhe hitam añjanam ||
dadhnā vighṛṣṭaṃ maricaṃ rātry-andhe 'ñjanam uttamam | / karañjikotpala-svarṇa-gairikāmbho-ja-kesaraiḥ ||
piṣṭair go-maya-toyena vartir doṣāndha-nāsinī | / ajā-mūtreṇa vā kauntī-kṛṣṇā-sroto-ja-saindhavaiḥ ||
kālānusārī-tri-kaṭu-tri-phalāla-manaḥśilāḥ | / sa-phenāś chāga-dugdhena rātry-andhe vartayo hitāḥ ||
sanniveśya yakṛn-madhye pippalīr a-dahan pacet | / tāḥ śuṣkā madhunā ghṛṣṭā niśāndhe śreṣṭham añjanam ||
khādec ca plīha-yakṛtī māhiṣe taila-sarpiṣā | / ghṛte siddhāni jīvantyāḥ pallavāni ca bhakṣayet ||
tathātimuktakairaṇḍa-śephāly-abhīru-jāni ca | / bhṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ kumbhayoneḥ pattraiḥ pāne ca pūjitam ||
dhūmarākhyāmla-pittoṣṇa-vidāhe jīrṇa-sarpiṣā | / snigdhaṃ virecayec chītaiḥ śītair dihyāc ca sarvataḥ ||
go-śakṛd-rasa-dugdhājyair vipakvaṃ śasyate 'ñjanam | / svarṇa-gairika-tālīśa-cūrṇāvāpā rasa-kriyā ||
medā-śābarakānantā-mañjiṣṭhā-dārvi-yaṣṭibhiḥ | / kṣīrāṣṭāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ sa-tailaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam ||
tarpaṇaṃ kṣīra-sarpiḥ syād a-śāmyati sirā-vyadhaḥ | / cintābhighāta-bhī-śoka-raukṣyāt sotkaṭakāsanāt ||
vireka-nasya-vamana-puṭa-pākādi-vibhramāt | / vidagdhāhāra-vamanāt kṣut-tṛṣṇādi-vidhāraṇāt ||
akṣi-rogāvasānāc ca paśyet timira-rogi-vat | / yathā-svaṃ tatra yuñjīta doṣādīn vīkṣya bheṣajam ||
sūryoparāgānala-vidyud-ādi-vilokanenopahatekṣaṇasya | / santarpaṇaṃ snigdha-himādi kāryaṃ tathāñjanaṃ hema ghṛtena ghṛṣṭam ||
cakṣū-rakṣāyāṃ sarva-kālaṃ manuṣyair yatnaḥ kartavyo jīvite yāvad icchā | / vyartho loko 'yaṃ tulya-rātrin-divānāṃ puṃsām andhānāṃ vidyamāne 'pi vitte ||
tri-phalā rudhira-srutir viśuddhir manaso nirvṛtir añjanaṃ sa-nasyam | / śakunāśana-tā sa-pāda-pūjā ghṛta-pānaṃ ca sadaiva netra-rakṣā ||
a-hitād aśanāt sadā nivṛttir bhṛśa-bhās-vac-cala-sūkṣma-vīkṣaṇāc ca | / muninā niminopadiṣṭam etat paramaṃ rakṣaṇam īkṣaṇasya puṃsām ||
vidhyet su-jātaṃ niṣ-prekṣyaṃ liṅga-nāśaṃ kaphodbhavam | / āvartaky-ādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhir vivarjitam upadravaiḥ ||
so '-sañjāto hi viṣamo dadhi-mastu-nibhas tanuḥ | / śalākayāvakṛṣṭo 'pi punar ūrdhvaṃ prapadyate ||
karoti vedanāṃ tīvrāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca sthagayet punaḥ | / śleṣmalaiḥ pūryate cāśu so 'nyaiḥ sopadravaś cirāt ||
ślaiṣmiko liṅga-nāśo hi sita-tvāc chleṣmaṇaḥ sitaḥ | / tasyānya-doṣābhibhavād bhavaty ā-nīla-tā gadaḥ ||
tatrāvarta-calā dṛṣṭir āvartaky aruṇāsitā | / śarkarārka-payo-leśa-niciteva ghanāti ca ||
rājī-matī dṛṅ nicitā śāli-śūkābha-rājibhiḥ | / viṣama-cchinna-dagdhābhā sa-ruk chinnāṃśukā smṛtā ||
dṛṣṭiḥ kāṃsya-sama-cchāyā candrakī candrakākṛtiḥ | / chattrābhā naika-varṇā ca chattrakī nāma nīlikā ||
na vidhyed a-sirārhāṇāṃ na tṛṭ-pīnasa-kāsinām | / nā-jīrṇi-bhīru-vamita-śiraḥ-karṇākṣi-śūlinām ||
atha sādhāraṇe kāle śuddha-sambhojitātmanaḥ | / deśe prakāśe pūrvāhṇe bhiṣag jānūcca-pīṭha-gaḥ ||
yantritasyopaviṣṭasya svinnākṣasya mukhānilaiḥ | / aṅguṣṭha-mṛdite netre dṛṣṭau dṛṣṭvotplutaṃ malam ||
svāṃ nāsāṃ prekṣamāṇasya niṣ-kampaṃ mūrdhni dhārite | / kṛṣṇād ardhāṅgulaṃ muktvā tathārdhārdham apāṅgataḥ ||
tarjanī-madhyamāṅguṣṭhaiḥ śalākāṃ niś-calaṃ dhṛtām | / daiva-cchidraṃ nayet pārśvād ūrdhvam āmanthayan iva ||
savyaṃ dakṣiṇa-hastena netraṃ savyena cetarat | / vidhyet su-viddhe śabdaḥ syād a-ruk cāmbu-lava-srutiḥ ||
sāntvayann āturaṃ cānu netraṃ stanyena secayet | / śalākāyās tato 'greṇa nirlikhen netra-maṇḍalam ||
a-bādhamānaḥ śanakair nāsāṃ prati nudaṃs tataḥ | / ucchiṅghanāc cāpahared dṛṣṭi-maṇḍala-gaṃ kapham ||
sthire doṣe cale vāti svedayed akṣi bāhyataḥ | / atha dṛṣṭeṣu rūpeṣu śalākām āharec chanaiḥ ||
ghṛtāplutaṃ picuṃ dattvā baddhākṣaṃ śāyayet tataḥ | / viddhād anyena pārśvena tam uttānaṃ dvayor vyadhe ||
nivāte śayane 'bhyakta-śiraḥ-pādaṃ hite ratam | / kṣavathuṃ kāsam udgāraṃ ṣṭhīvanaṃ pānam ambhasaḥ ||
adho-mukha-sthitiṃ snānaṃ danta-dhāvana-bhakṣaṇam | / saptāhaṃ nācaret sneha-pīta-vac cātra yantraṇā ||
śaktito laṅghayet seko ruji koṣṇena sarpiṣā | / sa-vyoṣāmalakaṃ vāṭyam aśnīyāt sa-ghṛtaṃ dravam ||
vilepīṃ vā try-ahāc cāsya kvāthair muktvākṣi secayet | / vāta-ghnaiḥ saptame tv ahni sarva-thaivākṣi mocayet ||
yantraṇām anurudhyeta dṛṣṭer ā-sthairya-lābhataḥ | / rūpāṇi sūkṣma-dīptāni sahasā nāvalokayet ||
śopha-rāga-rujādīnām adhimanthasya codbhavaḥ | / a-hitair vedha-doṣāc ca yathā-svaṃ tān upācaret ||
kalkitāḥ sa-ghṛtā dūrvā-yava-gairika-śārivāḥ | / mukhālepe prayoktavyā rujā-rāgopaśāntaye ||
sa-sarṣapās tilās tad-van mātuluṅga-rasāplutāḥ | / payasyā-śārivā-pattra-mañjiṣṭhā-madhuyaṣṭibhiḥ ||
ajā-kṣīra-yutair lepaḥ sukhoṣṇaḥ śarma-kṛt param | / lodhra-saindhava-mṛdvīkā-madhukaiś chāgalaṃ payaḥ ||
śṛtam āścyotanaṃ yojyaṃ rujā-rāga-vināśanam | / madhukotpala-kuṣṭhair vā drākṣā-lākṣā-sitānvitaiḥ ||
vāta-ghna-siddhe payasi śṛtaṃ sarpiś catur-guṇe | / padmakādi-pratīvāpaṃ sarva-karmasu śasyate ||
sirāṃ tathān-upaśame snigdha-svinnasya mokṣayet | / manthoktāṃ ca kriyāṃ kuryād vedhe rūḍhe 'ñjanaṃ mṛdu ||
āḍhakī-mūla-marica-haritāla-rasāñjanaiḥ | / viddhe 'kṣṇi sa-guḍā vartir yojyā divyāmbu-peṣitā ||
jātī-śirīṣa-dhava-meṣaviṣāṇi-puṣpa-vaiḍūrya-mauktika-phalaṃ payasā su-piṣṭam | / ājena tāmram amunā pratanu pradigdhaṃ saptāhataḥ punar idaṃ payasaiva piṣṭam ||
piṇḍāñjanaṃ hitam an-ātapa-śuṣkam akṣṇi viddhe prasāda-jananaṃ bala-kṛc ca dṛṣṭeḥ | / sroto-ja-vidruma-śilāmbu-dhi-phena-tīkṣṇair asyaiva tulyam uditaṃ guṇa-kalpanābhiḥ ||
vātena netre 'bhiṣyaṇṇe nāsānāho 'lpa-śopha-tā | / śaṅkhākṣi-bhrū-lalāṭasya toda-sphuraṇa-bhedanam ||
śuṣkālpā dūṣikā śītam acchaṃ cāśru calā rujaḥ | / nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ kṛcchrāj jantūnām iva sarpaṇam ||
akṣy ādhmātam ivābhāti sūkṣmaiḥ śalyair ivācitam | / snigdhoṣṇaiś copaśamanaṃ so 'bhiṣyanda upekṣitaḥ ||
adhimantho bhavet tatra karṇayor nadanaṃ bhramaḥ | / araṇyeva ca mathyante lalāṭākṣi-bhruvādayaḥ ||
hatādhimanthaḥ so 'pi syāt pramādāt tena vedanāḥ | / aneka-rūpā jāyante vraṇo dṛṣṭau ca dṛṣṭi-hā ||
manyākṣi-śaṅkhato vāyur anyato vā pravartayan | / vyathāṃ tīvrām a-paicchilya-rāga-śophaṃ vilocanam ||
saṅkocayati pary-aśru so 'nyato-vāta-sañjñitaḥ | / tad-vaj jihmaṃ bhaven netram ūnaṃ vā vāta-paryaye ||
dāho dhūmāyanaṃ śophaḥ śyāva-tā vartmano bahiḥ | / antaḥ-kledo 'śru pītoṣṇaṃ rāgaḥ pītābha-darśanam ||
kṣārokṣita-kṣatākṣi-tvaṃ pittābhiṣyanda-lakṣaṇam | / jvalad-aṅgāra-kīrṇābhaṃ yakṛt-piṇḍa-sama-prabham ||
adhimanthe bhaven netraṃ syande tu kapha-sambhave | / jāḍyaṃ śopho mahān kaṇḍūr nidrānnān-abhinandanam ||
sāndra-snigdha-bahu-śveta-picchā-vad-dūṣikāśru-tā | / adhimanthe nataṃ kṛṣṇam unnataṃ śukla-maṇḍalam ||
praseko nāsikādhmānaṃ pāṃsu-pūrṇam ivekṣaṇam | / raktāśru-rājī-dūṣīkā-rakta-maṇḍala-darśanam ||
rakta-syandena nayanaṃ sa-pitta-syanda-lakṣaṇam | / manthe 'kṣi tāmra-pary-antam utpāṭana-samāna-ruk ||
rāgeṇa bandhūka-nibhaṃ tāmyati sparśanā-kṣamam | / asṛṅ-nimagnāriṣṭābhaṃ kṛṣṇam agny-ābha-darśanam ||
adhimanthā yathā-svaṃ ca sarve syandādhika-vyathāḥ | / śaṅkha-danta-kapoleṣu kapāle cāti-ruk-karāḥ ||
vāta-pittāturaṃ gharṣa-toda-bhedopadeha-vat | / rūkṣa-dāruṇa-vartmākṣi kṛcchronmīla-nimīlanam ||
vikūṇana-viśuṣka-tva-śītecchā-śūla-pāka-vat | / uktaḥ śuṣkādi-pāko yaṃ sa-śophaḥ syāt tribhir malaiḥ ||
sa-raktais tatra śopho 'ti-rug-dāha-ṣṭhīvanādi-mān | / pakvodumbara-saṅkāśaṃ jāyate śukla-maṇḍalam ||
aśrūṣṇa-śīta-viśada-picchilāccha-ghanaṃ muhuḥ | / alpa-śophe 'lpa-śophas tu pāko 'nyair lakṣaṇais tathā ||
akṣi-pākātyaye śophaḥ saṃrambhaḥ kaluṣāśru-tā | / kaphopadigdham asitaṃ sitaṃ prakleda-rāga-vat ||
dāho darśana-saṃrodho vedanāś cān-avasthitāḥ | / anna-sāro 'mla-tāṃ nītaḥ pitta-raktolbaṇair malaiḥ ||
sirābhir netram ārūḍhaḥ karoti śyāva-lohitam | / sa-śopha-dāha-pākāśru bhṛśaṃ cāvila-darśanam ||
amloṣito 'yam ity uktā gadāḥ ṣo-ḍaśa sarva-gāḥ | / hatādhimantham eteṣu sākṣi-pākātyayaṃ tyajet ||
vātodbhūtaḥ pañca-rātreṇa dṛṣṭiṃ saptāhena śleṣma-jāto 'dhimanthaḥ | / raktotpanno hanti tad-vat tri-rātrān mithyācārāt paittikaḥ sadya eva ||
prāg-rūpa eva syandeṣu tīkṣṇaṃ gaṇḍūṣa-nāvanam | / kārayed upavāsaṃ ca kopād anya-tra vāta-jāt ||
dāhopadeha-rāgāśru-śopha-śāntyai biḍālakam | / kuryāt sarva-tra pattrailā-marica-svarṇa-gairikaiḥ ||
sa-rasāñjana-yaṣṭy-āhva-nata-candana-saindhavaiḥ | / saindhavaṃ nāgaraṃ tārkṣyaṃ bhṛṣṭaṃ maṇḍena sarpiṣaḥ ||
vāta-je ghṛta-bhṛṣṭaṃ vā yojyaṃ śabara-deśa-jam | / māṃsī-padmaka-kālīya-yaṣṭy-āhvaiḥ pitta-raktayoḥ ||

manohvā-phalinī-kṣaudraiḥ kaphe sarvais tu sarva-je || 5ab || / sita-marica-bhāgam ekaṃ catur-manohvaṃ dvir aṣṭa-śābarakam || 5cd || / sañcūrṇya vastra-baddhaṃ prakupita-mātre 'vaguṇṭhanaṃ netre || 5ef ||
āraṇyāś chagaṇa-rase paṭāvabaddhāḥ su-svinnā nakha-vi-tuṣī-kṛtāḥ kulatthāḥ | / tac-cūrṇaṃ sakṛd avacūrṇanān niśīthe netrāṇāṃ vidhamati sadya eva kopam ||
ghoṣābhayā-tutthaka-yaṣṭi-lodhrair mūtī su-sūkṣmaiḥ ślatha-vastra-baddhaiḥ | / tāmra-stha-dhānyāmla-nimagna-mūrtir artiṃ jayaty akṣiṇi naika-rūpām ||
ṣo-ḍaśabhiḥ salila-palaiḥ palaṃ tathaikaṃ kaṭaṅkaṭeryāḥ siddham | / seko 'ṣṭa-bhāga-śiṣṭaḥ kṣaudra-yutaḥ sarva-doṣa-kupite netre ||
vāta-pitta-kapha-sannipāta-jāṃ netrayor bahu-vidhām api vyathām | / śīghram eva jayati prayojitaḥ śigru-pallava-rasaḥ sa-mākṣikaḥ ||
taruṇam urubūka-pattraṃ mūlaṃ ca vibhidya siddham āje kṣīre | / vātābhiṣyanda-rujaṃ sadyo vinihanti saktu-piṇḍikā coṣṇā ||
āścyotanaṃ māruta-je kvātho bilvādibhir hitaḥ | / koṣṇaḥ sahairaṇḍa-jaṭā-bṛhatī-madhu-śigrubhiḥ ||
hrīvera-vakra-śārṅgaṣṭodumbara-tvakṣu sādhitam | / sāmbhasā payasājena śūlāścyotanam uttamam ||
mañjiṣṭhā-rajanī-lākṣā-drākṣarddhi-madhukotpalaiḥ | / kvāthaḥ sa-śarkaraḥ śītaḥ secanaṃ rakta-pitta-jit ||
kaseru-yaṣṭy-āhva-rajas tāntave śithilaṃ sthitam | / apsu divyāsu nihitaṃ hitaṃ syande 'sra-pitta-je ||
puṇḍra-yaṣṭī-niśā-mūtī plutā stanye sa-śarkare | / chāga-dugdhe 'tha-vā dāha-rug-rāgāśru-nivartanī ||
śveta-lodhraṃ sa-madhukaṃ ghṛta-bhṛṣṭaṃ su-cūrṇitam | / vastra-sthaṃ stanya-mṛditaṃ pitta-raktābhighāta-jit ||
nāgara-tri-phalā-nimba-vāsā-lodhra-rasaḥ kaphe | / koṣṇam āścyotanaṃ miśrair bheṣajaiḥ sānnipātike ||
sarpiḥ purāṇaṃ pavane pitte śarkarayānvitam | / vyoṣa-siddhaṃ kaphe pītvā yava-kṣārāvacūrṇitam ||
srāvayed rudhiraṃ bhūyas tataḥ snigdhaṃ virecayet | / ānūpa-vesavāreṇa śiro-vadana-lepanam ||
uṣṇena śūle dāhe tu payaḥ-sarpir-yutair himaiḥ | / timira-pratiṣedhaṃ ca vīkṣya yuñjyād yathā-yatham ||
ayam eva vidhiḥ sarvo manthādiṣv api śasyate | / a-śāntau sarva-thā manthe bhruvor upari dāhayet ||
rūpyaṃ rūkṣeṇa go-dadhnā limpen nīla-tvam āgate | / śuṣke tu mastunā vartir vātākṣy-āmaya-nāśinī ||
sumanaḥ-korakāḥ śaṅkhas tri-phalā madhukaṃ balā | / pitta-raktāpahā vartiḥ piṣṭā divyena vāriṇā ||
saindhavaṃ tri-phalā vyoṣaṃ śaṅkhanābhiḥ samudra-jaḥ | / phena aileyakaṃ sarjo vartiḥ śleṣmākṣi-roga-nut ||
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ yaṣṭy-āhvaṃ dārvī cāṣṭa-palaṃ pacet | / jala-droṇe rase pūte punaḥ pakve ghane kṣipet ||
puṣpāñjanād daśa-palaṃ karṣaṃ ca maricāt tataḥ | / kṛtaś cūrṇo 'tha-vā vartiḥ sarvābhiṣyanda-sambhavān ||
hanti rāga-rujā-gharṣān sadyo dṛṣṭiṃ prasādayet | / ayaṃ pāśupato yogo rahasyaṃ bhiṣajāṃ param ||
śuṣkākṣi-pāke haviṣaḥ pānam akṣṇoś ca tarpaṇam | / ghṛtena jīvanīyena nasyaṃ tailena vāṇunā ||
pariṣeko hitaś cātra payaḥ koṣṇaṃ sa-saindhavam | / sarpir-yuktaṃ stanya-piṣṭam añjanaṃ ca mahauṣadham ||
vasā vānūpa-sat-tvotthā kiñ-cit-saindhava-nāgarā | / ghṛtāktān darpaṇe ghṛṣṭān keśān mallaka-sampuṭe ||
dagdhvājya-piṣṭā loha-sthā sā maṣī śreṣṭham añjanam | / sa-śophe vālpa-śophe ca snigdhasya vyadhayet sirām ||
rekaḥ snigdhe punar drākṣā-pathyā-kvātha-trivṛd-ghṛtaiḥ | / śveta-lodhraṃ ghṛte bhṛṣṭaṃ cūrṇitaṃ tāntava-sthitam ||
uṣṇāmbunā vimṛditaṃ sekaḥ śūla-haraḥ param | / dārvī-prapauṇḍarīkasya kvātho vāścyotane hitaḥ ||
tāmraṃ lohe mūtra-ghṛṣṭaṃ prayuktaṃ netre sarpir-dhūpitaṃ vedanā-ghnam | / tāmre ghṛṣṭo gavya-dadhnaḥ saro vā yuktaḥ kṛṣṇā-saindhavābhyāṃ variṣṭhaḥ ||
śaṅkhaṃ tāmre stanya-ghṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtāktaiḥ śamyāḥ pattrair dhūpitaṃ tad yavaiś ca | / netre yuktaṃ hanti sandhāva-sañjñaṃ kṣipraṃ gharṣaṃ vedanāṃ cāti-tīvrām ||
sājyaiḥ śamī-cchadair dāha-śūla-rāgāśru-harṣa-jit | / śigru-pallava-niryāsaḥ su-ghṛṣṭas tāmra-sampuṭe ||
ghṛtena dhūpito hanti śopha-gharṣāśru-vedanāḥ | / tilāmbhasā mṛt-kapālaṃ kāṃsye ghṛṣṭaṃ su-dhūpitam ||
nimba-pattrair ghṛtābhyaktair gharṣa-śūlāśru-rāga-jit | / sandhāvenāñjite netre vigatauṣadha-vedane ||
stanyenāścyotanaṃ kāryaṃ triḥ paraṃ nāñjayec ca taiḥ | / tālīśa-pattra-capalā-nata-loha-rajo-'ñjanaiḥ ||
jātī-mukula-kāsīsa-saindhavair mūtra-peṣitaiḥ | / tāmram ālipya saptāhaṃ dhārayet peṣayet tataḥ ||
mūtreṇaivānu guṭikāḥ kāryāś chāyā-viśoṣitāḥ | / tāḥ stanya-ghṛṣṭā gharṣāśru-śopha-kaṇḍū-vināśanāḥ ||
vyāghrī-tvaṅ-madhukaṃ tāmra-rajo 'jā-kṣīra-kalkitam | / śamy-āmalaka-pattrājya-dhūpitaṃ śopha-ruk-praṇut ||
amloṣite prayuñjīta pittābhiṣyanda-sādhanam | / utkliṣṭāḥ kapha-pittāsra-nicayotthāḥ kukūṇakaḥ ||
pakṣmoparodhaṃ śuṣkākṣi-pākaḥ pūyālaso bisaḥ | / pothaky-amloṣito 'lpākhyaḥ syanda-manthā vinānilāt ||
ete 'ṣṭā-daśa pillākhyā dīrgha-kālānubandhinaḥ | / cikitsā pṛthag eteṣāṃ svaṃ svam uktātha vakṣyate ||
pillī-bhūteṣu sāmānyād atha pillākhya-rogiṇaḥ | / snigdhasya chardita-vataḥ sirā-vyadha-hṛtāsṛjaḥ ||
viriktasya ca vartmānu nirlikhed ā-viśuddhitaḥ | / tutthakasya palaṃ śveta-maricāni ca viṃśatiḥ ||
triṃśatā kāñjika-palaiḥ piṣṭvā tāmre nidhāpayet | / pillān a-pillān kurute bahu-varṣotthitān api ||
tat sekenopadehāśru-kaṇḍū-śophāṃś ca nāśayet | / karañja-bījaṃ surasaṃ sumanaḥ-korakāṇi ca ||
saṅkṣudya sādhayet kvāthe pūte tatra rasa-kriyā | / añjanaṃ pilla-bhaiṣajyaṃ pakṣmaṇāṃ ca prarohaṇam ||
rasāñjanaṃ sarja-raso rīti-puṣpaṃ manaḥśilā | / samudra-pheno lavaṇaṃ gairikaṃ maricāni ca ||
añjanaṃ madhunā piṣṭaṃ kleda-kaṇḍū-ghnam uttamam | / abhayā-rasa-piṣṭaṃ vā tagaraṃ pilla-nāśanam ||
bhāvitaṃ basta-mūtreṇa sa-snehaṃ devadāru ca | / saindhava-tri-phalā-kṛṣṇā-kaṭukā-śaṅkhanābhayaḥ ||
sa-tāmra-rajaso vartiḥ pilla-śukraka-nāśinī | / puṣpa-kāsīsa-cūrṇo vā surasā-rasa-bhāvitaḥ ||
alaṃ ca sauvīrakam añjanaṃ ca tābhyāṃ samaṃ tāmra-rajaḥ su-sūkṣmam | / pilleṣu romāṇi niṣevito 'sau cūrṇaḥ karoty eka-śalākayāpi ||
lākṣā-nirguṇḍī-bhṛṅga-dārvī-rasena śreṣṭhaṃ kārpāsaṃ bhāvitaṃ sapta-kṛtvaḥ | / dīpaḥ prajvālyaḥ sarpiṣā tat-samutthā śreṣṭhā pillānāṃ ropaṇārthe maṣī sā ||
punaḥ punar virekaṃ ca nityam āścyotanāñjanam | / nāvanaṃ dhūma-pānaṃ ca pilla-rogāturo bhajet ||
pūyālase tv a-śānte 'nte dāhaḥ sūkṣma-śalākayā | / catur-ṇavatir ity akṣṇo hetu-lakṣaṇa-sādhanaiḥ ||
paras-param a-saṅkīrṇāḥ kārtsnyena gaditā gadāḥ | / sarva-dā ca niṣeveta svastho 'pi nayana-priyaḥ ||
purāṇa-yava-godhūma-śāli-ṣaṣṭika-kodravān | / mudgādīn kapha-pitta-ghnān bhūri-sarpiḥ-pariplutān ||
śākaṃ caivaṃ-vidhaṃ māṃsaṃ jāṅgalaṃ dāḍimaṃ sitām | / saindhavaṃ tri-phalāṃ drākṣāṃ vāri pāne ca nābhasam ||
ātapa-traṃ pada-trāṇaṃ vidhi-vad doṣa-śodhanam | / varjayed vega-saṃrodham a-jīrṇādhyaśanāni ca ||
krodha-śoka-divā-svapna-rātri-jāgaraṇātapān | / vidāhi viṣṭambha-karaṃ yac cehāhāra-bheṣajam ||
dve pāda-madhye pṛthu-sanniveśe sire gate te bahu-dhā ca netre | / tā mrakṣaṇodvartana-lepanādīn pāda-prayuktān nayane nayanti ||
malauṣṇya-saṅghaṭṭana-pīḍanādyais tā dūṣayante nayanāni duṣṭāḥ | / bhajet sadā dṛṣṭi-hitāni tasmād upānad-abhyañjana-dhāvanāni ||
pratiśyāya-jala-krīḍā-karṇa-kaṇḍūyanair marut | / mithyā-yogena śabdasya kupito 'nyaiś ca kopanaiḥ ||
prāpya śrotra-sirāḥ kuryāc chūlaṃ srotasi vega-vat | / ardhāvabhedakaṃ stambhaṃ śiśirān-abhinandanam ||
cirāc ca pākaṃ pakvaṃ tu lasīkām alpa-śaḥ sravet | / śrotraṃ śūnyam a-kasmāc ca syāt sañcāra-vicāra-vat ||
śūlaṃ pittāt sa-dāhoṣā-śītecchā-śvayathu-jvaram | / āśu-pākaṃ prapakvaṃ ca sa-pīta-lasikā-sruti ||
sā lasīkā spṛśed yad yat tat tat pākam upaiti ca | / kaphāc chiro-hanu-grīvā-gauravaṃ manda-tā rujaḥ ||
kaṇḍūḥ śvayathur uṣṇecchā pākāc chveta-ghana-srutiḥ | / karoti śravaṇe śūlam abhighātādi-dūṣitam ||
raktaṃ pitta-samānārti kiñ-cid vādhika-lakṣaṇam | / śūlaṃ samuditair doṣaiḥ sa-śopha-jvara-tīvra-ruk ||
paryāyād uṣṇa-śītecchāṃ jāyate śruti-jāḍya-vat | / pakvaṃ sitāsitā-rakta-ghana-pūya-pravāhi ca ||
śabda-vāhi-sirā-saṃsthe śṛṇoti pavane muhuḥ | / nādān a-kasmād vividhān karṇa-nādaṃ vadanti tam ||
śleṣmaṇānugato vāyur nādo vā samupekṣitaḥ | / uccaiḥ kṛcchrāc chrutiṃ kuryād badhira-tvaṃ krameṇa ca ||
vātena śoṣitaḥ śleṣmā śroto limpet tato bhavet | / rug-gauravaṃ pidhānaṃ ca sa pratīnāha-sañjñitaḥ ||
kaṇḍū-śophau kaphāc chrotre sthirau tat-sañjñayā smṛtau | / kapho vidagdhaḥ pittena sa-rujaṃ nī-rujaṃ tv api ||
ghana-pūti-bahu-kledaṃ kurute pūti-karṇakam | / vātādi-dūṣitaṃ śrotraṃ māṃsāsṛk-kleda-jā rujam ||
khādanto jantavaḥ kuryus tīvrāṃ sa kṛmi-karṇakaḥ | / śrotra-kaṇḍūyanāj jāte kṣate syāt pūrva-lakṣaṇaḥ ||
vidradhiḥ pūrva-vac cānyaḥ śopho 'rśo 'rbudam īritam | / teṣu ruk pūti-karṇa-tvaṃ badhira-tvaṃ ca bādhate ||
garbhe 'nilāt saṅkucitā śaṣkulī kuci-karṇakaḥ | / eko nī-rug aneko vā garbhe māṃsāṅkuraḥ sthiraḥ ||
pippalī pippalī-mānaḥ sannipātād vidārikā | / sa-varṇaḥ sa-rujaḥ stabdhaḥ śvayathuḥ sa upekṣitaḥ ||
kaṭu-taila-nibhaṃ pakvaḥ sravet kṛcchreṇa rohati | / saṅkocayati rūḍhā ca sā dhruvaṃ karṇa-śaṣkulīm ||
sirā-sthaḥ kurute vāyuḥ pālī-śoṣaṃ tad-āhvayam | / kṛśā dṛḍhā ca tantrī-vat pālī vātena tantrikā ||
su-kumāre cirotsargāt sahasaiva pravardhite | / karṇe śophaḥ sa-ruk pālyām aruṇaḥ paripoṭa-vān ||
paripoṭaḥ sa pavanād utpātaḥ pitta-śoṇitāt | / gurv-ābharaṇa-bhārādyaiḥ śyāvo rug-dāha-pāka-vān ||
śvayathuḥ sphoṭa-piṭikā-rāgoṣā-kleda-saṃyutaḥ | / pālyāṃ śopho 'nila-kaphāt sarvato nir-vyathaḥ sthiraḥ ||
stabdhaḥ sa-varṇaḥ kaṇḍū-mān unmantho galliraś ca saḥ | / dur-viddhe vardhite karṇe sa-kaṇḍū-dāha-pāka-ruk ||
śvayathuḥ sannipātotthaḥ sa nāmnā duḥkha-vardhanaḥ | / kaphāsṛk-kṛmi-jāḥ sūkṣmāḥ sa-kaṇḍū-kleda-vedanāḥ ||
lihyuḥ pālīm upekṣitāḥ lehyākhyāḥ piṭikās tā hi | / pippalī sarva-jaṃ śūlaṃ vidārī kuci-karṇakaḥ ||
eṣām a-sādhyā yāpyaikā tantrikānyāṃs tu sādhayet | / pañca-viṃśatir ity uktāḥ karṇa-rogā vibhāgataḥ ||
karṇa-śūle pavana-je pibed rātrau rasāśitaḥ | / vāta-ghna-sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ karṇaṃ svinnaṃ ca pūrayet ||
pattrāṇāṃ pṛthag aśvattha-bilvārkairaṇḍa-janmanām | / taila-sindhūttha-digdhānāṃ svinnānāṃ puṭa-pākataḥ ||
rasaiḥ kavoṣṇais tad-vac ca mūlakasyāralor api | / gaṇe vāta-hare 'mleṣu mūtreṣu ca vipācitaḥ ||
mahā-sneho drutaṃ hanti su-tīvrām api vedanām | / mahataḥ pañca-mūlasya kāṣṭhāt kṣaumeṇa veṣṭitāt ||
taila-siktāt pradīptāgrāt snehaḥ sadyo rujāpahaḥ | / yojyaś caivaṃ bhadrakāṣṭhāt kuṣṭhāt kāṣṭhāc ca sāralāt ||
vāta-vyādhi-pratiśyāya-vihitaṃ hitam atra ca | / varjayec chirasā snānaṃ śītāmbhaḥ-pānam ahny api ||
pitta-śūle sitā-yukta-ghṛta-snigdhaṃ virecayet | / drākṣā-yaṣṭī-śṛtaṃ stanyaṃ śasyate karṇa-pūraṇam ||
yaṣṭy-anantā-himośīra-kākolī-lodhra-jīvakaiḥ | / mṛṇāla-bisa-mañjiṣṭhā-śārivābhiś ca sādhayet ||
yaṣṭīmadhu-rasa-prastha-kṣīra-dvi-prastha-saṃyutam | / tailasya kuḍavaṃ nasya-pūraṇābhyañjanair idam ||
nihanti śūla-dāhoṣāḥ kevalaṃ kṣaudram eva vā | / yaṣṭy-ādibhiś ca sa-ghṛtaiḥ karṇau dihyāt samantataḥ ||
vāmayet pippalī-siddha-sarpiḥ-snigdhaṃ kaphodbhave | / dhūma-nāvana-gaṇḍūṣa-svedān kuryāt kaphāpahān ||
laśunārdraka-śigrūṇāṃ muraṅgyā mūlakasya ca | / kadalyāḥ sva-rasaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kad-uṣṇaḥ karṇa-pūraṇe ||
arkāṅkurān amla-piṣṭāṃs tailāktāl̐ lavaṇānvitān | / sannidhāya snuhī-kāṇḍe korite tac-chadāvṛtān ||
svedayet puṭa-pākena sa rasaḥ śūla-jit param | / rasena bījapūrasya kapitthasya ca pūrayet ||
śuktena pūrayitvā vā phenenānv avacūrṇayet | / ajāvi-mūtra-vaṃśa-tvak-siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca pūraṇam ||
siddhaṃ vā sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ hiṅgu-tumburu-nāgaraiḥ | / rakta-je pitta-vat kāryaṃ sirāṃ cāśu vimokṣayet ||
pakve pūya-vahe karṇe dhūma-gaṇḍūṣa-nāvanam | / yuñjyān nāḍī-vidhānaṃ ca duṣṭa-vraṇa-haraṃ ca yat ||
srotaḥ pramṛjya digdhaṃ tu dvau kālau picu-vartibhiḥ | / pureṇa dhūpayitvā tu mākṣikeṇa prapūrayet ||
surasādi-gaṇa-kvātha-phāṇitāktāṃ ca yojayet | / picu-vartiṃ su-sūkṣmaiś ca tac-cūrṇair avacūrṇayet ||
śūla-kleda-guru-tvānāṃ vidhir eṣa nivartakaḥ | / priyaṅgu-madhukāmbaṣṭhā-dhātaky-utpala-parṇibhiḥ ||
mañjiṣṭhā-lodhra-lākṣābhiḥ kapitthasya rasena ca | / pacet tailaṃ tad āsrāvaṃ nigṛhṇāty āśu pūraṇāt ||
nāda-bādhiryayoḥ kuryād vāta-śūloktam auṣadham | / śleṣmānubandhe śleṣmāṇam prāg jayed vamanādibhiḥ ||
eraṇḍa-śigru-varuṇa-mūlakāt pattra-je rase | / catur-guṇe pacet tailaṃ kṣīre cāṣṭa-guṇonmite ||
yaṣṭy-āhvā-kṣīra-kākolī-kalka-yuktaṃ nihanti tat | / nāda-bādhirya-śūlāni nāvanābhyaṅga-pūraṇaiḥ ||
pakvaṃ prativiṣā-hiṅgu-miśi-tvak-svarjikoṣaṇaiḥ | / sa-śuktaiḥ pūraṇāt tailaṃ ruk-srāvā-śruti-nāda-nut ||
karṇa-nāde hitaṃ tailaṃ sarṣapotthaṃ ca pūraṇe | / śuṣka-mūlaka-khaṇḍānāṃ kṣāro hiṅgu mahauṣadham ||
śatapuṣpā-vacā-kuṣṭha-dāru-śigru-rasāñjanam | / sauvarcala-yava-kṣāra-svarjikaudbhida-saindhavam ||
bhūrja-granthi-viḍaṃ mustā madhu-śuktaṃ catur-guṇam | / mātuluṅga-rasas tad-vat kadalī-sva-rasaś ca taiḥ ||
pakvaṃ tailaṃ jayaty āśu su-kṛcchrān api pūraṇāt | / kaṇḍūṃ kledaṃ ca bādhirya-pūti-karṇa-tva-ruk-kṛmīn ||
kṣāra-tailam idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mukha-dantāmayeṣu ca | / atha suptāv iva syātāṃ karṇau raktaṃ haret tataḥ ||
sa-śopha-kledayor manda-śruter vamanam ācaret | / bādhiryaṃ varjayed bāla-vṛddhayoś cira-jaṃ ca yat ||
pratīnāhe parikledya sneha-svedair viśodhayet | / karṇa-śodhanakenānu karṇaṃ tailasya pūrayet ||
sa-śukta-saindhava-madhor mātuluṅga-rasasya vā | / śodhanād rūkṣa-totpattau ghṛta-maṇḍasya pūraṇam ||
kramo 'yaṃ mala-pūrṇe 'pi karṇe kaṇḍvāṃ kaphāpaham | / nasyādi tad-vac chophe 'pi kaṭūṣṇaiś cātra lepanam ||
karṇa-srāvoditaṃ kuryāt pūti-kṛmiṇa-karṇayoḥ | / pūraṇaṃ kaṭu-tailena viśeṣāt kṛmi-karṇake ||
vami-pūrvā hitā karṇa-vidradhau vidradhi-kriyā | / pittottha-karṇa-śūloktaṃ kartavyaṃ kṣata-vidradhau ||
arśo-'rbudeṣu nāsā-vad āmā karṇa-vidārikā | / karṇa-vidradhi-vat sādhyā yathā-doṣodayena ca ||
pālī-śoṣe 'nila-śrotra-śūla-van nasya-lepanam | / svedaṃ ca kuryāt svinnāṃ ca pālīm udvartayet tilaiḥ ||
priyāla-bīja-yaṣṭy-āhva-hayagandhā-yavānvitaiḥ | / tataḥ puṣṭi-karaiḥ snehair abhyaṅgaṃ nityam ācaret ||
śatāvarī-vājigandhā-payasyairaṇḍa-jīvakaiḥ | / tailaṃ vipakvaṃ sa-kṣīraṃ pālīnāṃ puṣṭi-kṛt param ||
kalkena jīvanīyena tailaṃ payasi pācitam | / ānūpa-māṃsa-kvāthe ca pālī-poṣaṇa-vardhanam ||
pālīṃ chittvāti-saṅkṣīṇāṃ śeṣāṃ sandhāya poṣayet | / yāpyaivaṃ tantrikākhyāpi paripoṭe 'py ayaṃ vidhiḥ ||
utpāte śītalair lepo jalauko-hṛta-śoṇite | / jambv-āmra-pallava-balā-yaṣṭī-lodhra-tilotpalaiḥ ||
sa-dhānyāmlaiḥ sa-mañjiṣṭhaiḥ sa-kadambaiḥ sa-śārivaiḥ | / siddham abhyañjane tailaṃ visarpokta-ghṛtāni ca ||
unmanthe 'bhyañjanaṃ tailaṃ godhā-karka-vasānvitam | / tālapattry-aśvagandhārka-vākucī-phala-saindhavaiḥ ||
surasā-lāṅgalībhyāṃ ca siddhaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ ca nāvanam | / dur-viddhe 'śmanta-jambv-āmra-pattra-kvāthena secitām ||
tailena pālīṃ sv-abhyaktāṃ su-ślakṣṇair avacūrṇayet | / cūrṇair madhuka-mañjiṣṭhā-prapuṇḍrāhva-niśodbhavaiḥ ||
lākṣā-viḍaṅga-siddhaṃ ca tailam abhyañjane hitam | / svinnāṃ go-maya-jaiḥ piṇḍair bahu-śaḥ parilehikām ||
viḍaṅga-sārair ālimped urabhrī-mūtra-kalkitaiḥ | / kauṭajeṅguda-kārañja-bīja-śamyāka-valkalaiḥ ||
atha-vābhyañjanaṃ tair vā kaṭu-tailaṃ vipācayet | / sa-nimba-pattra-marica-madanair lehikā-vraṇe ||
chinnaṃ tu karṇaṃ śuddhasya bandham ālocya yaugikam | / śuddhāsraṃ lāgayel lagne sadyaś-chinne viśodhanam ||
atha grathitvā keśāntaṃ kṛtvā chedana-lekhanam | / niveśya sandhiṃ suṣamaṃ na nimnaṃ na samunnatam ||
abhyajya madhu-sarpirbhyāṃ picu-plotāvaguṇṭhitam | / sūtreṇā-gāḍha-śithilaṃ baddhvā cūrṇair avākiret ||
śoṇita-sthāpanair vraṇyam ācāraṃ cādiśet tataḥ | / saptāhād āma-tailāktaṃ śanair apanayet picum ||
su-rūḍhaṃ jāta-romāṇaṃ śliṣṭa-sandhiṃ samaṃ sthiram | / su-varṣmāṇam a-rogaṃ ca śanaiḥ karṇaṃ vivardhayet ||
jala-śūkaḥ svayaṅguptā rajanyau bṛhatī-phalam | / aśvagandhā-balā-hasti-pippalī-gaura-sarṣapāḥ ||
mūlaṃ kośātakāśvaghna-rūpikā-saptaparṇa-jam | / chucchundarī kāla-mṛtā gṛhaṃ madhu-karī-kṛtam ||
jatūkā jala-janmā ca tathā śabarakandakam | / ebhiḥ kalkaiḥ kharaṃ pakvaṃ sa-tailaṃ māhiṣaṃ ghṛtam ||
hasty-aśva-mūtreṇa param abhyaṅgāt karṇa-vardhanam | / atha kuryād vayaḥ-sthasya cchinnāṃ śuddhasya nāsikām ||
chindyān nāsā-samaṃ pattraṃ tat-tulyaṃ ca kapolataḥ | / tvaṅ-māṃsaṃ nāsikāsanne rakṣaṃs tat tanu-tāṃ nayet ||
sīvyed gaṇḍaṃ tataḥ sūcyā sevinyā picu-yuktayā | / nāsā-cchede 'tha likhite parivartyopari tvacam ||
kapola-vadhraṃ sandadhyāt sīvyen nāsāṃ ca yatnataḥ | / nāḍībhyām utkṣiped antaḥ sukhocchvāsa-pravṛttaye ||
āma-tailena siktvānu pattaṅga-madhukāñjanaiḥ | / śoṇita-sthāpanaiś cānyaiḥ su-ślakṣṇair avacūrṇayet ||
tato madhu-ghṛtābhyaktaṃ baddhvācārikam ādiśet | / jñātvāvasthāntaraṃ kuryāt sadyo-vraṇa-vidhiṃ tataḥ ||
chindyād rūḍhe 'dhikaṃ māṃsaṃ nāsopāntāc ca carma tat | / sīvyet tataś ca su-ślakṣṇaṃ hīnaṃ saṃvardhayet punaḥ ||
niveśite yathā-nyāsaṃ sadyaś-chinne 'py ayaṃ vidhiḥ | / nāḍī-yogād vinauṣṭhasya nāsā-sandhāna-vad vidhiḥ ||
avaśyāyānila-rajo-bhāṣyāti-svapna-jāgaraiḥ | / nīcāty-uccopadhānena pītenānyena vāriṇā ||
aty-ambu-pāna-ramaṇa-cchardi-bāṣpa-grahādibhiḥ | / kruddhā vātolbaṇā doṣā nāsāyāṃ styāna-tāṃ gatāḥ ||
janayanti pratiśyāyaṃ vardhamānaṃ kṣaya-pradam | / tatra vātāt pratiśyāye mukha-śoṣo bhṛśaṃ kṣavaḥ ||
ghrāṇoparodha-nistoda-danta-śaṅkha-śiro-vyathāḥ | / kīṭikā iva sarpantīr manyate parito bhruvau ||
svara-sādaś cirāt pākaḥ śiśirāccha-kapha-srutiḥ | / pittāt tṛṣṇā-jvara-ghrāṇa-piṭikā-sambhava-bhramāḥ ||
nāsāgra-pāko rūkṣoṣṇa-tāmra-pīta-kapha-srutiḥ | / kaphāt kāso '-ruciḥ śvāso vamathur gātra-gauravam ||
mādhuryaṃ vadane kaṇḍūḥ snigdha-śukla-kapha-srutiḥ | / sarva-jo lakṣaṇaiḥ sarvair a-kasmād vṛddhi-śānti-mān ||
duṣṭaṃ nāsā-sirāḥ prāpya pratiśyāyaṃ karoty asṛk | / urasaḥ supta-tā tāmra-netra-tvaṃ śvāsa-pūti-tā ||
kaṇḍūḥ śrotrākṣi-nāsāsu pittoktaṃ cātra lakṣaṇam | / sarva eva pratiśyāyā duṣṭa-tāṃ yānty upekṣitāḥ ||
yathoktopadravādhikyāt sa sarvendriya-tāpanaḥ | / sāgni-sāda-jvara-śvāsa-kāsoraḥ-pārśva-vedanaḥ ||
kupyaty a-kasmād bahu-śo mukha-daurgandhya-śopha-kṛt | / nāsikā-kleda-saṃśoṣa-śuddhi-rodha-karo muhuḥ ||
pūyopamāsitā-rakta-grathita-śleṣma-saṃsrutiḥ | / mūrchanti cātra kṛmayo dīrgha-snigdha-sitāṇavaḥ ||
pakva-liṅgāni teṣv aṅga-lāghavaṃ kṣavathoḥ śamaḥ | / śleṣmā sa-cikkaṇaḥ pīto '-jñānaṃ ca rasa-gandhayoḥ ||
tīkṣṇāghrāṇopayogārka-raśmi-sūtra-tṛṇādibhiḥ | / vāta-kopibhir anyair vā nāsikā-taruṇāsthani ||
vighaṭṭite 'nilaḥ kruddho ruddhaḥ śṛṅgāṭakaṃ vrajet | / nivṛttaḥ kurute 'ty-arthaṃ kṣavathuṃ sa bhṛśa-kṣavaḥ ||
śoṣayan nāsikā-srotaḥ kaphaṃ ca kurute 'nilaḥ | / śūka-pūrṇābha-nāsā-tvaṃ kṛcchrād ucchvasanaṃ tataḥ ||
smṛto 'sau nāsikā-śoṣo nāsānāhe tu jāyate | / naddha-tvam iva nāsāyāḥ śleṣma-ruddhena vāyunā ||
niḥśvāsocchvāsa-saṃrodhāt srotasī saṃvṛte iva | / pacen nāsā-puṭe pittaṃ tvaṅ-māṃsaṃ dāha-śūla-vat ||
sa ghrāṇa-pākaḥ srāvas tu tat-sañjñaḥ śleṣma-sambhavaḥ | / accho jalopamo 'jasraṃ viśeṣān niśi jāyate ||
kaphaḥ pravṛddho nāsāyāṃ ruddhvā srotāṃsy a-pīnasam | / kuryāt sa-ghurghura-śvāsaṃ pīnasādhika-vedanam ||
aver iva sravaty asya praklinnā tena nāsikā | / ajasraṃ picchilaṃ pītaṃ pakvaṃ siṅghāṇakaṃ ghanam ||
raktena nāsā dagdheva bāhyāntaḥ-sparśanā-sahā | / bhaved dhūmopamocchvāsā sā dīptir dahatīva ca ||
tālu-mūle malair duṣṭair māruto mukha-nāsikāt | / śleṣmā ca pūtir nirgacchet pūti-nāsaṃ vadanti tam ||
nicayād abhighātād vā pūyāsṛṅ nāsikā sravet | / tat pūya-raktam ākhyātaṃ śiro-dāha-rujā-karam ||
pitta-śleṣmāvaruddho 'ntar nāsāyāṃ śoṣayen marut | / kaphaṃ sa śuṣkaḥ puṭa-tāṃ prāpnoti puṭakaṃ tu tat ||
arśo-'rbudāni vibhajed doṣa-liṅgair yathā-yatham | / sarveṣu kṛcchrocchvasanaṃ pīnasaḥ pratataṃ kṣutiḥ ||
sānunāsika-vādi-tvaṃ pūti-nāsaḥ śiro-vyathā | / aṣṭā-daśānām ity eṣāṃ yāpayed duṣṭa-pīnasam ||
sarveṣu pīnaseṣv ādau nivātāgāra-go bhajet | / snehana-sveda-vamana-dhūma-gaṇḍūṣa-dhāraṇam ||
vāso gurūṣṇaṃ śirasaḥ su-ghanaṃ pariveṣṭanam | / laghv-amla-lavaṇaṃ snigdham uṣṇaṃ bhojanam a-dravam ||
dhanva-māṃsa-guḍa-kṣīra-caṇaka-tri-kaṭūtkaṭam | / yava-godhūma-bhūyiṣṭhaṃ dadhi-dāḍima-sārikam ||
bāla-mūlaka-jo yūṣaḥ kulatthotthaś ca pūjitaḥ | / kavoṣṇaṃ daśa-mūlāmbu jīrṇāṃ vā vāruṇīṃ pibet ||
jighrec coraka-tarkārī-vacājājy-upakuñcikāḥ | / vyoṣa-tālīśa-cavikā-tintiḍīkāmla-vetasam ||
sāgny-ajāji dvi-palikaṃ tvag-elā-pattra-pādikam | / jīrṇād guḍāt tulārdhena pakvena vaṭakī-kṛtam ||
pīnasa-śvāsa-kāsa-ghnaṃ ruci-svara-karaṃ param | / śatāhvā-tvag-balā mūlaṃ śyoṇākairaṇḍa-bilva-jam ||
sāragvadhaṃ pibed dhūmaṃ vasājya-madanānvitam | / atha-vā sa-ghṛtān saktūn kṛtvā mallaka-sampuṭe ||
tyajet snānaṃ śucaṃ krodhaṃ bhṛśaṃ śayyāṃ himaṃ jalam | / pibed vāta-pratiśyāye sarpir vāta-ghna-sādhitam ||
paṭu-pañcaka-siddhaṃ vā vidāry-ādi-gaṇena vā | / sveda-nasyādikāṃ kuryāt cikitsām arditoditām ||
pitta-raktotthayoḥ peyaṃ sarpir madhurakaiḥ śṛtam | / pariṣekān pradehāṃś ca śītaiḥ kurvīta śītalān ||
dhava-tvak-tri-phalā-śyāmā-śrīparṇī-yaṣṭi-tilvakaiḥ | / kṣīre daśa-guṇe tailaṃ nāvanaṃ sa-niśaiḥ pacet ||
kapha-je laṅghanaṃ lepaḥ śiraso gaura-sarṣapaiḥ | / sa-kṣāraṃ vā ghṛtam pītvā vamet piṣṭais tu nāvanam ||
bastāmbunā paṭu-vyoṣa-vella-vatsaka-jīrakaiḥ | / kaṭu-tīkṣṇair ghṛtair nasyaiḥ kavaḍaiḥ sarva-jaṃ jayet ||
yakṣma-kṛmi-kramaṃ kurvan yāpayed duṣṭa-pīnasam | / vyoṣorubūka-kṛmijid-dāru-mādrī-gadeṅgudam ||
vārtāka-bījaṃ trivṛtā siddhārthaḥ pūti-matsyakaḥ | / agnimanthasya puṣpāṇi pīlu-śigru-phalāni ca ||
aśva-viḍ-rasa-mūtrābhyāṃ hasti-mūtreṇa caikataḥ | / kṣauma-garbhāṃ kṛtāṃ vartiṃ dhūmaṃ ghrāṇāsyataḥ pibet ||
kṣavathau puṭakākhye ca tīkṣṇaiḥ pradhamanaṃ hitam | / śuṇṭhī-kuṣṭha-kaṇā-vella-drākṣā-kalka-kaṣāya-vat ||
sādhitaṃ tailam ājyaṃ vā nasyaṃ kṣava-puṭa-praṇut | / nāsā-śoṣe balā-tailaṃ pānādau bhojanaṃ rasaiḥ ||
snigdho dhūmas tathā svedo nāsānāhe 'py ayaṃ vidhiḥ | / pāke dīptau ca pitta-ghnaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ nasyādi saṃsrutau ||
kapha-pīnasa-vat pūti-nāsā-pīnasayoḥ kriyā | / lākṣā-karañja-marica-vella-hiṅgu-kaṇā-guḍaiḥ ||
avi-mūtra-drutair nasyaṃ kārayed vamane kṛte | / śigru-siṃhī-nikumbhānāṃ bījaiḥ sa-vyoṣa-saindhavaiḥ ||
sa-vella-surasais tailaṃ nāvanaṃ paramaṃ hitam | / pūya-rakte nave kuryād rakta-pīnasa-vat kramam ||
ati-pravṛddhe nāḍī-vad dagdheṣv arśo-'rbudeṣu ca | / nikumbha-kumbha-sindhūttha-manohvāla-kaṇāgnikaiḥ ||
kalkitair ghṛta-madhv-aktāṃ ghrāṇe vartiṃ praveśayet | / śigrv-ādi-nāvanaṃ cātra pūti-nāsoditaṃ bhajet ||
mātsya-māhiṣa-vārāha-piśitāmaka-mūlakam | / māṣa-sūpa-dadhi-kṣīra-śuktekṣu-rasa-phāṇitam ||
avāk-śayyāṃ ca bhajato dviṣato danta-dhāvanam | / dhūma-cchardana-gaṇḍūṣān ucitaṃ ca sirā-vyadham ||
kruddhāḥ śleṣmolbaṇā doṣāḥ kurvanty antar mukhaṃ gadān | / tatra khaṇḍauṣṭha ity ukto vātenauṣṭho dvi-dhā kṛtaḥ ||
oṣṭha-kope tu pavanāt stabdhāv oṣṭhau mahā-rujau | / dālyete paripāṭyete paruṣāsita-karkaśau ||
pittāt tīkṣṇa-sahau pītau sarṣapākṛtibhiś citau | / piṭikābhir bahu-kledāv āśu-pākau kaphāt punaḥ ||
śītā-sahau gurū śūnau sa-varṇa-piṭikācitau | / sannipātād anekābhau dur-gandhāsrāva-picchilau ||
a-kasmān mlāna-saṃśūna-rujau viṣama-pākinau | / raktopasṛṣṭau rudhiraṃ sravataḥ śoṇita-prabhau ||
kharjūra-sadṛśaṃ cātra kṣīṇe rakte 'rbudaṃ bhavet | / māṃsa-piṇḍopamau māṃsāt syātāṃ mūrchat-kṛmī kramāt ||
tailābha-śvayathu-kledau sa-kaṇḍvau medasā mṛdū | / kṣata-jāv avadīryete pāṭyete cā-sakṛt punaḥ ||
grathitau ca punaḥ syātāṃ kaṇḍūlau daśana-cchadau | / jala-budbuda-vad vāta-kaphād oṣṭhe jalārbudam ||
gaṇḍālajī sthiraḥ śopho gaṇḍe dāha-jvarānvitaḥ | / vātād uṣṇa-sahā dantāḥ śīta-sparśe 'dhika-vyathāḥ ||
dālyanta iva śūlena śītākhyo dālanaś ca saḥ | / danta-harṣe pravātāmla-śīta-bhakṣā-kṣamā dvi-jāḥ ||
bhavanty amlāśaneneva sa-rujāś calitā iva | / danta-bhede dvi-jās toda-bheda-ruk-sphuṭanānvitāḥ ||
cālaś caladbhir daśanair bhakṣaṇād adhika-vyathaiḥ | / karālas tu karālānāṃ daśanānāṃ samudgamaḥ ||
danto 'dhiko 'dhi-dantākhyaḥ sa coktaḥ khalu vardhanaḥ | / jāyamāne 'ti-rug dante jāte tatra tu śāmyati ||
a-dhāvanān malo dante kapho vā vāta-śoṣitaḥ | / pūti-gandhiḥ sthirī-bhūtaḥ śarkarā sāpy upekṣitā ||
śātayaty aṇu-śo dantāt kapālāni kapālikā | / śyāvaḥ śyāva-tvam āyāto rakta-pittānilair dvi-jaḥ ||
sa-mūlaṃ dantam āśritya doṣair ulbaṇa-mārutaiḥ | / śoṣite majjñi suṣire dante 'nna-mala-pūrite ||
pūti-tvāt kṛmayaḥ sūkṣmā jāyante jāyate tataḥ | / a-hetu-tīvrārti-śamaḥ sa-saṃrambho 'sitaś calaḥ ||
pralūnaḥ pūya-rakta-srut sa coktaḥ kṛmi-dantakaḥ | / śleṣma-raktena pūtīni vahanty asram a-hetukam ||
śīryante danta-māṃsāni mṛdu-klinnāsitāni ca | / śītādo 'sāv upa-kuśaḥ pākaḥ pittāsṛg-udbhavaḥ ||
danta-māṃsāni dahyante raktāny utsedha-vanty ataḥ | / kaṇḍū-manti sravanty asram ādhmāyante 'sṛji sthite ||
calā manda-rujo dantāḥ pūti vaktraṃ ca jāyate | / dantayos triṣu vā śopho badarāsthi-nibho ghanaḥ ||
kaphāsrāt tīvra-ruk śīghraṃ pacyate danta-puppuṭaḥ | / danta-māṃse malaiḥ sāsrair bāhyāntaḥ śvayathur guruḥ ||
sa-rug-dāhaḥ sraved bhinnaḥ pūyāsraṃ danta-vidradhiḥ | / śvayathur danta-mūleṣu rujā-vān pitta-rakta-jaḥ ||
lālā-srāvī sa suṣiro danta-māṃsa-praśātanaḥ | / sa sannipātāj jvara-vān sa-pūya-rudhira-srutiḥ ||
mahā-suṣira ity ukto viśīrṇa-dvi-ja-bandhanaḥ | / dantānte kīla-vac chopho hanu-karṇa-rujā-karaḥ ||
pratihanty abhyavahṛtim śleṣmaṇā so 'dhi-māṃsakaḥ | / ghṛṣṭeṣu danta-māṃseṣu saṃrambho jāyate mahān ||
yasmiṃś calanti dantāś ca sa vidarbho 'bhighāta-jaḥ | / danta-māṃsāśritān rogān yaḥ sādhyān apy upekṣate ||
antas tasyāsravan doṣaḥ sūkṣmāṃ sañjanayed gatim | / pūyaṃ muhuḥ sā sravati tvaṅ-māṃsāsthi-prabhedinī ||
tāḥ punaḥ pañca vijñeyā lakṣaṇaiḥ svair yathoditaiḥ | / śāka-pattra-kharā suptā sphuṭitā vāta-dūṣitā ||
jihvā pittāt sa-dāhoṣā raktair māṃsāṅkuraiś citā | / śālmalī-kaṇṭakābhais tu kaphena bahalā guruḥ ||
kapha-pittād adhaḥ śopho jihvā-stambha-kṛd unnataḥ | / matsya-gandhir bhavet pakvaḥ so 'laso māṃsa-śātanaḥ ||
prabandhane 'dho jihvāyāḥ śopho jihvāgra-sannibhaḥ | / sāṅkuraḥ kapha-pittāsrair lāloṣā-stambha-vān kharaḥ ||
adhi-jihvaḥ sa-ruk-kaṇḍur vākyāhāra-vighāta-kṛt | / tādṛg evopa-jihvas tu jihvāyā upari sthitaḥ ||
tālu-māṃse 'nilād duṣṭe piṭikāḥ sa-rujaḥ kharāḥ | / bahvyo ghanāḥ srāva-yutās tās tālu-piṭikāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
tālu-mūle kaphāt sāsrān matsya-vasti-nibho mṛduḥ | / pralambaḥ picchilaḥ śopho nāsayāhāram īrayan ||
kaṇṭhoparodha-tṛṭ-kāsa-vami-kṛt gala-śuṇḍikā | / tālu-madhye ni-ruṅ māṃsaṃ saṃhataṃ tālu-saṃhatiḥ ||
padmākṛtis tālu-madhye raktāc chvayathur arbudam | / kacchapaḥ kacchapākāraś cira-vṛddhiḥ kaphād a-ruk ||
kolābhaḥ śleṣma-medobhyāṃ puppuṭo nī-rujaḥ sthiraḥ | / pittena pākaḥ pākākhyaḥ pūyāsrāvī mahā-rujaḥ ||
vāta-pitta-jvarāyāsais tālu-śoṣas tad-āhvayaḥ | / jihvā-prabandha-jāḥ kaṇṭhe dāruṇā mārga-rodhinaḥ ||
māṃsāṅkurāḥ śīghra-cayā rohiṇī śīghra-kāriṇī | / kaṇṭhāsya-śoṣa-kṛd vātāt sā hanu-śrotra-ruk-karī ||
pittāj jvaroṣā-tṛṇ-moha-kaṇṭha-dhūmāyanānvitā | / kṣipra-jā kṣipra-pākāti-rāgiṇī sparśanā-sahā ||
kaphena picchilā pāṇḍur asṛjā sphoṭakācitā | / taptāṅgāra-nibhā karṇa-ruk-karī pitta-jākṛtiḥ ||
gambhīra-pākā nicayāt sarva-liṅga-samanvitā | / doṣaiḥ kapholbaṇaiḥ śophaḥ kola-vad grathitonnataḥ ||
śūka-kaṇṭaka-vat kaṇṭhe śālūko mārga-rodhanaḥ | / vṛndo vṛttonnato dāha-jvara-kṛd gala-pārśva-gaḥ ||
hanu-sandhy-āśritaḥ kaṇṭhe kārpāsī-phala-sannibhaḥ | / picchilo manda-ruk śophaḥ kaṭhinas tuṇḍikerikā ||
bāhyāntaḥ śvayathur ghoro gala-mārgārgalopamaḥ | / galaugho mūrdha-guru-tā-tandrā-lālā-jvara-pradaḥ ||
valayaṃ nāti-ruk śophas tad-vad evāyatonnataḥ | / māṃsa-kīlo gale doṣair eko 'neko 'tha-vā 'lpa-ruk ||
kṛcchrocchvāsābhyavahṛtiḥ pṛthu-mūlo gilāyukaḥ | / bhūri-māṃsāṅkura-vṛtā tīvra-tṛḍ-jvara-mūrdha-ruk ||
śata-ghnī nicitā vartiḥ śata-ghnīvāti-ruk-karī | / vyāpta-sarva-galaḥ śīghra-janma-pāko mahā-rujaḥ ||
pūti-pūya-nibha-srāvī śvayathur gala-vidradhiḥ | / jihvāvasāne kaṇṭhādāv a-pākaṃ śvayathuṃ malāḥ ||
janayanti sthiraṃ raktaṃ nī-rujaṃ tad galārbudam || 53ab || / pavana-śleṣma-medobhir gala-gaṇḍo bhaved bahiḥ || 53cd || / vardhamānaḥ sa kālena muṣka-val lambate 'ti-ruk || 53ef ||
kṛṣṇo 'ruṇo vā todāḍhyaḥ sa vātāt kṛṣṇa-rāji-mān | / vṛddhas tālu-gale śoṣaṃ kuryāc ca vi-rasāsya-tām ||
sthiraḥ sa-varṇaḥ kaṇḍū-mān śīta-sparśo guruḥ kaphāt | / vṛddhas tālu-gale lepaṃ kuryāc ca madhurāsya-tām ||
medasaḥ śleṣma-vad dhāni-vṛddhyoḥ so 'nuvidhīyate | / dehaṃ vṛddhaś ca kurute gale śabdaṃ svare 'lpa-tām ||
śleṣma-ruddhānila-gatiḥ śuṣka-kaṇṭho hata-svaraḥ | / tāmyan prasaktaṃ śvasiti yena sa svara-hānilāt ||
karoti vadanasyāntar vraṇān sarva-saro 'nilaḥ | / sañcāriṇo 'ruṇān rūkṣān oṣṭhau tāmrau cala-tvacau ||
jihvā śītā-sahā gurvī sphuṭitā kaṇṭakācitā | / vivṛṇoti ca kṛcchreṇa mukhaṃ pāko mukhasya saḥ ||
adhaḥ pratihato vāyur arśo-gulma-kaphādibhiḥ | / yāty ūrdhvaṃ vaktra-daurgandhyaṃ kurvann ūrdhva-gudas tu saḥ ||
mukhasya pitta-je pāke dāhoṣe tikta-vaktra-tā | / kṣārokṣita-kṣata-samā vraṇās tad-vac ca rakta-je ||
kapha-je madhurāsya-tvaṃ kaṇḍū-mat-picchilā vraṇāḥ | / antaḥ-kapolam āśritya śyāva-pāṇḍu kapho 'rbudam ||
kuryāt tad ghaṭṭitaṃ chinnaṃ mṛditaṃ ca vivardhate | / mukha-pāko bhavet sāsraiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvākṛtir malaiḥ ||
pūty-āsya-tā ca tair eva danta-kāṣṭhādi-vidviṣaḥ | / oṣṭhe gaṇḍe dvi-je mūle jihvāyāṃ tāluke gale ||
vaktre sarva-tra cety uktāḥ pañca-saptatir āmayāḥ | / ekā-daśaiko daśa ca trayo-daśa tathā ca ṣaṭ ||
aṣṭāv aṣṭā-daśāṣṭau ca kramāt teṣv an-upakramāḥ | / karālo māṃsa-raktauṣṭhāv arbudāni jalād vinā ||
kacchapas tālu-piṭikā galaughaḥ suṣiro mahān | / svara-ghnordhva-guda-śyāva-śata-ghnī-valayālasāḥ ||
nāḍy-oṣṭha-kopau nicayād raktāt sarvaiś ca rohiṇī | / daśane sphuṭite danta-bhedaḥ pakvopa-jihvikā ||
gala-gaṇḍaḥ svara-bhraṃśī kṛcchrocchvāso 'ti-vatsaraḥ | / yāpyas tu harṣo bhedaś ca śeṣāñ chastrauṣadhair jayet ||
khaṇḍauṣṭhasya vilikhyāntau syūtvā vraṇa-vad ācaret | / yaṣṭī-jyotiṣmatī-lodhra-śrāvaṇī-śārivotpalaiḥ ||
paṭolyā kākamācyā ca tailam abhyañjanaṃ pacet | / nasyaṃ ca tailaṃ vāta-ghna-madhura-skandha-sādhitam ||
mahā-snehena vātauṣṭhe siddhenāktaḥ picur hitaḥ | / deva-dhūpa-madhūcchiṣṭa-guggulv-amaradārubhiḥ ||
yaṣṭy-āhva-cūrṇa-yuktena tenaiva pratisāraṇam | / nāḍy-oṣṭhaṃ svedayed dugdha-siddhair eraṇḍa-pallavaiḥ ||
khaṇḍauṣṭha-vihitaṃ nasyaṃ tasya mūrdhni ca tarpaṇam | / pittābhighāta-jāv oṣṭhau jalaukobhir upācaret ||
lodhra-sarja-rasa-kṣaudra-madhukaiḥ pratisāraṇam | / guḍūcī-yaṣṭi-pattaṅga-siddham abhyañjane ghṛtam ||
pitta-vidradhi-vac cātra kriyā śoṇita-je 'pi ca | / idam eva nave kāryaṃ karmauṣṭhe tu kaphāture ||
pāṭhā-kṣāra-madhu-vyoṣair hṛtāsre pratisāraṇam | / dhūma-nāvana-gaṇḍūṣāḥ prayojyāś ca kapha-cchidaḥ ||
svinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vi-medaskaṃ dahen medo-jam agninā | / priyaṅgu-lodhra-tri-phalā-mākṣikaiḥ pratisārayet ||
sa-kṣaudrā gharṣaṇaṃ tīkṣṇā bhinna-śuddhe jalārbude | / avagāḍhe 'ti-vṛddhe vā kṣāro 'gnir vā pratikriyā ||
āmādy-avasthāsv alajīṃ gaṇḍe śopha-vad ācaret | / svinnasya śīta-dantasya pālīṃ vilikhitāṃ dahet ||
tailena pratisāryā ca sa-kṣaudra-ghana-saindhavaiḥ | / dāḍima-tvag-varā-tārkṣya-kāntā-jambv-asthi-nāgaraiḥ ||
kavaḍaḥ kṣīriṇāṃ kvāthair aṇu-tailaṃ ca nāvanam | / danta-harṣe tathā bhede sarvā vāta-harā kriyā ||
tila-yaṣṭīmadhu-śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ gaṇḍūṣa-dhāraṇam | / sa-snehaṃ daśa-mūlāmbu gaṇḍūṣaḥ pracalad-dvi-je ||
tuttha-lodhra-kaṇā-śreṣṭhā-pattaṅga-paṭu-gharṣaṇam | / snigdhāḥ śīlyā yathāvasthaṃ nasyānna-kavaḍādayaḥ ||
adhi-dantakam āliptaṃ yadā kṣāreṇa jarjaram | / kṛmi-dantam ivotpāṭya tad-vac copacaret tadā ||
an-avasthita-rakte ca dagdhe vraṇa iva kriyā | / a-hiṃsan danta-mūlāni dantebhyaḥ śarkarāṃ haret ||
kṣāra-cūrṇair madhu-yutais tataś ca pratisārayet | / kapālikāyām apy evaṃ harṣoktaṃ ca samācaret ||
jayed visrāvaṇaiḥ svinnam a-calaṃ kṛmi-dantakam | / snigdhaiś cālepa-gaṇḍūṣa-nasyāhāraiś calāpahaiḥ ||
guḍena pūrṇaṃ suṣiraṃ madhūcchiṣṭena vā dahet | / saptacchadārka-kṣīrābhyāṃ pūraṇaṃ kṛmi-śūla-jit ||
hiṅgu-kaṭphala-kāsīsa-svarjikā-kuṣṭha-vella-jam | / rajo rujaṃ jayaty āśu vastra-sthaṃ daśane ghṛtam ||
gaṇḍūṣaṃ grāhayet tailam ebhir eva ca sādhitam | / kvāthair vā yuktam eraṇḍa-dvi-vyāghrī-bhūkadamba-jaiḥ ||
kriyā-yogair bahu-vidhair ity a-śānta-rujaṃ bhṛśam | / dṛḍham apy uddhared dantaṃ pūrvaṃ mūlād vimokṣitam ||
sandaṃśakena laghunā danta-nirghātanena vā | / tailaṃ sa-yaṣṭy-āhva-rajo gaṇḍūṣo madhu vā tataḥ ||
tato vidāri-yaṣṭy-āhva-śṛṅgāṭaka-kaserubhiḥ | / tailaṃ daśa-guṇa-kṣīraṃ siddhaṃ yuñjīta nāvanam ||
kṛśa-dur-bala-vṛddhānāṃ vātārtānāṃ ca noddharet | / noddharec cottaraṃ dantaṃ bahūpadrava-kṛd dhi saḥ ||
eṣām apy uddhṛtau snigdha-svādu-śīta-kramo hitaḥ | / visrāvitāsre śītāde sa-kṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇam ||
mustārjuna-tvak-tri-phalā-phalinī-tārkṣya-nāgaraiḥ | / tat-kvāthaḥ kavaḍo nasyaṃ tailaṃ madhura-sādhitam ||
danta-māṃsāny upa-kuśe svinnāny uṣṇāmbu-dhāraṇaiḥ | / maṇḍalāgreṇa śākādi-pattrair vā bahu-śo likhet ||
tataś ca pratisāryāṇi ghṛta-maṇḍa-madhu-drutaiḥ | / lākṣā-priyaṅgu-pattaṅga-lavaṇottama-gairikaiḥ ||
sa-kuṣṭha-śuṇṭhī-marica-yaṣṭīmadhu-rasāñjanaiḥ | / sukhoṣṇo ghṛta-maṇḍo 'nu tailaṃ vā kavaḍa-grahaḥ ||
ghṛtaṃ ca madhuraiḥ siddhaṃ hitaṃ kavaḍa-nasyayoḥ | / danta-puppuṭake svinna-cchinna-bhinna-vilekhite ||
yaṣṭy-āhva-svarjikā-śuṇṭhī-saindhavaiḥ pratisāraṇam | / vidradhau kaṭu-tīkṣṇoṣṇa-rūkṣaiḥ kavaḍa-lepanam ||
gharṣaṇaṃ kaṭukā-kuṣṭha-vṛścikālī-yavodbhavaiḥ | / rakṣet pākaṃ himaiḥ pakvaḥ pāṭyo dāhyo 'vagāḍhakaḥ ||
suṣire chinna-likhite sa-kṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇam | / lodhra-musta-miśi-śreṣṭhā-tārkṣya-pattaṅga-kiṃśukaiḥ ||
sa-kaṭphalaiḥ kaṣāyaiś ca teṣāṃ gaṇḍūṣa iṣyate | / yaṣṭī-lodhrotpalānantā-śārivāguru-candanaiḥ ||
sa-gairika-sitā-puṇḍraiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca nāvanam | / chittvādhi-māṃsakaṃ cūrṇaiḥ sa-kṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet ||
vacā-tejovatī-pāṭhā-svarjikā-yava-śūka-jaiḥ | / paṭola-nimba-tri-phalā-kaṣāyaḥ kavaḍo hitaḥ ||
vidarbhe danta-mūlāni maṇḍalāgreṇa śodhayet | / kṣāraṃ yuñjyāt tato nasyaṃ gaṇḍūṣādi ca śītalam ||
saṃśodhyobhayataḥ kāyaṃ śiraś copacaret tataḥ | / nāḍīṃ dantānugāṃ dantaṃ samuddhṛtyāgninā dahet ||
kubjāṃ naika-gatiṃ pūrṇāṃ guḍena madanena vā | / dhāvanaṃ jāti-madana-khadira-svādukaṇṭakaiḥ ||
kṣīri-vṛkṣāmbu-gaṇḍūṣo nasyaṃ tailaṃ ca tat-kṛtam | / kuryād vātauṣṭha-kopoktaṃ kaṇṭakeṣv anilātmasu ||
jihvāyāṃ pitta-jāteṣu ghṛṣṭeṣu rudhire srute | / pratisāraṇa-gaṇḍūṣa-nāvanaṃ madhurair hitam ||
tīkṣṇaiḥ kaphottheṣv evaṃ ca sarṣapa-try-ūṣaṇādibhiḥ | / nave jihvālase 'py evaṃ taṃ tu śastreṇa na spṛśet ||
unnamya jihvām ākṛṣṭāṃ baḍiśenādhi-jihvikām | / chedayen maṇḍalāgreṇa tīkṣṇoṣṇair gharṣaṇādi ca ||
upa-jihvāṃ parisrāvya yava-kṣāreṇa gharṣayet | / kapha-ghnaiḥ śuṇḍikā sādhyā nasya-gaṇḍūṣa-gharṣaṇaiḥ ||
ervāru-bīja-pratimaṃ vṛddhāyām a-sirā-tatam | / agraṃ niviṣṭaṃ jihvāyā baḍīśādy-avalambitam ||
chedayen maṇḍalāgreṇa nāty-agre na ca mūlataḥ | / chede 'ty asṛk-kṣayān mṛtyur hīne vyādhir vivardhate ||
maricātiviṣā-pāṭhā-vacā-kuṣṭha-kuṭannaṭaiḥ | / chinnāyāṃ sa-paṭu-kṣaudrair gharṣaṇaṃ kavaḍaḥ punaḥ ||
kaṭukātiviṣā-pāṭhā-nimba-rāsnā-vacāmbubhiḥ | / saṅghāte puppuṭe kūrme vilikhyaivaṃ samācaret ||
a-pakve tālu-pāke tu kāsīsa-kṣaudra-tārkṣya-jaiḥ | / gharṣaṇaṃ kavaḍaḥ śīta-kaṣāya-madhurauṣadhaiḥ ||
pakve 'ṣṭā-pada-vad bhinne tīkṣṇoṣṇaiḥ pratisāraṇam | / vṛṣa-nimba-paṭolādyais tiktaiḥ kavaḍa-dhāraṇam ||
tālu-śoṣe tv a-tṛṣṇasya sarpir uttara-bhaktikam | / kaṇā-śuṇṭhī-śṛtaṃ pānam amlair gaṇḍūṣa-dhāraṇam ||
dhanva-māṃsa-rasāḥ snigdhāḥ kṣīra-sarpiś ca nāvanam | / kaṇṭha-rogeṣv asṛṅ-mokṣas tīkṣṇair nasyādi karma ca ||
kvāthaḥ pānaṃ ca dārvī-tvaṅ-nimba-tārkṣya-kaliṅga-jaḥ | / harītakī-kaṣāyo vā peyo mākṣika-saṃyutaḥ ||
śreṣṭhā-vyoṣa-yava-kṣāra-dārvī-dvīpi-rasāñjanaiḥ | / sa-pāṭhā-tejinī-nimbaiḥ śukta-go-mūtra-sādhitaiḥ ||
kavaḍo guṭikā vātra kalpitā pratisāraṇam | / niculaṃ kaṭabhī mustaṃ devadāru mahauṣadham ||
vacā dantī ca mūrvā ca lepaḥ koṣṇo 'rti-śopha-hā | / athāntar-bāhyataḥ svinnāṃ vāta-rohiṇikāṃ likhet ||
aṅgulī-śastrakeṇāśu paṭu-yukta-nakhena vā | / pañca-mūlāmbu kavaḍas tailaṃ gaṇḍūṣa-nāvanam ||
visrāvya pitta-sambhūtāṃ sitā-kṣaudra-priyaṅgubhiḥ | / gharṣet sa-lodhra-pattaṅgaiḥ kavaḍaḥ kvathitaiś ca taiḥ ||
drākṣā-parūṣaka-kvātho hitaś ca kavaḍa-grahe | / upācared evam eva pratyākhyāyāsra-sambhavām ||
sāgāra-dhūmaiḥ kaṭukaiḥ kapha-jāṃ pratisārayet | / nasya-gaṇḍūṣayos tailaṃ sādhitaṃ ca praśasyate ||
apāmārga-phala-śvetā-dantī-jantughna-saindhavaiḥ | / tad-vac ca vṛnda-śālūka-tuṇḍikerī-gilāyuṣu ||
vidradhau srāvite śreṣṭhā-rocanā-tārkṣya-gairikaiḥ | / sa-lodhra-paṭu-pattaṅga-kaṇair gaṇḍūṣa-gharṣaṇe ||
gala-gaṇḍaḥ pavana-jaḥ svinno niḥsruta-śoṇitaḥ | / tilair bījaiś ca laṭvomā-priyāla-śaṇa-sambhavaiḥ ||
upanāhyo vraṇe rūḍhe pralepyaś ca punaḥ punaḥ | / śigru-tilvaka-tarkārī-gaja-kṛṣṇā-punarnavaiḥ ||
kālāmṛtārka-mūlaiś ca puṣpaiś ca karahāṭa-jaiḥ | / ekaiṣīkānvitaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ surayā kāñjikena vā ||
guḍūcī-nimba-kuṭaja-haṃsapadī-balā-dvayaiḥ | / sādhitaṃ pāyayet tailaṃ sa-kṛṣṇā-devadārubhiḥ ||
kartavyaṃ kapha-je 'py etat sveda-vimlāpane tv ati | / lepo 'jagandhātiviṣā-viśalyāḥ sa-viṣāṇikāḥ ||
guñjālābu-śukāhvāś ca palāśa-kṣāra-kalkitāḥ | / mūtra-srutaṃ haṭha-kṣāraṃ paktvā kodrava-bhuk pibet ||
sādhitaṃ vatsakādyair vā tailaṃ sa-paṭu-pañcakaiḥ | / kapha-ghnān dhūma-vamana-nāvanādīṃś ca śīlayet ||
medo-bhave sirāṃ vidhyet kapha-ghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ bhajet | / asanādi-rajaś cainaṃ prātar mūtreṇa pāyayet ||
a-śāntau pācayitvā ca sarvān vraṇa-vad ācaret | / mukha-pākeṣu sa-kṣaudrā prayojyā mukha-dhāvanāḥ ||
kvathitās tri-phalā-pāṭhā-mṛdvīkā-jāti-pallavāḥ | / niṣṭhevyā bhakṣayitvā vā kuṭherādir gaṇo 'tha-vā ||
mukha-pāke 'nilāt kṛṣṇā-paṭv-elāḥ pratisāraṇam | / tailaṃ vāta-haraiḥ siddhaṃ hitaṃ kavaḍa-nasyayoḥ ||
pittāsre pitta-rakta-ghnaḥ kapha-ghnaś ca kaphe vidhiḥ | / likhec chākādi-pattraiś ca piṭikāḥ kaṭhināḥ sthirāḥ ||
yathā-doṣodayaṃ kuryāt sannipāte cikitsitam | / nave 'rbude tv a-saṃvṛddhe chedite pratisāraṇam ||
svarjikā-nāgara-kṣaudraiḥ kvātho gaṇḍūṣa iṣyate | / guḍūcī-nimba-kalkottho madhu-taila-samanvitaḥ ||
yavānna-bhuk tīkṣṇa-taila-nasyābhyaṅgāṃs tathācaret | / vamite pūti-vadane dhūmas tīkṣṇaḥ sa-nāvanaḥ ||
samaṅgā-dhātakī-lodhra-phalinī-padmakair jalam | / dhāvanaṃ vadanasyāntaś cūrṇitair avacūrṇitam ||

śītādopa-kuśoktaṃ ca nāvanādi ca śīlayet || 81ab || / phala-traya-dvīpi-kirātatikta-yaṣṭy-āhva-siddhārtha-kaṭu-trikāṇi || 81cd || / mustā-haridrā-dvaya-yāva-śūka-vṛkṣāmlakāmlāgrima-vetasāś ca || 81ef ||
aśvattha-jambv-āmra-dhanañjaya-tvak tvak cāhimārāt khadirasya sāraḥ | / kvāthena teṣāṃ ghana-tāṃ gatena tac-cūrṇa-yuktā guṭikā vidheyāḥ ||
tā dhāritā ghnanti mukhena nityaṃ kaṇṭhauṣṭha-tālv-ādi-gadān su-kṛcchrān | / viśeṣato rohiṇikāsya-śoṣa-gandhān videhādhipati-praṇītāḥ ||
khadira-tulām ambu-ghaṭe paktvā toyena tena piṣṭaiś ca | / candana-joṅgaka-kuṅkuma-paripelava-vālakośīraiḥ ||
surataru-lodhra-drākṣā-mañjiṣṭhā-coca-padmaka-viḍaṅgaiḥ | / spṛkkā-nata-nakha-kaṭphala-sūkṣmailā-dhyāmakaiḥ sa-pattaṅgaiḥ ||
taila-prasthaṃ vipacet karṣāṃśaiḥ pāna-nasya-gaṇḍūṣais tat | / hatvāsye sarva-gadān janayati gārdhrīṃ dṛśaṃ śrutiṃ ca vārāhīm ||
udvartitaṃ ca prapunāṭa-lodhra-dārvībhir abhyaktam anena vaktram | / nir-vyaṅga-nīlī-mukha-dūṣikādi sañjāyate candra-samāna-kānti ||
pala-śataṃ bāṇāt toya-ghaṭe paktvā rase 'smiṃś ca palārdhikaiḥ | / khadira-jambū-yaṣṭyānantāmrair ahimāra-nīlotpalānvitaiḥ ||
taila-prasthaṃ pācayec chlakṣṇa-piṣṭair ebhir dravyair dhāritaṃ tan mukhena | / rogān sarvān hanti vaktre viśeṣāt sthairyaṃ dhatte danta-paṅkteś calāyāḥ ||
khadira-sārād dve tule paced valkāt tulāṃ cārimedasaḥ | / ghaṭa-catuṣke pāda-śeṣe 'smin pūte punaḥ kvathanād ghane ||
ākṣikaṃ kṣipet su-sūkṣmaṃ rajaḥ sevyāmbu-pattaṅga-gairikam | / candana-dvaya-lodhra-puṇḍrāhva-yaṣṭy-āhva-lākṣāñjana-dvayam ||
dhātakī-kaṭphala-dvi-niśā-tri-phalā-catur-jāta-joṅgakam | / musta-mañjiṣṭhā-nyagrodha-praroha-māṃsī-yavāsakam ||
padmakailā-samaṅgāś ca śīte tasmiṃs tathā pālikāṃ pṛthak | / jātīpattrikāṃ sa-jāti-phalāṃ saha-lavaṅga-kaṇkollakām ||
sphaṭika-śubhra-surabhi-karpūra-kuḍavaṃ ca tatrāvapet tataḥ | / kārayed guṭikāḥ sadā caitā dhāryā mukhe tad-gadāpahāḥ ||
kvāthyauṣadha-vyatyaya-yojanena tailaṃ pacet kalpanayānayaiva | / sarvāsya-rogoddhṛtaye tad āhur danta-sthira-tve tv idam eva mukhyam ||
khadireṇaitā guṭikās tailam idaṃ cārimedasā prathitam | / anuśīlayan prati-dinaṃ svastho 'pi dṛḍha-dvi-jo bhavati ||
kṣudrā-guḍūcī-sumanaḥ-pravāla-dārvī-yavāsa-tri-phalā-kaṣāyaḥ | / kṣaudreṇa yuktaḥ kavaḍa-graho 'yaṃ sarvāmayān vaktra-gatān nihanti ||
pāṭhā-dārvī-tvak-kuṣṭha-mustā-samaṅgā-tiktā-pītāṅgī-lodhra-tejovatīnām | / cūrṇaḥ sa-kṣaudro danta-māṃsārti-kaṇḍū-pāka-srāvāṇāṃ nāśano gharṣaṇena ||
gṛha-dhūma-tārkṣya-pāṭhā-vyoṣa-kṣārāgny-ayo-varā-tejo-hvaiḥ | / mukha-danta-gala-vikāre sa-kṣaudraḥ kālako vidhāryaś cūrṇaḥ ||
dārvī-tvak-sindhūdbhava-manaḥśilā-yāva-śūka-haritālaiḥ | / dhāryaḥ pītaka-cūrṇo dantāsya-galāmaye sa-madhv-ājyaḥ ||
dvi-kṣāra-dhūmaka-varā-pañca-paṭu-vyoṣa-vella-giri-tārkṣyaiḥ | / go-mūtreṇa vipakvā galāmaya-ghnī rasa-kriyā eṣā ||
go-mūtra-kvathana-vilīna-vigrahāṇāṃ pathyānāṃ jala-miśi-kuṣṭha-bhāvitānām | / attāraṃ naram aṇavo 'pi vaktra-rogāḥ śrotāraṃ nṛpam iva na spṛśanty an-arthāḥ ||
saptacchadośīra-paṭola-musta-harītakī-tiktaka-rohiṇībhiḥ | / yaṣṭy-āhva-rājadruma-candanaiś ca kvāthaṃ pibet pāka-haraṃ mukhasya ||
paṭola-śuṇṭhī-tri-phalā-viśālā-trāyanti-tiktā-dvi-niśāmṛtānām | / pītaḥ kaṣāyo madhunā nihanti mukhe sthitaś cāsya-gadān a-śeṣān ||
sva-rasaḥ kvathito dārvyā ghanī-bhūtaḥ sa-gairikaḥ | / āsya-sthaḥ sa-madhur vaktra-pāka-nāḍī-vraṇāpahaḥ ||
paṭola-nimba-yaṣṭy-āhva-vāsā-jāty-arimedasām | / khadirasya varāyāś ca pṛthag evaṃ prakalpanā ||
khadirāyo-varā-pārtha-madayanty-ahimārakaiḥ | / gaṇḍūṣo 'mbu-śṛtair dhāryo dur-bala-dvi-ja-śāntaye ||
mukha-danta-mūla-gala-jāḥ prāyo rogāḥ kaphāsra-bhūyiṣṭhāḥ | / tasmāt teṣām a-sakṛd rudhiraṃ visrāvayed duṣṭam ||
kāya-śirasor vireko vamanaṃ kavaḍa-grahāś ca kaṭu-tiktāḥ | / prāyaḥ śastaṃ teṣāṃ kapha-rakta-haraṃ tathā karma ||
yava-tṛṇa-dhānyaṃ bhaktaṃ vidalaiḥ kṣāroṣitair apa-snehāḥ | / yūṣā bhakṣyāś ca hitā yac cānyac chleṣma-nāśāya ||
prāṇānila-patha-saṃsthāḥ śvasitam api nirundhate pramāda-vataḥ | / kaṇṭhāmayāś cikitsitam ato drutaṃ teṣu kurvīta ||
dhūmātapa-tuṣārāmbu-krīḍāti-svapna-jāgaraiḥ | / utsvedādhi-puro-vāta-bāṣpa-nigraha-rodanaiḥ ||
aty-ambu-madya-pānena kṛmibhir vega-dhāraṇaiḥ | / upadhāna-mṛjābhyaṅga-dveṣādhaḥ-pratatekṣaṇaiḥ ||
a-sātmya-gandha-duṣṭāma-bhāṣyādyaiś ca śiro-gatāḥ | / janayanty āmayān doṣās tatra māruta-kopataḥ ||
nistudyete bhṛśaṃ śaṅkhau ghāṭā sambhidyate tathā | / bhruvor madhyaṃ lalāṭaṃ ca patatīvāti-vedanam ||
bādhyete svanataḥ śrotre niṣkṛṣyete ivākṣiṇī | / ghūrṇatīva śiraḥ sarvaṃ sandhibhya iva mucyate ||
sphuraty ati sirā-jālaṃ kandharā-hanu-saṅgrahaḥ | / prakāśā-saha-tā ghrāṇa-srāvo '-kasmād vyathā-śamau ||
mārdavaṃ mardana-sneha-sveda-bandhaiś ca jāyate | / śiras-tāpo 'yam ardhe tu mūrdhnaḥ so 'rdhāvabhedakaḥ ||
pakṣāt kupyati māsād vā svayam eva ca śāmyati | / ati-vṛddhas tu nayanaṃ śravaṇaṃ vā vināśayet ||
śiro-'bhitāpe pittotthe śiro-dhūmāyanaṃ jvaraḥ | / svedo 'kṣi-dahanaṃ mūrchā niśi śītaiś ca mārdavam ||
a-ruciḥ kapha-je mūrdhno guru-stimita-śīta-tā | / sirā-niṣpanda-tālasyaṃ ruṅ mandāhny adhikā niśi ||
tandrā śūnākṣi-kūṭa-tvaṃ karṇa-kaṇḍūyanaṃ vamiḥ | / raktāt pittādhika-rujaḥ sarvaiḥ syāt sarva-lakṣaṇaḥ ||
saṅkīrṇair bhojanair mūrdhni kledite rudhirāmiṣe | / kopite sannipāte ca jāyante mūrdhni jantavaḥ ||
śirasas te pibanto 'sraṃ ghorāḥ kurvanti vedanāḥ | / citta-vibhraṃśa-jananīr jvaraḥ kāso bala-kṣayaḥ ||
raukṣya-śopha-vyadha-ccheda-dāha-sphuraṇa-pūti-tāḥ | / kapāle tālu-śirasoḥ kaṇḍūḥ śoṣaḥ pramīlakaḥ ||
tāmrāccha-siṅghāṇaka-tā karṇa-nādaś ca jantu-je | / vātolbaṇāḥ śiraḥ-kampaṃ tat-sañjñaṃ kurvate malāḥ ||
pitta-pradhānair vātādyaiḥ śaṅkhe śophaḥ sa-śoṇitaiḥ | / tīvra-dāha-rujā-rāga-pralāpa-jvara-tṛḍ-bhramāḥ ||
tiktāsyaḥ pīta-vadanaḥ kṣipra-kārī sa śaṅkhakaḥ | / tri-rātrāj jīvitaṃ hanti sidhyaty apy āśu sādhitaḥ ||
pittānubaddhaḥ śaṅkhākṣi-bhrū-lalāṭeṣu mārutaḥ | / rujaṃ sa-spandanāṃ kuryād anu-sūryodayodayām ||
ā-madhyāhnaṃ vivardhiṣṇuḥ kṣud-vataḥ sā viśeṣataḥ | / a-vyavasthita-śītoṣṇa-sukhā śāmyaty ataḥ param ||
sūryāvartaḥ sa ity uktā daśa rogāḥ śiro-gatāḥ | / śirasy eva ca vakṣyante kapāle vyādhayo nava ||
kapāle pavane duṣṭe garbha-sthasyāpi jāyate | / sa-varṇo nī-rujaḥ śophas taṃ vidyād upa-śīrṣakam ||
yathā-doṣodayaṃ brūyāt piṭikārbuda-vidradhīn | / kapāle kleda-bahulāḥ pittāsṛk-śleṣma-jantubhiḥ ||
kaṅgu-siddhārthaka-nibhāḥ piṭikāḥ syur arūṃṣikāḥ | / kaṇḍū-keśa-cyuti-svāpa-raukṣya-kṛt sphuṭanaṃ tvacaḥ ||
su-sūkṣmaṃ kapha-vātābhyāṃ vidyād dāruṇakaṃ tu tat | / roma-kūpānugaṃ pittaṃ vātena saha mūrchitam ||
pracyāvayati romāṇi tataḥ śleṣmā sa-śoṇitaḥ | / roma-kūpān ruṇaddhy asya tenānyeṣām a-sambhavaḥ ||
tad indra-luptaṃ rujyāṃ ca prāhuś cāceti cāpare | / khalater api janmaivaṃ śātanaṃ tatra tu kramāt ||
sā vātād agni-dagdhābhā pittāt svinna-sirāvṛtā | / kaphād ghana-tvag varṇāṃś ca yathā-svaṃ nirdiśet tvaci ||
doṣaiḥ sarvākṛtiḥ sarvair a-sādhyā sā nakha-prabhā | / dagdhāgnineva nī-romā sa-dāhā yā ca jāyate ||
śoka-śrama-krodha-kṛtaḥ śarīroṣmā śiro-gataḥ | / keśān sa-doṣaḥ pacati palitaṃ sambhavaty ataḥ ||
tad vātāt sphuṭitaṃ śyāvaṃ kharaṃ rūkṣaṃ jala-prabham | / pittāt sa-dāhaṃ pītābhaṃ kaphāt snigdhaṃ vivṛddhi-mat ||
sthūlaṃ su-śuklaṃ sarvais tu vidyād vyāmiśra-lakṣaṇam | / śiro-rujodbhavaṃ cānyad vi-varṇaṃ sparśanā-saham ||
a-sādhyā sannipātena khalatiḥ palitāni ca | / śarīra-pariṇāmotthāny apekṣante rasāyanam ||
śiro-'bhitāpe 'nila-je vāta-vyādhi-vidhiṃ caret | / ghṛtam akta-śirā rātrau pibed uṣṇa-payo-'nupaḥ ||
māṣān kulatthān mudgān vā tad-vat khāded ghṛtānvitān | / tailaṃ tilānāṃ kalkaṃ vā kṣīreṇa saha pāyayet ||
piṇḍopanāha-svedāś ca māṃsa-dhānya-kṛtā hitāḥ | / vāta-ghna-daśa-mūlādi-siddha-kṣīreṇa secanam ||
snigdhaṃ nasyaṃ tathā dhūmaḥ śiraḥ-śravaṇa-tarpaṇam | / varaṇādau gaṇe kṣuṇṇe kṣīram ardhodakaṃ pacet ||
kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ tac chītaṃ mathitvā sāram āharet | / tato madhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ nasyaṃ tat pūjitaṃ haviḥ ||
varge 'tra pakvaṃ kṣīre ca peyaṃ sarpiḥ sa-śarkaram | / kārpāsa-majjā tvaṅ mustā sumanaḥ-korakāṇi ca ||
nasyam uṣṇāmbu-piṣṭāni sarva-mūrdha-rujāpaham | / śarkarā-kuṅkuma-śṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ pittāsṛg-anvaye ||
pralepaiḥ sa-ghṛtaiḥ kuṣṭha-kuṭilotpala-candanaiḥ | / vātodreka-bhayād raktaṃ na cāsminn avasecayet ||
ity a-śāntau cale dāhaḥ kaphe ceṣṭo yathoditaḥ | / ardhāvabhedake 'py eṣā tathā doṣānvayāt kriyā ||
śirīṣa-bījāpāmārga-mūlaṃ nasyaṃ viḍānvitam | / sthirā-raso vā lepe tu prapunnāṭo 'mla-kalkitaḥ ||
sūryāvarte 'pi tasmiṃs tu sirayāpahared asṛk | / śiro-'bhitāpe pittotthe snigdhasya vyadhayet sirām ||
śītāḥ śiro-mukhālepa-seka-śodhana-vastayaḥ | / jīvanīya-śṛte kṣīra-sarpiṣī pāna-nasyayoḥ ||
kartavyaṃ rakta-je 'py etat pratyākhyāya ca śaṅkhake | / śleṣmābhitāpe jīrṇājya-snehitaiḥ kaṭukair vamet ||
sveda-pralepa-nasyādyā rūkṣa-tīkṣṇoṣṇa-bheṣajaiḥ | / śasyante copavāso 'tra nicaye miśram ācaret ||
kṛmi-je śoṇitaṃ nasyaṃ tena mūrchanti jantavaḥ | / mattāḥ śoṇita-gandhena niryānti ghrāṇa-vaktrayoḥ ||
su-tīkṣṇa-nasya-dhūmābhyāṃ kuryān nirharaṇaṃ tataḥ | / viḍaṅga-svarjikā-dantī-hiṅgu-go-mūtra-sādhitam ||
kaṭu-nimbeṅgudī-pīlu-tailaṃ nasyaṃ pṛthak pṛthak | / ajā-mūtra-drutaṃ nasyaṃ kṛmijit kṛmi-jit param ||
pūti-matsya-yutaiḥ kuryād dhūmaṃ nāvana-bheṣajaiḥ | / kṛmibhiḥ pīta-rakta-tvād raktam atra na nirhared ||
vātābhitāpa-vihitaḥ kampe dāhād vinā kramaḥ | / nave janmottaraṃ jāte yojayed upa-śīrṣake ||
vāta-vyādhi-kriyāṃ pakve karma vidradhi-coditam | / āma-pakve yathā-yogyaṃ vidradhi-piṭikārbude ||
arūṃṣikā jalaukobhir hṛtāsrā nimba-vāriṇā | / siktā prabhūta-lavaṇair limped aśva-śakṛd-rasaiḥ ||
paṭola-nimba-pattrair vā sa-haridraiḥ su-kalkitaiḥ | / go-mūtra-jīrṇa-piṇyāka-kṛkavāku-malair api ||
kapāla-bhṛṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vā cūrṇitaṃ taila-saṃyutam | / rūṃṣikālepanaṃ kaṇḍū-kleda-dāhārti-nāśanam ||
mālatī-citrakāśvaghna-naktamāla-prasādhitam | / cācārūṃṣikayos tailam abhyaṅgaḥ kṣura-ghṛṣṭayoḥ ||
a-śāntau śirasaḥ śuddhyai yateta vamanādibhiḥ | / vidhyet sirāṃ dāruṇake lālāṭyāṃ śīlayen mṛjām ||
nāvanaṃ mūrdha-vastiṃ ca lepayec ca sa-mākṣikaiḥ | / priyāla-bīja-madhuka-kuṣṭha-māṣaiḥ sa-sarṣapaiḥ ||
lākṣā-śamyāka-pattraiḍagaja-dhātrī-phalais tathā | / koradūṣa-tṛṇa-kṣāra-vāri-prakṣālanaṃ hitam ||
indra-lupte yathāsannaṃ sirāṃ viddhvā pralepayet | / pracchāya gāḍhaṃ kāsīsa-manohvā-tutthakoṣaṇaiḥ ||
vanyāmaratarubhyāṃ vā guñjā-mūla-phalais tathā | / tathā lāṅgalikā-mūlaiḥ karavīra-rasena vā ||
sa-kṣaudra-kṣudra-vārtāka-sva-rasena rasena vā | / dhattūrakasya pattrāṇāṃ bhallātaka-rasena vā ||
atha-vā mākṣika-havis-tila-puṣpa-trikaṇṭakaiḥ | / tailāktā hasti-dantasya maṣī cācauṣadhaṃ param ||
śukla-romodgame tad-van maṣī meṣa-viṣāṇa-jā | / varjayed vāriṇā sekaṃ yāvad roma-samudbhavaḥ ||
khalatau palite valyāṃ harid-romni ca śodhitam | / nasya-vaktra-śiro-'bhyaṅga-pradehaiḥ samupācaret ||
siddhaṃ tailaṃ bṛhaty-ādyair jīvanīyaiś ca nāvanam | / māsaṃ vā nimba-jaṃ tailaṃ kṣīra-bhuṅ nāvayed yatiḥ ||
nīlī-śirīṣa-koraṇṭa-bhṛṅga-sva-rasa-bhāvitam | / śelv-akṣa-tila-rāmāṇāṃ bījaṃ kākāṇḍakī-samam ||
piṣṭvāja-payasā lohāl liptād arkāṃśu-tāpitāt | / tailaṃ srutaṃ kṣīra-bhujo nāvanāt palitānta-kṛt ||
kṣīrāt sāhacarād bhṛṅgarajasaḥ saurasād rasāt | / prasthais tailasya kuḍavaḥ siddho yaṣṭī-palānvitaḥ ||
nasyaṃ śailāsane bhāṇḍe śṛṅge meṣasya vā sthitaḥ | / kṣīreṇa ślakṣṇa-piṣṭau vā dugdhikā-karavīrakau ||
utpāṭya palitaṃ deyāv āśaye palitāpahau | / kṣīraṃ priyālaṃ yaṣṭy-āhvaṃ jīvanīyo gaṇas tilāḥ ||
kṛṣṇāḥ pralepo vaktrasya harid-roma-valī-hitaḥ | / tilāḥ sāmalakāḥ padma-kiñjalko madhukaṃ madhu ||
bṛṃhayed rañjayec caitat keśān mūrdha-pralepanāt | / māṃsī kuṣṭhaṃ tilāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ śārivā nīlam utpalam ||
kṣaudraṃ ca kṣīra-piṣṭāni keśa-saṃvardhanam param | / ayo-rajo bhṛṅgarajas tri-phalā kṛṣṇa-mṛttikā ||
sthitam ikṣu-rase māsaṃ sa-mūlaṃ palitaṃ rajet | / māṣa-kodrava-dhānyāmlair yavāgūṃs tri-dinoṣitā ||
loha-śuklotkaṭā piṣṭā balākām api rañjayet | / prapauṇḍarīka-madhuka-pippalī-candanotpalaiḥ ||
siddhaṃ dhātrī-rase tailaṃ nasyenābhyañjanena ca | / sarvān mūrdha-gadān hanti palitāni ca śīlitam ||
varī-jīvanti-niryāsa-payobhir yamakaṃ pacet | / jīvanīyaiś ca tan nasyaṃ sarva-jatrūrdhva-roga-jit ||
mayūraṃ pakṣa-pittāntra-pāda-viṭ-tuṇḍa-varjitam | / daśa-mūla-balā-rāsnā-madhukais tri-palair yutam ||
jale paktvā ghṛta-prasthaṃ tasmin kṣīra-samaṃ pacet | / kalkitair madhura-dravyaiḥ sarva-jatrūrdhva-roga-jit ||
tad abhyāsī-kṛtaṃ pāna-vasty-abhyañjana-nāvanaiḥ | / etenaiva kaṣāyeṇa ghṛta-prasthaṃ vipācayet ||
catur-guṇena payasā kalkair ebhiś ca kārṣikaiḥ | / jīvantī-tri-phalā-medā-mṛdvīkarddhi-parūṣakaiḥ ||
samaṅgā-cavikā-bhārgī-kāśmarī-karkaṭāhvayaiḥ | / ātmaguptā-mahāmedā-tāla-kharjūra-mastakaiḥ ||
mṛṇāla-bisa-kharjūra-yaṣṭīmadhuka-jīvakaiḥ | / śatāvarī-vidārīkṣu-bṛhatī-śārivā-yugaiḥ ||
mūrvā-śvadaṃṣṭrarṣabhaka-śṛṅgāṭaka-kaserukaiḥ | / rāsnā-sthirā-tāmalakī-sūkṣmailā-śaṭhi-pauṣkaraiḥ ||
punarnavā-tavakṣīrī-kākolī-dhanvayāsakaiḥ | / madhūkākṣoṭa-vātāma-muñjātābhiṣukair api ||
mahā-māyūram ity etan māyūrād adhikaṃ guṇaiḥ | / dhātv-indriya-svara-bhraṃśa-śvāsa-kāsārditāpaham ||
yony-asṛk-śukra-doṣeṣu śastaṃ vandhyā-suta-pradam | / ākhubhiḥ kukkuṭair haṃsaiḥ śaśaiś ceti prakalpayet ||
jatrūrdhva-jānāṃ vyādhīnām eka-triṃśac-chata-dvayam | / paras-param a-saṅkīrṇaṃ vistareṇa prakāśitam ||
ūrdhva-mūlam adhaḥ-śākham ṛṣayaḥ puruṣaṃ viduḥ | / mūla-prahāriṇas tasmād rogāñ chīghra-taraṃ jayet ||
sarvendriyāṇi yenāsmin prāṇā yena ca saṃśritāḥ | / tena tasyottamāṅgasya rakṣāyām ādṛto bhavet ||
vraṇo dvi-dhā nijāgantu-duṣṭa-śuddha-vibhedataḥ | / nijo doṣaiḥ śarīrotthair āgantur bāhya-hetu-jaḥ ||
doṣair adhiṣṭhito duṣṭaḥ śuddhas tair an-adhiṣṭhitaḥ | / saṃvṛta-tvaṃ vivṛta-tā kāṭhinyaṃ mṛdu-tāti vā ||
aty-utsannāvasanna-tvam aty-auṣṇyam ati-śīta-tā | / rakta-tvaṃ pāṇḍu-tā kārṣṇyaṃ pūti-pūya-parisrutiḥ ||
pūti-māṃsa-sirā-snāyu-cchanna-totsaṅgi-tāti-ruk | / saṃrambha-dāha-śvayathu-kaṇḍv-ādibhir upadrutaḥ ||
dīrgha-kālānubandhaś ca vidyād duṣṭa-vraṇākṛtim | / sa pañca-daśa-dhā doṣaiḥ sa-raktais tatra mārutāt ||
śyāvaḥ kṛṣṇo 'ruṇo bhasma-kapotāsthi-nibho 'pi vā | / mastu-māṃsa-pulākāmbu-tulya-tanv-alpa-saṃsrutiḥ ||
nir-māṃsas toda-bhedāḍhyo rūkṣaś caṭacaṭāyate | / pittena kṣipra-jaḥ pīto nīlaḥ kapila-piṅgalaḥ ||
mūtra-kiṃśuka-bhasmāmbu-tailābhoṣṇa-bahu-srutiḥ | / kṣārokṣita-kṣata-sama-vyatho rāgoṣma-pāka-vān ||
kaphena pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍū-mān bahu-śveta-ghana-srutiḥ | / sthūlauṣṭhaḥ kaṭhinaḥ snāyu-sirā-jāla-tato 'lpa-ruk ||
pravāla-rakto raktena sa-raktaṃ pūyam udgiret | / vāji-sthāna-samo gandhe yukto liṅgaiś ca paittikaiḥ ||
dvābhyāṃ tribhiś ca sarvaiś ca vidyāl lakṣaṇa-saṅkarāt | / jihvā-prabho mṛduḥ ślakṣṇaḥ śyāvauṣṭha-piṭikaḥ samaḥ ||
kiñ-cid-unnata-madhyo vā vraṇaḥ śuddho 'n-upadravaḥ | / tvag-āmiṣa-sirā-snāyu-sandhy-asthīni vraṇāśayāḥ ||
koṣṭho marma ca tāny aṣṭau duḥ-sādhyāny uttarottaram | / su-sādhyaḥ sat-tva-māṃsāgni-vayo-bala-vati vraṇaḥ ||
vṛtto dīrghas tri-puṭakaś catur-aśrākṛtiś ca yaḥ | / tathā sphik-pāyu-meḍhrauṣṭha-pṛṣṭhāntar-vaktra-gaṇḍa-gaḥ ||
kṛcchra-sādhyo 'kṣi-daśana-nāsikāpāṅga-nābhiṣu | / sevanī-jaṭhara-śrotra-pārśva-kakṣā-staneṣu ca ||
phena-pūyānila-vahaḥ śalya-vān ūrdhva-nirvamī | / bhagandaro 'ntar-vadanas tathā kaṭy-asthi-saṃśritaḥ ||
kuṣṭhināṃ viṣa-juṣṭānāṃ śoṣiṇāṃ madhu-mehināṃ | / vraṇāḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhyanti yeṣāṃ ca syur vraṇe vraṇāḥ ||
naiva sidhyanti vīsarpa-jvarātīsāra-kāsinām | / pipāsūnām a-nidrāṇāṃ śvāsinām a-vipākinām ||
bhinne śiraḥ-kapāle vā mastuluṅgasya darśane | / snāyu-kledāt sirā-chedād gāmbhīryāt kṛmi-bhakṣaṇāt ||
asthi-bhedāt sa-śalya-tvāt sa-viṣa-tvād a-tarkitāt | / mithyā-bandhād ati-snehād raukṣyād romādi-ghaṭṭanāt ||
kṣobhād a-śuddha-koṣṭha-tvāt sauhityād ati-karśanāt | / madya-pānād divā-svapnād vyavāyād rātri-jāgarāt ||
vraṇo mithyopacārāc ca naiva sādhyo 'pi sidhyati | / kapota-varṇa-pratimā yasyāntaḥ kleda-varjitāḥ ||
sthirāś cipiṭikā-vanto rohatīti tam ādiśet | / athātra śophāvasthāyāṃ yathāsannaṃ viśodhanam ||
yojyaṃ śopho hi śuddhānāṃ vraṇaś cāśu praśāmyati | / kuryāc chītopacāraṃ ca śophāvasthasya santatam ||
doṣāgnir agni-vat tena prayāti sahasā śamam | / śophe vraṇe ca kaṭhine vi-varṇe vedanānvite ||
viṣa-yukte viśeṣeṇa jala-jādyair hared asṛk | / duṣṭāsre 'pagate sadyaḥ śopha-rāga-rujāṃ śamaḥ ||
hṛte hṛte ca rudhire su-śītaiḥ sparśa-vīryayoḥ | / su-ślakṣṇais tad-ahaḥ-piṣṭaiḥ kṣīrekṣu-sva-rasa-dravaiḥ ||
śata-dhauta-ghṛtopetair muhur anyair a-śoṣibhiḥ | / pratilomaṃ hito lepaḥ sekābhyaṅgāś ca tat-kṛtāḥ ||
nyagrodhodumbarāśvattha-plakṣa-vetasa-valkalaiḥ | / pradeho bhūri-sarpirbhiḥ śopha-nirvāpaṇaḥ param ||
vātolbaṇānāṃ stabdhānāṃ kaṭhinānāṃ mahā-rujām | / srutāsṛjāṃ ca śophānāṃ vraṇānām api cedṛśām ||
ānūpa-vesavārādyaiḥ svedaḥ somās tilāḥ punaḥ | / bhṛṣṭā nirvāpitāḥ kṣīre tat-piṣṭā dāha-rug-harāḥ ||
sthirān manda-rujaḥ śophān snehair vāta-kaphāpahaiḥ | / abhyajya svedayitvā ca veṇu-nāḍyā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||
vimlāpanārthaṃ mṛdnīyāt talenāṅguṣṭhakena vā | / yava-godhūma-mudgaiś ca siddha-piṣṭaiḥ pralepayet ||
vilīyate sa cen naivaṃ tatas tam upanāhayet | / a-vidagdhas tathā śāntiṃ vidagdhaḥ pākam aśnute ||
sa-kola-tila-vallomā dadhy-amlā saktu-piṇḍikā | / sa-kiṇva-kuṣṭha-lavaṇā koṣṇā śastopanāhane ||
su-pakve piṇḍite śophe pīḍanair upapīḍite | / dāraṇaṃ dāraṇārhasya su-kumārasya ceṣyate ||
guggulv-atasi-go-danta-svarṇakṣīrī-kapota-viṭ | / kṣārauṣadhāni kṣārāś ca pakva-śopha-vidāraṇam ||
pūya-garbhān aṇu-dvārān sotsaṅgān marma-gān api | / niḥ-snehaiḥ pīḍana-dravyaiḥ samantāt pratipīḍayet ||
śuṣyantaṃ samupekṣeta pralepaṃ pīḍanaṃ prati | / na mukhe cainam ālimpet tathā doṣaḥ prasicyate ||
kalāya-yava-godhūma-māṣa-mudga-hareṇavaḥ | / dravyāṇāṃ picchilānāṃ ca tvaṅ-mūlāni prapīḍanam ||
saptasu kṣālanādyeṣu surasāragvadhādikau | / bhṛśaṃ duṣṭe vraṇe yojyau meha-kuṣṭha-vraṇeṣu ca ||
atha-vā kṣālanaṃ kvāthaḥ paṭolī-nimba-pattra-jaḥ | / a-viśuddhe viśuddhe tu nyagrodhādi-tvag-udbhavaḥ ||
paṭolī-tila-yaṣṭy-āhva-trivṛd-dantī-niśā-dvayam | / nimba-pattrāṇi cālepaḥ sa-paṭur vraṇa-śodhanaḥ ||
vraṇān viśodhayed vartyā sūkṣmāsyān sandhi-marma-gān | / kṛtayā trivṛtā-dantī-lāṅgalī-madhu-saindhavaiḥ ||
vātābhibhūtān sāsrāvān dhūpayed ugra-vedanān | / yavājya-bhūrja-madana-śrīveṣṭaka-surāhvayaiḥ ||
nirvāpayed bhṛśaṃ śītaiḥ pitta-rakta-viṣolbaṇān | / śuṣkālpa-māṃse gambhīre vraṇa utsādanaṃ hitam ||
nyagrodha-padmakādibhyām aśvagandhā-balā-tilaiḥ | / adyān māṃsāda-māṃsāni vidhinopahitāni ca ||
māṃsaṃ māṃsāda-māṃsena vardhate śuddha-cetasaḥ | / utsanna-mṛdu-māṃsānāṃ vraṇānām avasādanam ||
jātī-mukula-kāsīsa-manohvāla-purāgnikaiḥ | / utsanna-māṃsān kaṭhinān kaṇḍū-yuktāṃś cirotthitān ||
vraṇān su-duḥkha-śodhyāṃś ca śodhayet kṣāra-karmaṇā | / sravanto 'śmarī-jā mūtraṃ ye cānye rakta-vāhinaḥ ||
chinnāś ca sandhayo yeṣāṃ yathoktair ye ca śodhanaiḥ | / śodhyamānā na śudhyanti śodhyāḥ syus te 'gni-karmaṇā ||
śuddhānāṃ ropaṇaṃ yojyam utsādāya yad īritam | / aśvagandhā ruhā lodhraṃ kaṭphalaṃ madhuyaṣṭikā ||
samaṅgā dhātakī-puṣpaṃ paramaṃ vraṇa-ropaṇam | / apeta-pūti-māṃsānāṃ māṃsa-sthānām a-rohatām ||
kalkaṃ saṃrohaṇaṃ kuryāt tilānāṃ madhukānvitam | / snigdhoṣṇa-tikta-madhura-kaṣāya-tvaiḥ sa sarva-jit ||
sa kṣaudra-nimba-pattrābhyāṃ yuktaḥ saṃśodhanaṃ param | / pūrvābhyāṃ sarpiṣā cāsau yuktaḥ syād āśu ropaṇaḥ ||
tila-vad yava-kalkaṃ tu ke-cid icchanti tad-vidaḥ | / sāsra-pitta-viṣāgantu-gambhīrān soṣmaṇo vraṇān ||
kṣīra-ropaṇa-bhaiṣajya-śṛtenājyena ropayet | / ropaṇauṣadha-siddhena tailena kapha-vāta-jān ||
kācchī-lodhrābhayā-sarja-sindūrāñjana-tutthakam | / cūrṇitaṃ taila-madanair yuktaṃ ropaṇam uttamam ||
samānāṃ sthira-māṃsānāṃ tvak-sthānāṃ cūrṇa iṣyate | / kakubhodumbarāśvattha-jambū-kaṭphala-lodhra-jaiḥ ||
tvak-cūrṇaiś cūrṇitā vraṇāḥ tvak-cūrṇaiś cūrṇitā vraṇāḥ | / lākṣā-manohvā-mañjiṣṭhā-haritāla-niśā-dvayaiḥ ||
pralepaḥ sa-ghṛta-kṣaudras tvag-viśuddhi-karaḥ param | / kālīyaka-latāmrāsthi-hema-kālā-rasottamaiḥ ||
lepaḥ sa-go-maya-rasaḥ sa-varṇa-karaṇaḥ param | / dagdho vāraṇa-danto 'ntar-dhūmaṃ tailaṃ rasāñjanam ||
roma-sañjanano lepas tad-vat taila-pariplutā | / catuṣ-pān-nakha-romāsthi-tvak-śṛṅga-khura-jā maṣī ||
vraṇinaḥ śastra-karmoktaṃ pathyā-pathyānnam ādiśet | / dve pañca-mūle vargaś ca vāta-ghno vātike hitaḥ ||
nyagrodha-padmakādyau tu tad-vat pitta-pradūṣite | / āragvadhādiḥ śleṣma-ghnaḥ kaphe miśrās tu miśra-je ||
ebhiḥ prakṣālanaṃ lepo ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ rasa-kriyā | / cūrṇo vartiś ca saṃyojya vraṇe sapta yathā-yatham ||

jātī-nimba-paṭola-pattra-kaṭukā-dārvī-niśā-śārivā- || 67a || / -mañjiṣṭhābhaya-siktha-tuttha-madhukair naktāhva-bījānvitaiḥ || 67b || / sarpiḥ sādhyam anena sūkṣma-vadanā marmāśritāḥ kledino || 67c || / gambhīrāḥ sa-rujo vraṇāḥ sa-gatayaḥ śudhyanti rohanti ca || 67d ||
sadyo-vraṇā ye sahasā sambhavanty abhighātataḥ | / an-antair api tair aṅgam ucyate juṣṭam aṣṭa-dhā ||
ghṛṣṭāvakṛtta-vicchinna-pravilambita-pātitam | / viddhaṃ bhinnaṃ vidalitaṃ tatra ghṛṣṭaṃ lasīkayā ||
rakta-leśena vā yuktaṃ sa-ploṣaṃ chedanāt sravet | / avagāḍhaṃ tataḥ kṛttaṃ vicchinnaṃ syāt tato 'pi ca ||
pravilambi sa-śeṣe 'sthni patitaṃ pātitaṃ tanoḥ | / sūkṣmāsya-śalya-viddhaṃ tu viddhaṃ koṣṭha-vivarjitam ||
bhinnam anyad vidalitaṃ majja-rakta-pariplutam | / prahāra-pīḍanotpeṣāt sahāsthnā pṛthu-tāṃ gatam ||
sadyaḥ sadyo-vraṇaṃ siñced atha yaṣṭy-āhva-sarpiṣā | / tīvra-vyathaṃ kavoṣṇena balā-tailena vā punaḥ ||
kṣatoṣmaṇo nigrahārthaṃ tat-kālaṃ visṛtasya ca | / kaṣāya-śīta-madhura-snigdhā lepādayo hitāḥ ||
sadyo-vraṇeṣv āyateṣu sandhānārthaṃ viśeṣataḥ | / madhu-sarpiś ca yuñjīta pitta-ghnīś ca himāḥ kriyāḥ ||
sa-saṃrambheṣu kartavyam ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca śodhanam | / upavāso hitaṃ bhuktaṃ pratataṃ rakta-mokṣaṇam ||
ghṛṣṭe vidalite caiṣa su-tarām iṣyate vidhiḥ | / tayor hy alpaṃ sravaty asraṃ pākas tenāśu jāyate ||
aty-artham asraṃ sravati prāya-śo 'nya-tra vikṣate | / tato rakta-kṣayād vāyau kupite 'ti-rujā-kare ||
sneha-pāna-parīṣeka-sveda-lepopanāhanam | / sneha-vastiṃ ca kurvīta vāta-ghnauṣadha-sādhitam ||
iti sāptāhikaḥ proktaḥ sadyo-vraṇa-hito vidhiḥ | / saptāhād gata-vege tu pūrvoktaṃ vidhim ācaret ||
prāyaḥ sāmānya-karmedaṃ vakṣyate tu pṛthak pṛthak | / ghṛṣṭe rujaṃ nigṛhyāśu vraṇe cūrṇāni yojayet ||
kalkādīny avakṛtte tu vicchinna-pravilambinoḥ | / sīvanaṃ vidhinoktena bandhanaṃ cānu pīḍanam ||
a-sādhyaṃ sphuṭitaṃ netram a-dīrṇaṃ lambate tu yat | / sanniveśya yathā-sthānam a-vyāviddha-siraṃ bhiṣak ||
pīḍayet pāṇinā padma-palāśāntaritena tat | / tato 'sya secane nasye tarpaṇe ca hitaṃ haviḥ ||
vipakvam ājaṃ yaṣṭy-āhva-jīvakarṣabhakotpalaiḥ | / sa-payaskaiḥ paraṃ tad dhi sarva-netrābhighāta-jit ||
gala-pīḍāvasanne 'kṣṇi vamanotkāsana-kṣavāḥ | / prāṇāyāmo 'tha-vā kāryaḥ kriyā ca kṣata-netra-vat ||
karṇe sthānāc cyute syūte śrotas tailena pūrayet | / kṛkāṭikāyāṃ chinnāyāṃ nirgacchaty api mārute ||
samaṃ niveśya badhnīyāt syūtvā śīghraṃ nir-antaram | / ājena sarpiṣā cātra pariṣekaḥ praśasyate ||
uttāno 'nnāni bhuñjīta śayīta ca su-yantritaḥ | / ghātaṃ śākhāsu tiryak-sthaṃ gātre samyaṅ-niveśite ||
syūtvā vellita-bandhena badhnīyād ghana-vāsasā | / carmaṇā goṣ-phaṇā-bandhaḥ kāryaś cā-saṅgate vraṇe ||
pādau vilambi-muṣkasya prokṣya netre ca vāriṇā | / praveśya vṛṣaṇau sīvyet sevanyā tunna-sañjñayā ||
kāryaś ca goṣ-phaṇā-bandhaḥ kaṭyām āveśya paṭṭakam | / sneha-sekaṃ na kurvīta tatra klidyati hi vraṇaḥ ||
kālānusāry-agurv-elā-jātī-candana-parpaṭaiḥ | / śilā-dārvy-amṛtā-tutthaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca ropaṇam ||
chinnāṃ niḥśeṣataḥ śākhāṃ dagdhvā tailena yuktitaḥ | / badhnīyāt kośa-bandhena tato vraṇa-vad ācaret ||
kāryā śalyāhṛte viddhe bhaṅgād vidalite kriyā | / śiraso 'pahṛte śalye vāla-vartiṃ praveśayet ||
mastuluṅga-sruteḥ kruddho hanyād enaṃ calo 'nya-thā | / vraṇe rohati caikaikaṃ śanair apanayet kacam ||
mastuluṅga-srutau khāden mastiṣkān anya-jīva-jān | / śalye hṛte 'ṅgād anyasmāt sneha-vartiṃ nidhāpayet ||
dūrāvagāḍhāḥ sūkṣmāsyā ye vraṇāḥ sruta-śoṇitāḥ | / secayec cakra-tailena sūkṣma-netrārpitena tān ||
bhinne koṣṭhe 'sṛjā pūrṇe mūrchā-hṛt-pārśva-vedanāḥ | / jvaro dāhas tṛḍ ādhmānaṃ bhaktasyān-abhinandanam ||
saṅgo viṇ-mūtra-marutāṃ śvāsaḥ svedo 'kṣi-rakta-tā | / loha-gandhi-tvam āsyasya syād gātre ca vi-gandha-tā ||
āmāśaya-sthe rudhire rudhiraṃ chardayaty api | / ādhmānenāti-mātreṇa śūlena ca viśasyate ||
pakvāśaya-sthe rudhire sa-śūlaṃ gauravaṃ bhavet | / nābher adhas-tāc chīta-tvaṃ khebhyo raktasya cāgamaḥ ||
a-bhinno 'py āśayaḥ sūkṣmaiḥ srotobhir abhipūryate | / asṛjā syandamānena pārśve mūtreṇa vasti-vat ||
tatrāntar-lohitaṃ śīta-pādocchvāsa-karānanam | / raktākṣaṃ pāṇdu-vadanam ānaddhaṃ ca vivarjayet ||
āmāśaya-sthe vamanaṃ hitaṃ pakvāśayāśrite | / virecanaṃ nirūhaṃ ca niḥ-snehoṣṇair viśodhanaiḥ ||
yava-kola-kulatthānāṃ rasaiḥ sneha-vivarjitaiḥ | / bhuñjītānnaṃ yavāgūṃ vā pibet saindhava-saṃyutām ||
ati-niḥsruta-raktas tu bhinna-koṣṭhaḥ pibed asṛk | / kliṣṭa-cchinnāntra-bhedena koṣṭha-bhedo dvi-dhā smṛtaḥ ||
mūrchādayo 'lpāḥ prathame dvitīye tv ati-bādhakāḥ | / kliṣṭāntraḥ saṃśayī dehī chinnāntro naiva jīvati ||
yathā-svaṃ mārgam āpannā yasya viṇ-mūtra-mārutāḥ | / vy-upadravaḥ sa bhinne 'pi koṣṭhe jīvaty a-saṃśayam ||
a-bhinnam antraṃ niṣkrāntaṃ praveśyaṃ na tv ato 'nya-thā | / utpaṅgila-śiro-grastaṃ tad apy eke vadanti tu ||
prakṣālya payasā digdhaṃ tṛṇa-śoṇita-pāṃsubhiḥ | / praveśayet k pta-nakho ghṛtenāktaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||
kṣīreṇārdrī-kṛtaṃ śuṣkaṃ bhūri-sarpiḥ-pariplutam | / aṅgulyā pramṛśet kaṇṭhaṃ jalenodvejayed api ||
tathāntrāṇi viśanty antas tat-kālaṃ pīḍayanti ca | / vraṇa-saukṣmyād bahu-tvād vā koṣṭham antram an-āviśat ||
tat-pramāṇena jaṭharaṃ pāṭayitvā praveśayet | / yathā-sthānaṃ sthite samyak antre sīvyed anu vraṇam ||
sthānād apetam ādatte jīvitaṃ kupitaṃ ca tat | / veṣṭayitvānu paṭṭena ghṛtena pariṣecayet ||
pāyayeta tataḥ koṣṇaṃ citrā-taila-yutaṃ payaḥ | / mṛdu-kriyārthaṃ śakṛto vāyoś cādhaḥ-pravṛttaye ||
anuvarteta varṣaṃ ca yathoktaṃ vraṇa-yantraṇām | / udarān medaso vartiṃ nirgatāṃ bhasmanā mṛdā ||
avakīrya kaṣāyair vā ślakṣṇair mūlais tataḥ samam | / dṛḍhaṃ baddhvā ca sūtreṇa vardhayet kuśalo bhiṣak ||
tīkṣṇenāgni-prataptena śastreṇa sakṛd eva tu | / syād anya-thā rug āṭopo mṛtyur vā chidyamānayā ||
sa-kṣaudre ca vraṇe baddhe su-jīrṇe 'nne ghṛtaṃ pibet | / kṣīraṃ vā śarkarā-citrā-lākṣā-gokṣurakaiḥ śṛtam ||
rug-dāha-jit sa-yaṣṭy-āhvaiḥ paraṃ pūrvodito vidhiḥ | / medo-granthy-uditaṃ tatra tailam abhyañjane hitam ||
tālīśaṃ padmakaṃ māṃsī hareṇv-aguru-candanam | / haridre padma-bījāni sośīraṃ madhukaṃ ca taiḥ ||
pakvaṃ sadyo-vraṇeṣūktaṃ tailaṃ ropaṇam uttamam | / gūḍha-prahārābhihate patite viṣamoccakaiḥ ||
kāryaṃ vātāsra-jit tṛpti-mardanābhyañjanādikam | / viśliṣṭa-dehaṃ mathitaṃ kṣīṇaṃ marmāhataṃ hatam ||
pāta-ghātādibhir dve-dhā bhaṅgo 'sthnāṃ sandhy-a-sandhitaḥ | / prasāraṇākuñcanayor a-śaktiḥ sandhi-mukta-tā ||
itarasmin bhṛśaṃ śophaḥ sarvāvasthāsv ati-vyathā | / a-śaktiś ceṣṭite 'lpe 'pi pīḍyamāne sa-śabda-tā ||
samāsād iti bhaṅgasya lakṣaṇaṃ bahu-dhā tu tat | / bhidyate bhaṅga-bhedena tasya sarvasya sādhanam ||
yathā syād upayogāya tathā tad upadekṣyate | / prājyāṇu-dāri yat tv asthi sparśe śabdaṃ karoti yat ||
yatrāsthi-leśaḥ praviśen madhyam asthno vidāritaḥ | / bhagnaṃ yac cābhighātena kiñ-cid evāvaśeṣitam ||
unnamyamānaṃ kṣata-vad yac ca majjani majjati | / tad duḥ-sādhyaṃ kṛśā-śakta-vātalālpāśinām api ||
bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ yat kaṭyāṃ sandhi-muktaṃ cyutaṃ ca yat | / jaghanaṃ prati piṣṭaṃ ca bhagnaṃ yat tad vivarjayet ||
a-saṃśliṣṭa-kapālaṃ ca lalāṭaṃ cūrṇitaṃ tathā | / yac ca bhagnaṃ bhavec chaṅkha-śiraḥ-pṛṣṭha-stanāntare ||
samyag-yamitam apy asthi dur-nyāsād dur-nibandhanāt | / saṅkṣobhād api yad gacched vi-kriyāṃ tad vivarjayet ||
ādito yac ca dur-jātam asthi sandhir athāpi vā | / taruṇāsthīni bhujyante bhajyante nalakāni tu ||
kapālāni vibhidyante sphuṭanty anyāni bhūyasā | / athāvanatam unnamyam unnataṃ cāvapīḍayet ||
āñched atikṣiptam adho-gataṃ copari vartayet | / āñchanotpīḍanonnāma-carma-saṅkṣepa-bandhanaiḥ ||
sandhīñ charīra-gān sarvāṃś calān apy a-calān api | / ity etaiḥ sthāpanopāyaiḥ samyak saṃsthāpya niś-calam ||
paṭṭaiḥ prabhūta-sarpirbhiḥ veṣṭayitvā sukhais tataḥ | / kadambodumbarāśvattha-sarjārjuna-palāśa-jaiḥ ||
vaṃśodbhavair vā pṛthubhis tanubhiḥ su-niveśitaiḥ | / su-ślakṣṇaiḥ sa-pratistambhair valkalaiḥ śakalair api ||
kuśāhvayaiḥ samaṃ bandhaṃ paṭṭasyopari yojayet | / śithilena hi bandhena sandhi-sthairyaṃ na jāyate ||
gāḍhenāti rujā-dāha-pāka-śvayathu-sambhavaḥ | / try-ahāt try-ahād ṛtau gharme saptāhān mokṣayed dhime ||
sādhāraṇe tu pañcāhād bhaṅga-doṣa-vaśena vā | / nyagrodhādi-kaṣāyeṇa tataḥ śītena secayet ||
taṃ pañca-mūla-pakvena payasā tu sa-vedanam | / sukhoṣṇaṃ vāvacāryaṃ syāc cakra-tailaṃ vijānatā ||
vibhajya deśaṃ kālaṃ ca vāta-ghnauṣadha-saṃyutam | / pratataṃ seka-lepāṃś ca vidadhyād bhṛśa-śītalān ||
gṛṣṭi-kṣīraṃ sa-sarpiṣkaṃ madhurauṣadha-sādhitam | / prātaḥ prātaḥ pibed bhagnaḥ śītalaṃ lākṣayā yutam ||
sa-vraṇasya tu bhagnasya vraṇo madhu-ghṛtottaraiḥ | / kaṣāyaiḥ pratisāryo 'tha śeṣo bhaṅgoditaḥ kramaḥ ||
lambāni vraṇa-māṃsāni pralipya madhu-sarpiṣā | / sandadhīta vraṇān vaidyo bandhanaiś copapādayet ||
tān samān su-sthitāñ jñātvā phalinī-lodhra-kaṭphalaiḥ | / samaṅgā-dhātakī-yuktaiś cūrṇitair avacūrṇayet ||
dhātakī-lodhra-cūrṇair vā rohanty āśu tathā vraṇāḥ | / iti bhaṅga upakrāntaḥ sthira-dhātor ṛtau hime ||
māṃsalasyālpa-doṣasya su-sādhyo dāruṇo 'nya-thā | / pūrva-madhyānta-vayasām eka-dvi-tri-guṇaiḥ kramāt ||
māsaiḥ sthairyaṃ bhavet sandher yathoktaṃ bhajatāṃ vidhim | / kaṭī-jaṅghoru-bhagnānāṃ kapāṭa-śayanaṃ hitam ||
yantraṇārthaṃ tathā kīlāḥ pañca kāryā nibandhanāḥ | / jaṅghorvoḥ pārśvayor dvau dvau tala ekaś ca kīlakaḥ ||
śroṇyāṃ vā pṛṣṭha-vaṃśe vā vakṣasy akṣakayos tathā | / vimokṣe bhagna-sandhīnāṃ vidhim evaṃ samācaret ||
sandhīṃś cira-vimuktāṃs tu snigdha-svinnān mṛdū-kṛtān | / uktair vidhānair buddhyā ca yathā-svaṃ sthānam ānayet ||
a-sandhi-bhagne rūḍhe tu viṣamolbaṇa-sādhite | / āpothya bhaṅgaṃ yamayet tato bhagna-vad ācaret ||
bhagnaṃ naiti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhiṣak | / pakva-māṃsa-sirā-snāyuḥ sandhiḥ śleṣaṃ na gacchati ||
vāta-vyādhi-vinirdiṣṭān snehān bhagnasya yojayet | / catuṣ-prayogān balyāṃś ca vasti-karma ca śīlayet ||
śāly-ājya-rasa-dugdhādyaiḥ pauṣṭikair a-vidāhibhiḥ | / mātrayopacared bhagnaṃ sandhi-saṃśleṣa-kāribhiḥ ||
glānir na śasyate tasya sandhi-viśleṣa-kṛd dhi sā || 35ab || / lavaṇaṃ kaṭukaṃ kṣāram amlaṃ maithunam ātapam || 35cd || / vyāyāmaṃ ca na seveta bhagno rūkṣaṃ ca bhojanam || 35ef ||
kṛṣṇāṃs tilān vi-rajaso dṛḍha-vastra-baddhān sapta kṣapā vahati vāriṇi vāsayet | / saṃśoṣayed anu-dinaṃ pravisārya caitān kṣīre tathaiva madhuka-kvathite ca toye ||
punar api pīta-payaskāṃs tān pūrva-vad eva śoṣitān bāḍham | / vigata-tuṣān a-rajaskān sañcūrṇya su-cūrṇitair yuñjyāt ||
nalada-vālaka-lohitayaṣṭikā-nakha-miśi-plava-kuṣṭha-balā-trayaiḥ | / aguru-kuṅkuma-candana-śārivā-sarala-sarja-rasāmaradārubhiḥ ||
padmakādi-gaṇopetais tila-piṣṭaṃ tataś ca tat | / samasta-gandha-bhaiṣajya-siddha-dugdhena pīḍayet ||
śaileya-rāsnāṃśumatī-kaseru-kālānusārī-nata-pattra-lodhraiḥ | / sa-kṣīraśuklaiḥ sa-payaḥ sa-dūrvais tailaṃ pacet tan naladādibhiś ca ||
gandha-tailam idam uttamam asthi-sthairya-kṛj jayati cāśu vikārān | / vāta-pitta-janitān ati-vīryān vyāpino 'pi vividhair upayogaiḥ ||
hasty-aśva-pṛṣṭha-gamana-kaṭhinotkaṭakāsanaiḥ | / arśo-nidānābhihitair aparaiś ca niṣevitaiḥ ||
an-iṣṭā-dṛṣṭa-pākena sadyo vā sādhu-garhaṇaiḥ | / prāyeṇa piṭikā-pūrvo yo 'ṅgule dvy-aṅgule 'pi vā ||
pāyor vraṇo 'ntar bāhyo vā duṣṭāsṛṅ-māṃsa-go bhavet | / vasti-mūtrāśayābhyāsa-gata-tvāt syandanātmakaḥ ||
bhagandaraḥ sa sarvāṃś ca dārayaty a-kriyā-vataḥ | / bhaga-vasti-gudāṃs teṣu dīryamāṇeṣu bhūribhiḥ ||
vāta-mūtra-śakṛc-chukraṃ khaiḥ sūkṣmair vamati kramāt | / doṣaiḥ pṛthag yutaiḥ sarvair āgantuḥ so 'ṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
a-pakvaṃ piṭikāṃ āhuḥ pāka-prāptaṃ bhagandaram | / gūḍha-mūlāṃ sa-saṃrambhāṃ rug-āḍhyāṃ rūḍha-kopinīm ||
bhagandara-karīṃ vidyāt piṭikāṃ na tv ato 'nya-thā | / tatra śyāvāruṇā toda-bheda-sphuraṇa-ruk-karī ||
piṭikā mārutāt pittād uṣṭra-grīvā-vad ucchritā | / rāgiṇī tanur ūṣmāḍhyā jvara-dhūmāyanānvitā ||
sthirā snigdhā mahā-mūlā pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍū-matī kaphāt | / śyāvā tāmrā sa-dāhoṣā ghora-rug vāta-pitta-jā ||
pāṇḍurā kiñ-cid-ā-śyāvā kṛcchra-pākā kaphānilāt | / pādāṅguṣṭha-samā sarvair doṣair nānā-vidha-vyathā ||
śūlā-rocaka-tṛḍ-dāha-jvara-cchardir-upadrutā | / vraṇa-tāṃ yānti tāḥ pakvāḥ pramādāt tatra vāta-jā ||
cīyate 'ṇu-mukhaiś chidraiḥ śata-ponaka-vat kramāt | / acchaṃ sravadbhir āsrāvam ajasraṃ phena-saṃyutam ||
śata-ponaka-sañjño 'yam uṣṭra-grīvas tu pitta-jaḥ | / bahu-picchā-parisrāvī parisrāvī kaphodbhavaḥ ||
vāta-pittāj parikṣepī parikṣipya gudaṃ gatiḥ | / jāyate paritas tatra prākāraṃ parikheva ca ||
ṛjur vāta-kaphād ṛjvyā gudo gatyātra dīryate | / kapha-pitte tu pūrvotthaṃ dur-nāmāśritya kupyataḥ ||
arśo-mūle tataḥ śophaḥ kaṇḍū-dāhādi-mān bhavet | / sa śīghraṃ pakva-bhinno 'sya kledayan mūlam arśasaḥ ||
sravaty ajasraṃ gatibhir ayam arśo-bhagandaraḥ | / sarva-jaḥ śambukāvartaḥ śambūkāvarta-sannibhaḥ ||
gatayo dārayanty asmin rug-vegair dāruṇair gudam | / asthi-leśo 'bhyavahṛto māṃsa-gṛddhyā yadā gudam ||
kṣiṇoti tiryaṅ nirgacchann un-mārgaṃ kṣatato gatiḥ | / syāt tataḥ pūya-dīrṇāyāṃ māṃsa-kothena tatra ca ||
jāyante kṛmayas tasya khādantaḥ parito gudam | / vidārayanti na cirād un-mārgī kṣata-jaś ca saḥ ||
teṣu rug-dāha-kaṇḍv-ādīn vidyād vraṇa-niṣedhataḥ | / ṣaṭ kṛcchra-sādhanās teṣāṃ nicaya-kṣata-jau tyajet ||
pravāhiṇīṃ valīṃ prāptaṃ sevanīṃ vā samāśritam | / athāsya piṭikām eva tathā yatnād upācaret ||
śuddhy-asṛk-sruti-sekādyair yathā pākaṃ na gacchati | / pāke punar upasnigdhaṃ sveditaṃ cāvagāhataḥ ||
