yantrayitvārśasam iva paśyet samyag bhagandaram | / arvācīnaṃ parācīnam antar-mukha-bahir-mukham ||
athāntar-mukham eṣitvā samyak śastreṇa pāṭayet | / bahir-mukhaṃ ca niḥśeṣaṃ tataḥ kṣāreṇa sādhayet ||
agninā vā bhiṣak sādhu kṣāreṇaivoṣṭra-kandharam | / nāḍīr ekāntarāḥ kṛtvā pāṭayec chata-ponakam ||
tāsu rūḍhāsu śeṣāś ca mṛtyur dīrṇe gude 'nya-thā | / parikṣepiṇi cāpy evaṃ nāḍy-uktaiḥ kṣāra-sūtrakaiḥ ||
arśo-bhagandare pūrvam arśāṃsi pratisādhayet | / tyaktvopacaryaḥ kṣata-jaḥ śalyaṃ śalya-vatas tataḥ ||
āharec ca tathā dadyāt kṛmi-ghnaṃ lepa-bhojanam | / piṇḍa-nāḍy-ādayaḥ svedāḥ su-snigdhā ruji pūjitāḥ ||
sarva-tra ca bahu-cchidre chedān ālocya yojayet | / go-tīrtha-sarvato-bhadra-dala-lāṅgala-lāṅgalān ||
pārśvaṃ gatena śastreṇa cchedo go-tīrthako mataḥ | / sarvataḥ sarvato-bhadraḥ pārśva-cchedo 'rdha-lāṅgalaḥ ||
pārśva-dvaye lāṅgalakaḥ samastāṃś cāgninā dahet | / āsrāva-mārgān niḥśeṣaṃ naivaṃ vikurute punaḥ ||
yateta koṣṭha-śuddhau ca bhiṣak tasyāntarāntarā | / lepo vraṇe biḍālāsthi tri-phalā-rasa-kalkitam ||
jyotiṣmatī-malayu-lāṅgali-śelu-pāṭhā-kumbhāgni-sarja-karavīra-vacā-sudhārkaiḥ | / abhyañjanāya vipaceta bhagandarāṇāṃ tailaṃ vadanti paramaṃ hitam etad eṣām ||
madhuka-lodhra-kaṇā-truṭi-reṇukā-dvi-rajanī-phalinī-paṭu-śārivāḥ | / kamala-kesara-padmaka-dhātakī-madana-sarja-rasāmaya-rodikāḥ ||
sa-bījapūra-cchadanair ebhis tailaṃ vipācitam | / bhagandarāpacī-kuṣṭha-madhu-meha-vraṇāpaham ||
madhu-taila-yutā viḍaṅga-sāra-tri-phalā-māgadhikā-kaṇāś ca līḍhāḥ | / kṛmi-kuṣṭha-bhagandara-prameha-kṣata-nāḍī-vraṇa-ropaṇā bhavanti ||
amṛtā-truṭi-vella-vatsakaṃ kali-pathyāmalakāni gugguluḥ | / krama-vṛddham idaṃ madhu-drutaṃ piṭikā-sthaulya-bhagandarāñ jayet ||
māgadhikāgni-kaliṅga-viḍaṅgair bilva-ghṛtaiḥ sa-varā-pala-ṣaṭkaiḥ | / guggulunā sadṛśena sametaiḥ kṣaudra-yutaiḥ sakalāmaya-nāśaḥ ||
guggulu-pañca-palaṃ palikāṃśā māgadhikā tri-phalā ca pṛthak syāt | / tvak-truṭi-karṣa-yutaṃ madhu-līḍhaṃ kuṣṭha-bhagandara-gulma-gati-ghnam ||
śṛṅgavera-rajo-yuktaṃ tad eva ca su-bhāvitam | / kvāthena daśa-mūlasya viśeṣād vāta-roga-jit ||
uttamā-khadira-sāra-jaṃ rajaḥ śīlayann asana-vāri-bhāvitam | / hanti tulya-mahiṣākṣa-mākṣikaṃ kuṣṭha-meha-piṭikā-bhagandarān ||
bhagandareṣv eṣa viśeṣa uktaḥ śeṣāṇi tu vyañjana-sādhanāni | / vraṇādhikārāt pariśīlanāc ca samyag viditvaupayikaṃ vidadhyāt ||
aśva-pṛṣṭha-gamanaṃ cala-rodhaṃ madya-maithunam a-jīrṇam a-sātmyam | / sāhasāni vividhāni ca rūḍhe vatsaraṃ parihared adhikaṃ vā ||
kapha-pradhānāḥ kurvanti medo-māṃsāsra-gā malāḥ | / vṛttonnataṃ yaṃ śvayathuṃ sa granthir grathanāt smṛtaḥ ||
doṣāsra-māṃsa-medo-'sthi-sirā-vraṇa-bhavā nava | / te tatra vātād āyāma-toda-bhedānvito 'sitaḥ ||
sthānāt sthānāntara-gatir a-kasmād dhāni-vṛddhi-mān | / mṛdur vastir ivānaddho vibhinno 'cchaṃ sravaty asṛk ||
pittāt sa-dāhaḥ pītābho rakto vā pacyate drutam | / bhinno 'sram uṣṇaṃ sravati śleṣmaṇā nī-rujo ghanaḥ ||
śītaḥ sa-varṇaḥ kaṇḍū-mān pakvaḥ pūyaṃ sraved ghanam | / doṣair duṣṭe 'sṛji granthir bhaven mūrchatsu jantuṣu ||
sirā-māṃsaṃ ca saṃśritya sa-svāpaḥ pitta-lakṣaṇaḥ | / māṃsalair dūṣitaṃ māṃsam āhārair granthim āvahet ||
snigdhaṃ mahāntaṃ kaṭhinaṃ sirā-naddhaṃ kaphākṛtim | / pravṛddhaṃ medurair medo nītaṃ māṃse 'tha-vā tvaci ||
vāyunā kurute granthiṃ bhṛśaṃ snigdhaṃ mṛduṃ calam | / śleṣma-tulyākṛtiṃ deha-kṣaya-vṛddhi-kṣayodayam ||
sa vibhinno ghanaṃ medas tāmrāsita-sitaṃ sravet | / asthi-bhaṅgābhighātābhyām unnatāvanataṃ tu yat ||
so 'sthi-granthiḥ padātes tu sahasāmbho-'vagāhanāt | / vyāyāmād vā pratāntasya sirā-jālaṃ sa-śoṇitam ||
vāyuḥ sampīḍya saṅkocya vakrī-kṛtya viśoṣya ca | / niḥ-sphuraṃ nī-rujaṃ granthiṃ kurute sa sirāhvayaḥ ||
a-rūḍhe rūḍha-mātre vā vraṇe sarva-rasāśinaḥ | / sārdre vā bandha-rahite gātre 'śmābhihate 'tha-vā ||
vāto 'sram a-srutaṃ duṣṭaṃ saṃśoṣya grathitaṃ vraṇam | / kuryāt sa-dāhaḥ kaṇḍū-mān vraṇa-granthir ayaṃ smṛtaḥ ||
sādhyā doṣāsra-medo-jā na tu sthūla-kharāś calāḥ | / marma-kaṇṭhodara-sthāś ca mahat tu granthito 'rbudam ||
tal-lakṣaṇaṃ ca medo-'ntaiḥ ṣo-ḍhā doṣādibhis tu tat | / prāyo medaḥ-kaphāḍhya-tvāt sthira-tvāc ca na pacyate ||
sirā-sthaṃ śoṇitaṃ doṣaḥ saṅkocyāntaḥ prapīḍya ca | / pācayeta tad ānaddhaṃ sāsrāvaṃ māṃsa-piṇḍitam ||
māṃsāṅkuraiś citaṃ yāti vṛddhiṃ cāśu sravet tataḥ | / ajasraṃ duṣṭa-rudhiraṃ bhūri tac choṇitārbudam ||
teṣv asṛṅ-māṃsa-je varjye catvāry anyāni sādhayet | / prasthitā vaṅkṣaṇorv-ādim adhaḥ-kāyaṃ kapholbaṇāḥ ||
doṣā māṃsāsra-gāḥ pādau kālenāśritya kurvate | / śanaiḥ śanair ghanaṃ śophaṃ ślīpadaṃ tat pracakṣate ||
paripoṭa-yutaṃ kṛṣṇam a-nimitta-rujaṃ kharam | / rūkṣaṃ ca vātāt pittāt tu pītaṃ dāha-jvarānvitam ||
kaphād guru snigdham a-ruk citaṃ māṃsāṅkurair bṛhat | / tat tyajed vatsarātītaṃ su-mahat su-parisruti ||
pāṇi-nāsauṣṭha-karṇeṣu vadanty eke tu pāda-vat | / ślīpadaṃ jāyate tac ca deśe 'nūpe bhṛśaṃ bhṛśam ||
meda-sthāḥ kaṇṭha-manyākṣa-kakṣā-vaṅkṣaṇa-gā malāḥ | / sa-varṇān kaṭhinān snigdhān vārtākāmalakākṛtīn ||
avagāḍhān bahūn gaṇḍāṃś cira-pākāṃś ca kurvate | / pacyante 'lpa-rujas te 'nye sravanty anye 'ti-kaṇḍurāḥ ||
naśyanty anye bhavanty anye dīrgha-kālānubandhinaḥ | / gaṇḍa-mālāpacī ceyaṃ dūrveva kṣaya-vṛddhi-bhāk ||
tāṃ tyajet sa-jvara-cchardi-pārśva-ruk-kāsa-pīnasām | / a-bhedāt pakva-śophasya vraṇe cā-pathya-sevinaḥ ||
anupraviśya māṃsādīn dūraṃ pūyo 'bhidhāvati | / gatiḥ sā dūra-gamanān nāḍī nāḍīva saṃsruteḥ ||
nāḍy ekān-ṛjur anyeṣāṃ saivāneka-gatir gatiḥ | / sā doṣaiḥ pṛthag eka-sthaiḥ śalya-hetuś ca pañcamī ||
vātāt sa-ruk sūkṣma-mukhī vi-varṇā phenilodvamā | / sravaty abhyadhikaṃ rātrau pittāt tṛḍ-jvara-dāha-kṛt ||
pītoṣṇa-pūti-pūya-srud divā cāti niṣiñcati | / ghana-picchila-saṃsrāvā kaṇḍūlā kaṭhinā kaphāt ||

niśi cābhyadhika-kledā sarvaiḥ sarvākṛtiṃ tyajet || 31ab || / antaḥ-sthitaṃ śalyam an-āhṛtaṃ tu karoti nāḍīṃ vahate ca sāsya || 31cd || / phenānuviddhaṃ tanum alpam uṣṇaṃ sāsraṃ ca pūyaṃ sa-rujaṃ ca nityam || 31ef ||
granthiṣv āmeṣu kartavyā yathā-svaṃ śopha-vat kriyā | / bṛhatī-citraka-vyāghrī-kaṇā-siddhena sarpiṣā ||
snehayec chuddhi-kāmaṃ ca tīkṣṇaiḥ śuddhasya lepanam | / saṃsvedya bahu-śo granthiṃ vimṛdnīyāt punaḥ punaḥ ||
eṣa vāte viśeṣeṇa kramaḥ pittāsra-je punaḥ | / jalaukaso himaṃ sarvaṃ kapha-je vātiko vidhiḥ ||
tathāpy a-pakvaṃ chittvainaṃ sthite rakte 'gninā dahet | / sādhv a-śeṣaṃ sa-śeṣo hi punar āpyāyate dhruvam ||
māṃsa-vraṇodbhavau granthī yāpayed evam eva ca | / kāryaṃ medo-bhave 'py etat taptaiḥ phalādibhiś ca tam ||
pramṛdyāt tila-digdhena cchannaṃ dvi-guṇa-vāsasā | / śastreṇa pāṭayitvā vā dahen medasi sūddhṛte ||
sirā-granthau nave peyaṃ tailaṃ sāhacaraṃ tathā | / upanāho 'nila-harair vasti-karma sirā-vyadhaḥ ||
arbude granthi-vat kuryāt yathā-svaṃ su-tarāṃ hitam | / ślīpade 'nila-je vidhyet snigdha-svinnopanāhite ||
sirām upari gulphasya dvy-aṅgule pāyayec ca tam | / māsam eraṇḍa-jaṃ tailaṃ go-mūtreṇa samanvitam ||
jīrṇe jīrṇānnam aśnīyāc chuṇṭhī-śṛta-payo-'nvitam | / traivṛtaṃ vā pibed evam a-śāntāv agninā dahet ||
gulphasyādhaḥ sirā-mokṣaḥ paitte sarvaṃ ca pitta-jit | / sirām aṅguṣṭhake viddhvā kapha-je śīlayed yavān ||
sa-kṣaudrāṇi kaṣāyāṇi vardhamānās tathābhayāḥ | / limpet sarṣapa-vārtākī-mūlābhyāṃ dhanvayātha-vā ||
ūrdhvādhaḥ-śodhanaṃ peyam apacyāṃ sādhitaṃ ghṛtam | / dantī-dravantī-trivṛtā-jālinī-devadālibhiḥ ||
śīlayet kapha-medo-ghnaṃ dhūma-gaṇḍūṣa-nāvanam | / sirayāpahared raktaṃ piben mūtreṇa tārkṣya-jam ||
granthīn a-pakvān ālimpen nākulī-paṭu-nāgaraiḥ | / svinnān lavaṇa-poṭalyā kaṭhinān anu mardayet ||
śamī-mūlaka-śigrūṇāṃ bījaiḥ sa-yava-sarṣapaiḥ | / lepaḥ piṣṭo ṇmla-takreṇa granthi-gaṇḍa-vilāyanaḥ ||
pākon-mukhān srutāsrasya pitta-śleṣma-harair jayet | / a-pakvān evo voddhṛtya kṣārāgnibhyām upācaret ||
kākādanī-lāṅgalikā-nahikottuṇḍikī-phalaiḥ | / jīmūta-bīja-karkoṭī-viśālā-kṛtavedhanaiḥ ||
pāṭhānvitaiḥ palārdhāṃśair viṣa-karṣa-yutaiḥ pacet | / prasthaṃ karañja-tailasya nirguṇḍī-sva-rasāḍhake ||
anena mālā gaṇḍānāṃ cira-jā pūya-vāhinī | / sidhyaty a-sādhya-kalpāpi pānābhyañjana-nāvanaiḥ ||
tailaṃ lāṅgalikī-kanda-kalka-pādaṃ catur-guṇe | / nirguṇḍī-sva-rase pakvaṃ nasyādyair apacī-praṇut ||
bhadraśrī-dāru-marica-dvi-haridrā-trivṛd-ghanaiḥ | / manaḥśilāla-nalada-viśālā-karavīrakaiḥ ||
go-mūtra-piṣṭaiḥ palikair viṣasyārdha-palena ca | / brāhmī-rasārka-ja-kṣīra-go-śakṛd-rasa-saṃyutam ||
prasthaṃ sarṣapa-tailasya siddham āśu vyapohati | / pānādyaiḥ śīlitaṃ kuṣṭha-duṣṭa-nāḍī-vraṇāpacīḥ ||
vacā-harītakī-lākṣā-kaṭu-rohiṇi-candanaiḥ | / tailaṃ prasādhitaṃ pītaṃ sa-mūlām apacīṃ jayet ||
śarapuṅkhodbhavaṃ mūlaṃ piṣṭaṃ taṇḍula-vāriṇā | / nasyāl lepāc ca duṣṭārur-apacī-viṣa-jantu-jit ||
mūlair uttamakāraṇyāḥ pīluparṇyāḥ sahācarāt | / sa-lodhrābhaya-yaṣṭy-āhva-śatāhvā-dvīpi-dārubhiḥ ||
tailaṃ kṣīra-samaṃ siddhaṃ nasye 'bhyaṅge ca pūjitam | / go-'vy-ajāśva-khurā dagdhāḥ kaṭu-tailena lepanam ||
aiṅgudena tu kṛṣṇāhir vāyaso vā svayaṃ mṛtaḥ | / ity a-śāntau gadasyānya-pārśva-jaṅghā-samāśritam ||
vaster ūrdhvam adhas-tād vā medo hṛtvāgninā dahet | / sthitasyordhvaṃ padaṃ mitvā tan-mānena ca pārṣṇitaḥ ||

tata ūrdhvaṃ hared granthīn ity āha bhaga-vān nimiḥ || 31ab || / pārṣṇiṃ prati dvā-daśa cāṅgulāni muktvendra-vastiṃ ca gadānya-pārśve || 31cd || / vidārya matsyāṇḍa-nibhāni madhyāj jālāni karṣed iti suśrutoktiḥ || 31ef ||
ā-gulpha-karṇāt su-mitasya jantos tasyāṣṭa-bhāgaṃ khuḍakād vibhajya | / ghrāṇārjave 'dhaḥ sura-rāja-vaster bhittvākṣa-mātraṃ tv apare vadanti ||
upanāhyānilān nāḍīṃ pāṭitāṃ sādhu lepayet | / pratyakpuṣpī-phala-yutais tailaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ sa-saindhavaiḥ ||
paittīṃ tu tila-mañjiṣṭhā-nāgadantī-niśā-dvayaiḥ | / ślaiṣmikīṃ tila-saurāṣṭrī-nikumbhāriṣṭa-saindhavaiḥ ||
śalya-jāṃ tila-madhv-ājyair lepayec chinna-śodhitām | / a-śastra-kṛtyām eṣiṇyā bhittvānte samyag-eṣitām ||
kṣāra-pītena sūtreṇa bahu-śo dārayed gatim | / vraṇeṣu duṣṭa-sūkṣmāsya-gambhīrādiṣu sādhanam ||
yā vartyo yāni tailāni tan nāḍīṣv api śasyate | / piṣṭaṃ cañcu-phalaṃ lepān nāḍī-vraṇa-haraṃ param ||
ghoṇṭā-phala-tvak lavaṇaṃ sa-lākṣaṃ būkasya pattraṃ vanitā-payaś ca | / snug-arka-dugdhānvita eṣa kalko vartī-kṛto hanty a-cireṇa nāḍīm ||
sāmudra-sauvarcala-sindhu-janma-su-pakva-ghoṇṭā-phala-veśma-dhūmāḥ | / āmrāta-gāyatri-ja-pallavāś ca kaṭaṅkaṭeryāv atha cetakī ca ||
kalke 'bhyaṅge cūrṇe vartyāṃ caiteṣu śīlyamāneṣu | / a-gatir iva naśyati gatiś capalā capaleṣu bhūtir iva ||
snigdhā sa-varṇā grathitā nī-rujā mudga-sannibhā | / piṭikā kapha-vātābhyāṃ bālānām ajagallikā ||
yava-prakhyā yava-prakhyā tābhyāṃ māṃsāśritā ghanā | / a-vaktrā cālajī vṛttā stoka-pūyā ghanonnatā ||
granthayaḥ pañca vā ṣaḍ vā kacchapī kacchaponnatāḥ | / karṇasyordhvaṃ samantād vā piṭikā kaṭhinogra-ruk ||
śālūkābhā panasikā śophas tv alpa-rujaḥ sthiraḥ | / hanu-sandhi-samudbhūtas tābhyāṃ pāṣāṇa-gardabhaḥ ||
śālmalī-kaṇṭakākārāḥ piṭikāḥ sa-rujo ghanāḥ | / medo-garbhā mukhe yūnāṃ tābhyāṃ ca mukha-dūṣikāḥ ||
te padma-kaṇṭakā jñeyā yaiḥ padmam iva kaṇṭakaiḥ | / cīyate nī-rujaiḥ śvetaiḥ śarīraṃ kapha-vāta-jaiḥ ||
pittena piṭikā vṛttā pakvodumbara-sannibhā | / mahā-dāha-jvara-karī vivṛtā vivṛtānanā ||
gātreṣv antaś ca vaktrasya dāha-jvara-rujānvitāḥ | / masūra-mātrās tad-varṇās tat-sañjñāḥ piṭikā ghanāḥ ||
tataḥ kaṣṭa-tarāḥ sphoṭā visphoṭākhyā mahā-rujāḥ | / yā padma-karṇikākārā piṭikā piṭikācitā ||
sā viddhā vāta-pittābhyāṃ tābhyām eva ca gardabhī | / maṇḍalā vipulotsannā sa-rāga-piṭikācitā ||
kakṣeti kakṣāsanneṣu prāyo deśeṣu sānilāt | / pittād bhavanti piṭikāḥ sūkṣmā lājopamā ghanāḥ ||
tādṛśī mahatī tv ekā gandha-nāmeti kīrtitā | / gharma-sveda-parīte 'ṅge piṭikāḥ sa-rujo ghanāḥ ||
rājīkā-varṇa-saṃsthāna-pramāṇā rājikāhvayāḥ | / doṣaiḥ pittolbaṇair mandair visarpati visarpa-vat ||
śopho '-pākas tanus tāmro jvara-kṛj jāla-gardabhaḥ | / malaiḥ pittolbaṇaiḥ sphoṭā jvariṇo māṃsa-dāraṇāḥ ||
kakṣā-bhāgeṣu jāyante ye 'gny-ābhāḥ sāgni-rohiṇī | / pañcāhāt sapta-rātrād vā pakṣād vā hanti jīvitam ||
tri-liṅgā piṭikā vṛttā jatrūrdhvam irivellikā | / vidārī-kanda-kaṭhinā vidārī kakṣa-vaṅkṣaṇe ||
medo-'nila-kaphair granthiḥ snāyu-māṃsa-sirāśrayaiḥ | / bhinno vasājya-madhv-ābhaṃ sravet tatrolbaṇo 'nilaḥ ||
māṃsaṃ viśoṣya grathitāṃ śarkarāṃ upapādayet | / dur-gandhaṃ rudhiraṃ klinnaṃ nānā-varṇaṃ tato malāḥ ||
tāṃ srāvayanti nicitāṃ vidyāt tac charkarārbudam | / pāṇi-pāda-tale sandhau jatrūrdhvaṃ vopacīyate ||
valmīka-vac chanair granthis tad-vad bahv-aṇubhir mukhaiḥ | / rug-dāha-kaṇḍū-kledāḍhyair valmīko 'sau samasta-jaḥ ||
śarkaronmathite pāde kṣate vā kaṇṭakādibhiḥ | / granthiḥ kīla-vad utsanno jāyate kadaraṃ tu tat ||
vega-sandhāraṇād vāyur apāno 'pāna-saṃśrayam | / aṇū-karoti bāhyāntar-mārgam asya tataḥ śakṛt ||
kṛcchrān nirgacchati vyādhir ayaṃ ruddha-gudo mataḥ | / kuryāt pittānilaṃ pākaṃ nakha-māṃse sa-rug-jvaram ||
cipyam a-kṣata-rogaṃ ca vidyād upa-nakhaṃ ca tam | / kṛṣṇo 'bhighātād rūkṣaś ca kharaś ca ku-nakho nakhaḥ ||
duṣṭa-kardama-saṃsparśāt kaṇḍū-kledānvitāntarāḥ | / aṅgulyo 'lasam ity āhus tilābhāṃs tila-kālakān ||
kṛṣṇān a-vedanāṃs tvak-sthān māṣāṃs tān eva connatān | / maṣebhyas tūnnata-tarāṃś carma-kīlān sitāsitān ||
tathā-vidho jatu-maṇiḥ saha-jo lohitas tu saḥ | / kṛṣṇaṃ sitaṃ vā saha-jaṃ maṇḍalaṃ lāñchanaṃ samam ||
śoka-krodhādi-kupitād vāta-pittān mukhe tanu | / śyāmalaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vyaṅgaṃ vaktrād anya-tra nīlikā ||
paruṣaṃ paruṣa-sparśaṃ vyaṅgaṃ śyāvaṃ ca mārutāt | / pittāt tāmrāntam ā-nīlaṃ śvetāntaṃ kaṇḍu-mat kaphāt ||
raktād raktāntam ā-tāmraṃ sauṣaṃ cimicimāyate | / vāyunodīritaḥ śleṣmā tvacaṃ prāpya viśuṣyati ||
tatas tvag jāyate pāṇduḥ krameṇa ca vi-cetanā | / alpa-kaṇḍūr a-vikledā sā prasuptiḥ prasuptitaḥ ||
a-samyag-vamanodīrṇa-pitta-śleṣmānna-nigrahaiḥ | / maṇḍalāny ati-kaṇḍūni rāga-vanti bahūni ca ||
utkoṭhaḥ so 'nubaddhas tu koṭha ity abhidhīyate | / proktāḥ ṣaṭ-triṃśad ity ete kṣudra-rogā vibhāga-śaḥ ||
visrāvayej jalaukobhir a-pakvām ajagallikām | / svedayitvā yava-prakhyāṃ vilayāya pralepayet ||
dāru-kuṣṭha-manohvālair ity ā-pāṣāṇa-gardabhāt | / vidhis tāṃś cācaret pakvān vraṇa-vat sājagallikān ||
lodhra-kustumburu-vacāḥ pralepo mukha-dūṣike | / vaṭa-pallava-yuktā vā nārikelottha-śuktayaḥ ||
a-śāntau vamanaṃ nasyaṃ lalāṭe ca sirā-vyadhaḥ | / nimbāmbu-vānto nimbāmbu-sādhitaṃ padma-kaṇṭake ||
pibet kṣaudrānvitaṃ sarpir nimbāragvadha-lepanam || 5ab || / vivṛtādīṃs tu jālāntāṃś cikitset serivellikān || 5cd || / pitta-visarpa-vat tad-vat pratyākhyāyāgni-rohiṇīm || 5ef ||
vilaṅghanaṃ rakta-vimokṣaṇaṃ ca virūkṣaṇaṃ kāya-viśodhanaṃ ca | / dhātrī-prayogāñ chiśira-pradehān kuryāt sadā jālaka-gardabhasya ||
vidārikāṃ hṛte rakte śleṣma-granthi-vad ācaret | / medo-'rbuda-kriyāṃ kuryāt su-tarāṃ śarkarārbude ||
pravṛddhaṃ su-bahu-cchidraṃ sa-śophaṃ marmaṇi sthitam | / valmīkaṃ hasta-pāde ca varjayed itarat punaḥ ||
śuddhasyāsre hṛte limpet sa-paṭv-ārevatāmṛtaiḥ | / śyāmā-kulatthikā-mūla-dantī-palala-saktubhiḥ ||
pakve tu duṣṭa-māṃsāni gatīḥ sarvāś ca śodhayet | / śastreṇa samyag anu ca kṣāreṇa jvalanena vā ||
śastreṇotkṛtya niḥ-śeṣaṃ snehena kadaraṃ dahet | / niruddha-maṇi-vat kāryaṃ ruddha-pāyoś cikitsitam ||
cipyaṃ śuddhyā jitoṣmāṇaṃ sādhayec chastra-karmaṇā | / duṣṭaṃ ku-nakham apy evaṃ caraṇāv alase punaḥ ||
dhānyāmla-siktau kāsīsa-paṭolī-rocanā-tilaiḥ | / sa-nimba-pattrair ālimped dahet tu tila-kālakān ||
maṣāṃś ca sūrya-kāntena kṣāreṇa yadi vāgninā | / tad-vad utkṛtya śastreṇa carma-kīla-jatū-maṇī ||
lāñchanādi-traye kuryād yathāsannaṃ sirā-vyadham | / lepayet kṣīra-piṣṭaiś ca kṣīri-vṛkṣa-tvag-aṅkuraiḥ ||
vyaṅgeṣu cārjuna-tvag vā mañjiṣṭhā vā sa-mākṣikā | / lepaḥ sa-nava-nītā vā śvetāśva-khura-jā maṣī ||
rakta-candana-mañjiṣṭhā-kuṣṭha-lodhra-priyaṅgavaḥ | / vaṭāṅkurā masūrāś ca vyaṅga-ghnā mukha-kānti-dāḥ ||
dve jīrake kṛṣṇa-tilāḥ sarṣapāḥ payasā saha | / piṣṭāḥ kurvanti vaktrendum apāsta-vyaṅga-lāñchanam ||
kṣīra-piṣṭā ghṛta-kṣaudra-yuktā vā bhṛṣṭa-nis-tuṣāḥ | / masūrāḥ kṣīra-piṣṭā vā tīkṣṇāḥ śālmali-kaṇṭakāḥ ||
sa-guḍaḥ kola-majjā vā śaśāsṛk-kṣaudra-kalkitaḥ | / saptāhaṃ mātuluṅga-sthaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vā madhunānvitam ||
piṣṭā vā chāga-payasā sa-kṣaudrā mausalī jaṭā | / gor asthi musalī-mūla-yuktaṃ vā sājya-mākṣikam ||
jambv-āmra-pallavā mastu haridre dve navo guḍaḥ | / lepaḥ sa-varṇa-kṛt piṣṭaṃ sva-rasena ca tindukam ||
utpalam utpala-kuṣṭhaṃ priyaṅgu-kālīyakaṃ badara-majjā | / idam udvartanam āsyaṃ karoti śatapattra-saṅkāśam ||
ebhir evauṣadhaiḥ piṣṭair mukhābhyaṅgāya sādhayet | / yathā-doṣartukān snehān madhuka-kvātha-saṃyutaiḥ ||
yavān sarja-rasaṃ lodhram uśīraṃ madanaṃ madhu | / ghṛtaṃ guḍaṃ ca go-mūtre paced ā-darvi-lepanāt ||
tad abhyaṅgān nihanty āśu nīlikā-vyaṅga-dūṣikān | / mukhaṃ karoti padmābhaṃ pādau padma-dalopamau ||
kuṅkumośīra-kālīya-lākṣā-yaṣṭy-āhva-candanam | / nyagrodha-pādāṃs taruṇān padmakaṃ padma-kesaram ||
sa-nīlotpala-mañjiṣṭhaṃ pālikaṃ salilāḍhake | / paktvā pādāvaśeṣeṇa tena piṣṭaiś ca kārṣikaiḥ ||
lākṣā-pattaṅga-mañjiṣṭhā-yaṣṭīmadhuka-kuṅkumaiḥ | / ajā-kṣīraṃ dvi-guṇitaṃ tailasya kuḍavaṃ pacet ||
nīlikā-palita-vyaṅga-valī-tilaka-dūṣikān | / hanti tan nasyam abhyastaṃ mukhopacaya-varṇa-kṛt ||

mañjiṣṭhā śabarodbhavas tubarikā lākṣā haridrā-dvayaṃ || 31a || / nepālī haritāla-kuṅkuma-gadā go-rocanā gairikam || 31b || / pattraṃ pāṇḍu vaṭasya candana-yugaṃ kālīyakaṃ pāradaṃ || 31c || / pattaṅgaṃ kanaka-tvacaṃ kamala-jaṃ bījaṃ tathā kesaram || 31d ||
sikthaṃ tutthaṃ padmakādyo vasājyaṃ majjā kṣīraṃ kṣīri-vṛkṣāmbu cāgnau | / siddhaṃ siddhaṃ vyaṅga-nīly-ādi-nāśe vaktre chāyām aindavīṃ cāśu dhatte ||
mārkava-sva-rasa-kṣīra-toyānīṣṭāni nāvane | / prasuptau vāta-kuṣṭhoktaṃ kuryād dāhaṃ ca vahninā ||
strī-vyavāya-nivṛttasya sahasā bhajato 'tha-vā | / doṣādhyuṣita-saṅkīrṇa-malināṇu-rajaḥ-pathām ||
anya-yonim an-icchantīm a-gamyāṃ nava-sūtikām | / dūṣitaṃ spṛśatas toyaṃ ratānteṣv api naiva vā ||
vivardhayiṣayā tīkṣṇān pralepādīn prayacchataḥ | / muṣṭi-danta-nakhotpīḍā-viṣa-vac-chūka-pātanaiḥ ||
vega-nigraha-dīrghāti-khara-sparśa-vighaṭṭanaiḥ | / doṣā duṣṭā gatā guhyaṃ trayo-viṃśatim āmayān ||
janayanty upadaṃśādīn upadaṃśo 'tra pañca-dhā | / pṛthag doṣaiḥ sa-rudhiraiḥ samastaiś cātra mārutāt ||
meḍhre śopho rujaś citrāḥ stambhas tvak-paripoṭanam | / pakvodumbara-saṅkāśaḥ pittena śvayathur jvaraḥ ||
śleṣmaṇā kaṭhinaḥ snigdhaḥ kaṇḍū-māñ chītalo guruḥ | / śoṇitenāsita-sphoṭa-sambhavo 'sra-srutir jvaraḥ ||
sarva-je sarva-liṅga-tvaṃ śvayathur muṣkayor api | / tīvrā rug āśu-pacanaṃ daraṇaṃ kṛmi-sambhavaḥ ||
yāpyo raktodbhavas teṣāṃ mṛtyave sannipāta-jaḥ | / jāyante kupitair doṣair guhyāsṛk-piśitāśrayaiḥ ||
antar bahir vā meḍhrasya kaṇḍūlā māṃsa-kīlakāḥ | / picchilāsra-sravā yonau tad-vac ca cchattra-sannibhāḥ ||
te 'rśāṃsy upekṣayā ghnanti meḍhra-puṃs-tvaṃ bhagārtavaṃ | / guhyasya bahir antar vā piṭikāḥ kapha-rakta-jāḥ ||
sarṣapā-māna-saṃsthānā ghanāḥ sarṣapikāḥ smṛtāḥ | / piṭikā bahavo dīrghā dīryante madhyataś ca yāḥ ||
so 'vamanthaḥ kaphāsṛgbhyāṃ vedanā-roma-harṣa-vān | / kumbhīkā rakta-pittotthā jāmbavāsthi-nibhāśu-jā ||
alajīṃ meha-vad vidyād uttamāṃ pitta-rakta-jām | / piṭikāṃ māṣa-mudgābhāṃ piṭikā piṭikācitā ||
karṇikā puṣkarasyeva jñeyā puṣkariketi sā | / pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśa-saṃvyūḍhe saṃvyūḍha-piṭikā bhavet ||
mṛditaṃ mṛditaṃ vastra-saṃrabdhaṃ vāta-kopataḥ | / viṣamā kaṭhinā bhugnā vāyunāṣṭhīlikā smṛtā ||
vimardanādi-duṣṭena vāyunā carma meḍhra-jam | / nivartate sa-rug-dāhaṃ kva-cit pākaṃ ca gacchati ||
piṇḍitaṃ granthitaṃ carma tat pralambam adho maṇeḥ | / nivṛtta-sañjñaṃ sa-kaphaṃ kaṇḍū-kāṭhinya-vat tu tat ||
dur-ūḍhaṃ sphuṭitaṃ carma nirdiṣṭam avapāṭikā | / vātena dūṣitaṃ carma maṇau saktaṃ ruṇaddhi cet ||
sroto mūtraṃ tato 'bhyeti manda-dhāram a-vedanam | / maṇer vikāśa-rodhaś ca sa niruddha-maṇir gadaḥ ||
liṅgaṃ śūkair ivāpūrṇaṃ grathitākhyaṃ kaphodbhavam | / śūka-dūṣita-raktotthā sparśa-hānis tad-āhvayā ||
chidrair aṇu-mukhair yat tu mehanaṃ sarvataś citam | / vāta-śoṇita-kopena taṃ vidyāc chata-ponakam ||
pittāsṛgbhyāṃ tvacaḥ pākas tvak-pāko jvara-dāha-vān | / māṃs-pākaḥ sarva-jaḥ sarva-vedano māṃsa-śātanaḥ ||
sa-rāgair asitaiḥ sphoṭaiḥ piṭikābhiś ca pīḍitam | / mehanaṃ vedanā cogrā taṃ vidyād asṛg-arbudam ||
māṃsārbudaṃ prāg uditaṃ vidradhiś ca tri-doṣa-jaḥ | / kṛṣṇāni bhūtvā māṃsāni viśīryante samantataḥ ||
pakvāni sannipātena tān vidyāt tila-kālakān | / māṃsottham arbudaṃ pākaṃ vidradhiṃ tila-kālakān ||
caturo varjayed eṣāṃ śeṣāñ chīghram upācaret | / viṃśatir vyāpado yoner jāyante duṣṭa-bhojanāt ||
viṣama-sthāṅga-śayana-bhṛśa-maithuna-sevanaiḥ | / duṣṭārtavād apadravair bīja-doṣeṇa daivataḥ ||
yonau kruddho 'nilaḥ kuryād ruk-todāyāma-supta-tāḥ | / pipīlikā-sṛptim iva stambhaṃ karkaśa-tāṃ svanam ||
phenilāruṇa-kṛṣṇālpa-tanu-rūkṣārtava-srutim | / sraṃsaṃ vaṅkṣaṇa-pārśvādau vyathāṃ gulmaṃ krameṇa ca ||
tāṃs tāṃś ca svān gadān vyāpad vātikī nāma sā smṛtā | / saivāti-caraṇā śopha-saṃyuktāti-vyavāyataḥ ||
maithunād ati-bālāyāḥ pṛṣṭha-jaṅghoru-vaṅkṣaṇam | / rujan sandūṣayed yoniṃ vāyuḥ prāk-caraṇeti sā ||
vegodāvartanād yoniṃ prapīḍayati mārutaḥ | / sā phenilaṃ rajaḥ kṛcchrād udāvṛttaṃ vimuñcati ||
iyaṃ vyāpad udāvṛttā jāta-ghnī tu yadānilaḥ | / jātaṃ jātaṃ sutaṃ hanti raukṣyād duṣṭārtavodbhavam ||
aty-āśitāyā viṣamaṃ sthitāyāḥ su-rate marut | / annenotpīḍito yoneḥ sthitaḥ srotasi vakrayet ||
sāsthi-māṃsaṃ mukhaṃ tīvra-rujam antar-mukhīti sā | / vātalāhāra-sevinyāṃ jananyāṃ kupito 'nilaḥ ||
striyo yonim aṇu-dvārāṃ kuryāt sūcī-mukhīti sā | / vega-rodhād ṛtau vāyur duṣṭo viṇ-mūtra-saṅgraham ||
karoti yoneḥ śoṣaṃ ca śuṣkākhyā sāti-vedanā | / ṣaḍ-ahāt sapta-rātrād vā śukraṃ garbhāśayān marut ||
vamet sa-ruṅ nī-rujo vā yasyāḥ sā vāminī matā | / yonau vātopataptāyāṃ strī-garbhe bīja-doṣataḥ ||
nṛ-dveṣiṇy a-stanī ca syāt ṣaṇḍha-sañjñān-upakramā | / duṣṭo viṣṭabhya yony-āsyaṃ garbha-koṣṭhaṃ ca mārutaḥ ||
kurute vivṛtāṃ srastāṃ vātikīm iva duḥkhitām | / utsanna-māṃsāṃ tām āhur mahā-yoniṃ mahā-rujām ||
yathā-svair dūṣaṇair duṣṭaṃ pittaṃ yonim upāśritam | / karoti dāha-pākoṣā-pūti-gandhi-jvarānvitām ||
bhṛśoṣṇa-bhūri-kuṇapa-nīla-pītāsitārtavām | / sā vyāpat paittikī rakta-yony-ākhyāsṛg-ati-sruteḥ ||
kapho 'bhiṣyandibhiḥ kruddhaḥ kuryād yonim a-vedanām | / śītalāṃ kaṇḍulāṃ pāṇḍu-picchilāṃ tad-vidha-srutim ||
sā vyāpac chlaiṣmikī vāta-pittābhyāṃ kṣīyate rajaḥ | / sa-dāha-kārśya-vaivarṇyaṃ yasyāḥ sā lohita-kṣayā ||
pittalāyā nṛ-saṃvāse kṣavathūdgāra-dhāraṇāt | / pitta-yuktena marutā yonir bhavati dūṣitā ||
śūnā sparśā-sahā sārtir nīla-pītāsra-vāhinī | / vasti-kukṣi-guru-tvātīsārā-rocaka-kāriṇī ||
śroṇi-vaṅkṣaṇa-ruk-toda-jvara-kṛt sā pariplutā | / vāta-śleṣmāmaya-vyāptā śveta-picchila-vāhinī ||
upaplutā smṛtā yonir viplutākhyā tv a-dhāvanāt | / sañjāta-jantuḥ kaṇḍūlā kaṇḍvā cāti-rati-priyā ||
a-kāla-vāhanād vāyuḥ śleṣma-rakta-vimūrchitaḥ | / karṇikāṃ janayed yonau rajo-mārga-nirodhinīm ||
sā karṇinī tribhir doṣair yoni-garbhāśayāśritaiḥ | / yathā-svopadrava-karair vyāpat sā sānnipātikī ||
iti yoni-gadā nārī yaiḥ śukraṃ na pratīcchati | / tato garbhaṃ na gṛhṇāti rogāṃś cāpnoti dāruṇān ||
meḍhra-madhye sirāṃ vidhyed upadaṃśe navotthite | / śītāṃ kuryāt kriyāṃ śuddhiṃ virekeṇa viśeṣataḥ ||
tila-kalka-ghṛta-kṣaudrair lepaḥ pakve tu pāṭite | / jambv-āmra-sumano-nīpa-śveta-kāmbojikāṅkurān ||
śallakī-badarī-bilva-palāśa-tiniśodbhavāḥ | / tvacaḥ kṣīri-drumāṇāṃ ca tri-phalāṃ ca pacej jale ||
sa kvāthaḥ kṣālanaṃ tena pakvaṃ tailaṃ ca ropaṇam | / tuttha-gairika-lodhrailā-manohvāla-rasāñjanaiḥ ||
hareṇu-puṣpa-kāsīsa-saurāṣṭrī-lavaṇottamaiḥ | / lepaḥ kṣaudra-drutaiḥ sūkṣmair upadaṃśa-vraṇāpahaḥ ||
kapāle tri-phalā dagdhā sa-ghṛtā ropaṇaṃ param | / sāmānyaṃ sādhanam idaṃ prati-doṣaṃ tu śopha-vat ||
na ca yāti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhṛśam | / pakvaiḥ snāyu-sirā-māṃsaiḥ prāyo naśyati hi dhvajaḥ ||
arśasāṃ chinna-dagdhānāṃ kriyā kāryopadaṃśa-vat | / sarṣapā likhitāḥ sūkṣmaiḥ kaṣāyair avacūrṇayet ||
tair evābhyañjanaṃ tailaṃ sādhayed vraṇa-ropaṇam | / kriyeyam avamanthe 'pi raktaṃ srāvyaṃ tathobhayoḥ ||
kumbhīkāyāṃ hared raktaṃ pakvāyāṃ śodhite vraṇe | / tinduka-tri-phalā-lodhrair lepas tailaṃ ca ropaṇam ||
alajyāṃ sruta-raktāyām ayam eva kriyā-kramaḥ | / uttamākhyāṃ tu piṭikāṃ sañchidya baḍiśoddhṛtām ||
kalkaiś cūrṇaiḥ kaṣāyāṇāṃ kṣaudra-yuktair upācaret | / kramaḥ pitta-visarpoktaḥ puṣkara-vyūḍhayor hitaḥ ||
tvak-pāke sparśa-hānyāṃ ca secayed mṛditaṃ punaḥ | / balā-tailena koṣṇena madhuraiś copanāhayet ||
aṣṭhīlikāṃ hṛte rakte śleṣma-granthi-vad ācaret | / nivṛttaṃ sarpiṣābhyajya svedayitvopanāhayet ||
tri-rātraṃ pañca-rātraṃ vā su-snigdhaiḥ śālvaṇādibhiḥ | / svedayitvā tato bhūyaḥ snigdhaṃ carma samānayet ||
maṇiṃ prapīḍya śanakaiḥ praviṣṭe copanāhanam | / maṇau punaḥ punaḥ snigdhaṃ bhojanaṃ cātra śasyate ||
ayam eva prayojyaḥ syād avapāṭyām api kramaḥ | / nāḍīm ubhayato-dvārāṃ niruddhe jatunā sṛtām ||
snehāktāṃ srotasi nyasya siñcet snehaiś calāpahaiḥ | / try-ahāt try-ahāt sthūla-tarāṃ nyasya nāḍīṃ vivardhayet ||
sroto-dvāram a-siddhau tu vidvān śastreṇa pāṭayet | / sevanīṃ varjayan yuñjyāt sadyaḥ-kṣata-vidhiṃ tataḥ ||
granthitaṃ sveditaṃ nāḍyā snigdhoṣṇair upanāhayet | / limpet kaṣāyaiḥ sa-kṣaudrair likhitvā śata-ponakam ||
rakta-vidradhi-vat kāryā cikitsā śoṇitārbude | / vraṇopacāraṃ sarveṣu yathāvasthaṃ prayojayet ||
yoni-vyāpatsu bhūyiṣṭhaṃ śasyate karma vāta-jit | / snehana-sveda-vasty-ādi vāta-jāsu viśeṣataḥ ||
na hi vātād ṛte yonir vanitānāṃ praduṣyati | / ato jitvā tam anyasya kuryād doṣasya bheṣajam ||
pāyayeta balā-tailaṃ miśrakaṃ su-kumārakam | / snigdha-svinnāṃ tathā yoniṃ duḥ-sthitāṃ sthāpayet samām ||
pāṇinā namayej jihmāṃ saṃvṛtāṃ vyadhayet punaḥ | / praveśayen niḥsṛtāṃ ca vivṛtāṃ parivartayet ||
sthānāpavṛttā yonir hi śalya-bhūtā striyo matā | / karmabhir vamanādyaiś ca mṛdubhir yojayet striyam ||
sarvataḥ su-viśuddhāyāḥ śeṣaṃ karma vidhīyate | / vasty-abhyaṅga-parīṣeka-pralepa-picu-dhāraṇam ||
kāśmarya-tri-phalā-drākṣā-kāsamarda-niśā-dvayaiḥ | / guḍūcī-sairyakābhīru-śukanāsā-punarnavaiḥ ||
parūṣakaiś ca vipacet prastham akṣa-samair ghṛtāt | / yoni-vāta-vikāra-ghnaṃ tat pītaṃ garbha-daṃ param ||
vacopakuñcikājājī-kṛṣṇā-vṛṣaka-saindhavam | / ajamodā-yava-kṣāra-śarkarā-citrakānvitam ||
piṣṭvā prasannayāloḍya khādet tad ghṛta-bharjitam | / yoni-pārśvārti-hṛd-roga-gulmārśo-vinivṛttaye ||
vṛṣakaṃ mātuluṅgasya mūlāni madayantikām | / piben madyaiḥ sa-lavaṇais tathā kṛṣṇopakuñcike ||
rāsnā-śvadaṃṣṭrā-vṛṣakaiḥ śṛtaṃ śūla-haraṃ payaḥ | / guḍūcī-tri-phalā-dantī-kvāthaiś ca pariṣecanam ||
nata-vārtākinī-kuṣṭha-saindhavāmaradārubhiḥ | / tailāt prasādhitād dhāryaḥ picur yonau rujāpahaḥ ||
pittalānāṃ tu yonīnāṃ sekābhyaṅga-picu-kriyāḥ | / śītāḥ pitta-jitaḥ kāryāḥ snehanārthaṃ ghṛtāni ca ||
śatāvarī-mūla-tulā-catuṣkāt kṣuṇṇa-pīḍitāt | / rasena kṣīra-tulyena pācayeta ghṛtāḍhakam ||
jīvanīyaiḥ śatāvaryā mṛdvīkābhiḥ parūṣakaiḥ | / piṣṭaiḥ priyālaiś cākṣāṃśair dvi-balā-madhukānvitaiḥ ||
siddha-śīte tu madhunaḥ pippalyāś ca palāṣṭakam | / śarkarāyā daśa-palaṃ kṣipel lihyāt picuṃ tataḥ ||
yony-asṛk-śukra-doṣa-ghnaṃ vṛṣyaṃ puṃ-savanaṃ param | / kṣataṃ kṣayam asṛk-pittaṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ halīmakam ||
kāmalāṃ vāta-rudhiraṃ visarpaṃ hṛc-chiro-graham | / apasmārārditāyāma-madonmādāṃś ca nāśayet ||
evam eva payaḥ-sarpir jīvanīyopasādhitam | / garbha-daṃ pitta-jānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ paramaṃ hitam ||
balā-droṇa-dvaya-kvāthe ghṛta-tailāḍhakaṃ pacet | / kṣīre catur-guṇe kṛṣṇā-kākanāsā-sitānvitaiḥ ||
jīvantī-kṣīra-kākolī-sthirā-vīrarddhi-jīvakaiḥ | / payasyā-śrāvaṇī-mudga-pīlu-māṣākhya-parṇibhiḥ ||
vāta-pittāmayān hatvā pānād garbhaṃ dadhāti tat | / rakta-yonyām asṛg-varṇair anubandham avekṣya ca ||
yathā-doṣodayaṃ yuñjyād rakta-sthāpanam auṣadham | / pāṭhāṃ jambv-āmrayor asthi śilodbhedaṃ rasāñjanam ||
ambaṣṭhāṃ śālmalī-picchāṃ samaṅgāṃ vatsaka-tvacam | / bāhlīka-bilvātiviṣā-lodhra-toyada-gairikam ||
śuṇṭhī-madhūka-mācīka-rakta-candana-kaṭphalam | / kaṭvaṅga-vatsakānantā-dhātakī-madhukārjunam ||
puṣye gṛhītvā sañcūrṇya sa-kṣaudraṃ taṇḍulāmbhasā | / pibed arśaḥsv atīsāre raktaṃ yaś copaveśyate ||
doṣā jantu-kṛtā ye ca bālānāṃ tāṃś ca nāśayet | / yoni-doṣaṃ rajo-doṣaṃ śyāva-śvetāruṇāsitam ||
cūrṇaṃ puṣyānugaṃ nāma hitam ātreya-pūjitam | / yonyāṃ balāsa-duṣṭāyāṃ sarvaṃ rūkṣoṣṇam auṣadham ||
dhātaky-āmalakī-pattra-sroto-ja-madhukotpalaiḥ | / jambv-āmra-sāra-kāsīsa-lodhra-kaṭphala-tindukaiḥ ||
saurāṣṭrikā-dāḍima-tvag-udumbara-śalāṭubhiḥ | / akṣa-mātrair ajā-mūtre kṣīre ca dvi-guṇe pacet ||
taila-prasthaṃ tad abhyaṅga-picu-vastiṣu yojayet | / tena śūnonnatā stabdhā picchilā srāviṇī tathā ||
viplutopaplutā yoniḥ sidhyet sa-sphoṭa-śūlinī | / yavānnam abhayāriṣṭaṃ sīdhu tailaṃ ca śīlayet ||
pippaly-ayo-rajaḥ-pathyā-prayogāṃś ca sa-mākṣikān | / kāsīsaṃ tri-phalā kāṅkṣī sāmra-jambv-asthi dhātakī ||
paicchilye kṣaudra-saṃyuktaś cūrṇo vaiśadya-kārakaḥ | / palāśa-dhātakī-jambū-samaṅgā-moca-sarja-jaḥ ||
dur-gandhe picchile klede stambhanaś cūrṇa iṣyate | / āragvadhādi-vargasya kaṣāyaḥ pariṣecanam ||
stabdhānāṃ karkaśānāṃ ca kāryaṃ mārdava-kārakam | / dhāraṇaṃ vesavārasya kṛśarā-pāyasasya ca ||
dur-gandhānāṃ kaṣāyaḥ syāt tailaṃ vā kalka eva vā | / cūrṇo vā sarva-gandhānāṃ pūti-gandhāpakarṣaṇaḥ ||
śleṣmalānāṃ kaṭu-prāyāḥ sa-mūtrā vastayo hitāḥ | / pitte sa-madhuka-kṣīrā vāte tailāmla-saṃyutāḥ ||
sannipāta-samutthāyāḥ karma sādhāraṇaṃ hitam | / evaṃ yoniṣu śuddhāsu garbhaṃ vindanti yoṣitaḥ ||
a-duṣṭe prākṛte bīje jīvopakramaṇe sati | / pañca-karma-viśuddhasya puruṣasyāpi cendriyam ||
parīkṣya varṇair doṣāṇāṃ duṣṭaṃ tad-ghnair upācaret | / mañjiṣṭhā-kuṣṭha-tagara-tri-phalā-śarkarā-vacāḥ ||
dve niśe madhukaṃ medāṃ dīpyakaṃ kaṭu-rohiṇīm | / payasyā-hiṅgu-kākolī-vājigandhā-śatāvarīḥ ||
piṣṭvākṣāṃśā ghṛta-prasthaṃ pacet kṣīra-catur-guṇam | / yoni-śukra-pradoṣeṣu tat sarveṣu praśasyate ||
āyuṣyaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ medhyaṃ dhanyaṃ puṃ-savanaṃ param | / phala-sarpir iti khyātaṃ puṣpe pītaṃ phalāya yat ||
mriyamāṇa-prajānāṃ ca garbhiṇīnāṃ ca pūjitam | / etat paraṃ ca bālānāṃ graha-ghnaṃ deha-vardhanam ||
mathyamāne jala-nidhāv amṛtārthaṃ surāsuraiḥ | / jātaḥ prāg amṛtotpatteḥ puruṣo ghora-darśanaḥ ||
dīpta-tejāś catur-daṃṣṭro hari-keśo 'nalekṣaṇaḥ | / jagad viṣaṇṇaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tenāsau viṣa-sañjñitaḥ ||
huṅ-kṛto brahmaṇā mūrtī tataḥ sthāvara-jaṅgame | / so 'dhyatiṣṭhan nijaṃ rūpam ujjhitvā vañcanātmakam ||
sthiram ity ulbaṇaṃ vīrye yat kandeṣu pratiṣṭhitam | / kālakūṭendravatsākhya-śṛṅgī-hālāhalādikam ||
sarpa-lūtādi-daṃṣṭrāsu dāruṇaṃ jaṅgamaṃ viṣam | / sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ceti viṣaṃ proktam a-kṛtrimam ||
kṛtrimaṃ gara-sañjñaṃ tu kriyate vividhauṣadhaiḥ | / hanti yoga-vaśenāśu cirāc cira-tarāc ca tat ||
śopha-pāṇḍūdaronmāda-dur-nāmādīn karoti vā | / tīkṣṇoṣṇa-rūkṣa-viśadaṃ vyavāyy āśu-karaṃ laghu ||
vikāṣi sūkṣmam a-vyakta-rasaṃ viṣama-pāki ca | / ojaso viparītaṃ tat tīkṣṇādyair anvitaṃ guṇaiḥ ||
vāta-pittottaraṃ nṝṇāṃ sadyo harati jīvitam | / viṣaṃ hi dehaṃ samprāpya prāg dūṣayati śoṇitam ||
kapha-pittānilāṃś cānu samaṃ doṣān sahāśayān | / tato hṛdayam āsthāya dehocchedāya kalpate ||
sthāvarasyopayuktasya vege pūrve prajāyate | / jihvāyāḥ śyāva-tā stambho mūrchā trāsaḥ klamo vamiḥ ||
dvitīye vepathuḥ svedo dāhaḥ kaṇṭhe ca vedanā | / viṣaṃ cāmāśayaṃ prāptaṃ kurute hṛdi vedanām ||
tālu-śoṣas tṛtīye tu śūlaṃ cāmāśaye bhṛśam | / dur-bale harite śūne jāyete cāsya locane ||
pakvāśaya-gate toda-hidhmā-kāsāntra-kūjanam | / caturthe jāyate vege śirasaś cāti-gauravam ||
kapha-praseko vaivarṇyaṃ parva-bhedaś ca pañcame | / sarva-doṣa-prakopaś ca pakvādhāne ca vedanā ||
ṣaṣṭhe sañjñā-praṇāśaś ca su-bhṛśaṃ cātisāryate | / skandha-pṛṣṭha-kaṭī-bhaṅgo bhaven mṛtyuś ca saptame ||
prathame viṣa-vege tu vāntaṃ śītāmbu-secinam | / sarpir-madhubhyāṃ saṃyuktam a-gadaṃ pāyayed drutam ||
dvitīye pūrva-vad vāntaṃ viriktaṃ cānupāyayet | / tṛtīye '-gada-pānaṃ tu hitaṃ nasyaṃ tathāñjanam ||

piṣṭo go-vāriṇāṣṭāṅgo hanti gonasa-jaṃ viṣam | / kaṭukātiviṣā-kuṣṭha-gṛha-dhūma-hareṇukāḥ ||
sa-kṣaudra-vyoṣa-tagarā ghnanti rājī-matāṃ viṣam | / nikhanet kāṇḍa-citrāyā daṃśaṃ yāma-dvayaṃ bhuvi ||
uddhṛtya pracchitaṃ sarpir-dhānya-mṛdbhyāṃ pralepayet | / pibet purāṇaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ varā-cūrṇāvacūrṇitam ||
jīrṇe virikto bhuñjīta yavānnaṃ sūpa-saṃskṛtam | / karavīrārka-kusuma-mūla-lāṅgalikā-kaṇāḥ ||
kalkayed āranālena pāṭhā-marica-saṃyutāḥ | / eṣa vyantara-daṣṭānām a-gadaḥ sārvakārmikaḥ ||
śirīṣa-puṣpa-sva-rase saptāhvaṃ maricaṃ sitam | / bhāvitaṃ sarpa-daṣṭānāṃ pāna-nasyāñjane hitam ||
dvi-palaṃ nata-kuṣṭhābhyāṃ ghṛta-kṣaudraṃ catuḥ-palam | / api takṣaka-daṣṭānāṃ pānam etat sukha-pradam ||
atha darvī-kṛtāṃ vege pūrve visrāvya śoṇitam | / a-gadaṃ madhu-sarpirbhyāṃ saṃyuktaṃ tvaritaṃ pibet ||
dvitīye vamanaṃ kṛtvā tad-vad evā-gadaṃ pibet | / viṣāpahe prayuñjīta tṛtīye 'ñjana-nāvane ||
pibec caturthe pūrvoktāṃ yavāgūṃ vamane kṛte | / ṣaṣṭha-pañcamayoḥ śītair digdhaṃ siktam abhīkṣṇa-śaḥ ||
pāyayed vamanaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ yavāgūṃ ca viṣāpahaiḥ | / a-gadaṃ saptame tīkṣṇaṃ yuñjyād añjana-nasyayoḥ ||
kṛtvāvagāḍhaṃ śastreṇa mūrdhni kāka-padaṃ tataḥ | / māṃsaṃ sa-rudhiraṃ tasya carma vā tatra nikṣipet ||
tṛtīye vamitaḥ peyāṃ vege maṇḍalināṃ pibet | / a-tīkṣṇam a-gadaṃ ṣaṣṭhe gaṇaṃ vā padmakādikam ||
ādye 'vagāḍhaṃ pracchāya vege daṣṭasya rājilaiḥ | / alābunā hared raktaṃ pūrva-vac cā-gadaṃ pibet ||
ṣaṣṭhe 'ñjanaṃ tīkṣṇa-tamam avapīḍaṃ ca yojayet | / an-ukteṣu ca vegeṣu kriyāṃ darvī-karoditām ||
garbhiṇī-bāla-vṛddheṣu mṛduṃ vidhyet sirāṃ na ca | / tvaṅ manohvā niśe vakraṃ rasaḥ śārdūla-jo nakhaḥ ||
tamālaḥ kesaraṃ śītaṃ pītaṃ taṇḍula-vāriṇā | / hanti sarva-viṣāṇy etad vajraṃ vajram ivāsurān ||
bilvasya mūlaṃ surasasya puṣpaṃ phalaṃ karañjasya nataṃ surāhvam | / phala-trikaṃ vyoṣa-niśā-dvayaṃ ca bastasya mūtreṇa su-sūkṣma-piṣṭam ||
bhujaṅga-lūtondura-vṛścikādyair viṣūcikā-jīrṇa-gara-jvaraiś ca | / ārtān narān bhūta-vidharṣitāṃś ca svasthī-karoty añjana-pāna-nasyaiḥ ||
pralepādyaiś ca niḥśeṣaṃ daṃśād apy uddhared viṣam | / bhūyo vegāya jāyeta śeṣaṃ dūṣī-viṣāya vā ||
viṣāpāye 'nilaṃ kruddhaṃ snehādibhir upācaret | / taila-madya-kulatthāmla-varjyaiḥ pavana-nāśanaiḥ ||
pittaṃ pitta-jvara-haraiḥ kaṣāya-sneha-vastibhiḥ | / sa-mākṣikeṇa vargeṇa kapham āragvadhādinā ||
sitā vaigandhiko drākṣā payasyā madhukaṃ madhu | / pānaṃ sa-mantra-pūtāmbu prokṣaṇaṃ sāntva-harṣaṇam ||
sarpāṅgābhihate yuñjyāt tathā śaṅkā-viṣārdite | / karketanaṃ marakataṃ vajraṃ vāraṇa-mauktikam ||
vaiḍūryaṃ gardabha-maṇiṃ picukaṃ viṣa-mūṣikām | / himavad-giri-sambhūtāṃ somarājīṃ punarnavām ||
tathā droṇāṃ mahā-droṇāṃ mānasīṃ sarpa-jaṃ maṇim | / viṣāṇi viṣa-śānty-arthaṃ vīrya-vanti ca dhārayet ||
chattrī jharjhara-pāṇiś ca cared rātrau viśeṣataḥ | / tac-chāyā-śabda-vitrastāḥ praṇaśyanti bhujaṅgamāḥ ||
sarpāṇām eva viṇ-mūtra-śukrāṇḍa-śava-kotha-jāḥ | / doṣair vyastaiḥ samastaiś ca yuktāḥ kīṭāś catur-vidhāḥ ||
daṣṭasya kīṭair vāyavyair daṃśas toda-rujolbaṇaḥ | / āgneyair alpa-saṃsrāvo dāha-rāga-visarpa-vān ||
pakva-pīlu-phala-prakhyaḥ kharjūra-sadṛśo 'tha-vā | / kaphādhikair manda-rujaḥ pakvodumbara-sannibhaḥ ||
srāvāḍhyaḥ sarva-liṅgas tu vivarjyaḥ sānnipātikaiḥ | / vegāś ca sarpa-vac chopho vardhiṣṇur visra-rakta-tā ||
śiro-'kṣi-gauravaṃ mūrchā bhramaḥ śvāso 'ti-vedanā | / sarveṣāṃ karṇikā śopho jvaraḥ kaṇḍūr a-rocakaḥ ||
vṛścikasya viṣaṃ tīkṣṇam ādau dahati vahni-vat | / ūrdhvam ārohati kṣipraṃ daṃśe paścāt tu tiṣṭhati ||
daṃśaḥ sadyo 'ti-ruk śyāvas tudyate sphuṭatīva ca | / te gavādi-śakṛt-kothād digdha-daṣṭādi-kothataḥ ||
sarpa-kothāc ca sambhūtā manda-madhya-mahā-viṣāḥ | / mandāḥ pītāḥ sitāḥ śyāvā rūkṣāḥ karbura-mecakāḥ ||
romaśā bahu-parvāṇo lohitāḥ pāṇḍurodarāḥ | / dhūmrodarās tri-parvāṇo madhyās tu kapilāruṇāḥ ||
piśaṅgāḥ śabarāś citrāḥ śoṇitābhā mahā-viṣāḥ | / agny-ābhā dvy-eka-parvāṇo raktāsita-sitodarāḥ ||
tair daṣṭaḥ śūna-rasanaḥ stabdha-gātro jvarārditaḥ | / khair vamañ choṇitaṃ kṛṣṇam indriyārthān a-saṃvidan ||
svidyan mūrchan viśuṣkāsyo vihvalo vedanāturaḥ | / viśīryamāṇa-māṃsaś ca prāya-śo vijahāty asūn ||
ucciṭiṅgas tu vaktreṇa daśaty abhyadhika-vyathaḥ | / sādhyato vṛścikāt stambhaṃ śephaso hṛṣṭa-roma-tām ||
karoti sekam aṅgānāṃ daṃśaḥ śītāmbuneva ca | / uṣṭra-dhūmaḥ sa evokto rātri-cārāc ca rātrikaḥ ||
vāta-pittottarāḥ kīṭāḥ ślaiṣmikāḥ kaṇabhondurāḥ | / prāyo vātolbaṇa-viṣā vṛścikāḥ soṣṭra-dhūmakāḥ ||
yasya yasyaiva doṣasya liṅgādhikyaṃ pratarkayet | / tasya tasyauṣadhaiḥ kuryād viparīta-guṇaiḥ kriyām ||
hṛt-pīḍordhvānila-stambhaḥ sirāyāmo 'sthi-parva-ruk | / ghūrṇanodveṣṭanaṃ gātra-śyāva-tā vātike viṣe ||
sañjñā-nāśoṣṇa-niśvāsau hṛd-dāhaḥ kaṭukāsya-tā | / māṃsāvadaraṇaṃ śopho rakta-pītaś ca paittike ||
chardy-a-rocaka-hṛl-lāsa-prasekotkleśa-pīnasaiḥ | / sa-śaitya-mukha-mādhuryair vidyāc chleṣmādhikaṃ viṣam ||
piṇyākena vraṇālepas tailābhyaṅgaś ca vātike | / svedo nāḍī-pulākādyair bṛṃhaṇaś ca vidhir hitaḥ ||
paittikaṃ stambhayet sekaiḥ pradehaiś cāti-śītalaiḥ | / lekhana-cchedana-sveda-vamanaiḥ ślaiṣmikaṃ jayet ||
kīṭānāṃ tri-prakārāṇāṃ traividhyena kriyā hitā | / svedālepana-sekāṃs tu koṣṇān prāyo 'vacārayet ||
anya-tra mūrchitād daṃśa-pākataḥ kothato 'tha-vā | / nṛ-keśāḥ sarṣapāḥ pītā guḍo jīrṇaś ca dhūpanam ||
viṣa-daṃśasya sarvasya kāśyapaḥ param abravīt | / viṣa-ghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ sarvaṃ kuryāt saṃśodhanāni ca ||
sādhayet sarpa-vad daṣṭān viṣograiḥ kīṭa-vṛścikaiḥ | / taṇḍulīyaka-tulyāṃśāṃ trivṛtāṃ sarpiṣā pibet ||
yāti kīṭa-viṣaiḥ kampaṃ na kailāsa ivānilaiḥ | / kṣīri-vṛkṣa-tvag-ālepaḥ śuddhe kīṭa-viṣāpahaḥ ||
muktā-lepo varaḥ śopha-toda-dāha-jvara-praṇut | / vacā-hiṅgu-viḍaṅgāni saindhavaṃ gaja-pippalī ||
pāṭhā prativiṣā vyoṣaṃ kāśyapena vinirmitam | / daśāṅgam a-gadaṃ pītvā sarva-kīṭa-viṣaṃ jayet ||
sadyo vṛścika-jaṃ daṃśaṃ cakra-tailena secayet | / vidārigandhā-siddhena kavoṣṇenetareṇa vā ||
lavaṇottama-yuktena sarpiṣā vā punaḥ punaḥ | / siñcet koṣṇāranālena sa-kṣīra-lavaṇena vā ||
upanāho ghṛte bhṛṣṭaḥ kalko 'jājyāḥ sa-saindhavaḥ | / ādaṃśaṃ sveditaṃ cūrṇaiḥ pracchāya pratisārayet ||
rajanī-saindhava-vyoṣa-śirīṣa-phala-puṣpa-jaiḥ | / mātuluṅgāmla-go-mūtra-piṣṭaṃ ca surasāgra-jam ||
lepaḥ sukhoṣṇaś ca hitaḥ piṇyāko go-mayo 'pi vā | / pāne sarpir madhu-yutaṃ kṣīraṃ vā bhūri-śarkaram ||
pārāvata-śakṛt pathyā tagaraṃ viśva-bheṣajam | / bījapūra-rasonmiśraḥ paramo vṛścikā-gadaḥ ||
sa-śaivaloṣṭra-daṃṣṭrā ca hanti vṛścika-jaṃ viṣam | / hiṅgunā haritālena mātuluṅga-rasena ca ||
lepāñjanābhyāṃ guṭikā paramaṃ vṛścikāpahā | / karañjārjuna-śelūnāṃ kaṭabhyāṃ kuṭajasya ca ||
śirīṣasya ca puṣpāṇi mastunā daṃśa-lepanam | / yo muhyati praśvasiti pralapaty ugra-vedanaḥ ||
tasya pathyā-niśā-kṛṣṇā-mañjiṣṭhātiviṣoṣaṇam | / sālābu-vṛntaṃ vārtāka-rasa-piṣṭaṃ pralepanam ||
sarva-tra cogrāli-viṣe pāyayed dadhi-sarpiṣī || 39ab || / vidhyet sirāṃ vidadhyāc ca vamanāñjana-nāvanam || 39cd || / uṣṇa-snigdhāmla-madhuraṃ bhojanaṃ cānilāpaham || 39ef ||
nāgaraṃ gṛha-kapota-purīṣaṃ bījapūraka-raso haritālam | / saindhavaṃ ca vinihanty a-gado 'yaṃ lepato 'li-kula-jaṃ viṣam āśu ||
ante vṛścika-daṣṭānāṃ samudīrṇe bhṛśaṃ viṣe | / viṣeṇālepayed daṃśam ucciṭiṅge 'py ayaṃ vidhiḥ ||
nāga-purīṣa-cchattraṃ rohiṣa-mūlaṃ ca śelu-toyena | / kuryād guṭikāṃ lepād iyam ali-viṣa-nāśanī śreṣṭhā ||
arkasya dugdhena śirīṣa-bījaṃ trir bhāvitaṃ pippali-cūrṇa-miśram | / eṣo '-gado hanti viṣāṇi kīṭa-bhujaṅga-lūtondura-vṛścikānām ||
śirīṣa-puṣpaṃ sa-karañja-bījaṃ kāśmīra-jaṃ kuṣṭha-manaḥśile ca | / eṣo '-gado rātrika-vṛścikānāṃ saṅkrānti-kārī kathito jinena ||
kīṭebhyo dāruṇa-tarā lūṭāḥ ṣo-ḍaśa tā jaguḥ | / aṣṭā-viṃśatir ity eke tato 'py anye tu bhūyasīḥ ||
sahasra-raśmy-anucarā vadanty anye sahasra-śaḥ | / bahūpadrava-rūpā tu lūtaikaiva viṣātmikā ||
rūpāṇi nāmatas tasyā dur-jñeyāny ati-saṅkarāt | / nāsti sthāna-vyavasthā ca doṣato 'taḥ pracakṣate ||
kṛcchra-sādhyā pṛthag-doṣair a-sādhyā nicayena sā | / tad-daṃśaḥ paittiko dāha-tṛṭ-sphoṭa-jvara-moha-vān ||
bhṛśoṣṃā rakta-pītābhaḥ kledī drākṣā-phalopamaḥ | / ślaiṣmikaḥ kaṭhinaḥ pāṇḍuḥ parūṣaka-phalākṛtiḥ ||
nidrāṃ śīta-jvaraṃ kāsaṃ kaṇḍūṃ ca kurute bhṛśam | / vātikaḥ paruṣaḥ śyāvaḥ parva-bheda-jvara-pradaḥ ||
tad-vibhāgaṃ yathā-svaṃ ca doṣa-liṅgair vibhāvayet | / a-sādhyāyāṃ tu hṛn-moha-śvāsa-hidhmā-śiro-grahāḥ ||
śveta-pītāsitā-raktāḥ piṭikāḥ śvayathūdbhavaḥ | / vepathur vamathur dāhas tṛḍ āndhyaṃ vakra-nāsa-tā ||
śyāvauṣṭha-vaktra-danta-tvaṃ pṛṣṭha-grīvāvabhañjanam | / pakva-jambū-sa-varṇaṃ ca daṃśāt sravati śoṇitam ||
sarvāpi sarva-jā prāyo vyapadeśas tu bhūyasā | / tīkṣṇa-madhyāvara-tvena sā tri-dhā hanty upekṣitā ||
saptāhena daśāhena pakṣeṇa ca paraṃ kramāt | / lūtā-daṃśaś ca sarvo 'pi dadrū-maṇḍala-sannibhaḥ ||
sito 'sito 'ruṇaḥ pītaḥ śyāvo vā mṛdur unnataḥ | / madhye kṛṣṇo 'tha-vā śyāvaḥ pary-ante jālakāvṛtaḥ ||
visarpa-vāṃś chopha-yutas tapyate bahu-vedanaḥ | / jvarāśu-pāka-vikleda-kothāvadaraṇānvitaḥ ||
kledena yat spṛśaty aṅgaṃ tatrāpi kurute vraṇam | / śvāsa-daṃṣṭrā-śakṛn-mūtra-śukra-lālā-nakhārtavaiḥ ||
aṣṭābhir udvamaty eṣā viṣaṃ vaktrād viśeṣataḥ | / lūtā nābher daśaty ūrdhvam ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca kīṭakāḥ ||
tad-dūṣitaṃ ca vastrādi dehe pṛktaṃ vikāra-kṛt | / dinārdhaṃ lakṣyate naiva daṃśo lūtā-viṣodbhavaḥ ||
sūcī-vyadha-vad ābhāti tato 'sau prathame 'hani | / a-vyakta-varṇaḥ pracalaḥ kiñ-cit-kaṇḍū-rujānvitaḥ ||
dvitīye 'bhyunnato 'nteṣu piṭikair iva vācitaḥ | / vyakta-varṇo nato madhye kaṇḍū-mān granthi-sannibhaḥ ||
tṛtīye sa-jvaro roma-harṣa-kṛd rakta-maṇḍalaḥ | / śarāva-rūpas todāḍhyo roma-kūpeṣu sāsravaḥ ||
mahāṃś caturthe śvayathus tāpa-śvāsa-bhrama-pradaḥ | / vikārān kurute tāṃs tān pañcame viṣa-kopa-jān ||
ṣaṣṭhe vyāpnoti marmāṇi saptame hanti jīvitam | / iti tīkṣṇaṃ viṣaṃ madhyaṃ hīnaṃ ca vibhajed ataḥ ||
eka-viṃśati-rātreṇa viṣaṃ śāmyati sarva-thā | / athāśu lūtā-daṣṭasya śastreṇādaṃśam uddharet ||
dahec ca jāmbavauṣṭhādyair na tu pittottaraṃ dahet | / karkaśaṃ bhinna-romāṇaṃ marma-sandhy-ādi-saṃśritam ||
prasṛtaṃ sarvato daṃśaṃ na cchindīta dahen na ca | / lepayed dagdham a-gadair madhu-saindhava-saṃyutaiḥ ||
su-śītaiḥ secayec cānu kaṣāyaiḥ kṣīri-vṛkṣa-jaiḥ | / sarvato 'pahared raktaṃ śṛṅgādyaiḥ sirayāpi vā ||
seka-lepās tataḥ śītā bodhi-śleṣmātakākṣakaiḥ | / phalinī-dvi-niśā-kṣaudra-sarpirbhiḥ padmakāhvayaḥ ||
a-śeṣa-lūtā-kīṭānām a-gadaḥ sārvakārmikaḥ | / haridrā-dvaya-pattaṅga-mañjiṣṭhā-nata-kesaraiḥ ||
sa-kṣaudra-sarpiḥ pūrvasmād adhikaś campakāhvayaḥ | / tad-vad go-maya-niṣpīḍa-śarkarā-ghṛta-mākṣikaiḥ ||
apāmārga-mano'hvāla-dārvī-dhyāmaka-gairikaiḥ | / natailā-kuṣṭha-marica-yaṣṭy-āhva-ghṛta-mākṣikaiḥ ||
a-gado mandaro nāma tathānyo gandha-mādanaḥ | / nata-lodhra-vacā-kaṭvī-pāṭhailā-pattra-kuṅkumaiḥ ||
viṣa-ghnaṃ bahu-doṣeṣu prayuñjīta viśodhanam | / yaṣṭy-āhva-madanāṅkolla-jālinī-sindhuvārikāḥ ||
kaphe jyeṣṭhāmbunā pītvā viṣam āśu samudvamet | / śirīṣa-pattra-tvaṅ-mūla-phalaṃ vāṅkolla-mūla-vat ||
virecayec ca tri-phalā-nīlinī-trivṛtādibhiḥ | / nivṛtte dāha-śophādau karṇikāṃ pātayed vraṇāt ||
kusumbha-puṣpaṃ go-dantaḥ svarṇakṣīrī kapota-viṭ | / trivṛtā saindhavaṃ dantī karṇikā-pātanaṃ tathā ||
mūlam uttaravāruṇyā vaṃśa-nirlekha-saṃyutam | / tad-vac ca saindhavaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ dantī kaṭuka-daugdhikam ||
rāja-kośātakī-mūlaṃ kiṇvo vā mathitodbhavaḥ | / karṇikā-pāta-samaye bṛṃhayec ca viṣāpahaiḥ ||
sneha-kāryam a-śeṣaṃ ca sarpiṣaiva samācaret | / viṣasya vṛddhaye tailam agner iva tṛṇolupam ||
hrīvera-vaikaṅkata-gopakanyā-mustā-śamī-candana-ṭuṇṭukāni | / śaivāla-nīlotpala-vakra-yaṣṭī-tvaṅ-nākulī-padmaka-rāṭha-madhyam ||
rajanī-ghana-sarpalocanā-kaṇa-śuṇṭhī-kaṇa-mūla-citrakāḥ | / varuṇāguru-bilva-pāṭalī-picumandāmaya-śelu-kesaram ||
bilva-candana-natotpala-śuṇṭhī-pippalī-nicula-vetasa-kuṣṭham | / śukti-śāka-vara-pāṭali-bhārgī-sindhuvāra-karaghāṭa-varāṅgam ||
pitta-kaphānila-lūtāḥ pānāñjana-nasya-lepa-sekena | / a-gada-varā vṛtta-sthāḥ ku-gatīr iva vārayanty ete ||
lodhraṃ sevyaṃ padmakaṃ padma-reṇuḥ kālīyākhyaṃ candanaṃ yac ca raktam | / kāntā-puṣpaṃ dugdhinīkā mṛṇālaṃ lūtāḥ sarvā ghnanti sarva-kriyābhiḥ ||
lālanaś capalaḥ putro hasiraś cikkiro 'jiraḥ | / kaṣāya-dantaḥ kulakaḥ kokilaḥ kapilo 'sitaḥ ||
aruṇaḥ śabaraḥ śvetaḥ kapotaḥ palitonduraḥ | / chucchundaro rasālākhyo daśāṣṭau ceti mūṣikāḥ ||
śukraṃ patati yatraiṣāṃ śukra-digdhaiḥ spṛśanti vā | / yad aṅgam aṅgais tatrāsre dūṣite pāṇḍu-tāṃ gate ||
granthayaḥ śvayathuḥ koṭho maṇḍalāni bhramo '-ruciḥ | / śīta-jvaro 'ti-ruk sādo vepathuḥ parva-bhedanam ||
roma-harṣaḥ srutir mūrchā dīrgha-kālānubandhanam | / śleṣmānubaddha-bahv-ākhu-potaka-cchardanaṃ sa-tṛṭ ||
vyavāyy ākhu-viṣaṃ kṛcchraṃ bhūyo bhūyaś ca kupyati | / mūrchāṅga-śopha-vaivarṇya-kleda-śabdā-śruti-jvarāḥ ||
śiro-guru-tvaṃ lālāsṛk-chardiś cā-sādhya-lakṣaṇam | / śūna-vastiṃ vi-varṇauṣṭham ākhv-ābhair granthibhiś citam ||
chucchundara-sa-gandhaṃ ca varjayed ākhu-dūṣitam | / śunaḥ śleṣmolbaṇā doṣāḥ sañjñāṃ sañjñā-vahāśritāḥ ||
muṣṇantaḥ kurvate kṣobhaṃ dhātūnām ati-dāruṇam | / lālā-vān andha-badhiraḥ sarvataḥ so 'bhidhāvati ||
srasta-puccha-hanu-skandhaḥ śiro-duḥkhī natānanaḥ | / daṃśas tena vidaṣṭasya suptaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṣaraty asṛk ||
hṛc-chiro-rug-jvara-stambha-tṛṣṇā-mūrchodbhavo 'nu ca | / anenānye 'pi boddhavyā vyālā daṃṣṭrā-prahāriṇaḥ ||
śṛgālāśvatarāśvarkṣa-dvīpi-vyāghra-vṛkādayaḥ | / kaṇḍū-nistoda-vaivarṇya-supti-kleda-jvara-bhramāḥ ||
vidāha-rāga-ruk-pāka-śopha-granthi-vikuñcanam | / daṃśāvadaraṇaṃ sphoṭāḥ karṇikā maṇḍalāni ca ||
sarva-tra sa-viṣe liṅgaṃ viparītaṃ tu nir-viṣe | / daṣṭo yena tu tac-ceṣṭā-rutaṃ kurvan vinaśyati ||
paśyaṃs tam eva cā-kasmād ādarśa-salilādiṣu | / yo 'dbhyas trasyed a-daṣṭo 'pi śabda-saṃsparśa-darśanaiḥ ||
jala-santrāsa-nāmānaṃ daṣṭaṃ tam api varjayet | / ākhunā daṣṭa-mātrasya daṃśaṃ kāṇḍena dāhayet ||
darpaṇenātha-vā tīvra-rujā syāt karṇikānya-thā | / dagdhaṃ visrāvayed daṃśaṃ pracchitaṃ ca pralepayet ||
śirīṣa-rajanī-vakra-kuṅkumāmṛtavallibhiḥ | / agāra-dhūma-mañjiṣṭhā-rajanī-lavaṇottamaiḥ ||
lepo jayaty ākhu-viṣaṃ karṇikāyāś ca pātanaḥ | / tato 'mlaiḥ kṣālayitvānu toyair anu ca lepayet ||
pālindī-śveta-kaṭabhī-bilva-mūla-guḍūcibhiḥ | / anyaiś ca viṣa-śopha-ghnaiḥ sirāṃ vā mokṣayed drutam ||
chardanaṃ nīlinī-kvāthaiḥ śukākhyāṅkollayor api | / kośātakyāḥ śukākhyāyāḥ phalaṃ jīmūtakasya ca ||
madanasya ca sañcūrṇya dadhnā pītvā viṣaṃ vamet | / vacā-madana-jīmūta-kuṣṭhaṃ vā mūtra-peṣitam ||
pūrva-kalpena pātavyaṃ sarvondura-viṣāpaham | / virecanaṃ trivṛn-nīlī-tri-phalā-kalka iṣyate ||
śiro-virecane sāraḥ śirīṣasya phalāni ca | / añjanaṃ go-maya-raso vyoṣa-sūkṣma-rajo-'nvitaḥ ||
kapittha-go-maya-raso madhu-mān avalehanam | / taṇḍulīyaka-mūlena siddhaṃ pāne hitaṃ ghṛtam ||
dvi-niśā-kaṭabhī-raktā-yaṣṭy-āhvair vāmṛtānvitaiḥ | / āsphota-mūla-siddhaṃ vā pañca-kāpittham eva vā ||
sindhuvāraṃ nataṃ śigru-bilva-mūlaṃ punarnavā | / vacā-śvadaṃṣṭrā-jīmūtam eṣāṃ kvāthaṃ sa-mākṣikam ||
pibec chāly-odanaṃ dadhnā bhuñjāno mūṣikārditaḥ | / takreṇa śarapuṅkhāyā bījaṃ sañcūrṇya vā pibet ||
aṅkolla-mūla-kalko vā basta-mūtreṇa kalkitaḥ | / pānālepanayor yuktaḥ sarvākhu-viṣa-nāśanaḥ ||
kapittha-madhya-tilaka-tilāṅkolla-jaṭāḥ pibet | / gavāṃ mūtreṇa payasā mañjarīṃ tilakasya vā ||
atha-vā sairyakān mūlaṃ sa-kṣaudraṃ taṇḍulāmbunā | / kaṭukālābu-vinyastaṃ pītaṃ vāmbu niśoṣitam ||
sindhuvārasya mūlāni biḍālāsthi viṣaṃ natam | / jala-piṣṭo '-gado hanti nasyādyair ākhu-jaṃ viṣam ||
sa-śeṣaṃ mūṣika-viṣaṃ prakupyaty abhra-darśane | / yathā-yathaṃ vā kāleṣu doṣāṇāṃ vṛddhi-hetuṣu ||
tatra sarve yathāvasthaṃ prayojyāḥ syur upakramāḥ | / yathā-svaṃ ye ca nirdiṣṭās tathā dūṣī-viṣāpahāḥ ||
daṃśaṃ tv alarka-daṣṭasya dagdham uṣṇena sarpiṣā | / pradihyād a-gadais tais taiḥ purāṇaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ pibet ||
arka-kṣīra-yutaṃ cāsya yojyam āśu virecanam | / aṅkollottara-mūlāmbu tri-palaṃ sa-haviḥ-palam ||
pibet sa-dhattūra-phalāṃ śvetāṃ vāpi punarnavām | / aikadhyaṃ palalaṃ tailaṃ rūpikāyāḥ payo guḍaḥ ||
bhinatti viṣam ālarkaṃ ghana-vṛndam ivānilaḥ | / sa-mantraṃ sauṣadhī-ratnaṃ snapanaṃ ca prayojayet ||
catuṣ-pādbhir dvi-pādbhir vā nakha-danta-parikṣatam | / śūyate pacyate rāga-jvara-srāva-rujānvitam ||
somavalko 'śvakarṇaś ca gojihvā haṃsapādikā | / rajanyau gairikaṃ lepo nakha-danta-viṣāpahaḥ ||
dīrgham āyuḥ smṛtiṃ medhām ārogyaṃ taruṇaṃ vayaḥ | / prabhā-varṇa-svaraudāryaṃ dehendriya-balodayam ||
vāk-siddhiṃ vṛṣa-tāṃ kāntim avāpnoti rasāyanāt | / lābhopāyo hi śastānāṃ rasādīnāṃ rasāyanam ||
pūrve vayasi madhye vā tat prayojyaṃ jitātmanaḥ | / snigdhasya sruta-raktasya viśuddhasya ca sarva-thā ||
a-viśuddhe śarīre hi yukto rāsāyano vidhiḥ | / vājī-karo vā maline vastre raṅga ivā-phalaḥ ||
rasāyanānāṃ dvi-vidhaṃ prayogam ṛṣayo viduḥ | / kuṭī-prāveśikaṃ mukhyaṃ vātātapikam anya-thā ||
pure prāpyopakaraṇe harmya-nir-vāta-nir-bhaye | / diśy udīcyāṃ śubhe deśe tri-garbhāṃ sūkṣma-locanām ||
dhūmātapa-rajo-vyāla-strī-mūrkhādya-vilaṅghitām | / sajja-vaidyopakaraṇāṃ su-mṛṣṭāṃ kārayet kuṭīm ||
atha puṇye 'hni sampūjya pūjyāṃs tāṃ praviśec chuciḥ | / tatra saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhaḥ sukhī jāta-balaḥ punaḥ ||
brahma-cārī dhṛti-yutaḥ śrad-dadhāno jitendriyaḥ | / dāna-śīla-dayā-satya-vrata-dharma-parāyaṇaḥ ||
devatānusmṛtau yukto yukta-svapna-prajāgaraḥ | / priyauṣadhaḥ peśala-vāg ārabheta rasāyanam ||
harītakīm āmalakaṃ saindhavaṃ nāgaraṃ vacām | / haridrāṃ pippalīṃ vellaṃ guḍaṃ coṣṇāmbunā pibet ||
snigdha-svinno naraḥ pūrvaṃ tena sādhu viricyate | / tataḥ śuddha-śarīrāya kṛta-saṃsarjanāya ca ||
tri-rātraṃ pañca-rātraṃ vā saptāhaṃ vā ghṛtānvitam | / dadyād yāvakam ā-śuddheḥ purāṇa-śakṛto 'tha-vā ||
itthaṃ saṃskṛta-koṣṭhasya rasāyanam upāharet | / yasya yad yaugikaṃ paśyet sarvam ālocya sātmya-vit ||
pathyā-sahasraṃ tri-guṇa-dhātrī-phala-samanvitam | / pañcānāṃ pañca-mūlānāṃ sārdhaṃ pala-śata-dvayam ||
jale daśa-guṇe paktvā daśa-bhāga-sthite rase | / āpothya kṛtvā vy-asthīni vijayāmalakāny atha ||
vinīya tasmin niryūhe yojayet kuḍavāṃśakam | / tvag-elā-musta-rajanī-pippaly-aguru-candanam ||
maṇḍūkaparṇī-kanaka-śaṅkhapuṣpī-vacā-plavam | / yaṣṭy-āhvayaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ ca cūrṇitaṃ tulayādhikam ||
sitopalārdha-bhāraṃ ca pātrāṇi trīṇi sarpiṣaḥ | / dve ca tailāt pacet sarvaṃ tad agnau leha-tāṃ gatam ||
avatīrṇaṃ himaṃ yuñjyād viṃśaiḥ kṣaudra-śatais tribhiḥ | / tataḥ khajena mathitaṃ nidadhyād ghṛta-bhājane ||
yā noparundhyād āhāram ekaṃ mātrāsya sā smṛtā | / ṣaṣṭikaḥ payasā cātra jīrṇe bhojanam iṣyate ||
vaikhānasā bālakhilyās tathā cānye tapo-dhanāḥ | / brahmaṇā vihitaṃ dhanyam idaṃ prāśya rasāyanam ||
tandrā-śrama-klama-valī-palitāmaya-varjitāḥ | / medhā-smṛti-balopetā babhūvur a-mitāyuṣaḥ ||
abhayāmalaka-sahasraṃ nir-āmayaṃ pippalī-sahasra-yutam | / taruṇa-palāśa-kṣāra-dravī-kṛtaṃ sthāpayed bhāṇḍe ||
upayukte ca kṣāre chāyā-saṃśuṣka-cūrṇitaṃ yojyam | / pādāṃśena sitāyāś catur-guṇābhyāṃ madhu-ghṛtābhyām ||
tad ghṛta-kumbhe bhūmau nidhāya ṣaṇ-māsa-saṃstham uddhṛtya | / prāhṇe prāśya yathānalam ucitāhāro bhavet satatam ||
ity upayuñjyā-śeṣaṃ varṣa-śatam an-āmayo jarā-rahitaḥ | / jīvati bala-puṣṭi-vapuḥ-smṛti-medhādy-anvito viśeṣeṇa ||
nī-rujārdra-palāśasya cchinne śirasi tat kṣatam | / antar dvi-hastaṃ gambhīraṃ pūryam āmalakair navaiḥ ||
ā-mūlaṃ veṣṭitaṃ darbhaiḥ padminī-paṅka-lepitam | / ādīpya go-mayair vanyair nir-vāte svedayet tataḥ ||
svinnāni tāny āmalakāni tṛptyā khāden naraḥ kṣaudra-ghṛtānvitāni | / kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ cānu pibet pra-kāmaṃ tenaiva varteta ca māsam ekam ||
varjyāni varjyāni ca tatra yatnāt spṛśyaṃ ca śītāmbu na pāṇināpi | / ekā-daśāhe 'sya tato vyatīte patanti keśā daśanā nakhāś ca ||
athālpakair eva dinaiḥ su-rūpaḥ strīṣv a-kṣayaḥ kuñjara-tulya-vīryaḥ | / viśiṣṭa-medhā-bala-buddhi-sat-tvo bhavaty asau varṣa-sahasra-jīvī ||
daśa-mūla-balā-musta-jīvakarṣabhakotpalam | / parṇinyau pippalī śṛṅgī medā tāmalakī truṭī ||
jīvantī joṅgakaṃ drākṣā pauṣkaraṃ candanaṃ śaṭhī | / punarnavarddhi-kākolī-kākanāsāmṛtā-dvayam ||
vidārī vṛṣa-mūlaṃ ca tad aikadhyaṃ palonmitam | / jala-droṇe pacet pañca dhātrī-phala-śatāni ca ||
pāda-śeṣaṃ rasaṃ tasmād vy-asthīny āmalakāni ca | / gṛhītvā bharjayet taila-ghṛtād dvā-daśabhiḥ palaiḥ ||
matsyaṇḍikā-tulārdhena yuktaṃ tal leha-vat pacet | / snehārdhaṃ madhu siddhe tu tavakṣīryāś catuḥ-palam ||
pippalyā dvi-palaṃ dadyāc catur-jātaṃ kaṇārdhitam | / ato 'valehayen mātrāṃ kuṭī-sthaḥ pathya-bhojanaḥ ||
ity eṣa cyavana-prāśo yaṃ prāśya cyavano muniḥ | / jarā-jarjarito 'py āsīn nārī-nayana-nandanaḥ ||
kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ jvaraṃ śoṣaṃ hṛd-rogaṃ vāta-śoṇitam | / mūtra-śukrāśrayān doṣān vaisvaryaṃ ca vyapohati ||

bāla-vṛddha-kṣata-kṣīṇa-kṛśānām aṅga-vardhanaḥ || 41ab || / medhāṃ smṛtiṃ kāntim an-āmaya-tvam āyuḥ-prakarṣaṃ pavanānulomyam || 41cd || / strīṣu praharṣaṃ balam indriyāṇām agneś ca kuryād vidhinopayuktaḥ || 41ef ||
madhukena tavakṣīryā pippalyā sindhu-janmanā | / pṛthag lohaiḥ suvarṇena vacayā madhu-sarpiṣā ||
sitayā vā samā yuktā samāyuktā rasāyanam | / tri-phalā sarva-roga-ghnī medhāyuḥ-smṛti-buddhi-dā ||
maṇḍūkaparṇyāḥ sva-rasaṃ yathāgni kṣīreṇa yaṣṭīmadhukasya cūrṇam | / rasaṃ guḍūcyās saha-mūla-puṣpyāḥ kalkaṃ prayuñjīta ca śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ ||
āyuḥ-pradāny āmaya-nāśanāni balāgni-varṇa-svara-vardhanāni | / medhyāni caitāni rasāyanāni medhyā viśeṣeṇa tu śaṅkhapuṣpī ||
naladaṃ kaṭu-rohiṇī payasyā madhukaṃ candana-śārivogragandhāḥ | / tri-phalā kaṭuka-trayaṃ haridre sa-paṭolaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca taiḥ su-piṣṭaiḥ ||
tri-guṇena rasena śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ sa-payaskaṃ ghṛta-nalvaṇaṃ vipakvam | / upayujya bhavej jaḍo 'pi vāṅmī śruta-dhārī pratibhāna-vān a-rogaḥ ||
peṣyair mṛṇāla-bisa-kesara-pattra-bījaiḥ siddhaṃ sa-hema-śakalaṃ payasā ca sarpiḥ | / pañcāravindam iti tat prathitaṃ pṛthivyāṃ prabhraṣṭa-pauruṣa-bala-pratibhair niṣevyam ||
yan nāla-kanda-dala-kesara-vad vipakvaṃ nīlotpalasya tad api prathitaṃ dvitīyam | / sarpiś catuṣ-kuvalayaṃ sa-hiraṇya-pattraṃ medhyaṃ gavām api bhavet kim u mānuṣāṇām ||
brāhmī-vacā-saindhava-śaṅkhapuṣpī-matsyākṣaka-brahmasuvarcalaindryaḥ | / vaidehikā ca tri-yavāḥ pṛthak syur yavau suvarṇasya tilo viṣasya ||
sarpiṣaś ca palam ekata etad yojayet pariṇate ca ghṛtāḍhyam | / bhojanaṃ sa-madhu vatsaram evaṃ śīlayann adhika-dhī-smṛti-medhaḥ ||
atikrānta-jarā-vyādhi-tandrālasya-śrama-klamaḥ | / jīvaty abda-śataṃ pūrṇaṃ śrī-tejaḥ-kānti-dīpti-mān ||
viśeṣataḥ kuṣṭha-kilāsa-gulma-viṣa-jvaronmāda-garodarāṇi | / atharva-mantrādi-kṛtāś ca kṛtyāḥ śāmyanty anenāti-balāś ca vātāḥ ||
śaran-mukhe nāgabalāṃ puṣya-yoge samuddharet | / akṣa-mātraṃ tato mūlāc cūrṇitāt payasā pibet ||
lihyān madhu-ghṛtābhyāṃ vā kṣīra-vṛttir an-anna-bhuk | / evaṃ varṣa-prayogena jīved varṣa-śataṃ balī ||
phalon-mukho gokṣurakaḥ sa-mūlaś chāyā-viśuṣkaḥ su-vicūrṇitāṅgaḥ | / su-bhāvitaḥ svena rasena tasmān mātrāṃ parāṃ prāsṛtikīṃ pibed yaḥ ||
kṣīreṇa tenaiva ca śālim aśnan jīrṇe bhavet sa dvi-tulopayogāt | / śaktaḥ su-rūpaḥ su-bhagaḥ śatāyuḥ kāmī kakud-mān iva go-kula-sthaḥ ||
vārāhī-kandam ārdrārdraṃ kṣīreṇa kṣīra-paḥ pibet | / māsaṃ nir-anno māsaṃ ca kṣīrānnādo jarāṃ jayet ||
tat-kanda-ślakṣṇa-cūrṇaṃ vā sva-rasena su-bhāvitam | / ghṛta-kṣaudra-plutaṃ lihyāt tat-pakvaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ pibet ||
tad-vad vidāry-atibalā-balā-madhuka-vāyasīḥ | / śreyasī-śreyasī-yuktā-pathyā-dhātrī-sthirāmṛtāḥ ||
maṇḍūkī-śaṅkhakusumā-vājigandhā-śatāvarīḥ | / upayuñjīta medhā-dhī-vayaḥ-sthairya-bala-pradāḥ ||
yathā-svaṃ citrakaḥ puṣpair jñeyaḥ pīta-sitāsitaiḥ | / yathottaraṃ sa guṇa-vān vidhinā ca rasāyanam ||
chāyā-śuṣkaṃ tato mūlaṃ māsaṃ cūrṇī-kṛtaṃ lihan | / sarpiṣā madhu-sarpirbhyāṃ piban vā payasā yatiḥ ||
ambhasā vā hitānnāśī śataṃ jīvati nī-rujaḥ | / medhāvī bala-vān kānto vapuṣ-mān dīpta-pāvakaḥ ||
tailena līḍho māsena vātān hanti su-dus-tarān | / mūtreṇa śvitra-kuṣṭhāni pītas takreṇa pāyu-jān ||
bhallātakāni puṣṭāni dhānya-rāśau nidhāpayet | / grīṣme saṅgṛhya hemante svādu-snigdha-himair vapuḥ ||
saṃskṛtya tāny aṣṭa-guṇe salile 'ṣṭau vipācayet | / aṣṭāṃśa-śiṣṭaṃ tat-kvāthaṃ sa-kṣīraṃ śītalaṃ pibet ||
vardhayet praty-ahaṃ cānu tatraikaikam aruṣkaram | / sapta-rātra-trayaṃ yāvat trīṇi trīṇi tataḥ param ||
ā-catvāriṃśatas tāni hrāsayed vṛddhi-vat tataḥ | / sahasram upayuñjīta saptāhair iti saptabhiḥ ||
yantritātmā ghṛta-kṣīra-śāli-ṣaṣṭika-bhojanaḥ | / tad-vat tri-guṇitaṃ kālaṃ prayogānte 'pi cācaret ||
āśiṣo labhate '-pūrvā vahner dīptiṃ viśeṣataḥ | / prameha-kṛmi-kuṣṭhārśo-medo-doṣa-vivarjitaḥ ||
piṣṭa-svedanam a-rujaiḥ pūrṇaṃ bhallātakair vijarjaritaiḥ | / bhūmi-nikhāte kumbhe pratiṣṭhitaṃ kṛṣṇa-mṛl-liptam ||
parivāritaṃ samantāt pacet tato go-mayāgninā mṛdunā | / tat-sva-raso yaś cyavate gṛhṇīyāt taṃ dine 'nyasmin ||
amum upayujya sva-rasaṃ madhv-aṣṭama-bhāgikaṃ dvi-guṇa-sarpiḥ | / pūrva-vidhi-yantritātmā prāpnoti guṇān sa tān eva ||
puṣṭāni pākena paricyutāni bhallātakāny āḍhaka-sammitāni | / ghṛṣṭveṣṭikā-cūrṇa-kaṇair jalena prakṣālya saṃśoṣya ca mārutena ||
jarjarāṇi vipacej jala-kumbhe pāda-śeṣa-ghṛta-gālita-śītam | / tad-rasaṃ punar api śrapayeta kṣīra-kumbha-sahitaṃ caraṇa-sthe ||
sarpiḥ pakvaṃ tatra tulya-pramāṇaṃ yuñjyāt svecchaṃ śarkarayā rajobhiḥ | / ekī-bhūtaṃ tat khaja-kṣobhaṇena sthāpyaṃ dhānye sapta-rātraṃ su-guptam ||
tam amṛta-rasa-pākaṃ yaḥ prage prāśam aśnann anupibati yatheṣṭaṃ vāri dugdhaṃ rasaṃ vā | / smṛti-mati-bala-medhā-sat-tva-sārair upetaḥ kanaka-nicaya-gauraḥ so 'śnute dīrgham āyuḥ ||
droṇe 'mbhaso vraṇakṛtāṃ tri-śatād vipakvāt kvāthāḍhake pala-samais tila-taila-pātram | / tiktā-viṣā-dvaya-varā-girijanma-tārkṣyaiḥ siddhaṃ paraṃ nikhila-kuṣṭha-nibarhaṇāya ||

sahāmalaka-śuktibhir dadhi-sareṇa tailena vā || 80a || / guḍena payasā ghṛtena yava-saktubhir vā saha || 80b || / tilena saha mākṣikeṇa palalena sūpena vā || 80c || / vapuṣ-karam aruṣkaraṃ parama-medhyam āyuṣ-karam || 80d ||
bhallātakāni tīkṣṇāni pākīny agni-samāni ca | / bhavanty amṛta-kalpāni prayuktāni yathā-vidhi ||
kapha-jo na sa rogo 'sti na vibandho 'sti kaś-ca-na | / yaṃ na bhallātakaṃ hanyāc chīghram agni-bala-pradam ||
vātātapa-vidhāne 'pi viśeṣeṇa vivarjayet | / kulattha-dadhi-śuktāni tailābhyaṅgāgni-sevanam ||
vṛkṣās tubarakā nāma paścimārṇava-tīra-jāḥ | / vīcī-taraṅga-vikṣobha-mārutoddhūta-pallavāḥ ||
tebhyaḥ phalāny ādadīta su-pakvāny ambu-dāgame | / majjñaḥ phalebhyaś cādāya śoṣayitvāvacūrṇya ca ||
tila-vat pīḍayed droṇyāṃ kvāthayed vā kusumbha-vat | / tat-tailaṃ sambhṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ paced ā-salila-kṣayāt ||
avatārya karīṣe ca pakṣa-mātraṃ nidhāpayet | / snigdha-svinno hṛta-malaḥ pakṣād uddhṛtya tat tataḥ ||
caturtha-bhaktāntaritaḥ prātaḥ pāṇi-talaṃ pibet | / mantreṇānena pūtasya tailasya divase śubhe ||
majja-sāra mahā-vīrya sarvān dhātūn viśodhaya | / śaṅkha-cakra-gadā-pāṇis tvām ājñāpayate '-cyutaḥ ||
tenāsyordhvam adhas-tāc ca doṣā yānty a-sakṛt tataḥ | / sāyam a-sneha-lavaṇāṃ yavāgūṃ śītalāṃ pibet ||
pañcāhāni pibet tailam itthaṃ varjyān vivarjayan | / pakṣaṃ mudga-rasānnāśī sarva-kuṣṭhair vimucyate ||
tad eva khadira-kvāthe tri-guṇe sādhu sādhitam | / nihitaṃ pūrva-vat pakṣaṃ piben māsaṃ su-yantritaḥ ||
tenābhyakta-śarīraś ca kurvann āhāram īritam | / anenāśu prayogeṇa sādhayet kuṣṭhinaṃ naram ||
sarpir-madhu-yutaṃ pītaṃ tad eva khadirād vinā | / pakṣaṃ māṃsa-rasāhāraṃ karoti dvi-śatāyuṣam ||
tad eva nasye pañcāśad divasān upayojitam | / vapuṣ-mataṃ śruta-dharaṃ karoti tri-śatāyuṣam ||
pañcāṣṭau sapta daśa vā pippalīr madhu-sarpiṣā | / rasāyana-guṇānveṣī samām ekāṃ prayojayet ||
tisras tisras tu pūrvāhṇe bhuktvāgre bhojanasya ca | / pippalyaḥ kiṃśuka-kṣāra-bhāvitā ghṛta-bharjitāḥ ||
prayojyā madhu-sammiśrā rasāyana-guṇaiṣiṇā | / krama-vṛddhyā daśāhāni daśa-paippalikaṃ dinam ||
vardhayet payasā sārdhaṃ tathaivāpanayet punaḥ | / jīrṇauṣadhaś ca bhuñjīta ṣaṣṭikaṃ kṣīra-sarpiṣā ||
pippalīnāṃ sahasrasya prayogo 'yaṃ rasāyanam | / piṣṭās tā balibhiḥ peyāḥ śṛtā madhya-balair naraiḥ ||
tad-vac ca cchāga-dugdhena dve sahasre prayojayet | / ebhiḥ prayogaiḥ pippalyaḥ kāsa-śvāsa-gala-grahān ||
yakṣma-meha-grahaṇy-arśaḥ-pāṇḍu-tva-viṣama-jvarān | / ghnanti śophaṃ vamiṃ hidhmāṃ plīhānaṃ vāta-śoṇitam ||
bilvārdha-mātreṇa ca pippalīnāṃ pātraṃ pralimped ayaso niśāyām | / prātaḥ pibet tat salilāñjalibhyāṃ varṣaṃ yatheṣṭāśana-pāna-ceṣṭaḥ ||
śuṇṭhī-viḍaṅga-tri-phalā-guḍūcī- yaṣṭī-haridrātibalā-balāś ca | / mustā-surāhvāguru-citrakāś ca saugandhikaṃ paṅka-jam utpalāni ||
dhavāśvakarṇāsana-bālapattra-sārās tathā pippali-vat prayojyāḥ | / lohopaliptāḥ pṛthag eva jīvet samāḥ śataṃ vyādhi-jarā-vimuktaḥ ||
kṣīrāñjalibhyāṃ ca rasāyanāni yuktāny amūny āyasa-lepanāni | / kurvanti pūrvokta-guṇa-prakarṣam āyuḥ-prakarṣaṃ dvi-guṇaṃ tataś ca ||
asana-khadira-yūṣair bhāvitāṃ somarājīṃ madhu-ghṛta-śikhi-pathyā-loha-cūrṇair upetām | / śaradam avalihānaḥ pāriṇāmān vikārāṃs tyajati mita-hitāśī tad-vad āhāra-jātān ||
tīvreṇa kuṣṭhena parīta-mūrtir yaḥ somarājīṃ niyamena khādet | / saṃvatsaraṃ kṛṣṇa-tila-dvitīyāṃ sa somarājīṃ vapuṣātiśete ||
ye somarājyā vi-tuṣī-kṛtāyāś cūrṇair upetāt payasaḥ su-jātāt | / uddhṛtya sāraṃ madhunā lihanti takraṃ tad evānupibanti cānte ||
kuṣṭhinaḥ śīryamāṇāṅgās te jātāṅguli-nāsikāḥ | / bhānti vṛkṣā iva punaḥ prarūḍha-nava-pallavāḥ ||
rāhor amṛta-cauryeṇa lūnād ye patitā galāt | / amṛtasya kaṇā bhūmau te laśuna-tvam āgatāḥ ||
dvi-jā nāśnanti tam ato daitya-deha-samudbhavam | / sākṣād amṛta-sambhūter grāmaṇīḥ sa rasāyanam ||
śīlayel laśunaṃ śīte vasante 'pi kapholbaṇaḥ | / ghanodaye 'pi vātārtaḥ sadā vā grīṣma-līlayā ||
snigdha-śuddha-tanuḥ śīta-madhuropaskṛtāśayaḥ | / tad-uttaṃsāvataṃsābhyāṃ carcitānucarājiraḥ ||
tasya kandān vasantānte himavac-chaka-deśa-jān | / apanīta-tvaco rātrau timayen madirādibhiḥ ||
tat-kalka-sva-rasaṃ prātaḥ śuci-tāntava-pīḍitam | / madirāyāḥ su-rūḍhāyās tri-bhāgena samanvitam ||
madyasyānyasya takrasya mastunaḥ kāñjikasya vā | / tat-kāla eva vā yuktaṃ yuktam ālocya mātrayā ||
taila-sarpir-vasā-majja-kṣīra-māṃsa-rasaiḥ pṛthak | / kvāthena vā yathā-vyādhi rasaṃ kevalam eva vā ||
pibed gaṇḍūṣa-mātraṃ prāk kaṇṭha-nālī-viśuddhaye | / pratataṃ svedanaṃ cānu vedanāyāṃ praśasyate ||
śītāmbu-sekaḥ sahasā vami-mūrchāyayor mukhe | / śeṣaṃ pibet klamāpāye sthira-tāṃ gata ojasi ||
vidāha-parihārāya paraṃ śītānulepanaḥ | / dhārayet sāmbu-kaṇikā muktā-karpūra-mālikāḥ ||
kuḍavo 'sya parā mātrā tad-ardhaṃ kevalasya tu | / palaṃ piṣṭasya tan-majjñaḥ sa-bhaktaṃ prāk ca śīlayet ||
jīrṇa-śāly-odanaṃ jīrṇe śaṅkha-kundendu-pāṇḍuram | / bhuñjīta yūṣair payasā rasair vā dhanva-cāriṇām ||
madyam ekaṃ pibet tatra tṛṭ-prabandhe jalānvitam | / a-madya-pas tv āranālaṃ phalāmbu parisikthakām ||
tat-kalkaṃ vā sama-ghṛtaṃ ghṛta-pātre khajāhatam | / sthitaṃ daśāhād aśnīyāt tad-vad vā vasayā samam ||
vi-kañcuka-prājya-rasona-garbhān sa-śūlya-māṃsān vividhopadaṃśān | / nimardakān vā ghṛta-śukta-yuktān pra-kāmam adyāl laghu tuccham aśnan ||
pitta-rakta-vinirmukta-samastāvaraṇāvṛte | / śuddhe vā vidyate vāyau na dravyaṃ laśunāt param ||
priyāmbu-guḍa-dugdhasya māṃsa-madyāmla-vidviṣaḥ | / a-titikṣor a-jīrṇaṃ ca laśuno vyāpade dhruvam ||
pitta-kopa-bhayād ante yuñjyān mṛdu virecanam | / rasāyana-guṇān evaṃ paripūrṇān samaśnute ||
grīṣme 'rka-taptā girayo jatu-tulyaṃ vamanti yat | / hemādi-ṣaḍ-dhātu-rasaṃ procyate tac chilā-jatu ||
sarvaṃ ca tikta-kaṭukaṃ nāty-uṣṇaṃ kaṭu pākataḥ | / chedanaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa lauhaṃ tatra praśasyate ||
go-mūtra-gandhi kṛṣṇaṃ guggulv-ābhaṃ vi-śarkaraṃ mṛtsnam | / snigdham an-amla-kaṣāyaṃ mṛdu guru ca śilā-jatu śreṣṭham ||
vyādhi-vyādhita-sātmyaṃ samanusmaran bhāvayed ayaḥ-pātre | / prāk kevala-jala-dhautaṃ śuṣkaṃ kvāthais tato bhāvyam ||
sama-girijam aṣṭa-guṇite niḥkvāthyaṃ bhāvanauṣadhaṃ toye | / tan-niryūhe 'ṣṭāṃśe pūtoṣṇe prakṣiped girijam ||
tat sama-rasa-tāṃ yātaṃ saṃśuṣkaṃ prakṣiped rase bhūyaḥ | / svaiḥ svair evaṃ kvāthair bhāvyaṃ vārān bhavet sapta ||
atha snigdhasya śuddhasya ghṛtaṃ tiktaka-sādhitam | / try-ahaṃ yuñjīta girijam ekaikena tathā try-aham ||
phala-trayasya yūṣeṇa paṭolyā madhukasya ca | / yogaṃ yogyaṃ tatas tasya kālāpekṣaṃ prayojayet ||
śilā-jam evaṃ dehasya bhavaty aty-upakārakam | / guṇān samagrān kurute sahasā vyāpadaṃ na ca ||
eka-tri-sapta-saptāhaṃ karṣam ardha-palaṃ palam | / hīna-madhyottamo yogaḥ śilā-jasya kramān mataḥ ||
saṃskṛtaṃ saṃskṛte dehe prayuktaṃ girijāhvayam | / yuktaṃ vyastaiḥ samastair vā tāmrāyo-rūpya-hemabhiḥ ||
kṣīreṇāloḍitaṃ kuryāc chīghraṃ rāsāyanaṃ phalam | / kulatthān kākamācīṃ ca kapotāṃś ca sadā tyajet ||
na so 'sti rogo bhuvi sādhya-rūpo jatv aśma-jaṃ yaṃ na jayet prasahya | / tat-kāla-yogair vidhi-vat prayuktaṃ svasthasya corjāṃ vipulāṃ dadhāti ||
kuṭī-praveśaḥ kṣaṇināṃ paricchada-vatāṃ hitaḥ | / ato 'nya-thā tu ye teṣāṃ saurya-mārutiko vidhiḥ ||
vātātapa-sahā yogā vakṣyante 'to viśeṣataḥ | / sukhopacārā bhraṃśe 'pi ye na dehasya bādhakāḥ ||
śītodakaṃ payaḥ kṣaudraṃ ghṛtam ekaika-śo dvi-śaḥ | / tri-śaḥ samastam atha-vā prāk pītaṃ sthāpayed vayaḥ ||
guḍena madhunā śuṇṭhyā kṛṣṇayā lavaṇena vā | / dve dve khādan sadā pathye jīved varṣa-śataṃ sukhī ||
harītakīṃ sarpiṣi sampratāpya samaśnatas tat pibato ghṛtaṃ ca | / bhavec cira-sthāyi balaṃ śarīre sakṛt kṛtaṃ sādhu yathā kṛta-jñe ||
dhātrī-rasa-kṣaudra-sitā-ghṛtāni hitāśanānāṃ lihatāṃ narāṇām | / praṇāśam āyānti jarā-vikārā granthā viśālā iva dur-gṛhītāḥ ||
dhātrī-kṛmighnāsana-sāra-cūrṇaṃ sa-taila-sarpir-madhu-loha-reṇu | / niṣevamāṇasya bhaven narasya tāruṇya-lāvaṇyam a-vipraṇaṣṭam ||
lauhaṃ rajo vella-bhavaṃ ca sarpiḥ-kṣaudra-drutaṃ sthāpitam abda-mātram | / samudgake bījaka-sāra-k pte lihan balī jīvati kṛṣṇa-keśaḥ ||
viḍaṅga-bhallātaka-nāgarāṇi ye 'śnanti sarpir-madhu-saṃyutāni | / jarā-nadīṃ roga-taraṅgiṇīṃ te lāvaṇya-yuktāḥ puruṣās taranti ||
khadirāsana-yūṣa-bhāvitāyās tri-phalāyā ghṛta-mākṣika-plutāyāḥ | / niyamena narā niṣevitāro yadi jīvanty a-rujaḥ kim atra citram ||
bījakasya rasam aṅguli-hāryaṃ śarkarāṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ tri-phalāṃ ca | / śīlayatsu puruṣeṣu jarat-tā sv-āgatāpi vinivartata eva ||
punarnavasyārdha-palaṃ navasya piṣṭaṃ pibed yaḥ payasārdha-māsam | / māsa-dvayaṃ tat-tri-guṇaṃ samāṃ vā jīrṇo 'pi bhūyaḥ sa punar-navaḥ syāt ||
mūrvā-bṛhaty-aṃśumatī-balānām uśīra-pāṭhāsana-śārivāṇām | / kālānusāryāguru-candanānāṃ vadanti paunarnavam eva kalpam ||
śatāvarī-kalka-kaṣāya-siddhaṃ ye sarpir aśnanti sitā-dvitīyam | / tāñ jīvitādhvānam abhiprapannān na vipralumpanti vikāra-caurāḥ ||
pītāśvagandhā payasārdha-māsaṃ ghṛtena tailena sukhāmbunā vā | / kṛśasya puṣṭiṃ vapuṣo vidhatte bālasya sasyasya yathā su-vṛṣṭiḥ ||
dine dine kṛṣṇa-tila-prakuñcaṃ samaśnatāṃ śīta-jalānu-pānam | / poṣaḥ śarīrasya bhavaty an-alpo dṛḍhī-bhavanty ā-maraṇāc ca dantāḥ ||
cūrṇaṃ śvadaṃṣṭrāmalakāmṛtānāṃ lihan sa-sarpir madhu-bhāga-miśram | / vṛṣaḥ sthiraḥ śānta-vikāra-duḥkhaḥ samāḥ śataṃ jīvati kṛṣṇa-keśaḥ ||
sārdhaṃ tilair āmalakāni kṛṣṇair akṣāṇi saṅkṣudya harītakīr vā | / ye 'dyur mayūrā iva te manuṣyā ramyaṃ parīṇāmam avāpnuvanti ||
śilā-jatu-kṣaudra-viḍaṅga-sarpir-lohābhayā-pārada-tāpya-bhakṣaḥ | / āpūryate dur-bala-deha-dhātus tri-pañca-rātreṇa yathā śaśāṅkaḥ ||
ye māsam ekaṃ sva-rasaṃ pibanti dine dine bhṛṅgarajaḥ-samuttham | / kṣīrāśinas te bala-vīrya-yuktāḥ samāḥ śataṃ jīvitam āpnuvanti ||
māsaṃ vacām apy upasevamānāḥ kṣīreṇa tailena ghṛtena vāpi | / bhavanti rakṣobhir a-dhṛṣya-rūpā medhāvino nir-mala-mṛṣṭa-vākyāḥ ||
maṇḍūkaparṇīm api bhakṣayanto bhṛṣṭāṃ ghṛte māsam an-anna-bhakṣāḥ | / jīvanti kālaṃ vipulaṃ pragalbhās tāruṇya-lāvaṇya-guṇodaya-sthāḥ ||
lāṅgalī-tri-phalā-loha-pala-pañcāśatā kṛtam | / mārkava-sva-rase ṣaṣṭyā guṭikānāṃ śata-trayam ||
chāyā-viśuṣkaṃ guṭikārdham adyāt pūrvaṃ samastām api tāṃ krameṇa | / bhajed viriktaḥ krama-śaś ca maṇḍaṃ peyāṃ vilepīṃ rasakaudanaṃ ca ||
sarpiḥ-snigdhaṃ māsam ekaṃ yatātmā māsād ūrdhvaṃ sarva-thā svaira-vṛttiḥ | / varjyaṃ yatnāt sarva-kālaṃ tv a-jīrṇaṃ varṣeṇaivaṃ yogam evopayuñjyāt ||
bhavati vigata-rogo yo 'py a-sādhyāmayārtaḥ prabala-puruṣa-kāraḥ śobhate yo 'pi vṛddhaḥ | / upacita-pṛthu-gātra-śrotra-netrādi-yuktas taruṇa iva samānāṃ pañca jīvec chatāni ||

gāyatrī-śikhi-śiṃśipāsana-śivā-vellākṣakāruṣkarān || 169a || / piṣṭvāṣṭā-daśa-saṅguṇe 'mbhasi dhṛtān khaṇḍaiḥ sahāyo-mayaiḥ || 169b || / pātre loha-maye try-ahaṃ ravi-karair āloḍayan pācayed || 169c || / agnau cānu mṛdau sa-loha-śakalaṃ pāda-sthitaṃ tat pacet || 169d ||
pūtasyāṃśaḥ kṣīrato 'ṃśas tathāṃśau bhārgān niryāsād dvau varāyās trayo 'ṃśāḥ | / aṃśāś catvāraś ceha haiyaṅgavīnād ekī-kṛtyaitat sādhayet kṛṣṇa-lauhe ||
vi-mala-khaṇḍa-sitā-madhubhiḥ pṛthag yutam a-yuktam idaṃ yadi vā ghṛtam | / sva-ruci-bhojana-pāna-viceṣṭito bhavati nā pala-śaḥ pariśīlayan ||

śrī-mān nirdhūta-pāpmā vana-mahiṣa-balo vāji-vegaḥ sthirāṅgaḥ || 172a || / keśair bhṛṅgāṅga-nīlair madhu-surabhi-mukho naika-yoṣin-niṣevī || 172b || / vāṅ-medhā-dhī-samṛddhaḥ su-paṭu-huta-vaho māsa-mātropayogād || 172c || / dhatte 'sau nārasiṃhaṃ vapur anala-śikhā-tapta-cāmīkarābham || 172d ||
attāraṃ nārasiṃhasya vyādhayo na spṛśanty api | / cakrojjvala-bhujaṃ bhītā nārasiṃham ivāsurāḥ ||
bhṛṅga-pravālān amunaiva bhṛṣṭān ghṛtena yaḥ khādati yantritātmā | / viśuddha-koṣṭho 'sana-sāra-siddha-dugdhānupas tat-kṛta-bhojanārthaḥ ||
māsopayogāt sa sukhī jīvaty abda-śata-trayam | / gṛhṇāti sakṛd apy uktam a-vilupta-smṛtīndriyaḥ ||
anenaiva ca kalpena yas tailam upayojayet | / tān evāpnoti sa guṇān kṛṣṇa-keśaś ca jāyate ||
uktāni śakyāni phalānvitāni yugānurūpāṇi rasāyanāni | / mahānuśaṃsāny api cāparāṇi prāpty-ādi-kaṣṭāni na kīrtitāni ||
rasāyana-vidhi-bhraṃśāj jāyeran vyādhayo yadi | / yathā-svam auṣadhaṃ teṣāṃ kāryaṃ muktvā rasāyanam ||
satya-vādinam a-krodham adhy-ātma-pravaṇendriyam | / śāntaṃ sad-vṛtta-nirataṃ vidyān nitya-rasāyanam ||
guṇair ebhiḥ samuditaḥ sevate yo rasāyanam | / sa nivṛttātmā dīrghāyuḥ para-treha ca modate ||
śāstrānusāriṇī caryā citta-jñāḥ pārśva-vartinaḥ | / buddhir a-skhalitārtheṣu paripūrṇaṃ rasāyanam ||
vājī-karaṇam anvicchet satataṃ viṣayī pumān | / tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭir apatyaṃ ca guṇa-vat tatra saṃśritam ||
apatya-santāna-karaṃ yat sadyaḥ sampraharṣaṇam | / vājīvāti-balo yena yāty a-pratihato 'ṅganāḥ ||
bhavaty ati-priyaḥ strīṇāṃ yena yenopacīyate | / tad vājī-karaṇaṃ tad dhi dehasyorjas-karaṃ param ||
dharmyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ loka-dvaya-rasāyanam | / anumodāmahe brahma-caryam ekānta-nirmalam ||
alpa-sat-tvasya tu kleśair bādhyamānasya rāgiṇaḥ | / śarīra-kṣaya-rakṣārthaṃ vājī-karaṇam ucyate ||
kalyasyodagra-vayaso vājī-karaṇa-sevinaḥ | / sarveṣv ṛtuṣv ahar ahar vyavāyo na nivāryate ||
atha snigdha-viśuddhānāṃ nirūhān sānuvāsanān | / ghṛta-taila-rasa-kṣīra-śarkarā-kṣaudra-saṃyutān ||
yoga-vid yojayet pūrvaṃ kṣīra-māṃsa-rasāśinām | / tato vājī-karān yogān śukrāpatya-bala-pradān ||
a-cchāyaḥ pūti-kusumaḥ phalena rahito drumaḥ | / yathaikaś caika-śākhaś ca nir-apatyas tathā naraḥ ||
skhalad-gamanam a-vyakta-vacanaṃ dhūli-dhūsaram | / api lālāvila-mukhaṃ hṛdayāhlāda-kārakam ||
apatyaṃ tulya-tāṃ kena darśana-sparśanādiṣu | / kiṃ punar yad yaśo-dharma-māna-śrī-kula-vardhanam ||
śuddha-kāye yathā-śakti vṛṣya-yogān prayojayet | / śarekṣu-kuśa-kāśānāṃ vidāryā vīraṇasya ca ||
mūlāni kaṇṭakāryāś ca jīvakarṣabhakau balām | / mede dve dve ca kākolyau śūrpaparṇyau śatāvarīm ||
aśvagandhām atibalāṃ ātmaguptāṃ punarnavām | / vīrāṃ payasyāṃ jīvantīm ṛddhiṃ rāsnāṃ trikaṇṭakam ||
madhukaṃ śāliparṇīṃ ca bhāgāṃs tri-palikān pṛthak | / māṣāṇām āḍhakaṃ caitad dvi-droṇe sādhayed apām ||
rasenāḍhaka-śeṣeṇa pacet tena ghṛtāḍhakam | / dattvā vidārī-dhātrīkṣu-rasānām āḍhakāḍhakam ||
ghṛtāc catur-guṇaṃ kṣīraṃ peṣyāṇīmāni cāvapet | / vīrāṃ svaguptāṃ kākolyau yaṣṭīṃ phalgūni pippalīm ||
drākṣāṃ vidārīṃ kharjūraṃ madhukāni śatāvarīm | / tat siddha-pūtaṃ cūrṇasya pṛthak prasthena yojayet ||
śarkarāyās tugāyāś ca pippalyāḥ kuḍavena ca | / maricasya prakuñcena pṛthag ardha-palonmitaiḥ ||
tvag-elā-kesaraiḥ ślakṣṇaiḥ kṣaudra-dvi-kuḍavena ca | / pala-mātraṃ tataḥ khādet praty-ahaṃ rasa-dugdha-bhuk ||
tenārohati vājīva kuliṅga iva hṛṣyati | / vidārī-pippalī-śāli-priyālekṣurakād rajaḥ ||
pṛthak svaguptā-mūlāc ca kuḍavāṃśaṃ tathā madhu | / tulārdhaṃ śarkarā-cūrṇāt prasthārdhaṃ nava-sarpiṣaḥ ||
so 'kṣa-mātram ataḥ khādet yasya rāmā-śataṃ gṛhe | / sātmaguptā-phalān kṣīre godhūmān sādhitān himān ||
māṣān vā sa-ghṛta-kṣaudrān khādan gṛṣṭi-payo-'nupaḥ | / jāgarti rātriṃ sakalām a-khinnaḥ khedayan striyaḥ ||
bastāṇḍa-siddhe payasi bhāvitān a-sakṛt tilān | / yaḥ khādet sa-sitān gacchet sa strī-śatam a-pūrva-vat ||
cūrṇaṃ vidāryā bahu-śaḥ sva-rasenaiva bhāvitam | / kṣaudra-sarpir-yutaṃ līḍhvā pramadā-śatam ṛcchati ||
kṛṣṇā-dhātrī-phala-rajaḥ sva-rasena su-bhāvitam | / śarkarā-madhu-sarpirbhir līḍhvā yo 'nu payaḥ pibet ||
sa naro 'śīti-varṣo 'pi yuveva parihṛṣyati | / karṣaṃ madhuka-cūrṇasya ghṛta-kṣaudra-samanvitam ||
payo-'nu-pānaṃ yo lihyān nitya-vegaḥ sa nā bhavet | / kulīraśṛṅgyā yaḥ kalkam āloḍya payasā pibet ||
sitā-ghṛta-payo-'nnāśī sa nārīṣu vṛṣāyate | / yaḥ payasyāṃ payaḥ-siddhāṃ khāden madhu-ghṛtānvitām ||
pibed bāṣkayaṇaṃ cānu kṣīraṃ na kṣayam eti saḥ | / svayaṅguptekṣurakayor bīja-cūrṇaṃ sa-śarkaram ||
dhāroṣṇena naraḥ pītvā payasā rāsabhāyate | / uccaṭā-cūrṇam apy evaṃ śatāvaryāś ca yojayet ||
candra-śubhraṃ dadhi-saraṃ sa-sitā-ṣaṣṭikaudanam | / paṭe su-mārjitaṃ bhuktvā vṛddho 'pi taruṇāyate ||
śvadaṃṣṭrekṣura-māṣātmaguptā-bīja-śatāvarīḥ | / piban kṣīreṇa jīrṇo 'pi gacchati pramadā-śatam ||
yat kiñ-cin madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ bala-vardhanam | / manaso harṣaṇaṃ yac ca tat sarvaṃ vṛṣyam ucyate ||
dravyair evaṃ-vidhais tasmād darpitaḥ pramadāṃ vrajet | / ātma-vegena codīrṇaḥ strī-guṇaiś ca praharṣitaḥ ||
sevyāḥ sarvendriya-sukhā dharma-kalpa-drumāṅkurāḥ | / viṣayātiśayāḥ pañca śarāḥ kusuma-dhanvanaḥ ||
iṣṭā hy ekaika-śo 'py arthā harṣa-prīti-karāḥ param | / kiṃ punaḥ strī-śarīre ye saṅghātena pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
nāmāpi yasyā hṛdayotsavāya yāṃ paśyatāṃ tṛptir an-āpta-pūrvā | / sarvendriyākarṣaṇa-pāśa-bhūtā kāntānuvṛtti-vrata-dīkṣitā yā ||
kalā-vilāsāṅga-vayo-vibhūṣā śuciḥ sa-lajjā rahasi pragalbhā | / priyaṃ-vadā tulya-manaḥ-śayā yā sā strī vṛṣya-tvāya paraṃ narasya ||
ācarec ca sakalāṃ rati-caryāṃ kāma-sūtra-vihitām an-a-vadyām | / deśa-kāla-bala-śakty-anurodhād vaidya-tantra-samayokty-a-viruddhām ||
abhyañjanodvartana-seka-gandha-srak-citra-vastrābharaṇa-prakārāḥ | / gāndharva-kāvyādi-kathā-pravīṇāḥ sama-sva-bhāvā vaśa-gā vayasyāḥ ||
dīrghikā sva-bhavanānta-niviṣṭā padma-reṇu-madhu-matta-vihaṅgā | / nīla-sānu-giri-kūṭa-nitambe kānanāni pura-kaṇṭha-gatāni ||
dṛṣṭi-sukhā vividhā taru-jātiḥ śrotra-sukhaḥ kala-kokila-nādaḥ | / aṅga-sukhartu-vaśena vibhūṣā citta-sukhaḥ sakalaḥ parivāraḥ ||
tāmbūlam accha-madirā kāntā kāntā niśā śaśāṅkāṅkā | / yad yac ca kiñ-cid iṣṭaṃ manaso vājī-karaṃ tat tat ||
madhu mukham iva sotpalaṃ priyāyāḥ kala-raṇanā parivādinī priyeva | / kusuma-caya-mano-ramā ca śayyā kisalayinī latikeva puṣpitāgrā ||
deśe śarīre ca na kā-cid artir artheṣu nālpo 'pi mano-vidhānaḥ | / vājī-karāḥ sannihitāś ca yogāḥ kāmasya kāmaṃ paripūrayanti ||

mustā parpaṭakaṃ jvare tṛṣi jalaṃ mṛd-bhṛṣṭa-loṣṭodbhavaṃ || 48a || / lājāś chardiṣu vasti-jeṣu girijaṃ meheṣu dhātrī-niśe || 48b || / pāṇḍau śreṣṭham ayo 'bhayānila-kaphe plīhāmaye pippalī || 48c || / sandhāne kṛmijā viṣe śukatarur medo-'nile gugguluḥ || 48d ||
vṛṣo 'sra-pitte kuṭajo 'tisāre bhallātako 'rśaḥsu gareṣu hema | / sthūleṣu tārkṣyaṃ kṛmiṣu kṛmighnaṃ śoṣe surā chāga-payo 'tha māṃsam ||
akṣy-āmayeṣu tri-phalā guḍūcī vātāsra-roge mathitaṃ grahaṇyām | / kuṣṭheṣu sevyaḥ khadirasya sāraḥ sarveṣu rogeṣu śilāhvayaṃ ca ||
unmādaṃ ghṛtam a-navaṃ śokaṃ madyaṃ vyapasmṛtiṃ brāhmī | / nidrā-nāśaṃ kṣīraṃ jayati rasālā pratiśyāyam ||
māṃsaṃ kārśyaṃ laśunaḥ prabhañjanaṃ stabdha-gātra-tāṃ svedaḥ | / guḍamañjaryāḥ khapuro nasyāt skandhāṃsa-bāhu-rujam ||
nava-nīta-khaṇḍa-marditam auṣṭraṃ mūtraṃ payaś ca hanty udaram | / nasyaṃ mūrdha-vikārān vidradhim a-cirotthitam asra-visrāvaḥ ||
nasyaṃ kavaḍo mukha-jān nasyāñjana-tarpaṇāni netra-rujaḥ | / vṛddhasya kṣīra-ghṛte mūrchāṃ śītāmbu-māruta-cchāyāḥ ||
sama-śuktārdraka-mātrā mande vahnau śrame surā snānam | / duḥkha-saha-tve sthairye vyāyāmo gokṣurur hitaḥ kṛcchre ||
kāse nidigdhikā pārśva-śūle puṣkara-jā jaṭā | / vayasaḥ sthāpane dhātrī tri-phalā guggulur vraṇe ||
vastir vāta-vikārān paittān rekaḥ kaphodbhavān vamanam | / kṣaudraṃ jayati balāsaṃ sarpiḥ pittaṃ samīraṇaṃ tailam ||
ity agryaṃ yat proktaṃ rogāṇām auṣadhaṃ śamāyālam | / tad deśa-kāla-balato vikalpanīyaṃ yathā-yogam ||
ity ātreyād āgamayyārtha-sūtraṃ tat-sūktānāṃ peśalānām a-tṛptaḥ | / bheḍādīnāṃ sammato bhakti-namraḥ papracchedaṃ saṃśayāno 'gniveśaḥ ||
dṛśyante bhaga-van ke-cid ātma-vanto 'pi rogiṇaḥ | / dravyopasthātṛ-sampannā vṛddha-vaidya-matānugāḥ ||
kṣīyamāṇāmaya-prāṇā viparītās tathā 'pare | / hitā-hita-vibhāgasya phalaṃ tasmād a-niścitam ||
kiṃ śāsti śāstram asmin iti kalpayato 'gniveśa-mukhyasya | / śiṣya-gaṇasya punarvasur ācakhyau kārtsnyatas tat-tvam ||
na cikitsā-cikitsā ca tulyā bhavitum arhati | / vināpi kriyayā svāsthyaṃ gacchatāṃ ṣo-ḍaśāṃśayā ||
ātaṅka-paṅka-magnānāṃ hastālambo bhiṣag-jitam | / jīvitaṃ mriyamāṇānāṃ sarveṣām eva nauṣadhāt ||
na hy upāyam apekṣante sarve rogā na cānya-thā | / upāya-sādhyāḥ sidhyanti nā-hetur hetu-mān yataḥ ||
yad uktaṃ sarva-sampatti-yuktayāpi cikitsayā | / mṛtyur bhavati tan naivaṃ nopāye 'sty an-upāya-tā ||
api copāya-yuktasya dhī-mato jātu cit kriyā | / na sidhyed daiva-vaiguṇyān na tv iyaṃ ṣo-ḍaśātmikā ||
kasyā-siddho 'gni-toyādiḥ sveda-stambhādi-karmaṇi | / na prīṇanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ vā kasya kṣīraṃ gavedhukam ||
kasya māṣātmaguptādau vṛṣya-tve nāsti niścayaḥ | / viṇ-mūtra-karaṇākṣepau kasya saṃśayitau yave ||
viṣaṃ kasya jarāṃ yāti mantra-tantra-vivarjitam | / kaḥ prāptaḥ kalya-tāṃ pathyād ṛte rohiṇikādiṣu ||
api cā-kāla-maraṇaṃ sarva-siddhānta-niścitam | / mahatāpi prayatnena vāryatāṃ katham anya-thā ||
candanādy api dāhādau rūḍham āgama-pūrvakam | / śāstrād eva gataṃ siddhiṃ jvare laṅghana-bṛṃhaṇam ||
catuṣ-pād-guṇa-sampanne samyag ālocya yojite | / mā kṛthā vyādhi-nirghātaṃ vicikitsāṃ cikitsite ||
etad dhi mṛtyu-pāśānām a-kāṇḍe chedanaṃ dṛḍham | / rogottrāsita-bhītānāṃ rakṣā-sūtram a-sūtrakam ||
etat tad amṛtaṃ sākṣāj jagad-āyāsa-varjitam | / yāti hālāhala-tvaṃ tu sadyo dur-bhājana-sthitam ||
a-jñāta-śāstra-sad-bhāvāñ chāstra-mātra-parāyaṇān | / tyajed dūrād bhiṣak-pāśān pāśān vaivasvatān iva ||
bhiṣajāṃ sādhu-vṛttānāṃ bhadram āgama-śālinām | / abhyasta-karmaṇāṃ bhadraṃ bhadraṃ bhadrābhilāṣiṇām ||
iti tantra-guṇair yuktaṃ tantra-doṣair vivarjitam | / cikitsā-śāstram a-khilaṃ vyāpya yat paritaḥ sthitam ||
vipulā-mala-vijñāna-mahā-muni-matānugam | / mahā-sāgara-gambhīra-saṅgrahārthopalakṣaṇam ||
aṣṭāṅga-vaidyaka-mahodadhi-manthanena yo 'ṣṭāṅga-saṅgraha-mahāmṛta-rāśir āptaḥ | / tasmād an-alpa-phalam alpa-samudyamānāṃ prīty-artham etad uditaṃ pṛthag eva tantram ||
idam āgama-siddha-tvāt pratyakṣa-phala-darśanāt | / mantra-vat samprayoktavyaṃ na mīmāṃsyaṃ kathañ-ca-na ||
dīrgha-jīvitam ārogyaṃ dharmam arthaṃ sukhaṃ yaśaḥ | / pāṭhāvabodhānuṣṭhānair adhigacchaty ato dhruvam ||
etat paṭhan saṅgraha-bodha-śaktaḥ sv-abhyasta-karmā bhiṣag a-prakampyaḥ | / ākampayaty anya-viśāla-tantra-kṛtābhiyogān yadi tan na citram ||
yadi carakam adhīte tad dhruvaṃ suśrutādi-praṇigadita-gadānāṃ nāma-mātre 'pi bāhyaḥ | / atha caraka-vihīnaḥ prakriyāyām a-klinnaḥ kim iva khalu karotu vyādhitānāṃ varākaḥ ||
abhiniveśa-vaśād abhiyujyate su-bhaṇite 'pi na yo dṛḍha-mūḍhakaḥ | / paṭhatu yatna-paraḥ puruṣāyuṣaṃ sa khalu vaidyakam ādyam a-nirvidaḥ ||
vāte pitte śleṣma-śāntau ca pathyaṃ tailaṃ sarpir mākṣikaṃ ca krameṇa | / etad brahmā bhāṣatāṃ brahma-jo vā kā nir-mantre vaktṛ-bhedokti-śaktiḥ ||
abhidhātṛ-vaśāt kiṃ vā dravya-śaktir viśiṣyate | / ato matsaram utsṛjya mādhyasthyam avalambyatām ||
ṛṣi-praṇīte prītiś cen muktvā caraka-suśrutau | / bheḍādyāḥ kiṃ na paṭhyante tasmād grāhyaṃ su-bhāṣitam ||
hṛdayam iva hṛdayam etat sarvāyur-veda-vāṅ-maya-payo-dheḥ | / kṛtvā yac chubham āptaṃ śubham astu paraṃ tato jagataḥ ||
tatra ślokāḥ / āyurvedāgamo heturāgamasya pravartanam / / sūtraṇasyābhyanujñānamāyurvedasya nirṇayaḥ //
tatra ślokaḥ --- / aṣṭāviṃśatirityetā yavāgvaḥ parikīrtitāḥ/ / pañcakarmāṇi cāśritya prokto bhaiṣajyasaṃgrahaḥ//
tatra ślokaḥ --- / ihātrijaḥ siddhatamānuvāca dvātriṃśataṃ siddhamaharṣipūjyaḥ/ / cūrṇapradehān vividhāmayaghnānāragvadhīye jagato hitārtham//
vallūraṃ śuṣkaśākāni śālūkāni bisāni ca/ / nābhyasedgauravānmāṃsaṃ kṛśaṃ naivopayojayet//
matsyān dadhi ca māṣāṃśca yavakāṃśca na śīlayet//
piṣṭikāñchālimudgāṃśca saindhavāmalake yavān/ / āntarīkṣaṃ payaḥ sarpirjāṅgalaṃ madhu cābhyaset//
tacca nityaṃ prayuñjīta svāsthyaṃ yenānuvartate/ / ajātānāṃ vikārāṇāmanutpattikaraṃ ca yat//
ata ūrdhvaṃ śarīrasya kāryamakṣyañjanādikam/ / svasthavṛttimabhipretya guṇataḥ saṃpravakṣyate//
sauvīramañjanaṃ nityaṃ hitamakṣṇoḥ prayojayet/ / pañcarātre 'aṣṭarātre vā srāvaṇārthe rasāñjanam//
cakṣustejomayaṃ tasya viśeṣācchleṣmato bhayam/ / tataḥ śleṣmaharaṃ karma hitaṃ dṛṣṭeḥ prasādanam//
divā tanna prayoktavyaṃ netrayostīkṣṇamañjanam/ / virekadurbalā dṛṣṭirādityaṃ prāpya sīdati//
tasmāt srāvyaṃ niśāyāṃ tu dhruvamañjanamiṣyate/ / yathā hi kanakādīnāṃ &malināṃ vividhātmanām//
dhautānāṃ nirmalā śuddhistailacelakacādibhiḥ/ / evaṃ netreṣu martyānāmañjanāścyotanādibhiḥ//
dṛṣṭirnirākulā bhāti nirmale nabhasīnduvat/ / hareṇukāṃ priyaṅguṃ ca pṛthvīkāṃ keśaraṃ nakham//
hrīveraṃ candanaṃ patraṃ tvagelośīrapadmakam/ / dhyāmakaṃ madhukaṃ māṃsī guggulvaguruśarkaram//
nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣalodhratvacaḥ śubhāḥ/ / vanyaṃ sarjarasaṃ mustaṃ śaileyaṃ kamalotpale//
śrīveṣṭakaṃ śallakīṃ ca śukaṣarhamathāpi ca/ / piṣṭvā limpecchareṣīkāṃ tāṃ vartiṃ yavasannibhām//
aṅguṣṭhasaṃmitāṃ kuryādaṣṭāṅgulasamāṃ bhiṣak/ / śuṣkāṃ nigarbhāṃ tāṃ vartiṃ dhūmanetrārpitāṃ naraḥ//
snehāktāmagnisaṃpluṣṭāṃ pibet prāyogikīṃ sukhām/ / vasāghṛtamadhūcchiṣṭairyuktiyuktairvarauṣadhaiḥ//
vartiṃ madhurakaiḥ kṛtvā snaihikīṃ dhūmamācaret/ / śvetā jyotiṣmatī caiva haritālaṃ manaḥśilā//
gandhāścāgurupatrādyā dhūmaṃ mūrdhavirecane&/ / gauravaṃ śirasaḥ śūlaṃ pīnasārdhāvabhedakau//
