karṇākṣiśūlaṃ kāsaśca hikkāśvāsau galagrahaḥ/ / dantadaurbalyamāsrāvaḥ śrotraghrāṇākṣidoṣajaḥ//
pūtirghrāṇāsyagandhaśca dantaśūlamarocakaḥ/ / hanumanyāgrahaḥ kaṇḍūḥ krimayaḥ pāṇḍutā mukhe//
śleṣmapraseko vaisvaryaṃ galaśuṇḍyupajihvikā/ / &khālityaṃ piñjaratvaṃ ca keśānāṃ patanaṃ tathā//
kṣavathuścātitandrā ca buddhermoho 'atinidratā/ / dhūmapānāt praśāmyanti balaṃ bhavati cādhikam//
śiroruhakapālānāmindriyāṇāṃ svarasya ca/ / na ca vātakaphātmāno balino 'apyūrdhvajatrujāḥ//
&dhūmavaktrakapānasya vyādhayaḥ syuḥ śirogatāḥ/ / prayogapāne tasyāṣṭau kālāḥ saṃparikīrtitāḥ//
vātaśleṣmasamutkleśaḥ kāleṣveṣu hi lakṣyate/ / snātvā bhuktvā samullikhya kṣutvā dantānnighṛṣya ca//
nāvanāñjananidrānte cātmavān dhūmapo bhavet/ / tathā vātakaphātmāno na bhavantyūrdhvajatrujāḥ//
rogāstasya tu peyāḥ syurāpānāstristrayastrayaḥ/ / paraṃ dvikālapāyī syādahnaḥ kāleṣu buddhimān//
prayoge, snaihike tvekaṃ, vairecyaṃ tricatuḥ pibet/ / hṛtkaṇṭhendriyasaṃśuddhirlaghutvaṃ śirasaḥ śamaḥ//
yatheritānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ samyakpītasya lakṣaṇam/ / bādhiryamāndhyamūkatvaṃ raktapittaṃ śirobhramam//
akāle cātipītaśca dhūmaḥ kuryādupadravān/ / tatraeṣṭaṃ sarpiṣaḥ pānaṃ nāvanāñjanatarpaṇam//
snaihikaṃ dhūmaje doṣe vāyuḥ pittānigo yadi/ / śītaṃ tu raktapitte syācchleṣmapitte virūkṣaṇam//
paraṃ tvataḥ pravakṣyāmi dhūmo yeṣāṃ vigarhitaḥ/ / na viriktaḥ pibeddhūmaṃ na kṛte bastikarmaṇi//
na raktī na viṣeṇārto na &śocanna ca garbhiṇī/ / na śrame na made nāme na pitte na prajāgare//
na mūrcchābhramatṛṣṇāsu na kṣīṇe nāpi ca kṣate/ / na &madyadugdhe pītvā ca na snehaṃ na ca mākṣikam//
dhūmaṃ na bhuktvā &dadhnā ca na rūkṣaḥ kruddha eva ca/ / na tāluśoṣe timire śirasyabhihite na ca//
na śaṅkhake na rohiṇyāṃ na mehe na madātyaye/ / eṣu dhūmamakāleṣu mohāt pibati yo naraḥ//
rogāstasya pravardhante dāruṇā dhūmavibhramāt/ / dhūmayogyaḥ pibeddoṣe śiroghrāṇākṣisaṃśraye//
ghrāṇenāsyena kaṇṭhasthe mukhena ghrāṇapo vamet/ / āsyena dhūmakavalān piban ghrāṇena nodvamet//
pratilomaṃ gato &hyāśu dhūmo hiṃsyāddhi cakṣuṣī/ / ṛjvaṅgacakṣustaccetāḥ sūpaviṣṭastriparyayam//
pibecchidraṃ pidhāyaikaṃ nāsayā dhūmamātmavān/ / caturviṃśatikaṃ netraṃ &svāṅgulībhirvirecane//
dvātriṃśadaṅgulaṃ snehe prayoge 'adhyardhamiṣyate/ / &ṛju trikoṣāphalitaṃ kolāsthyagrapramāṇitam//
bastinetrasamadravyaṃ dhūmanetraṃ praśasyate/ / dūrādvinirgataḥ parvacchinno nāḍītanūkṛtaḥ//
nendriyaṃ bādhate dhūmo mātrākālaniṣevitaḥ/ / yadā coraśca kaṇṭhaśca śiraśca laghutāṃ vrajet//
kaphaśca tanutāṃ prāptaḥ supītaṃ dhūmamādiśet/ / aviśuddhaḥ svaro yasya kaṇṭhaśca sakapho bhavet//
stimito mastakaścaivamapītaṃ dhūmamādiśet/ / tālu mūrdhā ca kaṇṭhaśca śuṣyate paritapyate//
tṛṣyate muhyate jantū raktaṃ ca sravate 'adhikam/ / śiraśca bhramate 'atyarthaṃ mūrcchā cāsyopajāyate//
indriyāṇyupatapyante dhūme 'atyarthaṃ niṣevite/ / &varṣe varṣe 'aṇutailaṃ ca kāleṣu triṣu nā caret//
prāvṛṭśaradvasanteṣu gatameghe nabhastale/ / nasyakarma yathākālaṃ yo yathoktaṃ niṣevate//
na tasya cakṣurna ghrāṇaṃ na śrotramupahanyate/ / na syuḥ śvetā na kapilāḥ keśāḥ śmaśrūṇi vā punaḥ//
na ca keśāḥ &pramucyante vardhante ca viśeṣataḥ/ / manyāstambhaḥ śiraḥśūlamarditaṃ hanusaṃgrahaḥ//
pīnasārdhāvabhedau ca śiraḥkampaśca śāmyati/ / sirāḥ śiraḥkapālānāṃ sandhayaḥ snāyukaṇḍarāḥ//
nāvanaprīṇitāścāsya labhante 'abhyadhikaṃ balam/ / mukhaṃ prasannopacitaṃ svaraḥ snigdhaḥ sthiro mahān//
sarvendriyāṇāṃ vaimalyaṃ balaṃ bhavati cādhikam/ / na cāsya rogāḥ sahasā prabhavantyūrdhvajatrujāḥ//
jīryataścottamāṅgeṣu& jarā na labhate balam/ / candanāguruṇī patraṃ dārvītvaṅmadhukaṃ balām//
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ sūkṣmailāṃ viḍaṅgaṃ bilvamutpalam/ / hrīberamabhayaṃ vanyaṃ tvaṅmustaṃ sārivāṃ sthirām//
jīvantīṃ pṛśniparṇīṃ ca suradāru& śatāvarīm/ / hareṇuṃ bṛhatīṃ vyādhrīṃ surabhīṃ padmakeśaram//
vipācayecchataguṇe māhendre vimale 'ambhasi/ / tailāddaśaguṇaṃ śeṣaṃ kaṣāyamavatārayet//
tena tailaṃ kaṣāyeṇa daśakṛtvo vipācayet/ / athāsya daśame pāke &samāṃśaṃ chāgalaṃ payaḥ//
dadyādeṣo 'aṇutailasya nāvanīyasya saṃvidhiḥ/ / asya mātrāṃ prayuñjīta tailasyārdhapalonmitām//
snigdhasvinnottamāṅgasya picunā nāvanaistribhiḥ/ / tryahāttryahācca saptāhametata karma samācaret//
nivātoṣṇasamācārī& hitāśī niyatendriyaḥ/ / tailametattridoṣaghnamindriyāṇāṃ balapradam//
prayuñjāno yathākālaṃ yathoktānaśnute guṇān/ / āpothitāgraṃ dvau kālau kaṣāyakaṭutiktakam//
bhakṣayeddantapavanaṃ dantamāṃsānyabādhayan/ / nihanti gandhaṃ vairasyaṃ jihvādantāsyajaṃ malam//
niṣkṛṣya rucimādhatte sadyo dantaviśodhanam/ / karañjakaravīrārkamālatīkakubhāsanāḥ//
śasyante dantapavane ye cāpyevaṃvidhā drumāḥ/ / suvarṇarūpyatāmrāṇi trapurītimayāni ca//
jihvānirlekhanāni syuratīkṣṇānyanṛjūni ca/ / jihvāmūlagataṃ yacca malamucchvāsarodhi ca//
daurgandhyaṃ bhajate tena tasmājjihvāṃ vinirlikhet/ / dhāryāṇyāsyena vaiśadyarucisaugandhyamicchatā//
jātīkaṭukapūgānāṃ lavaṅgasya phalāni ca/ / kakkolasya phalaṃ patraṃ tāmbūlasya śubhaṃ tathā/ / tathā karpūraniryāsaḥ sūkṣmailāyāḥ phalāni ca//
hanvorbalaṃ svarabalaṃ vadanopacayaḥ paraḥ/ / syāt paraṃ ca rasajñānamanne ca ruciruttamā//
na cāsya kaṇṭhaśoṣaḥ syānnauṣṭhayoḥ sphuṭanādbhayam/ / na ca dantāḥ kṣayaṃ yānti dṛḍhamūlā bhavanti ca//
na śūlyante na cāmlena hṛṣyante bhakṣayanti ca/ / parānapi kharān bhakṣyāṃstailagaṇḍūṣadhāraṇāt//
nityaṃ snehārdraśirasaḥ śiraḥśūlaṃ na jāyate/ / na khālityaṃ na pālityaṃ na keśāḥ prapatanti ca//
balaṃ śiraḥkapālānāṃ viśeṣeṇābhivardhate/ / dṛḍhamūlāśca dīrghāśca kṛṣṇāḥ keśā bhavanti ca//
indriyāṇi prasīdanti sutvagbhavati cānanam&/ / nidrālābhaḥ sukhaṃ ca syānmūrdhni tailaniṣevaṇāt//
na karṇarogā vātotthā na manyāhanusaṃgrahaḥ/ / noccaiḥ śrutirna vādhiryaṃ syānnityaṃ karṇatarpaṇāt//
snehābhyaṅgādyathā kumbhaścarma snehavimardanāt/ / bhavatyupāṅgādakṣaśca dṛḍhaḥ kleśasaho yathā//
tathā śarīramabhyaṅgāddṛḍhaṃ sutvak ca jāyate/ / praśāntamārutābādhaṃ kleśavyāyāmasaṃsaham//
sparśane 'abhyadhiko vāyuḥ sparśanaṃ ca tvagāśritam/ / tvacyaśca &paramabhyaṅgastasmāttaṃ śīlayennaraḥ//
na cābhighātābhihataṃ gātramabhyaṅgasevinaḥ/ / vikāraṃ bhajate 'atyarthaṃ balakarmaṇi vā kvacit//
susparśopacitāṅgaśca balavān priyadarśanaḥ/ / bhavatyaṅganityatvānnaro 'alpajara eva ca//
kharatvaṃ stabdhatā& raukṣyaṃ śramaḥ suptiśca pādayoḥ/ / sadya evopaśāmyanti pādābhyaṅgaviṣevaṇāt//
jāyate saukumāryaṃ ca balaṃ sthairyaṃ ca pādayoḥ/ / dṛṣṭiḥ prasādaṃ labhate mārutaścopaśāmyati//
na ca &syādgṛdhrasīvātaḥ pādayoḥ sphuṭanaṃ na ca/ / na sirāsnāyusaṃkocaḥ pādābhyaṅgena pādayoḥ//
daurgandhyaṃ gauravaṃ tandrāṃ kaṇḍūṃ malamarocakam/ / svedabībhatsatāṃ hanti śarīraparimārjanam//
pavitraṃ vṛṣyamāyuṣyaṃ &śramasvedamalāpaham/ / śarīrabalasandhānaṃ snānamojaskaraṃ param//
kāmyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyamalakṣmīghnaṃ praharṣaṇam/ / śrīmat pāriṣadaṃ śastaṃ nirmalāmbaradhāraṇam//
vṛṣyaṃ saugandhyamāyuṣayaṃ kāmyaṃ puṣṭibalapradam/ / saumanasyamalakṣmīghraṃ gandhamālyaniṣevaṇam//
dhanyaṃ maṅgalyamāyuṣyaṃ śrīmadvyasanasūdanam/ / harṣaṇaṃ kāmyamojasyaṃ ratnābharaṇadhāraṇam//
medhyaṃ pavitramāyuṣyamalakṣmīkalināśanam/ / pādayormalamārgāṇāṃ śaucādhānamabhīkṣṇaśaḥ//
pauṣṭikaṃ vṛṣyamāyuṣyaṃ śuci rūpavirājanam/ / keśaśmaśrunakhādīnāṃ kalpanaṃ saṃprasādhanam//
cakṣuṣyaṃ spraśanahitaṃ pādayorvyasanāpaham/ / balyaṃ parākramasukhaṃ vṛṣyaṃ pādatradhāraṇam//
&īteḥ praśamanaṃ balyaṃ guptyāvaraṇaśaṅkaram/ / gharmānilarajombughnaṃ chatradhāraṇamucyate//
skhalataḥ saṃpratiṣṭhānaṃ śatrūṇāṃ ca niṣūdanam/ / avaṣṭambhanamāyuṣyaṃ bhayaghnaṃ daṇḍadhāraṇam//
nagarī nagarasyeva rathasyeva rathī yathā/ / svaśarīrasya medhāvī kṛtyeṣvavahito bhavet//
bhavati cātra --- vṛttyupāyānniṣeveta ye syurdharmāvirodhinaḥ/ / śamamadhyayanaṃ caiva sukhamevaṃ samaśnute//
tatra ślokāḥ --- mātrā dravyāṇi mātrāṃ saṃśritya gurulāghavam/ / dravyāṇāṃ garhito 'abhyāso yeṣāṃ, yeṣāṃ ca śasyate//
añjanaṃ dhūmavartiśca trividhā vartikalpanā/ / dhūmapānaguṇāḥ kālāḥ pānamānaṃ ca yasya yat//
vyāpatticihnaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ dhūmo yeṣāṃ vigarhitaḥ/ / peyo yathā yanmayaṃ ca netraṃ yasya ca yadvidham//
nasyakarmaguṇā nastaḥkāryaṃ yacca yathā yadā/ / bhakṣayeddantapavanaṃ yathā yadyaṅguṇaṃ ca yat//
yadarthaṃ yāni cāsyena dhāryāṇi kavalagrahe/ / tailasya ye guṇā &diṣṭāḥ śirastailaguṇāśca ye//
karṇataile tathā 'abhyaṅge pādābhyaṅge 'aṅgamārjane/ / snāne vāsasi śuddhe ca saugandhye ratnadhāraṇe//
śauce saṃharaṇe lomnāṃ pādatracchatradhāraṇe/ / guṇā mātrāśitīye 'asmiṃstathoktā& daṇḍadhāraṇe//
tatra ślokaḥ / ṛtāvṛtau nṛbhiḥ sevyamasevyaṃ yacca kiṃcana / / tasyāśitīye nirdiṣṭaṃ hetumat sātmyameva ca //
tatra ślokāḥ / vegā vegasamutthāśca rogāsteṣāṃ ca bheṣajam / / yeṣāṃ vegā vidhāryāśca yadarthaṃ yaddhitāhitam //
kiṃyonayaḥ kati snehāḥ ke ca snehaguṇāḥ pṛthak/ / kālānupāne ke kasya kati kāśca vicāraṇāḥ//
kati mātrāḥ kathaṃmānāḥ kā ca keṣūpadiśyate/ / kaśca kebhyo hitaḥ snehaḥ prakarṣaḥ snehane ca kaḥ//
snehyāḥ ke ke na ca snigdhāsnigdhātisnigdhalakṣaṇam/ / kiṃ pānāt prathamaṃ pīte jīrṇe kiṃca hitāhitam//
ke mṛdukrūrakoṣṭhāḥ kā vyāpadaḥ siddhayaśca kāḥ/ / acche saṃśodhane caiva snehe kā vṛttiriṣyate//
vicāraṇāḥ keṣu yojyā vidhinā kena tat prabho!/ / snehasyāmitavijñāna jñānamicchāmi veditum//
atha tatsaṃśayacchettā pratyuvāca punarvasuḥ/ / snehānāṃ dvividhā saumya yoniḥ sthāvarajaṅgamā//
tilaḥ priyālābhiṣukau bibhītakaścitrābhayairaṇḍamadhūkasarṣapāḥ/ / kusumbhabilvārukamūlakātasīnikocakākṣoḍakarañjaśigrukāḥ//
snehāśayāḥ sthāvarasaṃjñitāstathā syurjaṅgamā matsyamṛgāḥ sapakṣiṇaḥ/ / teṣāṃ dadhikṣīraghṛtāmiṣaṃ vasā sneheṣu majjā ca tathopadiśyate//
sarveṣāṃ tailajātānāṃ tilatailaṃ viśiṣyate/ / balārthe snehane cāgryamairaṇḍaṃ tu virecane// / (kaṭūṣṇaṃ tailamairaṇḍaṃ vātaśleṣmaharaṃ guru/ / kaṣāyasvādutiktaiśca yojitaṃ pittahantrapi//1//)
sarpistailaṃ vasā majjā sarvasnehottamā matāḥ/ / eṣu caivottamaṃ sarpiḥ saṃskārasyānuvartanāt//
ghṛtaṃ pittānilaharaṃ rasaśukraujasāṃ hitam/ / nirvāpaṇaṃ mṛdukaraṃ svaravarṇaprasādanam//
mārutaghnaṃ na ca śleṣmavardhanaṃ balavardhanam/ / tvacyamuṣṇaṃ sthirakaraṃ tailaṃ yoniviśodhanam//
viddhabhagnāhatabhraṣṭayonikarṇaśiroruji/ / pauruṣopacaye snehe vyāyāme ceṣyate vasā//
balaśukrarasaśleṣmamedomajjavivardhanaḥ/ / majjā viśeṣato 'asthnāṃ ca balakṛt snehane hitaḥ//
sarpiḥ śaradi pātavyaṃ vasā majjā ca mādhave/ / tailaṃ prāvṛṣi nātyuṣṇaśīte snehaṃ pibennaraḥ//
vātapittādhiko rātrāvuṣṇe cāpi pibennaraḥ/ / śleṣmādhiko divā śīte pibeccāmalabhāskare//
atyuṣṇe vā divā pīto vātapittādhikena va/ / mūrcchāṃ pipāsāmunmādaṃ kāmalāṃ vā samīrayet//
śīte rātrau piban snehaṃ naraḥ śleṣmādhiko 'api vā/ / ānāhamaruciṃ śūlaṃ pāṇḍutāṃ vā samṛcchati//
jalamuṣṇaṃ ghṛte peyaṃ yūṣastaile 'anu śasyate/ / vasāmajjñostu maṇḍaḥ syāt sarveṣūṣṇamathāmbu vā//
odanaśca vilepī ca raso māṃsaṃ payo dadhi/ / yavāgūḥ sūpaśākau ca yūṣaḥ kāmbalikaḥ khaḍaḥ//
saktavastilapiṣṭaṃ ca madyaṃ lehāstathaiva ca/ / bhakṣyamabhyañjanaṃ bastistathā cottarabastayaḥ//
gaṇḍūṣaḥ karṇatailaṃ ca nastaḥkarṇākṣitarpaṇam/ / caturviṃśatirityetāḥ snehasya pravicāraṇāḥ&//
acchapeyastu yaḥ sneho na tāmāhurvicāraṇām/ / snehasya sa bhiṣagdṛṣṭaḥ& kalpaḥ prāthamakalpikaḥ//
rasaiścopahitaḥ snehaḥ samāsavyāsayogibhiḥ/ / ṣaḍbhistriṣaṣṭidhā saṃkhyāṃ prāpnotyekaśca kevalaḥ//
evametāścatuḥṣaṣṭiḥ snehānāṃ pravicāraṇā&/ / okartuvyādhipuruṣān prayojyā jānatā bhavet//
ahorātramahaḥ kṛtsnamardhāhaṃ ca pratīkṣate/ / pradhānā madhyamā hrasvā snehamātrā jarāṃ prati//
iti tisraḥ samuddiṣṭā mātrāḥ snehasya mānataḥ/ / tāsāṃ prayogān vakṣyāmi puruṣaṃ puruṣaṃ prati//
prabhūtasnehanityā ye kṣutpipāsāsahā narāḥ/ / pāvakaścottamabalo yeṣāṃ ye cottamā bale//
gulminaḥ sarpadaṣṭāśca visarpopahatāśca ye/ / unmattāḥ kṛcchramūtrāśca gāḍhavarcasa eva ca//
pibeyuruttamāṃ mātrāṃ tasyāḥ pāne guṇāñchṛṇu/ / vikārāñchamayatyeṣā śīghraṃ samyakprayojitā//
doṣānukarṣiṇī mātrā sarvamārgānusāriṇī/ / balyā punarnavakarī śarīrendriyacetasām//
aruṣkasphoṭapiḍakākaṇḍūpamābhirarditāḥ/ / kuṣṭhinaśca pramīḍhāśca vātaśoṇitikāśca ye//
nātibahvāśinaścaiva mṛdukoṣṭhāstathaiva ca/ / pibeyurmadhyamāṃ mātrāṃ madhyamāścāpi ye bale//
mātraiṣā mandavibhraṃśā na cātibalahāriṇī/ / sukhena ca snehayati śodhanārthe ca yujyate//
ye tu vṛddhāśca bālāśca sukumārāḥ sukhocitāḥ/ / riktakoṣṭhatvamahitaṃ yeṣāṃ mandāgnayaśca ye//
jvarātīsārakāsāśca yeṣāṃ cirasamutthitāḥ/ / snehamātrāṃ pibeyuste hrasvāṃ ye cāvarā bale//
parihāre sukhā caiṣā mātrā snehanabṛṃhaṇī/ / vṛṣyā balyā nirābādhā ciraṃ cāpyanuvartate//
vātapittaprakṛtayo vātapittavikāriṇaḥ/ / cakṣuḥkāmāḥ kṣatāḥ kṣīṇā vṛddhā bālāstathā 'abalāḥ//
āyuḥprakarṣakāmāśca balavarṇasvarārthinaḥ/ / puṣṭikāmāḥ prajākāmāḥ saukumāryārthinaśca ye//
dīptyojaḥsmṛtimedhāgnibuddhīndriyabalārthinaḥ/ / pibeyuḥ sarpirārtāśca dāhaśastraviṣāgnibhiḥ//
pravṛddhaśleṣmamedaskāścalasthūlagalodarāḥ/ / vātavyādhibhirāviṣṭā vātaprakṛtayaśca ye//
balaṃ tanutvaṃ laghutāṃ dṛḍhatāṃ sthiragātratām&/ / snigdhaślakṣṇatanutvaktāṃ ye ca kāṅkṣanti dehinaḥ//
kṛmikoṣṭhāḥ krūrakoṣṭhāstathā nāḍībhirarditāḥ/ / pibeyuḥ śītale kāle tailaṃ tailocitāśca ye//
vātātapasahā ye ca rūkṣā bhārādhvakarśitāḥ/ / saṃśuṣkaretorudhirā niṣpītakaphamedasaḥ//
asthisandhisirāsnāyumarmakoṣṭhamahārujaḥ/ / balavānmāruto yeṣāṃ khāni cāvṛtya tiṣṭhati//
mahaccāgnibalaṃ yeṣāṃ vasāsātmyāśca ye narāḥ/ / teṣāṃ snehayitavyānāṃ vasāpānaṃ vidhīyate//
dīptāgnayaḥ kleśasahā ghasmarāḥ snehasevinaḥ/ / vātārtāḥ krūrakoṣṭhāśca snehyā majjānamāpnuyuḥ//
yebhyo yebhyo hito yo yaḥ snehaḥ sa parikīrtitaḥ/ / snehanasya prakarṣau tu saptarātratrirātrakau//
svedyāḥ śodhayitavyāśca rūkṣā vātavikāriṇaḥ/ / vyāyāmamadyastrīnityāḥ snehyāḥ syurye ca cintakāḥ//
saṃśodhanādṛte yeṣāṃ rūkṣaṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyate/ / na teṣāṃ snehanaṃ śastamutsannakaphamedasām//
abhiṣyaṇṇānanagudā nityamandāgnayaśca ye/ / tṛṣṇāmūrcchāparītāśca garbhiṇyastāluśoṣiṇaḥ//
annadviṣaśchardayanto jaṭharāmagarārditāḥ/ / durbalāśca pratāntāśca snehaglānā madāturāḥ//
na snehyā vartamāneṣu na nastobastikarmasu/ / snehapānāt prajāyante teṣāṃ rogāḥ sudāruṇāḥ//
purīṣaṃ grathitaṃ rūkṣaṃ vāyurapraguṇo mṛduḥ/ / paktā kharatvaṃ raukṣyaṃ ca gātrasyāsnigdhalakṣaṇam//
vātānulomyaṃ dīpto 'agnirvarcaḥ snigdhamasaṃhatam/ / mārdavaṃ snigdhatā cāṅge snigdhānāmupajāyate//
pāṇḍutā &gauravaṃ jāḍyaṃ purīṣasyāvipakvatā/ / tandrīrarucirutkeśaḥ syādatisnigdhalakṣaṇam//
dravoṣṇamanabhiṣyandi bhojyamannaṃ pramāṇataḥ/ / nātisnigdhamasaṃkīrṇaṃ śvaḥ snehaṃ pātumicchatā//
pibet saṃśamanaṃ snehamannakāle prakāṃkṣitaḥ/ / śuddhyarthaṃ punarāhāre naiśe jīrṇe pibennaraḥ//
uṣṇodakopacārī syādbrahmacārī kṣapāśayaḥ&/ / śakṛnmūtrānilodgārānudīrṇāṃśca &na dhārayet//
vyāyāmamuccairvacanaṃ krodhaśokau himātapau/ / varjayedapravātaṃ ca seveta śayanāsanam//
snehaṃ& pītvā naraḥ snehaṃ pratibhuñjāna eva ca/ / snehamithyopacārāddhi jāyante dāruṇā gadāḥ//
mṛdukoṣṭhastrirātreṇa snihyatyacchopasevayā/ / snihyati krūrakroṣṭhastu saptarātreṇa mānavaḥ//
guḍamikṣurasaṃ mastu kṣīramulloḍitaṃ dadhi/ / pāyasaṃ kṛśarāṃ sarpiḥ kāśmaryatriphalārasam//
drākṣārasaṃ pīlurasaṃ jalamuṣṇamathāpi vā/ / madyaṃ vā taruṇaṃ pītvā mṛdukoṣṭho viricyate//
virecayanti naitāni krūrakoṣṭhaṃ kadācana/ / bhavati krūrakoṣṭhasya grahaṇyatyulbaṇānilā//
udīrṇapittā 'alpakaphā grahaṇī mandamārutā/ / mṛdukoṣṭhasya tasmāt sa suvirecyo naraḥ smṛtaḥ//
udīrṇapittā grahaṇī yasya cāgnibalaṃ mahat/ / bhasmībhavati tasyāśu snehaḥ pīto 'agnitejasā//
sa jagdhvā snehamātrāṃ tāmojaḥ prakṣārayan balī/ / snehāgniruttamāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ sopasargāmudīrayet//
nālaṃ snehasamṛddhasya śamāyānnaṃ sugurvapi/ / sa cet suśītaṃ salilaṃ nāsādayati dahyate/ / yathaivāśīviṣaḥ kakṣamadhyagaḥ svaviṣāgninā//
ajīrṇe yadi tu snehe tṛṣṇā syācchardayedbhiṣak/ / śītodakaṃ punaḥ pītvā bhuktvā rūkṣānnamullikhet//
na sarpiḥ kevalaṃ pitte sāme viśeṣataḥ/ / sarvaṃ &hyanurajeddehaṃ hantvā saṃjñāṃ ca mārayet//
&tandrā sotkleśa ānāho jvaraḥ stambho visaṃjñatā/ / kuṣṭhāni kaṇḍūḥ pāṇḍutvaṃ śophārśāṃsyarucistṛṣā//
jaṭharaṃ grahaṇīdoṣāḥ staimityaṃ vākyanigrahaḥ/ / śūlamāmapradoṣāśca jāyante snehavibhramāt//
tatrapyullekhanaṃ śastaṃ svedaḥ kālapratīkṣaṇam/ / prati prati vyādhibalaṃ buddhvā sraṃsanameva ca//
takrāriṣṭaprayogaśca rūkṣapānānnasevanam/ / mūtrāṇāṃ triphalāyāśca snehavyāpattibheṣajam//
akāle cāhitaścaiva mātrayā na ca yojitaḥ/ / sneho mithyopacārācca vyāpadyetātisevitaḥ//
snehāt praskandanaṃ jantustrirātroparataḥ pibet/ / snehavaddravamuṣṇaṃ ca tryahaṃ bhuktvā rasaudanam//
ekāhoparatastadvadbhuktvā pracchardanaṃ pibet/ / syāttvasaṃśodhanārthīye vṛttiḥ snehe viriktavat//
snehadviṣaḥ snehavityā mṛdukoṣṭhāśca ye narāḥ/ / kleśāsahā madyanityāsteṣāmiṣṭā vicāraṇā//
lāvataittiramāyūrahāṃsavārāhakaukkuṭāḥ/ / gavyājairabhramātsyāśca rasāḥ syuḥ snehane hitāḥ//
yavakolakulatthāśca snehāḥ saguḍaśarkarāḥ/ / dāḍimaṃ dadhi savyoṣaṃ rasasaṃyogasaṃgrahaḥ//
snehayanti tilāḥ pūrvaṃ jagdhāḥ sasnehaphāṇitāḥ/ / kṛśarāścabahusnehāstilakāmbalikāstathā//
phāṇitaṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ ca tailaṃ ca surayā saha/ / pibedrūkṣo bhṛtairmāṃsairjīrṇe 'aśnīyācca bhojanam//
tailaṃ surāyā maṇḍena vasāṃ majjānameva vā/ / piban saphāṇitaṃ kṣīraṃ naraḥ snihyati vātikaḥ//
dhāroṣṇaṃ snehasaṃyuktaṃ pītvā saśarkaraṃ payaḥ/ / naraḥ snihyati pītvā vā saraṃ dadhnaḥ saphāṇitam//
pāñcaprasṛtikī peyā pāyaso māṣamiśrakaḥ/ / kṣīrasiddho bahusnehaḥ snehayedacirānnaram//
sarpistailavasāmajjātaṇḍulaprasṛtaiḥ śṛ(kṛ)tā/ / pāñcaprasṛtikī peyā peyā snehanamicchatā// / (śaukaro vā rasaḥ snigdhaḥ sarpirlavaṇasaṃyutaḥ/ / pīto dvirvāsare yatnāt snehayedacirānnaram//1//)
grāmyānūpaudakaṃ māṃsaṃ guḍaṃ dadhi payastilān/ / kuṣṭhī śothī pramehī ca snehane na prayojayet//
snehairyathārhaṃ tān siddhaiḥ snehayedavikāribhiḥ/ / pippalībhirharītakyā siddhaistriphalayā 'api vā//
drākṣāmalakayūṣābhyāṃ dadhnā cāmlena sādhayet/ / vyoṣagarbhaṃ bhiṣak snehaṃ pītvā snihyati taṃ naraḥ//
yavakolakulatthānāṃ rasāḥ kṣāraḥ surā dadhi/ / kṣīrasarpiśca tat siddhaṃ snehanīyaṃ ghṛtottamam//
tailamajjavasāsarpirbadaratriphalārasaiḥ/ / yoniśukrapradoṣeṣu sādhayitvā prayojayet//
&gṛhṇātyambu yathā vastraṃ prasravatyadhikaṃ yathā/ / yathāgni jīryati snehastathā sravati cādhikaḥ//
yathā vā++ākledya mṛtpiṇḍamāsiktaṃ tvarayā jalam/ / sravati sraṃsate snehastathā tvaritasevitaḥ//
lavaṇopahitāḥ snehāḥ snehayantyacirānnaram/ / taddhyabhiṣyandyarūkṣaṃ ca sūkṣmamuṣṇaṃ vyavāyi ca//
snehamagre prayuñjīta tataḥ svedamanantaram/ / snehasvedopapannasya saṃśodhanamathetarat&//
snehāḥ snehavidhiḥ kṛtsnavyāpatsiddhiḥ sabheṣajā/ / &yathāpraśnaṃ bhagavatā vyāhṛtaṃ cāndrabhāginā//
ataḥ svedāḥ pravakṣyante yairyathāvatprayojitaiḥ/ / svedasādhyāḥ praśāmyanti gadā vātakaphātmakāḥ//
snehapūrvaṃ prayuktena svedenāvajite 'anile/ / purīṣamūtraretāṃsi na sajjanti kathaṃcana//
śuṣkāṇyapi hi kāṣṭhāni snehasvedopapādanaiḥ/ / namayanti yathānyāyaṃ kiṃ punarjīvato narān//
rogartuvyādhitāpekṣo nātyuṣṇo 'atimṛdurna ca/ / dravyavān kalpito deśe svedaḥ kāryakaro mataḥ//
vyādhau śīte śarīre ca mahān svedo mahābale/ / durbale durbalaḥ svedo madhyame madhyamo hitaḥ//
vātaśleṣmaṇi vāte vā kaphe vā sveda iṣyate/ / snigdharūkṣastathā snigdho rūkṣaścāpyupakalpitaḥ//
āmāśayagate vāte kaphe pakvāśayāśrite/ / rūkṣapūrvo hitaḥ svedaḥ snehapūrvastathaiva ca//
vṛṣaṇau hṛdayaṃ dṛṣṭī svedayenmṛdu naiva vā/ / madhyamaṃ vaṃkṣaṇau śeṣamaṅgāvayavamiṣṭataḥ//
suśuddhairnaktakaiḥ piṇḍyā godhūmānāmathāpi vā/ / padmotpalapalāśairvā svedyaḥ saṃvṛtya cakṣuṣī//
muktāvalībhiḥ śītābhiḥ śītalairbhājanairapi/ / jalārdrairjalajairhastaiḥ svidyato hṛdayaṃ spṛśet//
śītaśūlavyuparame stambhagauravanigrahe/ / saṃjāte mārdave svede svedanādviratirmatā//
pittaprakopo mūrcchā ca śarīrasadanaṃ tṛṣā/ / dāhaḥ svarāṅgadaurbalyamatisvinnasya lakṣaṇam/ / uktastasyāśitīye yo graiṣmikaḥ sarvaśo vidhiḥ/ / so 'atisvinnasya kartavyo madhuraḥ snigdhaśītalaḥ//
kaṣāyamadyanityānāṃ garbhiṇyā raktapittinām/ / pittināṃ sātisārāṇāṃ rūkṣāṇāṃ madhumehinām/ / vidagdhabhraṣṭabradhnānāṃ viṣamadyavikāriṇām/ / śrāntānāṃ naṣṭasaṃjñānāṃ sthūlānāṃ pittamehinām//
tṛṣyatāṃ &kṣudhitānāṃ ca kruddhānāṃ śocatāmapi/ / kāmalyudariṇāṃ caiva kṣatānāmāḍyarogiṇām//
durbalātiviśuṣkāṇāmupakṣīṇaujasāṃ tathā/ / bhiṣak taimirikāṇāṃ ca na svedamavatārayet//
pratiśyāye ca kāse ca hikkāśvāseṣvalāghave/ / karṇamanyāśiraḥśūle svarabhede galagrahe//
arditaikāṅgasarvāṅgapakṣāghāte vināmake/ / koṣṭhānāhavibandheṣu mūtrāghāte& vijṛmbhake//
pārśvapṛṣṭhakaṭīkukṣisaṃgrahe gṛdhrasīṣu ca/ / mūtrakṛcchre mahattve ca muṣkayoraṅgamardake//
pādajānūrujaṅghārtisaṃgrahe śvayathāvapi/ / khallīṣvāmeṣu śīte ca vepathau vātakaṇṭake//
saṃkocāyāmaśūleṣu stambhagauravasuptiṣu&/ / sarvāṅgeṣu vikāreṣu svedanaṃ hitamucyate//
tilamāṣakulatthāmlaghṛtatailāmiṣaudanaiḥ/ / pāyasaiḥ kṛśarairmāṃsaiḥ piṇḍasvedaṃ prayojayet//
gokharoṣṭravarāhāśvaśakṛdbhiḥ satuṣairyavaiḥ/ / sikatāpāṃśupāṣāṇakarīṣāyasapūṭakaiḥ//
ślaiṣmikān svedayet pūrvairvātikān samupācaret/ / dravyāṇyetāni śasyante yathāsvaṃ prastareṣvapi//
bhūgṛheṣu ca jentākeṣūṣṇagarbhagṛheṣu ca/ / vidhūmāṅgāratapteṣu svabhyaktaḥ svidyate sukham//
grāmyānūpaudakaṃ māṃsaṃ payo bastaśirastathā/ / &varāhamadhyapittāsṛk snehavattilataṇḍulāḥ//
ityetāni samutkvāthya nāḍīsvedaṃ prayojayet/ / &deśakālavibhāgajño yuktyapekṣo bhiṣaktamaḥ//
vāruṇāmṛtakairaṇḍaśigrumūlakasarṣapaiḥ/ / vāsāvaṃśakarañjārkapatrairaśmantakasya ca//
śobhāñjanakasaireyamālatīsurasārjakaiḥ&/ / patrairutkvāthya salilaṃ nāḍīsvedaṃ prayojayet//
bhūtīkapañcamūlābhyāṃ surayā dadhimastunā/ / mūtrairamlaiśca sasnehairnāḍīsvedaṃ prayojayet//
eta eva ca niryūhāḥ prayojyā jalakoṣṭhake/ / svedanārthaṃ ghṛtakṣīratailakoṣṭhāṃśca kārayet//
godhūmaśakalaiścūrṇairyavānāmamlasaṃyutaiḥ/ / sasnehakiṇvalavaṇairupanāhaḥ praśasyate//
gandhaiḥ surāyāḥ kiṇvena jīvantyā śatapuṣpayā/ / umayā kuṣṭhatailābhyāṃ yuktayā copanāhayet//
carmabhiścopanaddhavyaḥ salomabhirapūtibhiḥ/ / uṣṇavīryairalābhe tu kauśeyāvikaśāṭakaiḥ//
rātrau baddhaṃ divā muñcenmuñcedrātrau divā kṛtam/ / bidāhaparihārārthaṃ, syāt prakarṣastu śītale//
saṅkaraḥ prastaro nāḍī pariṣeko 'avagāhanam/ / jentāko 'aśmaghanaḥ karṣūḥ kuṭī bhūḥ kumbhikaiva ca//
kūpo holāka ityete svedayanti trayodaśa/ / tān yathāvat pravakṣyāmi sarvānevānupūrvaśaḥ//
śayānasya pramāṇena ghanāmaśmamayīṃ śilām/ / tāpayitvā mārutaghnairdārubhiḥ saṃpradīpitaiḥ//
vyapojjhya sarvānaṅgārān prokṣya caivoṣṇavāriṇā/ / tāṃ śilāmatha kurvīta kauṣeyāvikasaṃstarām//
tasyāṃ svabhyaktasarvāṅgaḥ svapan svidyati nā sukham/ / &kauravājinakauṣeyaprāvārādyaiḥ susaṃvṛtaḥ&//
ityukto 'aśmaghanasvedaḥ, karṣūsvedaḥ pravakṣyate/ / khānayecchayanasyādhaḥ karṣūṃ sthānavibhāgavit//
dīptairadhūmairaṅgāraistāṃ karṣūṃ pūrayettataḥ/ / tasyāmupari śayyāyāṃ svapan svidyati nā sukham//
anatyutsedhavistārāṃ vṛttākārāmalocanām/ / ghanabhittiṃ kuṭīṃ kṛtvā kuṣṭhādyaiḥ saṃpralepayet//
kuṭīmadhye bhiṣak śayyāṃ svāstīrṇāmupakalpayet/ / prāvārājinakauśeyakuthakambalagolakaiḥ//
hasantikābhiraṅgārapūrṇābhistāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ/ / parivāryāntarārohedabhyaktaḥ svidyate sukham//
ya evāśmaghanasvedavidhirbhūmau sa eva tu/ / praśastāyāṃ nivātāyāṃ samāyāmupadiśyate//
kumbhīṃ vātaharakvāthapūrṇāṃ bhūmau nikhānayet/ / ardhabhāgaṃ tribhāgaṃ vā śayanaṃ tatra copari//
sthāpayedāsanaṃ vā 'api nātisāndraparicchadam/ / atha kumbhyāṃ susantaptān prakṣipedayaso guḍān//
pāṣāṇān voṣmaṇā tena tatsthaḥ svidyati nā sukham/ / susaṃvṛtāṅgaḥ svabhyaktaḥ snehairanilanāśanaiḥ//
kūpaṃ śayanavistāraṃ dviguṇaṃ cāpi vedhataḥ/ / deśe nivāte śaste ca kuryādantaḥsumārjitam//
hastyaśvagokharoṣṭrāṇāṃ karīṣairdagdhapūrite/ / svavacchannaḥ susaṃstīrṇe 'abhyaktaḥ svidyati nā sukham//
dhītīkāṃ& tu karīṣāṇāṃ yathoktānāṃ pradīpayet/ / śayanāntaḥpramāṇena śayyāmupari tatra ca//
sudagdhāyāṃ vidhūmāyāṃ yathoktāmupakalpayet/ / svavacchannaḥ svapaṃstatrābhyaktaḥ svidyati nā sukham//
holākasveda ityeṣa sukhaḥ prokto maharṣiṇā/ / iti trayodaśavidhaḥ svedo 'agniguṇasaṃśrayaḥ//
vyāyāma uṣṇasadanaṃ guruprāvaraṇaṃ kṣudhā/ / bahupānaṃ bhayakrodhāvupanāhāhavātapāḥ//
svedayanti daśaitāni naramagniguṇādṛte/ / ityukto dvividhaḥ svedaḥ saṃyukto 'agniguṇairna ca//
ekāṅgasarvāṅgataḥ snigdho rūkṣastathaiva ca/ / ityetattrividhaṃ dvandvaṃ svedamuddiśya kīrtitam//
snigdhaḥ svedairupakramyaḥ svinnaḥ pathyāśano bhavet/ / tadahaḥ svinnagātrastu vyāyāmaṃ varjayennaraḥ//
tatra ślokāḥ --- svedo yathā kāryakaro hito yebhyaśca yadvidhaḥ/ / yatra deśe yathā yogyo deśo rakṣyaśca yo yathā//
svinnātisvinnarūpāṇi tathā 'atisvinnabheṣajam/ / asvedyāḥ svedayogyāśca svedadravyāṇi kalpanā//
trayodaśavidhaḥ svedo vinā daśavidho 'agninā/ / saṃgraheṇa ca ṣaṭ svedāḥ svedādhyāye nidarśitāḥ/ / svedādhikāre &yadvācyamuktametanmaharṣiṇā/ / śiṣyaistu pratipattavyamupadeṣṭā punarvasuḥ//
tatra ślokāḥ / īśvarāṇāṃ vasumatāṃ vamanaṃ savirecanam / / saṃbhārā ye yadarthaṃ ca samānīya prayojayet //
tatra ślokāḥ / cikitsāprābhṛtaguṇo doṣo yaścetarāśrayaḥ / / yogāyogātiyogānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śuddhisaṃśrayam //
hetulakṣaṇasaṃsargāducyate sānnipātikaḥ / / (hṛdrogaḥ kaṣṭadaḥkaṣṭasādhya ukto maharṣibhiḥ //)
tatra ślokāḥ / saṃkhyāṃ nimittaṃ rūpāṇi śothānāṃ sādhyatāṃ na ca / / teṣāṃ teṣāṃ vikārāṇāṃ śothāṃstāṃstāṃśca pūrvajān //
tatra ślokāḥ / saṃgrahaḥ prakṛtirdeśo vikāramukhamīraṇam / / asandeho 'anubandhaṃśca rogāṇāṃ saṃprakāśitaḥ //
tatra ślokāḥ / ninditāḥ puruṣāsteṣāṃ yau viśeṣeṇa ninditau / / nindite kāraṇaṃ doṣāstayorninditabheṣajam //
tapaḥsvādhyāyaniratānātreyaḥ śiṣyasattamān/ / ṣaḍagniveśapramukhānuktavān paricodayam//
laṅghanaṃ& bṛṃhaṇaṃ kāle rūkṣaṇaṃ snehanaṃ tathā/ / svedanaṃ stambhanaṃ caiva jānīte yaḥ sa vai bhiṣak//
tamuktavantamātreyamagniveśa uvāca ha//
bhagavaṃllaṅghanaṃ &kiṃsvillaṅghanīyāśca kīdṛśāḥ/ / bṛṃhaṇaṃ bṛṃhaṇīyāśca rūkṣaṇīyāśca rūkṣaṇam//
ke snehāḥ& snehanīyāśca svedāḥ svedyāśca ke matāḥ/ / stambhanaṃ stambhanīyāśca vaktumarhasi tadguro!//
laṅghanaprabhṛtīnāṃ ca ṣaṇṇāmeṣāṃ samāsataḥ/ / &kṛtākṛtātivṛttānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vaktumarhasi//
tadagniveśasya vaco niśamya gururabravīt/ / yat kiñcillāghavakaraṃ dehe tallaṅghanaṃ smṛtam//
bṛhattvaṃ yaccharīrasya janayettacca bṛṃhaṇam/ / raukṣyaṃ kharatvaṃ vaiśadyaṃ yat kuryāttaddhi rūkṣaṇam//
snehanaṃ &snehaviṣyandamārdavakledakārakam/ / stambhagauravaśītaghnaṃ svedanaṃ svedakārakam//
stambhanaṃ stambhayati yadgatimantaṃ calaṃ dhruvam/ / laghūṣṇatīkṣṇaviśadaṃ rūkṣaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kharaṃ saram//
kaṭhinaṃ caiva yaddravyaṃ prāyastallaṅghanaṃ smṛtam/ / guru śītaṃ mṛdu snigdhaṃ bahalaṃ sthūlapicchilam//
prāyo mandaṃ sthiraṃ ślakṣṇaṃ dravyaṃ bṛṃhaṇamucyate/ / rūkṣaṃ laghu kharaṃ tīkṣṇamuṣṇaṃ sthiramapicchilam//
prāyaśaḥ kaṭhinaṃ caiva yaddravyaṃ taddhi rūkṣaṇam/ / dravaṃ sūkṣmaṃ saraṃ snigdhaṃ picchilaṃ guru śītalam/ / prāyo mandaṃ mṛdu ca yaddravyaṃ tatsnehanaṃ matam//
uṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ saraṃ snigdhaṃ rūkṣaṃ sūkṣmaṃ dravaṃ sthiram/ / dravyaṃ guru ca yat prāyastaddhi svedanamucyate//
śītaṃ mandaṃ mṛdu ślakṣṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ sūkṣmaṃ dravaṃ sthiram/ / yaddravyaṃ laghu coddiṣṭaṃ prāyastat stambhanaṃ smṛtam//
catuṣprakārā saṃśuddhiḥ pipāsā mārutātapau/ / pācanānyupavāsaśca vyāyāmaśceti laṅghanam//
prabhūtaśleṣmapittāsramalāḥ saṃsṛṣṭamārutāḥ/ / bṛhaccharīrā balino laṅghanīyā viśuddhibhiḥ//
yeṣāṃ madhyabalā rogāḥ kaphapittasamutthitāḥ/ / vamyatīsārahṛdrogavisūcyalasakajvarāḥ//
vibandhagauravodgārahṛllāsārocakādayaḥ/ / pācanaistān bhiṣak prājñaḥ prāyeṇādāvupācaret//
eta eva yathoddiṣṭā yeṣāmalpabalā gadāḥ/ / pipāsānigrahaisteṣāmupavāsaiśca tāñjayet//
&rogāñjayenmadhyabalān vyāyāmātapamārutaiḥ/ / balināṃ kiṃ punaryeṣāṃ &rogāṇāmavaraṃ balam//
tvagdoṣiṇāṃ pramīḍhānāṃ& snigdhābhiṣyandibṛṃhiṇām/ / śiśire laṅghanaṃ śastamapi vātavikāriṇām//
adigdhaviddhamakliṣṭaṃ vayasthaṃ sātmyacāriṇām/ / mṛgamatsyavihaṅgānāṃ māṃsaṃ bṛṃhaṇamucyate//
kṣīṇāḥ kṣatāḥ kṛśā vṛddhā durbalā nityamadhvagāḥ/ / strīmadyanityā grīṣme ca bṛṃhaṇīyā narāḥ smṛtāḥ//
śoṣārśograhaṇīdoṣairvyādhibhiḥ karśitāśca ye/ / teṣāṃ kravyādamāṃsānāṃ bṛṃhaṇā laghavo rasāḥ//
snānamutsādanaṃ svapno madhurāḥ snehabastayaḥ/ / śarkarākṣīrasarpīṃṣi sarveṣāṃ buddhi bṛṃhaṇam//
kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ sevanaṃ strīṣvasaṃyamaḥ/ / khalipiṇyākatakrāṇāṃ madhvādīnāṃ ca rūkṣaṇam//
abhiṣyaṇṇā mahādoṣā marmasthā vyādhayaśca ye/ / ūrustambhaprabhṛtayo rūkṣaṇīyā nidarśitāḥ//
snehāḥ snehayitavyāśca svedāḥ svedyāśca ye narāḥ/ / snehādhyāye mayoktāste svedākhye ca savistaram//
dravaṃ tanvasaraṃ yāvacchītīkaraṇamauṣadham/ / svādu tiktaṃ kaṣāyaṃ ca stambhanaṃ sarvameva tat//
pittakṣārāgnidagdhā ye vamyatīsārapīḍitāḥ/ / viṣasvedātiyogārtāḥ &stambhanīyā nidarśitāḥ//
vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ visarge gātralāghave/ / hṛdayodgārakaṇṭhāsyaśuddhau tandrāklame gate//
svede jāte rucau caiva kṣutpipāsāsahodaye/ / kṛtaṃ laṅghanamādeśyaṃ nirvyathe cāntarātmani//
parvabhedo 'aṅgamardaśca kāsaḥ śoṣo mukhasya ca/ / kṣutpraṇāśo 'arucistṛṣṇā daurbalyaṃ śrotranetrayoḥ//
manasaḥ saṃbhramo 'abhīkṣṇamūrdhvavātastamo hṛdi/ / dehāgnibalanāśaśca laṅghane 'atikṛte bhavet//
balaṃ puṣṭyupalambhaśca kārśyadoṣavivarjanam/ / lakṣaṇaṃ bṛṃhite sthaulyamati cātyarthabṛṃhite//
kṛtātikṛtaliṅgaṃ yallaṅghite &taddhi rūkṣite/ / stambhitaḥ syādbale labdhe yathoktaiścāmayairjitaiḥ//
śyāvatā stabdhagātratvamudvego hanusaṃgrahaḥ/ / hṛdvarconigrahaśca syādatistambhitalakṣaṇam//
lakṣaṇaṃ cākṛtānāṃ syāt ṣaṇṇāmeṣāṃ samāsataḥ/ / tadauṣadhānāṃ &dhātūnāmaśamo vṛddhireva ca//
iti ṣaṭ sarvarogāṇāṃ proktāḥ samyagupakramāḥ/ / sādhyānāṃ sādhane siddhā mātrākālānurodhinaḥ//
saṃtarpayati yaḥ snigdhairmadhurairgurupicchilaiḥ/ / navānnairnavamadyaiśca māṃsaiścānūpavārijaiḥ//
gorasairgauḍikaiścānnaiḥ& paiṣṭikaiścātimātraśaḥ/ / ceṣṭādveṣī divāsvapnaśayyāsanasukhe rataḥ//
rogāstasyopajāyante saṃtarpaṇanimittajāḥ/ / pramehapiḍakākoṭhakaṇḍūpāṇḍvāmayajvarāḥ&//
kuṣṭhānyāmapradoṣāśca mūtrakṛcchramarocakaḥ/ / tandrā klaibyamatisthaulyamālasyaṃ gurugātratā//
indriyasrotasāṃ lepo buddhermohaḥ pramīlakaḥ/ / śophāścaivaṃvidhāścānye śīghramapratikurvataḥ//
śastamullekhanaṃ tatra vireko raktamokṣaṇam/ / vyāyāmaścopavāsaśca dhūmāśca svedanāni ca//
sakṣaudraścābhayāprāśaḥ prāyo rūkṣānnasevanam/ / cūrṇapradehā ye coktāḥ kaṇḍūkoṭhavināśanāḥ//
triphalāragvadhaṃ pāṭhāṃ saptaparṇaṃ savatsakam/ / mustaṃ samadanaṃ nimbaṃ jalenotkvathitaṃ pibet//
tena mehādayo yānti nāśamabhyasyato dhruvam/ / mātrākālaprayuktena saṃtarpaṇasamutthitāḥ//
mustamāragvadhaḥ pāṭhā triphalā devadāru ca/ / śvadaṃṣṭrā khadiro nimbo haridre tvakca vatsakāt//
rasameṣāṃ yathādoṣaṃ prātaḥ prātaḥ pibannaraḥ/ / saṃtarpaṇakṛtaiḥ sarvairvyādhibhiḥ saṃpramucyate//
ebhiścodvartanodgharṣasnānayogopayojitaiḥ/ / tvagdoṣāḥ praśamaṃ yānti tathā snehopasaṃhitaiḥ//
kuṣṭhaṃ gomedako hiṅgu krauñcāsthi tryūṣaṇaṃ vacā/ / vṛṣakaile śvadaṃṣṭrā ca kharāhvā cāśmabhedakaḥ//
takreṇa dadhimaṇḍena badarāmlarasena vā/ / mūtrakṛcchraṃ pramehaṃ ca pītametadvyapohati//
takrābhayāprayogaiśca triphalāyāstathaiva ca/ / ariṣṭānāṃ prayogaiśca yānti mehādayaḥ śamam//
tryūṣaṇaṃ triphalā kṣaudraṃ krimighnamajamodakaḥ/ / mantho 'ayaṃ saktavastailaṃ hito lohodakāplutaḥ//
&vyoṣaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ śigrūṇi triphalāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm/ / bṛhatyau dve haridre dve pāṭhāmativiṣāṃ sthirām//
hiṅgu kebukamūlāni yavānīdhānyacitrakān/ / sauvarcalamajājīṃ ca hapuṣāṃ ceti cūrṇayet//
cūrṇatailaghṛtakṣaudrabhāgāḥ syurmānataḥ samāḥ/ / saktūnāṃ ṣoḍaśaguṇo bhāgaḥ saṃtarpaṇaṃ pibet//
prayogādasya śāmyanti rogāḥ saṃtarpaṇotthitāḥ/ / pramehā mūḍhavātāśca kuṣṭhānyarśāṃsi kāmalāḥ//
plīhā pāṇḍvāmayaḥ śopho mūtrakṛcchramarocakaḥ/ / hṛdrogo rājayakṣmā ca kāsaḥ śvāso galagrahaḥ//
krimayo grahaṇīdoṣāḥ śvaitryaṃ sthaulyamatīva ca/ / narāṇāṃ dīpyate cāgniḥ smṛtirbuddhiśca vardhate//
vyāyāmanityo jīrṇaśī yavagodhūmabhojanaḥ/ / saṃtarpaṇakṛtairdoṣaiḥ &sthaulyaṃ muktvā vimucyate//
uktaṃ saṃtarpaṇotthānāmapatarpaṇamauṣadham/ / vakṣyante sauṣadhāścordhvamapatarpaṇajā gadāḥ//
dehāgnibalavarṇaujaḥśukramāṃsaparikṣayaḥ/ / jvaraḥ kāsānubandhaśca pārśvaśūlamarocakaḥ//
śrotradaurbalyamunmādaḥ pralāpo hṛdayavyathā/ / viṇmūtrasaṃgrahaḥ śūlaṃ jaṅghorutrikasaṃśrayam//
parvāsthisandhimedaśca ye cānye vātajā gadāḥ/ / ūrdhvavātādayaḥ sarve jāyante te 'apatarpaṇāt//
teṣāṃ saṃtarpaṇaṃ tajjñaiḥ punarākhyātamauṣadham/ / yattadātve samarthaṃ syādabhyāse vā tadiṣyate&//
sadyaḥkṣīṇo hi sadyo vai tarpaṇenopacīyate/ / narte saṃtarpaṇābhyāsāccirakṣīṇastu puṣyati//
dehāgnidoṣabhaiṣajyamātrākālānuvartinā/ / kāryamatvaramāṇena bheṣajaṃ ciradurbale//
hitā māṃsarasāstasmai payāṃsi ca ghṛtāni ca/ / snānāni bastayo 'abhyaṅgāstarpaṇāśca ye//
jvarakāsaprasaktānāṃ kṛśānāṃ mūtrakṛcchriṇām/ / tṛṣyatāmūrdhvavātānāṃ vakṣyante tarpaṇā hitāḥ//
śarkarāpippalītailaghṛtakṣaudraiḥ samāṃśakaiḥ/ / saktudviguṇito vṛṣyasteṣāṃ manthaḥ praśasyate//
saktavo madirā kṣaudraṃ śarkarā ceti tarpaṇam/ / pibenmārutaviṇmūtrakaphapittānulomanam//
phaṇitaṃ saktavaḥ sarpirdadhimaṇḍo 'amlakāñjikam/ / tarpaṇaṃ mūtrakṛcchraghnamudāvartaharaṃ pibet//
manthaḥ kharjūramṛdvīkāvṛkṣāmlāmlīkadāḍimaiḥ/ / parūṣakaiḥ sāmalakairyukto madyavikāranut//
svāduramlo jalakṛtaḥ sasneho rūkṣa eva vā/ / sadyaḥ saṃtarpaṇo manthaḥ sthairyavarṇabalapradaḥ//
vidhinā śoṇitaṃ jātaṃ śuddhaṃ bhavati dehinām/ / deśakālaukasātmyānāṃ vidhiryaḥ saṃprakāśitaḥ//
tadviśuddhaṃ hi rudhiraṃ balavarṇasukhāyuṣā/ / yunakti prāṇinaḥ śoṇitaṃ hyanuvartate//
praduṣṭabahutīkṣṇoṣṇairmadyairanyaiśca tadvidhraiḥ/ / tathā 'atilavaṇakṣārairamlaiḥ kaṭubhireva ca//
kulatthamāṣaniṣpāvatilatailaniṣevaṇaiḥ/ / piṇḍālumūlakādīnāṃ haritānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ//
jalajānūpabailānāṃ prasahānāṃ ca sevanāt/ / dadhyamlamastusuktānāṃ surāsauvīrakasya ca//
viruddhānāmupaklinnapūtīnāṃ bhakṣaṇena ca/ / bhuktvā divā prasvapatāṃ dravasnigdhagurūṇi ca//
atyādānāṃ tathā krodhaṃ bhajatāṃ cātapānalau/ / chardivegapratīghātāt kāle cānavasecanāt//
śramābhighātasaṃtāpairajīrṇādhyaśanaistathā/ / śaratkālasvabhāvācca śoṇitaṃ saṃpraduṣyati//
tataḥ śoṇitajā rogāḥ prajāyante pṛthagvidhāḥ/ / mukhapāko+&akṣirāgaśca pūtighrāṇāsyagandhitā//
gulmopakuśavīsarparaktapittapramīlakāḥ/ / vidradhī raktamehaśca pradaro vātaśoṇitam//
vaivarṇyamagnisādaśca pipāsā gurugātratā/ / saṃtāpaścātidaurbalyamaruciḥ śirasaśca ruk//
vidāhaścānnapānasya tiktāmlodgiraṇaṃ klamaḥ/ / krodhapracuratā buddheḥ saṃmoho lavaṇāsyatā//
svedaḥ śarīradaurgandhyaṃ madaḥ kampaḥ svarakṣayaḥ/ / tandrānidrātiyogaśca tamasaścātidarśanam//
kaṇḍvaruḥkoṭhapiḍakākuṣṭhacarmadalādayaḥ/ / vikārāḥ sarva evaite vijñeyāḥ śoṇitāśrayāḥ//
śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādyairupakrāntāśca ye gadāḥ/ / samyak sādhyā na sidhyanti raktajāṃstān vibhāvayet//
kuryācchoṇitarogeṣu raktapittaharīṃ kriyām/ / virekamupavāsaṃ ca srāvaṇaṃ śoṇitasya ca//
baladoṣapramāṇādvā viśuddhyā rudhirasya vā/ / rudhiraṃ srāvayejjantorāśayaṃ& prasamīkṣya vā//
aruṇābhaṃ bhavedvātādviśadaṃ phenilaṃ tanu/ / pittāt pītāsitaṃ raktaṃ styāyatyauṣṇyāccireṇa ca//
īṣatpāṇḍu kaphādduṣṭaṃ picchilaṃ tantumadghanam/ / saṃsṛṣṭaliṅgaṃ& saṃsargāttriliṅgaṃ sānnipātikam//
tapanīyendragopābhaṃ padmālaktakasannibham/ / guñjāphalasavarṇaṃ ca viśuddhaṃ viddhi śoṇitam//
nātyuṣṇaśītaṃ laghu dīpanīyaṃ rakte 'apanīte hitamannapānam/ / tadā śarīraṃ hyanavastitāsṛgagnirviśeṣeṇa ca rakṣitavyaḥ//
prasannavarṇendriyamindriyārthānicchantamavyāhatapaktṛvegam/ / sukhānvitaṃ tuṣṭibalopapannaṃ (puṣṭi-) viśuddharaktaṃ puruṣaṃ vandanti//
yadā tu raktavāhīni rasasaṃjñāvahāni ca/ / pṛthak pṛthak samastā vā srotāṃsi kupitā malāḥ//
malināhāraśīlasya rajomohāvṛtātmanaḥ/ / pratihatyāvatiṣṭhante jāyante vyādhayastadā//
madamūrcchāyasaṃnyāsāsteṣāṃ vidyādvicakṣaṇaḥ/ / yathottaraṃ balādhikyaṃ hetuliṅgopaśāntiṣu//
durbalaṃ cetasaḥ sthānaṃ yadā vāyuḥ prapadyate/ / mano vikṣobhayañjantoḥ saṃjñāṃ saṃmohayettadā//
pittamevaṃ kaphaścaivaṃ mano vikṣobhayannṛṇām/ / saṃjñāṃ nayatyākulatāṃ viśeṣaścātra vakṣyate//
saktānalpadrutābhāṣaṃ calaskhalitaceṣṭitam&/ / vidyādvātamadāviṣṭaṃ rūkṣaśyāvāruṇākṛtim/ / sakrodhaparuṣābhāṣaṃ saṃprahārakalipriyam/ / vidyāt pittamadāviṣṭaṃ raktapītāsitākṛtim//
svalpāsaṃbaddhavacanaṃ tandrālasyasamanvitam/ / vidyāt kaphamadāviṣṭaṃ pāṇḍuṃ pradhyānatatparam//
sarvāṇyetāni rūpāṇi sannipātakṛte made/ / jāyate śāmyati kṣipraṃ mado madyamadākṛtiḥ//
yaśca madyakṛtaḥ prokto viṣajo raudhiraśca yaḥ/ / sarva ete madā narte vātapittakaphatrayāt//
nīlaṃ vā yadi vā kṛṣṇamākāśamathavā 'aruṇam/ / paśyaṃstamaḥ praviśati śīghraṃ ca pratibudhyate&//
vepathuścāṅgamardaśca prapīḍā hṛdayasya ca/ / kārśyaṃ śyāvāruṇā cchāyā mūrcchāye vātasaṃbhave//
raktaṃ haritavarṇaṃ vā viyat pītamathāpi vā/ / paśyaṃstamaḥ praviśati sasvedaḥ pratibudhyate//
sapipāsaḥ sasaṃtāpo raktapītākulekṣaṇaḥ/ / saṃbhinnavarcāḥ pītābho mūrcchāye pittasaṃbhave//
meghasaṅkāśamākāśamāvṛtaṃ vā tamoghanaiḥ/ / paśyaṃstamaḥ praviśati cirācca pratibudhyate//
gurubhiḥ prāvṛtairaṅgairyathaivārdreṇa carmaṇā/ / saprasekaḥ sahṛllāso mūrcchāye kaphasaṃbhave//
sarvākṛtiḥ sannipātādapasmāra ivāgataḥ/ / sa jantuṃ pātayatyāśu vinā bībhatsaceṣṭitaiḥ//
doṣeṣu madamūrcchāyāḥ kṛtavegeṣu& dehinām/ / svayamevopaśāmyanti saṃnyāso nauṣadhairvinā//
vāgdehamanasāṃ ceṣṭāmākṣipyātibalā malāḥ/ / saṃnyasyantyabalaṃ jantuṃ prāṇāyatanasaṃśritāḥ//
sa nā saṃnyāsasaṃnyastaḥ kāṣṭhībhūto mṛtopamaḥ/ / prāṇairviyujyate śīghraṃ muktvā sadyaḥphalāḥ kriyāḥ//
durge 'ambhasi yathā majjadbhājanaṃ tvarayā budhaḥ/ / gṛhṇīyāttalamaprāptaṃ tathā saṃnyāsapīḍitam//
añjanānyavapīḍāśca dhūmāḥ pradhamanāni ca/ / sūcībhistodanaṃ śastaṃ dāhaḥ pīḍā nakhāntare//
luñcanaṃ keśalomnāṃ ca dantairdaśanameva ca/ / ātmaguptāvagharṣaśca hitaṃ tasyāvabodhane//
saṃmūrcchitāni tīkṣṇāni madyāni vividhāni ca/ / prabhūtakaṭuyuktāni& tasyāsye gālayenmuhuḥ//
mātuluṅgarasaṃ tadvanmahauṣadhasamāyutam/ / tadvatsauvarcalaṃ dadyādyuktaṃ madyāmlakāñjikaiḥ//
hiṅgūṣaṇasamāyuktaṃ yāvat saṃjñāprabodhanam/ / prabuddhasaṃjñamannaiśca laghubhistamupācaret//
vismāpanaiḥ smāraṇaiśca priyaśrutibhireva ca/ / paḍubhirgītavāditraśabdaiścitraiśca darśanaiḥ//
sraṃsanollekhanairdhūmairañjanaiḥ kavalagrahaiḥ/ / śoṇitasyāvasekaiśca vyāyāmodgharṣṇaistathā//
prabuddhasaṃjñaṃ matimānanubandhamupakramet/ / &tasya saṃrakṣitavyaṃ hi manaḥ pralayahetutaḥ//
snehasvedopapannānāṃ yathādoṣaṃ yathābalam/ / pañca karmāṇi kurvīta mūrcchāyeṣu madeṣu ca//
aṣṭāviṃśatyauṣadhasya tathā tiktasya sarpiṣaḥ/ / prayogaḥ śasyate tadvanmahataḥ ṣaṭpalasya vā//
triphalāyāḥ prayogo vā saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaraḥ/ / śilājatuprayogo vā prayogaḥ payaso 'api vā//
pippalīnāṃ prayogo vā payasā citrakasya vā/ / rasāyanānāṃ kaumbhasya sarpiṣo vā praśasyate//
raktāvasekācchāstrāṇāṃ satāṃ sattvavatāmapi/ / sevanānmadamūrcchāyāḥ praśamyanti śarīriṇām//
madamūrcchāyasaṃnyāsahetulakṣaṇabheṣajam/ / vidhiśoṇitake 'adhyāye sarvametat prakāśitam//
tatra ślokaḥ / śarīrarogaprakṛtau matāni tattvena cāhāraviniścayaṃ ca / / uvāca yajjaḥpuruṣādike 'asmin munistathā 'agryāṇi varāsavāṃśca //

eṣāṃ khalvapareṣāṃ ca vairodhikanimittānāṃ vyādhīnāmime bhāvāḥ pratikārā bhavanti / / tadyathā vamanaṃ virecanaṃ ca tadvirodhināṃ ca dravyāṇāṃ saṃśamanārthamupayogaḥ tathāvidhaiśca dravyaiḥ pūrvamabhisaṃskāraḥ śarīrasyeti //
bhavataścātra / viruddhāśanajān rogān pratihanti vivecanam / / vamanaṃ śamanaṃ caiva pūrvaṃ vā hitasevanam //
tatra ślokāḥ / matirāsīnmaharṣīṇāṃ yā yā rasaviniścaye / / dravyāṇi guṇakramabhyāṃ dravyasaṃkhyā rasāśrayā //
paramato &vargasaṃgraheṇāhāradravyāṇyanuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ//
śūkadhānyaśamīdhānyamāṃsaśākaphalāśrayān/ / vargān haritamadyāmbugorasekṣuvikārikān//
daśa dvau cāparau vargau kṛtānnāhārayoginām/ / rasavīryavipākaiśca prabhāvaiśca pracakṣmahe//
atha śūkadhānyavargaḥ--- raktaśālirmahāśāliḥ kalamaḥ śakunāhṛtaḥ&/ / &tūrṇako dīrghaśūkaśca gauraḥ pāṇḍukalāṅgulau//
sugandhako lohavālaḥ sārivākhyaḥ pramodakaḥ/ / pataṅgastapanīyaśca ye cānye śālayaḥ śubhāḥ//
śītā rase vipāke ca madhurāścālpamārutāḥ/ / baddhālpavarcasaḥ snigdhā bṛṃhaṇāḥ śukramūtralāḥ//
raktaśālirvarasteṣāṃ &tṛṣṇāghnastrimalāpahaḥ/ / mahāṃstasyānu kalamastasyāpyanu tataḥ pare//
yavakā hāyanāḥ pāṃsuvāpyanaiṣadhakādayaḥ&/ / śālīnāṃ śālayaḥ kurvantyanukāraṃ guṇāguṇaiḥ//
śītaḥ snigdho 'aguruḥ svādustridoṣaghnaḥ sthirātmakaḥ/ / ṣaṣṭikaḥ pravaro gauraḥ kṛṣṇagaurastato 'anu ca//
varakoddālakau cīnaśāradojjvaladardurāḥ/ / &gandhanāḥ kuruvindāśca ṣaṣṭikālpāntarā guṇaiḥ//
madhuraścāmlapākaśca vrīhiḥ pittakaro guruḥ/ / bahumūtrapurīṣoṣmā tridoṣastveva pāṭalaḥ//
sakoradūṣaḥ śyāmākaḥ kaṣāyamadhuro laghuḥ/ / vātalaḥ kaphapittaghnaḥ śītaḥ saṃgrāhiśoṣaṇaḥ//
hastiśyāmākanīvāratoyaparṇīgavedhukāḥ/ / praśāntikāmbhaḥśyāmākalauhityāṇupriyaṅgavaḥ&//
mukundo kṣiṇṭigarmūṭī& varukā varakāstathā/ / śibirotkaṭajūrṇāhvāḥ śyāmākasadṛśā guṇaiḥ//
rūkṣaḥ śīto 'aguruḥ svādurbahuvātaśakṛdyavaḥ/ / sthairyakṛt &sakaṣāyaśca balyaḥ śleṣmavikāranut//
rūkṣaḥ kaṣāyanuraso madhuraḥ kaphapittahā/ / medaḥkrimiviṣaghnaśca balyo veṇuyavo mataḥ//
sandhānakṛdvātaharo godhūmaḥ svāduśītalaḥ/ / jīvano bṛṃhaṇo vṛṣyaḥ snigdhaḥ sthairyakaro guruḥ//
nāndīmukhī madhūlī ca madhurasnigdhaśītale/ / ityayaṃ śūkadhānyānāṃ pūrvo vargaḥ samāpyate//
atha śamīdhānyavargaḥ--- kaṣāyamadhuro rūkṣaḥ śītaḥ pāke kaṭurlaghuḥ/ / &viśadaḥ śleṣmapittaghno mudgaḥ sūpyottamo mataḥ//
vṛṣyaḥ paraṃ vātaharaḥ snigdhoṣṇo madhuro guruḥ/ / balyo bahumalaḥ puṃstvaṃ māṣaḥ śīghraṃ dadāti ca//
rājamāṣaḥ& saro rucyaḥ kaphaśukrāmlapittanut/ / tatsvādurvātalo rūkṣaḥ kaṣāyo viśado guruḥ//
uṣṇāḥ kaṣāyāḥ pāke 'amlāḥ kaphaśukrānilāpahāḥ/ / kulatthā grāhiṇaḥ kāsahikkāśvāsārśasāṃ hitāḥ//
madhurā madhurāḥ pāke grāhiṇo rūkṣaśītalāḥ/ / makuṣṭhakāḥ praśasyante raktapittajvarādiṣu//
caṇakāścamasūrāśca khaṇḍikāḥ sahareṇavaḥ/ / laghavaḥ śītamadhurāḥ sakaṣāyā virūkṣaṇāḥ//
pittaśleṣmaṇi śasyante sūpeṣvālepaneṣu ca/ / teṣāṃ masūraḥ saṃgrāhī kalāyo vātalaḥ param//
snigdhoṣṇo madhurastiktaḥ kaṣāyaḥ kaṭukastilaḥ/ / tvacyaḥ keśyaśca balyaśca vātaghnaḥ kaphapittakṛt//
madhurāḥ śītalā gurvyo balaghnyo rūkṣaṇātmikāḥ/ / sasnehā balibhirbhojyā vividhāḥ śimbijātayaḥ//
śimbī rūkṣā kaṣāyā ca koṣṭhe vātaprakopinī/ / na ca vṛṣyā na cakṣuṣyā viṣṭabhya ca vipacyate//
āḍhakī kaphapittaghnī vātalā, kaphavātanut/ / avalgujaḥ saiḍagajo, niṣpāvā vātapittalāḥ//
kākāṇḍomā(lā)tmaguptānāṃ māṣavat phalamādiśet/ / dvitīyo 'ayaṃ śamīdhānyavargaḥ prokto maharṣiṇā//
atha māṃsavargaḥ--- gokharāśvataroṣṭrāśvadvīpisiṃharkṣavānarāḥ/ / vṛko vyāghrastarakṣuśca babhrumārjāramūṣikāḥ//
lopāko jambukaḥ śyeno vāntādaścāṣavāyasau/ / śaśaghnī madhuhā bhāso gṛdhrolūkakuliṅgakāḥ//
dhūmikā kuraraśceti prasahā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ/ / śvetaḥ śyāmaścitrapṛṣṭhaḥ kālakaḥ kākulīmṛgaḥ//
kūrcikā cillaṭo bheko godhā śallakagaṇḍakau/ / kadalī nakulaḥ śvāviditi bhūmiśayāḥ smṛtāḥ//
sṛmaraścamaraḥ khaṅgo mahiṣo gavayo gajaḥ/ / nyaṅkurvarāhaścānūpā mṛgāḥ sarve rurustathā//
kūrmaḥ karkaṭako matsyaḥ śiśumārastimiṅgilaḥ/ / śuktiśaṅkhodrakummīraculukīmakarādayaḥ//
iti vāriśayāḥ proktā, vakṣyante vāricāriṇaḥ/ / haṃsaḥ krauñco balākā ca bakaḥ kāraṇḍavaḥ plavaḥ//
śarāriḥ puṣkarāhvaśca keśarī maṇituṇḍakaḥ&/ / mṛṇālakaṇṭho madguśca kādambaḥ kākatuṇḍakaḥ//
utkrośaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo megharāvo 'ambukukkuṭī/ / ārā nandīmukhī vāṭī sumukhāḥ sahacāriṇaḥ//
rohiṇī kāmakālī ca sāraso raktaśīrṣakaḥ// / cakravākastathā 'anye ca khagāḥ santyambucāriṇaḥ//
pṛṣataḥ śarabho rāmaḥ śvadaṃṣṭro mṛgamātṛkā/ / śaśoraṇau kuraṅgaśca gokarṇaḥ koṭṭakārakaḥ//
cāruṣko hariṇaiṇau ca śambaraḥ kālapucchakaḥ/ / ṛṣyaśca varapotaśca vijñeyā jāṅgalā mṛgāḥ//
lāvo vartīrakaścaiva vārtīkaḥ sakapiñjalaḥ/ / cakoraścopacakraśca kukkubho raktavartmakaḥ//
lāvādyā viṣkirāstvete vakṣyante vartakādayaḥ/ / vartako vartikā caiva barhī tittirikukkuṭau//
kaṅkaśārapadendrābhagonardagirivartakāḥ/ / krakaro 'avakaraścaiva &vāraḍaśceti viṣkirāḥ//
śatapatro bhṛṅgarājaḥ koyaṣṭirjīvajīvakaḥ/ / kairātaḥ kokilo 'atyūho gopāputraḥ priyātmajaḥ//
laṭṭā laṭṭa(ṭū)ṣako babhrurvaṭahā ḍiṇḍimānakaḥ/ / jaṭī &dundubhipākkāralohapṛṣṭhakuliṅgakāḥ//
kapotaśukaśāraṅgāściraṭīkaṅkuyaṣṭikāḥ/ / sārikā kalaviṅkaśca caṭako 'aṅgāracūḍakaḥ//
pārāvataḥ pāṇḍa(na)vikaḥ ityuktāḥ pratudā dvijāḥ/ / prasahya bhakṣayantīti prasahāstena saṃjñitāḥ//
bhūśayā bilavāsitvādānūpānūpasaṃśrayāt&/ / jale nivāsājjalajā jalecaryājjalecarāḥ//
sthalajā jāṅgalāḥ proktā mṛgā jāṅgalacāriṇaḥ/ / vikīrya viṣkirāśceti pratudya pratudāḥ smṛtāḥ//
yoniraṣṭavidhā tveṣā māṃsānāṃ parikīrtitā/ / prasahā bhūśayānūpavārijā vāricāriṇaḥ//
gurūṣṇasnigdhamadhurā balopacayavardhanāḥ/ / vṛṣyāḥ paraṃ vātaharāḥ kaphapittavivardhanāḥ//
hitā vyāyāmanityebhyo narā dīptāgnayaśca ye/ / prasahānāṃ viśeṣeṇa māṃsaṃ māṃsāśināṃ bhiṣak//
jīrṇārśograhaṇīdoṣaśoṣārtānāṃ prayojayet/ / lāvādyo vaiṣkiro vargaḥ pratudā jāṅgalā mṛgāḥ//
laghavaḥ śītamadhurāḥ sakaṣāyā hitā nṛṇām/ / pittottare vātamadhye sannipāte kaphānuge//
viṣkirā vartakādyāstu prasahālpāntarā guṇaiḥ/ / &nātiśītagurusnigdhaṃ māṃsamājamadoṣalam//
śarīradhātusāmānyādanabhiṣyandi bṛṃhaṇam/ / māṃsaṃ madhuraśītatvādguru bṛṃhaṇamāvikam//
&yonāvajāvike miśragocaratvādaniścite/ / sāmānyenopadiṣṭānāṃ māṃsānāṃ svaguṇaiḥ pṛthak//
keṣāṃcidguṇavaiśeṣyādviśeṣa upadekṣyate/ / darśanaśrotramedhāgnivayovarṇasvarāyuṣām//
barhī hitatamo balyo vātaghno māṃsaśukralaḥ/ / gurūṣṇasnigdhamadhurāḥ svaravarṇabalapradāḥ//
bṛṃhaṇāḥ śukralāścoktā haṃsā mārutanāśanāḥ/ / snigdhāścoṣṇāśca vṛṣyāśca bṛṃhaṇāḥ svarabodhanāḥ//
balyāḥ paraṃ vātaharāḥ svedanāścaraṇāyudhāḥ/ / gurūṣṇo madhuro nātidhanvānūpaniṣevaṇāt//
tittiriḥ saṃjayecchīghraṃ trīn doṣānanilolbaṇān/ / pittaśleṣmavikāreṣu sarakteṣu kapiñjalāḥ//
mandavāteṣu śasyante śaityamādhuryalāghavāt/ / lāvāḥ kaṣāyamadhurā laghavo 'agnivivardhanāḥ//
sannipātapraśamanāḥ kaṭukāśca vipākataḥ/ / godhā vipāke madhurā kaṣāyakaṭukā rase//
vātapittapraśamanī bṛṃhaṇī balavardhanī/ / śallako madhurāmlaśca vipāke kaṭukaḥ smṛtaḥ//
vātapittakaphaghnaśca kāsaśvāsaharastathā/ / kaṣāyaviśadāḥ śītā raktapittanibarhaṇāḥ//
vipāke madhurāścaiva kapotā gṛhavāsinaḥ/ / tebhyo laghutarāḥ kiṃcit kapotā vanavāsinaḥ&//
śītāḥ saṃgrāhiṇaścaiva svalpamūtrakarāśca te/ / śukamāṃsaṃ kaṣāyāmlaṃ vipāke rūkṣaśītalam//
śoṣakāsakṣayahitaṃ saṃgrāhi laghu dīpanam/ / caṭakā madhurāḥ snigdhā balaśukravivardhanāḥ//
sannipātapraśamanāḥ śamanā mārutasya ca/ / kaṣāyo viśado rūkṣaḥ śītaḥ pāke kaṭurlaghuḥ//
śaśaḥ svāduḥ praśastaśca saṃnipāte 'anilāvare/ / madhurā madhurāḥ pāke tridoṣaśamanāḥ śivāḥ//
laghavo baddhaviṇmūtrāḥ śītāścaiṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥ/ / snehanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ vṛṣyaṃ śramaghnamanilāpaham//
varāhapiśitaṃ balyaṃ rocanaṃ svedanaṃ guru/ / gavyaṃ kevalavāteṣu pīnase viṣamajvare//
śuṣkakāsaśramātyagnimāṃsakṣayahitaṃ ca tat/ / snigdhoṣṇaṃ madhuraṃ vṛṣyaṃ māhiṣaṃ guru tarpaṇam//
dārḍhyaṃ bṛhattvamutsāhaṃ svapnaṃ ca janayatyapi/ / gurūṣṇā madhurā balyā bṛṃhaṇāḥ pavanāpahāḥ//
matsyāḥ snigdhāśca vṛṣyāśca bahudoṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ/ / śaivālaśaṣpabhojitvātsvapnasya ca vivarjanāt//
rohito dīpanīyaśca laghupāko mahābalaḥ/ / varṇyo vātaharo vṛṣyaścakṣuṣyo balavardhanaḥ//
medhāsmṛtikaraḥ pathyaḥ śoṣaghnaḥ kūrma ucyate/ / khaḍgamāṃsamabhiṣyandi balakṛnmadhuraṃ smṛtam//
snehanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ varṇyaṃ śramaghnamanilāpaham/ / dhārtarāṣṭracakorāṇāṃ dakṣāṇāṃ śikhināmapi//
caṭakānāṃ ca yāni syuraṇḍāni ca hitāni ca/ / kṣīṇaretaḥsu kāseṣu hṛdrogeṣu kṣateṣu ca//
madhurāṇyavidāhīni sadyobalakarāṇi ca/ / śarīrabṛṃhaṇe nānyat khādyaṃ māṃsādviśiṣyate//
iti vargastṛtīyo 'ayaṃ māṃsānāṃ parikīrtitaḥ/ / atha śākavargaḥ--- pāṭāśuṣāśaṭīśākaṃ vāstukaṃ suniṣaṇṇakam//
vidyādgrāhi tridoṣaghnaṃ bhinnavarcastu vāstukam/ / tridoṣaśamanī vṛṣyā kākamācī rasāyanī//
nātyuṣṇaśītavīryā ca bhedinī kuṣṭhanāśinī/ / rājakṣavakaśākaṃ tu tridoṣaśamanaṃ laghu//
grāhi śastaṃ viśeṣeṇa grahaṇyarśovikāriṇām/ / kālaśākaṃ tu kaṭukaṃ dīpanaṃ garaśophajit//
laghūṣṇaṃ vātalaṃ rūkṣaṃ &kālāyaṃ śākamucyate/ / dīpanī coṣṇavīryā ca grāhiṇī kaphamārute//
praśasyate 'amlacāṅgerī grahaṇyarśohitā ca sā/ / madhurā madhurā pāke bhedinī śleṣmavardhanī//
vṛṣyā snigdhā ca śītā ca madaghnī cāpyupodikā/ / rūkṣo madaviṣaghnaśca praśasto raktapittinām//
madhuro madhuraḥ pāke śītalastaṇḍulīyakaḥ/ / maṇḍūkaparṇī vetrāgraṃ kucelā vanatiktakam//
karkoṭakāvalgujakau paṭolaṃ śakulādanī/ / vṛṣapuṣpāṇi śārṅgeṣṭā kembūkaṃ sakaṭhillakam//
nāḍī kalāyaṃ gojihvā vārtākaṃ tilaparṇikā/ / kaulakaṃ kārkaśaṃ naimbaṃ śākaṃ pārpaṭakaṃ ca yat//
kaphapittaharaṃ tiktaṃ śītaṃ kaṭu vipacyate/ / sarvāṇi sūpyaśākāni phañjī cillī kutumbakaḥ//
ālukāni ca sarvāṇi sapatrāṇi kuṭiñjaram&/ / śaṇaśālmalipuṣpāṇi karbudāraḥ suvarcalā//
niṣpāvaḥ kovidāraśca patturaścuccuparṇikā/ / kumārajīvo loṭṭākaḥ pālaṅkyā māriṣastathā//
kalambanālikāsūryaḥ kusumbhavṛkadhūmakau/ / lakṣmaṇā ca prapunnāḍo nalinīkā kuṭherakaḥ//
loṇikā yavaśākaṃ ca kuṣmāṇḍakamavalgujam/ / yātukaḥ śālakalyāṇī triparṇī pīluparṇikā//
śākaṃ guru ca rūkṣaṃ ca prāyo viṣṭabhya jīryati/ / madhuraṃ śītavīryaṃ ca purīṣasya ca bhedanam//
svinnaṃ niṣpīḍitarasaṃ snehāḍhyaṃ tat praśasyate/ / śaṇasya kovidārasya karbudārasya śālmaleḥ//
puṣpaṃ grāhi praśastaṃ ca raktapitte viśeṣataḥ/ / nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣapadmādipallavāḥ//
kaṣāyāḥ stambhanāḥ śītā hitāḥ pittātisāriṇām/ / vāyuṃ vatsādanī hanyāt kaphaṃ gaṇḍīracitrakau//
śreyasī bilvaparṇī ca bilvapatraṃ tu vātanut/ / bhaṇḍī śatāvarīśākaṃ balā jīvantikaṃ ca yat//
parvaṇyāḥ parvapuṣpyāśca vātapittaharaṃ smṛtam/ / laghu bhinnaśakṛttiktaṃ lāṅgalakyurubūkayoḥ//
tilavetasaśākaṃ ca śākaṃ pañcāṅgulasya ca/ / vātalaṃ kaṭutiktāmlamadhomārgapravartanam//
rūkṣāmlamuṣṇaṃ kausumbhaṃ kaphaghnaṃ pittavardhanam/ / trapusairvārukaṃ svādu guru viṣṭambhi śītalam//
mukhapriyaṃ ca rūkṣaṃ ca mūtralaṃ trapusaṃ tvati/ / ervārukaṃ ca saṃpakvaṃ dāhatṛṣṇāklamārtinut//
varcobhedīnyalābūni& rūkṣaśītagurūṇi ca/ / cirbhaṭairvāruke tadvadvarcobhedahite tu te//
&sakṣāraṃ pakvakūṣmāṇḍaṃ madhurāmlaṃ tathā laghu/ / sṛṣṭamūtrapurīṣaṃ ca sarvadoṣanibarhaṇam//
kelūṭaṃ ca kadambaṃ ca nadīmāṣakamaindukam/ / viśadaṃ guru śītaṃ ca samabhiṣyandi cocyate//
utpalāni kaṣāyāṇi raktapittaharāṇi ca/ / tathā tālapralambaṃ syāduraḥkṣatarujāpaham//
kharjūraṃ tālaśasyaṃ ca raktapittakṣayāpaham/ / tarūṭabisaśālūkakrauñcādanakaśerukam//
śṛṅgāṭakāṅkaloḍyaṃ ca guru viṣṭambhi śītalam/ / kumudotpalanālāstu sapuṣpāḥ saphalāḥ smṛtāḥ//
śītāḥ svādukaṣāyāstu kaphamārutakopanāḥ/ / kaṣāyamīṣadviṣṭambhi raktapittaharaṃ smṛtam//
pauṣkaraṃ tu bhavedvījaṃ madhuraṃ rasapākayoḥ/ / balyaḥ śīto guruḥ snigdhastarpaṇo bṛṃhaṇātmakaḥ//
vātapittaharaḥ svādurvṛṣyo muñcātakaḥ param/ / jīvano bṛṃhaṇo vṛṣyaḥ kaṇṭhyaḥ śasto rasāyane//
vidārikando balyaśca mūtralaḥ svāduśītalaḥ/ / amlikāyāḥ smṛtaḥ kando grahaṇyarśohito laghuḥ//

nātyuṣṇaḥ kaphavātaghno grāhī śasto madātyaye/ / tridoṣaṃ baddhaviṇmūtraṃ sārṣapaṃ śākamucyate// / (&tadvat syādraktanālasya rūkṣamamlaṃ viśeṣataḥ/) / tadvat piṇḍālukaṃ vidyāt kandatvācca mukhapriyam/ / sarpacchatrakavarjyāstu bahvayo 'anyāśchatrajātayaḥ//
śītāḥ pīnasakartryaśca madhurā gurvya eva ca/ / caturthaḥ śākavargo 'ayaṃ patrakandaphalāśrayaḥ//
atha phalavargaḥ--- tṛṣṇādāhajvaraśvāsaraktapittakṣatakṣayān/ / vātapittamudāvartaṃ svarabhedaṃ madātyayam//
tiktāsyatāmāsyaśoṣaṃ kāsaṃ cāśu vyapohati/ / mṛdvīkā bṛṃhaṇī vṛṣyā madhurā snigdhaśītalā//
madhuraṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ vṛṣyaṃ kharjūraṃ guru śītalam/ / kṣaye 'abhighāte dāhe ca vātapitte ca taddhitam//
tarpaṇaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ phalgu guru viṣṭambhi śītalam/ / parūṣakaṃ madhūkaṃ ca vātapitte ca śasyate//
madhuraṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ balyamāmrātaṃ tarpaṇaṃ guru/ / sasnehaṃ śleṣmalaṃ śītaṃ vṛṣyaṃ viṣṭabhya jīryati//
tālaśasyāni siddhāni nārikelaphalāni ca/ / bṛṃhaṇasnigdhaśītāni balyāni madhurāṇi ca//
madhurāmlakaṣāyaṃ ca viṣṭambhi guru śītalam/ / pittaśleṣmakaraṃ bhavyaṃ grāhi vaktraviśodhanam//
amlaṃ parūṣakaṃ drākṣā badarāṇyārukāṇi ca/ / pittaśleṣmaprakopīṇi karkandhunikucānyapi//
nātyuṣṇaṃ guru saṃpakvaṃ svāduprāyaṃ mukhapriyam/ / bṛṃhaṇaṃ jīryati kṣipraṃ nātidoṣalamārukam//
dvividhaṃ śītamuṣṇaṃ ca madhuraṃ cāmlameva ca/ / guru pārāvataṃ jñeyamarucyatyagnināśanam//
bhavyādalpāntaraguṇaṃ kāśmaryaphalamucyate/ / tathaivālpāntaraguṇaṃ tūdamamlaṃ parūṣakāt//
kaṣāyamadhuraṃ ṭaṅkaṃ vātalaṃ guru śītalam/ / kapitthamāmaṃ kaṇṭhaghnaṃ viṣaghnaṃ grāhi vātalam&//
madhurāmlakaṣāyatvāt saugandhyācca rucipradam/ / &paripakvaṃ ca doṣaghnaṃ viṣaghnaṃ grāhi guruvapi//
bilvaṃ tu durjaraṃ pakvaṃ doṣalaṃ pūtimārutam/ / snigdhoṣṇatīkṣṇaṃ tadvālaṃ dīpanaṃ kaphavātajit//
raktapittakaraṃ bālamāpūrṇaṃ pittavardhanam/ / pakvamāmraṃ jayedvāyuṃ māṃsaśukrabalapradam//
kaṣāyamadhuraprāyaṃ guru viṣṭambhi śītalam/ / jāmbaraṃ kaphapittaghnaṃ grāhi vātakaraṃ param//
badaraṃ madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ bhedanaṃ vātapittajit/ / tacchuṣkaṃ kaphavātaghnaṃ pitte na ca virudhyate//
kaṣāyamadhuraṃ śītaṃ grāhi simbi(ñci)tikāphalam/ / gāṅgerukī karīraṃ ca bimbī todanadhanvanam//
madhuraṃ sakaṣāyaṃ ca śītaṃ pittakaphāpaham/ / saṃpakvaṃ panasaṃ mocaṃ rājādanaphalāni ca//
svādūni sakaṣāyāṇi snigdhaśītagurūṇi ca/ / kaṣāyaviśadatvācca saugandhyācca rucipradam//
avadaṃśakṣamaṃ hṛdyaṃ vātalaṃ lavalīphalam/ / nīpaṃ &śatāhvakaṃ pīlu tṛṇaśūnyaṃ vikaṅkatam//
prācīnāmalakaṃ caiva doṣaghnaṃ garahāri ca/ / aiṅgudaṃ tiktamadhuraṃ snigdhoṣṇaṃ kaphavātajit//
tindukaṃ kaphapittaghnaṃ kaṣāyaṃ madhuraṃ laghu/ / vidyādāmalake sarvān rasāṃllavaṇavarjitān//
rūkṣaṃ svādu kaṣāyāmlaṃ kaphapittaharaṃ param/ / rasāsṛṅgāṃsamedojāndoṣān hanti bibhītakam//
svarabhedakaphotkledapittarogavināśanam/ / amlaṃ kaṣāyamadhuraṃ vātaghnaṃ grāhi dīpanam//
snigdhoṣṇaṃ dāḍimaṃ hṛdyaṃ kaphapittāvirodhi ca/ / rūkṣāmlaṃ dāḍimaṃ yattu tat pittānilakopanam//
madhuraṃ pittanutteṣāṃ pūrvaṃ dāḍimamuttamam/ / bṛkṣāmlaṃ grāhi rūkṣoṣṇaṃ vātaśleṣmaṇi śasyate//
amlikāyāḥ phalaṃ pakvaṃ tasmādalpāntaraṃ guṇaiḥ/ / guṇaistaireva saṃyuktaṃ bhedanaṃ tvamlavetasam//
śūle 'arucau vibandhe ca mande 'agnau &madyaviplave/ / hikkāśvāse ca kāse ca vamyāṃ varcogadeṣu ca//
vātaśleṣmasamuttheṣu sarveṣvevopadiśyate/ / kesaraṃ mātuluṅgasya laghu śeṣamato 'anyathā//
rocano dīpano hṛdyaḥ sugandhistvagvivarjitaḥ/ / karcūraḥ kaphavātaghnaḥ śvāsahikkārśasāṃ hitaḥ//
madhuraṃ kiṃcidamlaṃ ca hṛdyaṃ bhaktaprarocanam/ / durjaraṃ vātaśamanaṃ nāgaraṅgaphalaṃ &guru//
vātamābhiṣukākṣoṭamukūlakanikocakāḥ/ / gurūṣṇasnigdhamadhurāḥ sorumāṇā balapradāḥ//
vātaghnā bṛṃhaṇā vṛṣyāḥ kaphapittābhivardhanāḥ/ / priyālameṣāṃ sadṛśaṃ vidyādauṣṇyaṃ vinā guṇaiḥ//
śleṣmalaṃ madhuraṃ śītaṃ śleṣmātakaphalaṃ guru/ / śleṣmalaṃ guru viṣṭmbhi cāṅkoṭaphalamagnijit//
gurūṣṇaṃ madhuraṃ rūkṣaṃ keśaghnaṃ ca śamīphalam/ / viṣṭambhayati kārañjaṃ vātaśleṣmāvirodhi ca//
āmrātakaṃ dantaśaṭhamamlaṃ sakaramardakam/ / raktapittakaraṃ vidyādairāvatakameva ca//
vātaghnaṃ dīpanaṃ caiva vārtākaṃ kaṭu tiktakam/ / vātalaṃ kaphapittaghnaṃ vidyāt parpaṭakīphalam//
pittaśleṣmaghnamamlaṃ ca vātalaṃ cākṣikīphalam/ / madhurāṇyamlapākīni pittaśleṣmaharāṇi ca//
aśvatthodumbaraplakṣanyagrodhānāṃ phalāni ca/ / kaṣāyamadhurāmlāni vātalāni gurūṇi ca//
bhallātakāsthyagnisamaṃ tanmāṃsaṃ svādu śītalam/ / pañcamaḥ phalavargo 'ayamuktaḥ prāyopayogikaḥ//
atha haritavargaḥ--- rocanaṃ dīpanaṃ vṛṣyamārdrakaṃ viśvabheṣajam/ / vātaśleṣmavibandheṣu rasastasyopadiśyate//
rocano dīpanastīkṣṇaḥ sugandhirmukhaśodhanaḥ/ / jambīraḥ kaphavātaghnaḥ krimighno bhaktapācanaḥ//
bālaṃ doṣaharaṃ, vṛddhaṃ tridoṣaṃ, mārutāpaham/ / snigdhasiddhaṃ, viśuṣkaṃ tu mūlakaṃ kaphavātajit//
hikkākāsaviṣaśvāsapārśvaśūlavināśanaḥ/ / pittakṛt kaphavātaghnaḥ surasaḥ pūtigandhahā//
yavānī cārjakaścaiva śigruśāleyamṛṣṭakam/ / hṛdyānyāmvādanīyāni pittamutkleśayanti ca//
gaṇḍīro jalapippalyastumbaruḥ śṛṅgaverikā/ / tīkṣṇoṣṇakaṭurūkṣāṇi kaphavātaharāṇi ca//
puṃstvaghnaḥ kaṭurūkṣoṣṇo bhūstṛṇo vaktraśodhanaḥ/ / kharāhvā kaphavātaghnī bastirogarujāpahā//
dhānyakaṃ cājagandhā ca sumukhaśceti rocanāḥ/ / sugandhā nātikaṭukā doṣānutkleśayanti ca//
grāhī gṛñjanakastīkṣṇo vātaśleṣmārśasāṃ hitaḥ/ / svedane 'abhyavahāre ca yojayettamapittinām//
śleṣmalo mārutaghnaśca palāṇḍurna ca pittanut&/ / āhārayogī balyaśca gururvṛṣyo 'atha rocanaḥ//
krimikuṣṭhakilāsaghno vātaghno gulmanāśanaḥ/ / snigdhaścoṣṇaśca vṛṣyaśca laśunaḥ kaṭuko guruḥ//
śuṣkāṇi kaphavātaghnānyetānyeṣāṃ phalāni ca/ / haritānāmayaṃ caiṣa ṣaṣṭho vargaḥ samāpyate//
atha madyavargaḥ--- prakṛtyā madyamamloṣṇamamlaṃ coktaṃ vipākataḥ/ / sarvaṃ sāmānyatastasya viśeṣa upadekṣyate//
kṛśānāṃ saktamūtrāṇāṃ grahaṇyarśovikāriṇām/ / surā praśastā vātaghnī stanyaraktakṣayeṣu ca//
hikkāśvāsapratiśyāyakāsavarcograhārucau/ / vamyānāhavibandheṣu vātaghnī madirā hitā//
śūlapravāhikāṭopakaphavātārśasāṃ hitaḥ/ / jagalo grāhirūkṣoṣṇaḥ śophaghno bhaktapācanaḥ//
śoṣārśograhaṇīdoṣapāṇḍurogārucijvarān/ / hantyariṣṭaḥ kaphakṛtān rogānrocanadīpanaḥ&//
mukhapriyaḥ sukhamadaḥ sugandhirbastiroganut&/ / jaraṇīyaḥ pariṇato hṛdyo varṇyaśca śārkaraḥ//
rocano dīpano hṛdyaḥ śoṣaśophārśasāṃ hitaḥ/ / snehaśleṣmavikāraghno varṇyaḥ pakvaraso mataḥ//
jaraṇīyo vibandhaghnaḥ svaravarṇaviśodhanaḥ/ / lekhanaḥ śītarasiko hitaḥ śophodarārśasām//
sṛṣṭabhinnaśakṛdvāto gauḍastarpaṇadīpanaḥ/ / pāṇḍurogavraṇahitā dīpanī cākṣikī matā&//
surāsavastīvramado vātaghno vadanapriyaḥ/ / chedī madhvāsavastīkṣṇo maireyo madhuro guruḥ//
dhātakyā 'abhiṣuto hṛdyo& rūkṣo rocanadīpanaḥ/ / &mādhvīkavanna cātyuṣṇo mṛdvīkekṣurasāsavaḥ//
rocanaṃ dīpanaṃ hṛdyaṃ balyaṃ pittāvirodhi ca/ / vibandhaghnaṃ kaphaghnaṃ ca madhu laghvalpamārutam//
surā samaṇḍā rūkṣoṣṇā yavānāṃ vātapittalā/ / gurvī jīryati viṣṭabhya śleṣmalā tu madhūlikā//
dīpanaṃ jaraṇīyaṃ ca hṛtpāṇḍukrimiroganut/ / grahaṇyarśohitaṃ bhedi sauvīrakatuṣodakam//
dāhajvarāpahaṃ sparśāt pānādvātakaphāpaham/ / vibandhaghnamavasraṃsi dīpanaṃ cāmlakāñjikam//
prāyaśo 'abhinavaṃ madyaṃ gurudoṣasamīraṇam/ / srotasāṃ śodhanaṃ jīrṇaṃ dīpanaṃ laghu rocanam//
harṣaṇaṃ prīṇanaṃ madyaṃ bhayaśokaśramāpaham/ / prāgalbhyavīryapratibhātuṣṭipuṣṭibalarpadam//
sāttvikairvidhivadyuktyā pītaṃ syādamṛtaṃ yathā/ / vargo 'ayaṃ saptamo madyamadhikṛtya prakīrtitaḥ//
atha jalavargaḥ--- jalamekavidhaṃ sarvaṃ patatyaindraṃ nabhastalāt/ / &tat patat patitaṃ caiva deśakālāvapekṣate//
khāt& patat somavāyvarkaiḥ spṛṣṭaṃ kālānuvartibhiḥ/ / śotoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādyairyathāsannaṃ mahīguṇaiḥ//
śītaṃ śuci śivaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ vimalaṃ laghu ṣaḍguṇam/ / prakṛtyā divyamudakaṃ, bhraṣṭaṃ pātramapekṣate//
śvete kaṣāyaṃ bhavati pāṇḍare syāttu tiktakam/ / kapile kṣārasaṃsṛṣṭamūṣare lavaṇānvitam//
kaṭu parvatavistāre& madhuraṃ kṛṣṇamṛttike/ / etat ṣāḍguṇyamākhyātaṃ mahīsthasya jalasya hi/ / tathā 'avyaktarasaṃ vidyādaindraṃ kāraṃ himaṃ ca yat//
yadantarīkṣāt patatīndrasṛṣṭaṃ coktaiśca pātraiḥ parigṛhyate 'ambhaḥ/ / tadaindramityeva vadanti dhīrā narendrapeyaṃ &salilaṃ pradhānam//
īṣatkaṣāyamadhuraṃ susūkṣmaṃ viśadaṃ laghu/ / arūkṣamanabhiṣyandi sarvaṃ pānīyamuttamam//
gurvabhiṣyandi pānīyaṃ vārṣikaṃ madhuraṃ navam/ / tanu ladhvanabhiṣyandi prāyaḥ śaradi varṣati//
tattu ye sukumārāḥ syuḥ snigdhabhūyiṣṭhabhojanāḥ/ / teṣāṃ bhojye ca bhakṣye ca lehye peye ca śasyate//
hemante salilaṃ snigdhaṃ vṛṣyaṃ balahitaṃ guru/ / kiṃcittato laghutaraṃ śiśire kaphavātajit//
kaṣāyamadhuraṃ rūkṣaṃ vidyādvāsantikaṃ jalam/ / graiṣmikaṃ tvanabhiṣyandi jalamityeva niścayaḥ//
vibhrānteṣu tu kāleṣu yat prayacchanti toyadāḥ/ / salilaṃ tattu doṣāya yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ//
rājabhī rājamātraiśca sukumāraiśca mānavaiḥ/ / sugṛhītāḥ śaradyāpaḥ prayoktavyā viśeṣataḥ//
nadyaḥ pāṣāṇavicchinnavikṣubdhābhihatodakāḥ&/ / himavatprabhavāḥ pathyāḥ puṇyā devarṣisevitāḥ//
nadyaḥ pāṣāṇasikatāvāhinyo vimalodakāḥ/ / malayaprabhavā yāśca jalaṃ tāsvamṛtopamam//
paścimābhimukhā yāśca pathyāstā nirmalodakāḥ/ / prāyo mṛduvahā gurvyo yāśca pūrvasamudragāḥ//
pāriyātrabhavā yāśca vindhyasahyabhavāśca yāḥ/ / śirohṛdrogakuṣṭhānāṃ tā hetuḥ ślīpadasya ca//
vasudhākīṭasarpākhumalasaṃdūṣitodakāḥ/ / varṣājalavahā nadyaḥ sarvadoṣasamīraṇāḥ//
vāpīkūpataḍāgotsasaraḥprasravaṇādiṣu/ / ānūpaśailadhanvānāṃ guṇadoṣairvibhāvayet//
picchilaṃ krimilaṃ klinnaṃ parṇaśaivālakardamaiḥ/ / vivarṇaṃ virasaṃ sāndraṃ durgandhaṃ na hitaṃ jalam//
visraṃ tridoṣaṃ lavaṇamambu yadvaruṇālayam/ / ityambuvargaḥ prokto 'ayamaṣṭamaḥ suviniścitaḥ//
atha gorasavargaḥ--- svādu śītaṃ mṛdu snigdhaṃ bahalaṃ ślakṣṇapicchilam/ / guru mandaṃ prasannaṃ ca gavyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ payaḥ//
tadevaṃguṇamevaujaḥ sāmānyādabhivardhayet/ / pravaraṃ jīvanīyānāṃ kṣīramuktaṃ rasāyanam//
mahiṣīṇāṃ gurutaraṃ gavyācchītataraṃ payaḥ/ / snehānyūnamanidrāya hitamatyagnaye ca tat//
rūkṣoṣṇaṃ kṣīramuṣṭrīṇāmīṣatsalavaṇaṃ laghu/ / śastaṃ vātakaphānāhakrimiśophodarārśasām//
balyaṃ sthairyakaraṃ sarvamuṣṇaṃ caikaśaphaṃ payaḥ/ / sāmlaṃ salavaṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ śākhāvātaharaṃ laghu//
chāgaṃ kaṣāyamadhuraṃ śītaṃ grāhi payo laghu/ / raktapittātisāraghnaṃ kṣayakāsajvarāpaham//
hikkāśvāsakaraṃ tūṣṇaṃ pittaśleṣmalamāvikam/ / hastinīnāṃ payo balyaṃ guru sthairyakaraṃ param//
jīvanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ sātmyaṃ snehanaṃ mānuṣaṃ payaḥ/ / nāvanaṃ raktapitte ca tarpaṇaṃ cākṣiśūlinām//
rocanaṃ dīpanaṃ vṛṣyaṃ snehanaṃ balavardhanam/ / pāke 'amlamuṣṇaṃ vātaghnaṃ maṅgalyaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ dadhi//
pīnase cātisāre ca śītake viṣamajvare/ / arucau mūtrakṛcchre ca kārśye ca dadhi śasyate//
śaradgrīṣmavasanteṣu prāyaśo dadhi garhitam/ / raktapittakaphottheṣu vikāreṣvahitaṃ ca tat//
&tridoṣaṃ mandakaṃ, jātaṃ vātaghnaṃ dadhi, śukralaḥ/ / saraḥ, śleṣmānilaghnastu maṇḍaḥ srotoviśodhanaḥ//
śophārśograhaṇīdoṣamūtragrahodarārucau/ / snehavyāpadi pāṇḍutve takraṃ dadyādgareṣu ca//
saṃgrāhi dīpanaṃ hṛdyaṃ navanītaṃ navoddhṛtam/ / grahaṇyarśovikāraghnamarditārucināśanam//
smṛtibuddhyagniśukraujaḥkaphamedovivardhanam/ / vātapittaviṣonmādaśoṣālakṣmījvarāpaham&//
sarvasnehottamaṃ śītaṃ madhuraṃ rasapākayoḥ/ / sahasravīryaṃ vidhibhirghṛtaṃ karmasahasrakṛt//
madāpasmāramūrcchsāyaśoṣonmādagarajvarān/ / yonikarṇaśiraḥśūlaṃ ghṛtaṃ jīrṇamapohati//
sarpīṃṣyajāvimahiṣīkṣīravat svāni nirdiśet/ / pīyūṣo moraṭaṃ caiva kilāṭā vividhāśca ye//
dīpatāgnīnāmanidrāṇāṃ sarva eva sukhapradāḥ/ / guravastarpaṇā vṛṣyā bṛṃhaṇāḥ pavanāpahāḥ//
viśadā guravo rūkṣā grāhiṇastakrapiṇḍakāḥ/ / gorasānāmayaṃ vargo navamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ//
athokṣuvargaḥ--- vṛṣyaḥ śītaḥ saraḥ snigdho bṛṃhaṇo madhuro rasaḥ/ / śleṣmalo bhakṣitasyekṣoryāntrikastu& vidahyate//
śaityāt prasādānmadhuryāt pauṇḍrakādvaṃśako varaḥ/ / prabhūtakrimimajjāsṛṅnodomāṃsakaro guḍaḥ//
kṣudro guḍaścaturbhāgatribhāgārdhāvaśeṣitaḥ/ / raso gururyathāpūrvaṃ dhautaḥ svalpamalo guḍaḥ//
tato matsyaṇḍikākhaṇḍaśarkarā vimalāḥ param/ / yathā yathaiṣāṃ vaimalyaṃ bhavecchaityaṃ tathā tathā//
vṛṣyā kṣīṇakṣatahitā sasnehā guḍaśarkarā/ / kaṣāyamadhurā śītā satiktā yāsaśarkarā//
rūkṣā vamyatisāraghnī cchedanī madhuśarkarā/ / tṛṣṇāsṛkpittadāheṣu praśastāḥ sarvaśarkarāḥ//
mākṣikaṃ bhrāmaraṃ kṣaudraṃ paittikaṃ madhujātayaḥ/ / mākṣikaṃ pravaraṃ teṣāṃ viśeṣādbhrāmaraṃ guru//
mākṣikaṃ tailavarṇaṃ syādghṛtavarṇaṃ tu pauttikam/ / kṣaudraṃ kapilavarṇaṃ syācchvetaṃ bhrāmaramucyate//
vātalaṃ guru śītaṃ ca raktapittakaphāpaham/ / sandhātṛ cchedanaṃ rūkṣaṃ kaṣāyaṃ madhuraṃ madhu&//
hanyānmadhūṣṇamuṣṇārtamathavā saviṣānvayāt/ / gururūkṣakaṣāyatvācchaityāccalpaṃ hitaṃ madhu//
nātaḥ kaṣṭatamaṃ kiṃcinmadhvāmāttaddhi mānavam/ / upakramavirochitvāt sadyo hanyādyathā viṣam//
āme soṣṇā kriyā kāryā sā madhvāme virudhyate/ / madhvāmaṃ dāruṇaṃ tasmāt sadyo hanyādyathā viṣam//
nānādravyātmakatvācca yogavāhi paraṃ madhu/(=Sū.sū.45.142cd) itīkṣuvikṛtiprāyo vargo 'ayaṃ daśamo mataḥ//
atha kṛtānnavargaḥ--- kṣuttṛṣṇāglānidaurbalyakukṣirogajvarāpahā/ / svedāgnijananī peyā vātavarconulomanī//
tarpaṇī grāhiṇī ladhvī hṛdyā cāpi vilepikā/ / maṇḍastu dīpayatyagniṃ vātaṃ cāpyanulomayet//
mṛdūkaroti srotāṃsi svedaṃ saṃjanayatyapi/ / laṅghitānāṃ viriktānāṃ jīrṇe snehe ca tṛṣyatām//
dīpanatvāllaghutvācca maṇḍaḥ syāt prāṇadhāraṇaḥ/ / lājapeyā śramaghnī tu kṣāmakaṇṭhasya dehinaḥ//
tṛṣṇātīsāraśamano dhātusāmyakaraḥ śivaḥ/ / lājamaṇḍo 'agnijanano &dāhamūrcchānivāraṇaḥ//
mandāgniviṣamāgnīnāṃ bālasthavirayoṣitām/ / deyaśca sukumārāṇāṃ lājamaṇḍaḥ susaṃskṛtaḥ//
kṣutpipāsāpahaḥ pathyaḥ śuddhānāṃ ca malāpahaḥ/ / śṛtaḥ pippaliśuṇṭhībhyāṃ &yukto lājāmladāḍimaiḥ//
kaṣāyamadhurāḥ śītā laghavo lājasaktavaḥ/ / sudhautaḥ prasrutaḥ svinnaḥ saṃtaptaścaudano laghuḥ//
bhṛṣṭataṇḍulamicchanti garaśleṣmāmayeṣvapi/ / adhauto 'aprasruto 'asvinnaḥ śītaścāpyodano guruḥ//
māṃsaśākavasātailaghṛtamajjaphalaudanāḥ/ / balyāḥ saṃtarpaṇā hṛdyā guravo bṛṃhayanti ca//
tadvanmāṣatilakṣīramudgasaṃyogasādhitāḥ/ / kulmāṣā guravo rūkṣā vātalā bhinnavarcasaḥ//
svinnabhakṣyāstu ye kecit saupyagaudhūmayāvikāḥ/ / bhiṣak teṣāṃ yathādravyamādiśedgurulāghavam//
akṛtaṃ kṛtayūṣaṃ ca tanuṃ sāṃskārikaṃ rasam/ / sūpamamlamanamlaṃ ca guruṃ vidyādyathottaram//
saktavo vātalā rūkṣā bahuvarconulominaḥ/ / tarpayanti naraṃ sadyaḥ pītāḥ sadyobalāśca te//
madhurā laghavaḥ śītāḥ saktavaḥ śālisaṃbhavāḥ/ / grāhiṇo raktapittaghnāstṛṣṇācchardijvarāpahāḥ//
hanyādvyādhīn yavāpūpo yāvako vāḍya eva ca/ / udāvartapratiśyāyakāsamehagalagrahān//
dhānāsaṃjñāstu ye bhakṣyāḥ prāyaste lekhanātmakāḥ/ / śuṣkatvāttarpaṇāścaiva viṣṭambhitvācca durjarāḥ//
virūḍhadhānā śaṣkulyo madhukroḍāḥ sapiṇḍakāḥ/ / pūpāḥ pūpalikādyāśca guruvaḥ paiṣṭikāḥ param//
phalamāṃsavasāśākapalalakṣaudrasaṃskṛtāḥ/ / bhakṣyā vṛṣyāśca balyāśca guravo bṛṃhaṇātmakāḥ//
veśavāro guruḥ snigdho balopacayavardhanaḥ/ / guravastarpaṇā vṛṣyāḥ kṣīrekṣurasapūpakāḥ&//
saguḍāḥ satilāścaiva sakṣīrakṣaudraśarkarāḥ/ / bhakṣyā vṛṣyāśca balyāśca paraṃ tu guravaḥ smṛtāḥ//
sasnehāḥ snehasiddhāśca bhakṣyā vividhalakṣaṇāḥ/ / guravastarpaṇā vṛṣyā hṛdyā gaudhūmikā matāḥ//
saṃskārāllaghavaḥ santi bhakṣyā gaudhūmapaiṣṭikāḥ/ / dhānāparpaṭapūpādyāstān buddhvā nirdiśettathā//
pṛthukā guravo &bhṛṣṭān bhakṣayedalpaśastu tān/ / yāvā viṣṭabhya jīryanti sarasā bhinnavarcasaḥ//
sūpyānnavikṛtā bhakṣyā vātalā rūkṣaśītalāḥ/ / sakaṭusnehalavaṇānalpaśo bhakṣayettu tān//
mṛdupākāśca ye bhakṣyāḥ sthūlāśca kaṭhināśca ye/ / guravaste vyatikrāntapākāḥ puṣṭibalapradāḥ//
dravyasaṃyogasaṃskāraṃ dravyamānaṃ pṛthak tathā/ / bhakṣyāṇāmādiśedbuddhvā yathāsvaṃ gurulāghavam//
(&nānādravyaiḥ samāyuktaḥ pakvāmaklinnabharjitaiḥ/ / vimardako gururhṛdyo vṛṣyo balavatāṃ hitaḥ//)
rasālā bṛṃhaṇī vṛṣyā snigdhā balyā rucipradā/ / snehanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ hṛdyaṃ vātaghnaṃ saguḍaṃ dadhi//
drākṣākharjūrakolānāṃ guru viṣṭambhi pānakam/ / parūṣakāṇāṃ kṣaudrasya yaccekṣuvikṛtiṃ prati//
teṣāṃ kaṭvamlasaṃyogān& pānakānāṃ pṛthak pṛthak/ / dravyaṃ mānaṃ ca vijñāya guṇakarmāṇi cādiśet//
kaṭvamlasvādulavaṇā laghavo rāgaṣāḍavāḥ/ / mukhapriyāśca hṛdyāśca dīpanā bhaktarocanāḥ//
āmrāmlakalehāśca bṛṃhaṇā balavardhanāḥ/ / rocanāstarpaṇāścoktāḥ snehamādhuryagauravāt//
buddhvā saṃyogasaṃskāraṃ dravyamānaṃ ca tacchritam/ / guṇakarmāṇi lehānāṃ teṣāṃ teṣāṃ tathā vadet//
raktapittakaphotkledi śuktaṃ vātānulomanam/ / kandamūlaphalādyaṃ ca tadvadvidyāttadāsutam//
śiṇḍākī cāsutaṃ cānyat kālāmlaṃ rocanaṃ laghu/ / vidyādvargaṃ kṛtānnānāmekādaśatamaṃ bhiṣak//
&kaṣāyānurasaṃ svādu sūkṣmamuṣṇaṃ vyavāyi ca/ / pittalaṃ baddhaviṇmūtraṃ na ca śleṣmābhivardhanam//
vātaghneṣūttamaṃ balyaṃ medhāgnivardhanam/ / tailaṃ saṃyogasaṃskārāt sarvarogāpahaṃ matam//
tailaprayogādajarā nirvikārā jitaśramāḥ/ / āsannatibalāḥ saṃkhye daityādhipatayaḥ purā//
airaṇḍatailaṃ madhuraṃ guru śleṣmābhivardhanam/ / vātāsṛgagulmahṛdrogajīrṇajvaraharaṃ param//
kaṭūṣṇaṃ sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ raktapittapradūṣaṇam/ / kaphaśukrānilaharaṃ kaṇḍūkoṭhavināśanam&//
priyālatailaṃ madhuraṃ guru śleṣmābhivardhanam/ / hitamicchanti nātyauṣṇyātsaṃyoge vātapittayoḥ//
ātasyaṃ madhurāmlaṃ tu vipāke kaṭukaṃ tathā/ / uṣṇavīryaṃ hitaṃ vāte raktapittaprakopaṇam//
kusumbhatailamuṣṇaṃ ca vipāke kaṭukaṃ guru/ / vidāhi ca ciśeṣeṇa sarvadoṣaprakopaṇam//
phalānāṃ yāni cānyāni &tailānyāhārasaṃvidhau/ / yujyante guṇakarmabhyāṃ tāni brūyādathāphalam//
madhuro bṛṃhaṇo vṛṣyo balyo majjā tathā vasā/ / yathāsattvaṃ tu śaityoṣṇe vasāmajjñorvinirdiśet//
sasnehaṃ dīpanaṃ vṛṣyamuṣṇaṃ vātakaphāpaham/ / vipāke madhuraṃ hṛdyaṃ rocanaṃ viśvabheṣajam//
śleṣmalā madhurā cārdrā gurvī snigdhā ca pippalī/ / sā śuṣkā kaphavātaghnī kaṭūṣṇā vṛṣyasaṃmatā&//
nātyarthamuṣṇaṃ maricamavṛṣyaṃ laghu rocanam/ / cheditvācchoṣaṇatvācca dīpanaṃ kaphavātajit&//
vātaśleṣmavibandhaghnaṃ kaṭūṣṇaṃ dīpanaṃ laghu/ / hiṅgu śūlapraśamanaṃ vidyāt pācanarocanam//
rocanaṃ dīpanaṃ vṛṣyaṃ cakṣuṣyamavidāhi ca/ / triḍoṣaghnaṃ &samadhuraṃ saindhavaṃ lavaṇottamam//
saukṣmyādauṣṇyāllaghutvācca saugandhyācca rucipradam/ / sauvarcalaṃ vibandhaghnaṃ hṛdyamudgāraśodhi ca//
taikṣṇyādauṣṇyādvyavāyitvāddīpanaṃ śūlanāśanam/ / ūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca vātānāmānulomyakaraṃ biḍam//
satiktakaṭu sakṣāraṃ tīkṣṇamutkledi caudbhidam/ / na kālalavaṇe gandhaḥ sauvarcalaguṇāśca te//
sāmudrakaṃ samadhuraṃ, satiktaṃ kaṭu pāṃśujam/ / rocanaṃ lavaṇaṃ sarvaṃ pāki sraṃsyanilāpaham//
hṛtpāṇḍugrahaṇīrogaplīhānāhagalagrahān/ / kāsaṃ kaphajamarśāṃsi yāvaśūko vyapohati//
tīkṣṇoṣṇo laghurūkṣaśca kledī &paktā vidāraṇaḥ/ / dāhano dīpanaśchettā sarvaḥ &kṣāro 'agnisannibhaḥ//
kāravī kuñcikā 'ajājī yavānī dhānyatumburu/ / rocanaṃ dīpanaṃ vātakaphadaurgandhyanāśanam//
āhārayogināṃ bhaktiniścayo na tu vidyate/ / &samāpto dvādaśaścāyaṃ varga āhārayoginām//
śūladhānyaṃ śamīdhānyaṃ samātītaṃ praśasyate/ / purāṇaṃ prāyaśo rūkṣaṃ prāyeṇābhinavaṃ &guru//
yadyadāgacchati& kṣipraṃ tattallaghutaraṃ smṛtam/ / nistuṣaṃ yuktibhṛṣṭaṃ ca sūpyaṃ laghu vipacayate//
mṛtaṃ kṛśaṃ cātimedyaṃ vṛddhaṃ bālaṃ viṣairhatam/ / agocarabhṛtaṃ vyālasūditaṃ māṃsamutsṛjet//
ato 'anyathā hitaṃ māṃsaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ balavardhanam/ / prīṇanaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hṛdyo māṃsarasaḥ param//
śuṣyatāṃ vyādhimuktānāṃ kṛśānāṃ kṣīṇaretasām/ / balavarṇārthināṃ caiva rasaṃ vidyādyathāmṛtam//
sarvarogapraśamanaṃ yathāsvaṃ vihitaṃ rasam/ / vidyāt svaryaṃ balakaraṃ vayobuddhīndriyāyuṣām//
vyāyāmanityāḥ strīnityā madyanityāśca ye narāḥ/ / nityaṃ māṃsarasāhārā nāturāḥ syurna durbalāḥ//
krimivātātapahataṃ śuṣkaṃ jīrṇamanārtavam/ / śākaṃ niḥsnehasiddhaṃ ca varjyaṃ yaccāparisrutam//
purāṇamāmaṃ saṃkliṣṭaṃ krimivyālahimātapaiḥ/ / adeśakālajaṃ klinnaṃ yatsyātphalamasādhu tat//
&haritānāṃ yathāśākaṃ nirdeśaḥ sādhanādṛte/ / madyāmbugorasādīnāṃ sve sve varge viniścayaḥ//
&yadāhāraguṇaiḥ pānaṃ viparītaṃ tadiṣyate/ / annānupānaṃ dhātūnāṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yanna virodhi ca//
āsavānāṃ samuddiṣṭāmaśītiṃ caturuttarām/ / jalaṃ peyamapeyaṃ ca parīkṣyānupibeddhitam//
&snigdhoṣṇaṃ mārute śastaṃ pitte madhuraśītalam/ / kaphe 'anupānaṃ rūkṣoṣṇaṃ kṣaye māṃsarasaḥ param//
upavāsādhvabhāṣyastrīmārutātapakarmabhiḥ/ / klāntānāmanupānārthaṃ payaḥ pathyaṃ yathā 'amṛtam//
surā kṛśānāṃ puṣṭyarthamanupānaṃ vidhīyate/ / kārśyārthaṃ sthūladehānāmanu śastaṃ madhūdakam//
alpāgnīnāmanidrāṇāṃ tandrāśokabhayaklamaiḥ/ / madyamāṃsocitānāṃ ca madyamevānuśasyate//

&athānupānakarmaguṇān pravakṣyāmaḥ anupānaṃ tarpayati, prīṇayati, ūrjayati, bṛṃhayati, paryāptimabhinirvartayati, bhuktamavasādayati, annasaṅghātaṃ bhinatti, mārdavamāpādayati, kledayati, jarayati, sukhapariṇāmitāmāśuvyavāyitāṃ cāhārasyopajanayatīti //
bhavati cātra / anupānaṃ hitaṃ yuktaṃ tarpayatyāśu mānavam / / sukhaṃ pacati cāhāramāyuṣe ca balāya ca //
karmāpavarge yaccoktaṃ taccāpyanne pratiṣṭhitam / / tatra ślokaḥ / annapānaguṇāḥ sāgryā vargā dvādaśa niścitāḥ //
tatra ślokāḥ / arthe daśamahāmūlāḥ saṃjñā cāsāṃ yathā kṛtā / / ayanāntāḥ ṣaḍagryāśca rūpaṃ vedavidāṃ ca yat //
snehādvātaṃ śamayati, śaityāt pittaṃ niyacchati/ / ghṛtaṃ tulyaguṇaṃ doṣaṃ saṃskārāttu jayet kapham//
nānyaḥ snehastathā kaścit saṃskāramanuvartate/ / yathā sarpirataḥ sarpiḥ sarvasnehottamaṃ matam//
gadyokto yaḥ punaḥ ślokairarthaḥ samanugīyate/ / tadvyaktivyavasāyārthaṃ dviruktaṃ tanna garhyate//
jvaramaṣṭavidhaṃ tasya prakṛṣṭāsannakāraṇam/ / pūrvarūpaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca bheṣajaṃ saṃgraheṇa ca//
vyājahāra jvarasyāgre nidāne vigatajvaraḥ/
virecanaṃ tu pittasya jayārthe paramauṣadham/ / yaśca &tatrānvayaḥ śleṣmā tasya cānadhamaṃ smṛtam//
bhavedyogāvahaṃ tatra &madhuraṃ caiva bheṣajam/ / tasmāt sādhyaṃ mataṃ raktaṃ yadūrdhvaṃ pratipadyate//
raktaṃ tu yadadhobhāgaṃ tadyāpyamiti niścitam/ / vamanasyālpayogitvādalpatvādbheṣajasya ca//
vamanaṃ hi na pittasya &haraṇe śreṣṭhamucyate/ / yaśca &tatrānvayo vāyustacchāntau cāvaraṃ smṛtam//
&taccāyogāvahaṃ tatra kaṣāyaṃ tiktakāni ca/ / tasmādyāpyaṃ samākhyātaṃ &yaduktamanulomagam//
raktapittaṃ tu yanmārgau dvāvapi pratipadyate/ / asādhyamiti tajjñeyaṃ pūrvoktādeva kāraṇāt//
nahi saṃśodhanaṃ kiṃcidastyasya pratimārgagam/ / pratimārgaṃ ca haraṇaṃ raktapitte vidhīyate//
evamevopaśamanaṃ sarvaśo nāsya vidyate/ / saṃsṛṣṭeṣu ca doṣeṣu sarvajicchamanaṃ &matam//
ityuktaṃ trividhodarkaṃ raktaṃ mārgaviśeṣataḥ/ / ebhyastu khalu hetubhyaḥ kiṃcitsādhyaṃ na sidhyati//
preṣyopakaraṇābhāvāaddaurātmyādvaidyadoṣataḥ/ / akarmataśca sādhyatvaṃ kaścidrogo 'ativartate//
tatrāsādhyatvamekaṃ syāt sādhyayāpyaparikramāt/ / raktapittasya vijñānamidaṃ tasyopadiśyate//
yat kṛṣṇamathavā nīlaṃ yadvā śakradhanuṣprabham/ / raktapittamasādhyaṃ tadvāsaso rañjanaṃ ca yat//
bhṛśaṃ pūtyatimātraṃ ca sarvopadravavacca yat/ / balamāṃsakṣaye yacca tacca raktamasiddhimat//
yena copahato raktaṃ raktapittena mānavaḥ/ / paśyeddṛśyaṃ viyaccāpi taccāsādhyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ//
tatrāsādhyaṃ parityājyaṃ, yāpyaṃ yatnena yāpayet/ / sādhyaṃ cāvahitaḥ siddhairbheṣajaiḥ sādhayedbhiṣak//
nidāne raktapittasya vyājahāra punarvasuḥ/ / vītamoharajodoṣalobhamānamadaspṛhaḥ//
acchaṃ bahu sitaṃ śītaṃ nirgandhamudakopamam/ / śleṣmakopānnaro mūtramudamehī pramehati//
atyarthamadhuraṃ śītamīṣatpicchilamāvilam/ / kāṇḍekṣurasasaṅkāśaṃ śleṣmakopāt pramehati//
yasya paryuṣitaṃ mūtraṃ sāndrībhavati bhājane/ / puruṣaṃ kaphakopena tamāhuḥ sāndramehinam//
yasya saṃhanyate mūtraṃ kiṃcit kiṃcit prasīdati/ / sāndraprasādamehīti tamāhuḥ śleṣmakopataḥ//
śuklaṃ piṣṭanibhaṃ mūtramabhīkṣṇaṃ yaḥ pramehati/ / puruṣaṃ kaphakopena tamāhuḥ śuklamehinam//
śukrābhaṃ śukramiśraṃ vā mururmehati yo naraḥ/ / śukramehinamāhustaṃ puruṣaṃ śleṣmakopataḥ//
atyarthamadhuraṃ śītaṃ mūtraṃ mehati yo bhṛśam/ / śītamehinamāhustaṃ puruṣaṃ śleṣmakopataḥ//
mūrtānmūtragatān doṣānaṇūnamehati yo naraḥ/ / sikatāmehinaṃ vidyāttaṃ naraṃ śleṣmakopataḥ//
mandaṃ mandamavegaṃ tu kṛcchraṃ yo mūtrayecchanaiḥ/ / śanairmehinamāhustaṃ puruṣaṃ śleṣmakopataḥ//
tantubaddhamivālālaṃ picchilaṃ yaḥ pramehati/ / ālālamehinaṃ vidyāttaṃ naraṃ śleṣmakopataḥ//
gandhavarṇarasasparśairyathā kṣārastathāvidham/ / pittakopānnaro mūtraṃ kṣāramehī pramehati//
masīvarṇamajasraṃ yo mūtramuṣṇaṃ pramehati/ / pittasya parikopeṇa taṃ vidyāt kālamehinam//
cāṣapakṣanibhaṃ mūtramamlaṃ mehati yo naraḥ/ / pittasya parikopeṇa taṃ vidyānnīlamehinam//
visraṃ lavaṇamuṣṇaṃ ca raktaṃ mehati yo naraḥ/ / pittasya parikopeṇa taṃ vidyādraktamehinam//
mañjiṣṭhodakasaṃkāśaṃ bhṛśaṃ visraṃ pramehati/ / pittasya parikopāttaṃ vidyānmāñjiṣṭhamehinam//
haridrodakasaṅkāśaṃ kaṭukaṃ yaḥ pramehati/ / pittasya parikopāttaṃ vidyāddhāridramehinam//
vasāmiśraṃ vasābhaṃ vā muhurmehati yo naraḥ/ / vasāmehinamāhustamasādhyaṃ vātakopataḥ//
majjānaṃ saha mūtreṇa muhurmehati yo naraḥ/ / majjamehinamāhustamasādhyaṃ vātakopataḥ//
hastī matta ivājasraṃ mūtraṃ kṣarati yo bhṛśam/ / hastimehinamāhustamasādhyaṃ vātakopataḥ//
kaṣāyamadhuraṃ pāṇḍu rūkṣaṃ mehati yo naraḥ/ / vātakopādasādhyaṃ taṃ pratīyānmadhumehinam//
daśa śleṣmakṛtā yasmāt pramehāḥ ṣaṭ ca pittajāḥ/ / yathā ca vāyuścaturaḥ pramehān kurute balī//
sādhyāsādhyaviśeṣāśca pūrvarūpāṇyupadravāḥ/ / pramehāṇāṃ nidāne 'asmin kriyāsūtraṃ ca bhāṣitam//
yastu prāgeva rogebhyo rogeṣu taruṇeṣu vā/ / bheṣajaṃ kurute samyak sa ciraṃ sukhamaśnute//
yathā hyalpena yatnena chidyate taruṇastṣaruḥ/ / sa evātipravṛddhastu chidyate 'atiprayatnataḥ//
evameva vikāro 'api taruṇaḥ sādhyate sukham/ / vivṛddhaḥ sādhyate kṛcchrādasādhyo vā 'api jāyate//
sādhyāṃstu bhiṣajaḥ prājñāḥ sādhyanti samāhitāḥ/ / tīkṣṇaiḥ saṃśodhanaiścaiva yathāsvaṃ śamanairapi//
yadā doṣanimittasya bhavatyāganturanvayaḥ/ / tadā sādhāraṇaṃ karma pravadanti bhiṣagvidaḥ//
sarvarogaviśeṣajñaḥ sarvauṣadhaviśāradaḥ/ / bhiṣak sarvāmayān hanti na ca mohaṃ &nigacchati//
ityetadakhilenoktaṃ nidānasthānamuttamam/ / nidānārthakaro rogo rogasyāpyupalabhyate//
tadyathā---jvarasaṃtāpādraktapittamudīryate/ / raktapittājjvarastābhyāṃ &śoṣaścāpyupajāyate//
plīhābhivṛddhyā jaṭharaṃ jaṭharācchotha eva ca/ / arśobhyo jaṭharaṃ duḥkhaṃ gulmaścāpyupajāyate//
pratiśyāyādbhavet kāsaḥ kāsāt saṃjāyate kṣayaḥ/ / kṣayo rogasya hetutve śoṣasyāpyupalabhyate//
te pūrvaṃ kevalā rogāḥ paścāddhetvarthakāriṇaṃ/ / ubhayārthakarā &dṛṣṭāstathaivaikārthakāriṇaḥ//
kaściddhi rogo rogasya heturbhūtvā praśāmyati/ / na praśāmyati cāpyanyo &hetvarthaṃ kurute 'api ca//
evaṃ kṛcchratamā nYṇāṃ dṛśyante vyādhisaṅkarāḥ/ / prayogāpariśuddhatvāttathā cānyonyasaṃbhavāt//
prayogaḥ śamayedvyādhiṃ yo 'ayamanyamudīrayet/ / nāsau viśuddhaḥ, śuddhastu śamayedyo na kopayet//
eko heturanekasya tathaikasyaika eva hi/ / vyādherekasya cāneko bahūnāṃ bahavo 'api ca//
jvarabhramapralāpādyā dṛśyante rūkṣahetujāḥ/ / rūkṣeṇaikena cāpyeko jvara evopajāyate//
hetubhirbahubhiścaiko jvaro rūkṣādibhirbhavet/ / rūkṣādibhirjvarādyāśca vyādhayaḥ saṃbhavanti hi//
liṅgaṃ caikamanekasya &tathaivaikasya lakṣyate/ / bahūnyekasya ca vyādherbahūnāṃ &syurbahūni ca//
viṣamārambhamūlānāṃ liṅgamekaṃ jvaro mataḥ/ / jvarasyaikasya cāpyekaḥ saṃtāpo liṅgamucyate//
viṣamārambhamūlaiśca jvara eko nirucyate/ / liṅgairetairjvaraśvāsahikkādyāḥ santi cāmayāḥ//
ekā śāntiranekasya &tathaivaikasya lakṣyate/ / vyādherekasya cānekā bahūnāṃ bahvya eva ca//
śāntirāmāśayotthānāṃ vyādhīnāṃ laṅghanakriyā/ / jvarasyaikasya cāpyekā śāntirlaṅghanamucyate//
tathā laghvaśanādyāśca jvarasyaikasya śāntayaḥ/ / etāścaiva jvaraśvāsahikkādīnāṃ praśāntayaḥ//
sukhasādhyaḥ sukhopāyaḥ kālenālpena sādhyate/ / sādhyate kṛcchrasādhyastu yatnena mahatā cirāt//
yāti nāśeṣatāṃ vyādhirasādhyo yāpyasaṃjñītaḥ/ / paro 'asādhyaḥ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ pratyākhyeyo 'ativartate//
nāsādhyaḥ sādhyatāṃ yāti sādhyo yāti tvasādhyatām/ / pādāpacārāddaivādvā yānti bhāvāntaraṃ gadāḥ//
vṛddhisthānakṣayāvasthāṃ &rogāṇāmupalakṣayet/ / susūkṣmāmapi ca prājño dehāgnibalacetasām//
vyādhyavasthāviśeṣān hi jñātvā jñātvā vicakṣaṇaḥ/ / tasyāṃ tasyāmavasthāyāṃ &catuḥśreyaḥ prapadyate//
prāyastiryaggatā doṣāḥ kleśayantyāturāṃściram/ / &teṣu na tvarayā kuryāddehāgnibalavit kriyām//
prayogaiḥ kṣapayedvā tān sukhaṃ vā koṣṭhamānayet/ / jñātvā koṣṭhaprapannāṃstān &yathāsannaṃ haredbudhaḥ//
jñānārthaṃ yāni coktāni vyādhiliṅgāni saṃgrahe/ / vyādhayaste tadātve tu liṅgānīṣṭāni nāmayāḥ//
vikāraḥ prakṛtiścaiva dvayaṃ sarvaṃ samāsataḥ/ / taddhetuvaśagaṃ hetorabhāvānnānuvartate//
jvarādīnāṃ vikārāṇāmaṣṭānāṃ sādhyatā na ca/ / pṛthagekaikaśaścoktā hetuliṅgopaśāntayaḥ//
hetuparyāyanāmāni vyādhīnāṃ lakṣaṇasya ca/ / nidānasthānametāvat saṃgraheṇopadiśyate//
āhārāyatanānyaṣṭau bhojyasādguṇyameva ca/ / vimāne rasasaṃkhyāte sarvametat prakāśitam//
aśitaṃ khāditaṃ pītaṃ līḍhaṃ ca kva vipacyate/ / etattvāṃ dhīra pṛcchāmastanna ācakṣva buddhiman//
ityagniveśapramukhaiḥ śiṣyaiḥ pṛṣṭaḥ punarvasuḥ/ / ācacakṣe tatastebhyo yatrāhāro vipacyate//
nābhistanāntaraṃ jantorāmāśaya iti smṛtaḥ/ / aśitaṃ khāditaṃ pītaṃ līḍhaṃ cātra vipacyate//
āmāśayagataḥ pākamāhāraḥ prāpya kevalam/ / pakvaḥ sarvāśayaṃ paścāddhamanībhiḥ prapadyate//
vātājjalaṃ jalāddeśaṃ deśāt kālaṃ svabhāvataḥ/ / *vidyādduṣparihāryatvādgarīyastaramarthavit//
vāyvādiṣu yathoktānāṃ koṣāṇāṃ tu viśeṣavit/ / pratīkārasya saukarye nidyāllāghavalakṣaṇam//
caturṣvapi tu duṣṭeṣu kālānteṣu yadā narāḥ/ / bheṣajenopapādyante na bhavantyāturāstadā//
yeṣāṃ na mṛtyusāmānyaṃ sāmānyaṃ na ca karmaṇām/ / karma pañcavidhaṃ teṣāṃ bheṣajaṃ paramucyate//
rasāyanānāṃ vidhivaccopayogaḥ praśasyate/ / śasyate dehavṛttiśca bheṣajaiḥ pūrṛvamuddhṛtaiḥ//
satyaṃ bhūte dayā dānaṃ balayo devatārcanam/ / sadvṛttasyānuvṛttiśca praśamo guptirātmanaḥ//
hitaṃ janapadānāṃ ca śivānāmupasevanam/ / sevanaṃ brahmacaryasya tathaiva brahmacāriṇām//
saṃkathā dharmaśāstrāṇāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ jitātmanām/ / dhārmikaiḥ sāttvikairnityaṃ sahāsyā vṛddhasaṃmataiḥ//
ityetadbheṣajaṃ proktamāyuṣaḥ paripālanam/ / yeṣāmaniyato mṛtyustasmin kāle sudāruṇe//
saṃvatsaraśate pūrṇe yāti saṃvatsaraḥ kṣayam/ / dehināmāyuṣaḥ kāle yatra yanmānamiṣyate//
daivamātmakṛtaṃ vidyāt karma yati paurvadaihikam/ / smṛtaḥ puruṣakārastu kriyate yadihāparam//
balābalaviśeṣo 'asthi tayorapi ca karmaṇoḥ/ / dṛṣṭaṃ hi trividhaṃ karma hīnaṃ madhyamamuttamam//
tayorudārayoryuktirdīrghasya ca sukhasya ca/ / niyatasyāyuṣo heturviparītasya cetarā//
madhyamā madhyamasyeṣṭā kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu cāparam/ / daivaṃ puruṣakāreṇa durbalaṃ hyupahanyate//
daivena cetarat karma viśiṣṭenopahanyate/ / dṛṣṭvā yadeke manyante niyataṃ mānamāyuṣaḥ//
karma kiṃcit kvacit kāle vipāke niyataṃ mahat/ / kiṃcittvakālaniyataṃ pratyayaiḥ pratibodhyate//
(alpodakadrumo yastu pravātaḥ pracurātapaḥ/ / jñeyaḥ sa jāṅgalo deśaḥ svalparogatamo 'api ca//
pracurodakavṛkṣo yo nivāto durlabhātapaḥ/ / anūpo bahudoṣaśca, samaḥ sādhāraṇo mataḥ//)
prāgvikārasamutpattirāyuṣaśca kṣayakramaḥ/ / maraṇaṃ prati bhūtānāṃ kālākālaviniścayaḥ//
yathā cākālamaraṇaṃ yathāyuktaṃ ca bheṣajam/ / siddhiṃ yātyauṣadhaṃ yeṣāṃ na kuryādyena hetunā//
tadātreyo 'agniveśāya nikhilaṃ sarvamuktavān/ / deśoddhvaṃsanimittīye vimāne munisattamaḥ//
sarvathā sarvamālocya yathāsaṃbhavamarthavit/ / athādhyavasyettattve ca kārye ca tadanantaram//
kāryatattvaviśeṣajñaḥ pratipattau na muhyati/ / amūḍhaḥ phalamāpnoti yadamohanimittajam//
jñānabuddhipradīpena yo nāviśati *tattvavit/ / āturasyāntarātmānaṃ na sa rogāṃścikitsati//
ye yathā cānumānena jñeyāstāṃścāpyudāradhīḥ/ / bhāvāṃstrirogavijñāne vimāne muniruktavān//
auṣṇyādāmādbhayāt pānādatiśuṣkānnasevanāt/ / ambuvāhīni duṣyanti tṛṣṇāyāścātipīḍanāt//
atimātrasya cākāle cāhitasya ca bhojanāt/ / annavāhīni duṣyanti vaiguṇyāt pāvakasya ca//
guruśītamatisnigdhamatimātraṃ samaśnatām/ / rasavāhīni duṣyanti cintyānāṃ cāticintanāt//
vidāhīnyannapānāni snigdhoṣṇāni dravāṇi ca/ / raktavāhīni duṣyanti bhajatāṃ cātapānalau//
abhiṣyandīni bhojyāni sthūlāni ca gurūṇi ca/ / māṃsavāhīni duṣyanti bhuktvā ca svapatāṃ divā//
avyāyāmāddivāsvapnānmedyānāṃ cātibhakṣaṇāt/ / midovāhīni duṣyanti vāruṇyāścātisevanāt//
vyāyāmādatisaṃkṣobhādasthnāmativighaṭṭanāt/ / asthivāhīni duṣyanti vātalānāṃ ca sevanāt//
utpeṣādatyabhiṣyandādabhighātāt prapīḍanāt/ / majjavāhīni duṣyanti viruddhānāṃ ca sevanāt//
akālayonigamanānnigrahādatimaithunāt/ / śukravāhīni duṣyanti śastrakṣārāgnibhistathā//
mūtritodakabhakṣyastrīsevanānmūtranigrahāt/ / mūtravāhīni duṣyanti *kṣīṇasyābhikṣatasya ca//
saṃdhāraṇādatyaśanādajīrṇādhyaśanāttathā/ / varcovāhīni duṣyanti durbalāgneḥ kṛśasya ca//
